name: DescriptiveComplexity.realize_paramTerm
statement:
theorem realize_paramTerm {β : Type} (ρ : B.withParam.Assignment N) (c : N)
    (v : β → N) (t : (((newLang L).sum Language.order).sum B.lang).Term β) :
    letI
proof:
:= (B.withParam.structure₁ (L := L.sum Language.order) ρ)
    letI := @SOBlock.structure₁ ((newLang L).sum Language.order) B N
      (@sumOrderStructure (newLang L) N (markOne L c) _) (B.atParam ρ c)
    (paramTerm B t).realize v = t.realize v := by
  match t with
  | .var _ => rfl
  | .func f _ => exact isEmptyElim f

/
extended block, the substituted formula says what the original said in the
instance whose mark is the parameter, at that assignment read at the
parameter. -/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.realize_paramLift
statement:
theorem realize_paramLift (ρ : B.withParam.Assignment N) (v : α → N) :
    ∀ {n : ℕ} (φ : (((newLang L).sum Language.order).sum B.lang).BoundedFormula α n)
      (xs : Fin n → N),
      letI
proof:
:= (B.withParam.structure₁ (L := L.sum Language.order) ρ)
      letI := @SOBlock.structure₁ ((newLang L).sum Language.order) B N
        (@sumOrderStructure (newLang L) N (markOne L (v p)) _) (B.atParam ρ (v p))
      ((paramLift B p φ).Realize v xs ↔ φ.Realize v xs) := by
  let := (B.withParam.structure₁ (L := L.sum Language.order) ρ)
  let := @SOBlock.structure₁ ((newLang L).sum Language.order) B N
    (@sumOrderStructure (newLang L) N (markOne L (v p)) _) (B.atParam ρ (v p))
  intro n φ
  induction φ with
  | falsum => exact fun _ => Iff.rfl
  | equal t₁ t₂ =>
    intro xs
    change ((paramTerm B t₁).realize _ = (paramTerm B t₂).realize _) ↔ _
    rw [realize_paramTerm ρ (v p) _ t₁, realize_paramTerm ρ (v p) _ t₂]
    exact Iff.rfl
  | @rel _ l r ts =>
    intro xs
    have hts : ∀ i, (paramTerm B (ts i)).realize (Sum.elim v xs) =
        (ts i).realize (Sum.elim v xs) := fun i => realize_paramTerm ρ (v p) _ (ts i)
    match l, r with
    | _, Sum.inl (Sum.inl (Sum.inl s)) =>
      change (@RelMap ((L.sum Language.order).sum B.withParam.lang) N _ _
        (Sum.inl (Sum.inl s)) fun i => (paramTerm B (ts i)).realize (Sum.elim v xs)) ↔ _
      rw [funext hts]
      exact Iff.rfl
    | _, Sum.inl (Sum.inl (Sum.inr .old)) =>
      change ((paramTerm B (ts 0)).realize (Sum.elim v xs) =
        (Term.var (Sum.inl p) : ((L.sum Language.order).sum
          B.withParam.lang).Term _).realize (Sum.elim v xs)) ↔ _
      rw [hts 0]
      exact Iff.rfl
    | _, Sum.inl (Sum.inr .le) =>
      change (@RelMap ((L.sum Language.order).sum B.withParam.lang) N _ _
        (Sum.inl (Sum.inr Language.orderRel.le))
        fun i => (paramTerm B (ts i)).realize (Sum.elim v xs)) ↔ _
      rw [funext hts]
      exact Iff.rfl
    | _, Sum.inr b =>
      set w : Fin _ → N := fun j =>
        ((Fin.cons (Term.var (Sum.inl p)) fun i => paramTerm B (ts i) : Fin _ →
          ((L.sum Language.order).sum B.withParam.lang).Term _) j).realize
            (Sum.elim v xs) with hwdef
      have hw0 : w 0 = v p := by
        rw [hwdef]
        simp only [Fin.cons_zero, Term.realize_var, Sum.elim_inl]
      have hwsucc : ∀ i, w i.succ = (ts i).realize (Sum.elim v xs) := by
        intro i
        rw [hwdef]
        simp only [Fin.cons_succ]
        exact hts i
      change (@RelMap ((L.sum Language.order).sum B.withParam.lang) N _ _
          (Sum.inr (B.paramSym b)) w) ↔
        (@RelMap (((newLang L).sum Language.order).sum B.lang) N _ _ (Sum.inr b)
          fun i => (ts i).realize (Sum.elim v xs))
      rw [← funext hwsucc]
      exact SOBlock.relMap_paramSym B ρ (v p) b w hw0
  | imp φ ψ ihφ ihψ =>
    intro xs
    exact Iff.trans BoundedFormula.realize_imp
      (Iff.trans (imp_congr (ihφ xs) (ihψ xs)) BoundedFormula.realize_imp.symm)
  | all φ ih =>
    intro xs
    refine Iff.trans BoundedFormula.realize_all (Iff.trans ?_ BoundedFormula.realize_all.symm)
    exact forall_congr' fun x => ih (Fin.snoc xs x)

name: DescriptiveComplexity.StepDef.next_param
statement:
theorem next_param (ρ : d.param.B.Assignment N) (c : N) :
    d.B.atParam (d.param.next ρ) c = @StepDef.next _ d N (markOneOrd L c) (d.B.atParam ρ c)
proof:
:= by
  funext i x
  let := markOneOrd L c
  let := @SOBlock.structure₁ ((newLang L).sum Language.order) d.B N (markOneOrd L c)
    (d.B.atParam ρ c)
  let := d.param.B.structure₁ (L := L.sum Language.order) ρ
  have hcomp : ((Fin.cons c x : Fin (d.B.arity i + 1) → N) ∘ Fin.succ) = x := by
    funext j
    simp
  have h := realize_paramLift (B := d.B) (p := (0 : Fin (d.B.arity i + 1))) ρ (Fin.cons c x)
    ((d.step i).relabel Fin.succ) (default : Fin 0 → N)
  refine propext (Iff.trans h ?_)
  refine Iff.trans Formula.realize_relabel ?_
  rw [hcomp]
  exact Iff.rfl

/
parameter. -/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.StepDef.inflStep_param
proof:
:= by
  funext i x
  exact congrArg (Or (d.B.atParam ρ c i x)) (congrFun (congrFun (next_param (d := d) ρ c) i) x)

/
instances side by side.** -/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.StepDef.inflStage_param
proof:
:= by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero => exact d.B.atParam_bot c
  | succ k ih =>
    have hstep : d.param.inflStage N (k + 1) = d.param.inflStep (d.param.inflStage N k) :=
      d.param.inflStage_succ k
    have hstepd : @StepDef.inflStage _ d N (markOneOrd L c) (k + 1) =
        @StepDef.inflStep _ d N (markOneOrd L c) (@StepDef.inflStage _ d N (markOneOrd L c) k) :=
      @StepDef.inflStage_succ _ d N (markOneOrd L c) k
    rw [hstep, hstepd, ← ih]
    exact inflStep_param (d := d) (d.param.inflStage N k) c

/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.StepDef.inflLimit_param
statement:
theorem inflLimit_param (c : N) :
    d.B.atParam (d.param.inflLimit N) c = @StepDef.inflLimit _ d N (markOneOrd L c)
proof:
:= by
  funext i x
  exact propext (exists_congr fun k =>
    iff_of_eq (congrFun (congrFun (inflStage_param (d := d) c k) i) x))

/
element of the instance. -/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.StepDef.ifpHolds_param
statement:
theorem ifpHolds_param :
    d.param.IFPHolds N ↔ ∃ c : N, @StepDef.IFPHolds _ d N (markOneOrd L c)
proof:
:= by
  let := d.param.B.structure₁ (L := L.sum Language.order) (d.param.inflLimit N)
  have hcongr : ∀ (c : N) (σ τ : d.B.Assignment N), σ = τ →
      (@Sentence.Realize _ N (@SOBlock.structure₁ ((newLang L).sum Language.order) d.B N
          (markOneOrd L c) σ) d.out ↔
        @Sentence.Realize _ N (@SOBlock.structure₁ ((newLang L).sum Language.order) d.B N
          (markOneOrd L c) τ) d.out) := by
    rintro c σ τ rfl
    exact Iff.rfl
  refine Iff.trans Formula.realize_iExs ?_
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨w, hw⟩
    refine ⟨w 0, ?_⟩
    let := markOneOrd L (w 0)
    let := @SOBlock.structure₁ ((newLang L).sum Language.order) d.B N (markOneOrd L (w 0))
      (d.B.atParam (d.param.inflLimit N) (w 0))
    have h := (realize_paramLift (B := d.B) (p := (Sum.inr 0 : Empty ⊕ Fin 1))
      (d.param.inflLimit N) (Sum.elim default w) (d.out.relabel Sum.inl)
      (default : Fin 0 → N)).mp hw
    have h2 := Formula.realize_relabel.mp h
    exact (hcongr (w 0) _ _ (inflLimit_param (d := d) (w 0))).mp h2
  · rintro ⟨c, hc⟩
    refine ⟨fun _ => c, ?_⟩
    let := markOneOrd L c
    let := @SOBlock.structure₁ ((newLang L).sum Language.order) d.B N (markOneOrd L c)
      (d.B.atParam (d.param.inflLimit N) c)
    refine (realize_paramLift (B := d.B) (p := (Sum.inr 0 : Empty ⊕ Fin 1))
      (d.param.inflLimit N) (Sum.elim default fun _ => c) (d.out.relabel Sum.inl)
      (default : Fin 0 → N)).mpr ?_
    refine Formula.realize_relabel.mpr ?_
    exact (hcongr c _ _ (inflLimit_param (d := d) c)).mpr hc

name: DescriptiveComplexity.IFPDefinable.exElement
statement:
theorem IFPDefinable.exElement (hR : IFPDefinable R)
    (h : ∀ (N : Type) [L.Structure N] [Finite N] [Nonempty N],
      P N ↔ ∃ c : N, @DecisionProblem.Holds (newLang L) _ R N (markOne L c)) :
    IFPDefinable P
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := hR
  refine ⟨d.param, fun N _ _ _ _ => ?_⟩
  rw [h N, StepDef.ifpHolds_param]
  exact exists_congr fun c => @hd N (markOne L c) _ _ _

/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.mem_PTIME_exElement
statement:
theorem mem_PTIME_exElement (hR : R ∈ PTIME)
    (h : ∀ (N : Type) [L.Structure N] [Finite N] [Nonempty N],
      P N ↔ ∃ c : N, @DecisionProblem.Holds (newLang L) _ R N (markOne L c)) :
    P ∈ PTIME
proof:
:=
  (ifpDefinable_iff_mem_PTIME P).mp
    (IFPDefinable.exElement ((ifpDefinable_iff_mem_PTIME R).mpr hR) h)

name: DescriptiveComplexity.StepDef.PFPHolds.converges
statement:
theorem PFPHolds.converges {d : StepDef L} {A : Type} [L.Structure A]
    (h : d.PFPHolds A) : d.PFPConverges A
proof:
:=
  ⟨h.choose, h.choose_spec.1⟩

name: DescriptiveComplexity.StepDef.exists_least_stable
statement:
theorem exists_least_stable (d : StepDef L) (A : Type) [L.Structure A]
    (h : d.PFPConverges A) :
    ∃ N, d.partStage A N = d.partStage A (N + 1) ∧
      ∀ n, n < N → d.partStage A n ≠ d.partStage A (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hex : ∃ n, d.partStage A n = d.partStage A (n + 1) := by
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := h
    exact ⟨n, by rw [d.partStage_succ, hn]⟩
  exact ⟨Nat.find hex, Nat.find_spec hex, fun n hn => Nat.find_min hex hn⟩

name: DescriptiveComplexity.StepDef.realize_pfpValue_iff
statement:
theorem realize_pfpValue_iff (d : StepDef L) (A : Type) [L.Structure A] :
    (@Sentence.Realize _ A (d.B.structure₁ (L := L) (d.pfpValue A)) d.out) ↔
      d.PFPHolds A ∨ (¬d.PFPConverges A ∧
        @Sentence.Realize _ A (d.B.structure₁ (L := L) (d.B.botAssign A)) d.out)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : d.PFPConverges A
  · rw [pfpValue, dite_eq_left h]
    constructor
    · intro hout
      exact Or.inl ⟨h.choose, h.choose_spec, hout⟩
    · rintro (⟨n, hn, hout⟩ | ⟨hdiv, -⟩)
      · rwa [d.partStage_eq_of_isFixedPt h.choose_spec hn]
      · exact absurd h hdiv
  · rw [pfpValue, dite_eq_right h]
    constructor
    · intro hout
      exact Or.inr ⟨h, hout⟩
    · rintro (⟨n, hn, -⟩ | ⟨-, hout⟩)
      · exact absurd ⟨n, hn⟩ h
      · exact hout

/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.StepDef.pfpHolds_equiv
statement:
theorem pfpHolds_equiv (d : StepDef L) {M N : Type} [L.Structure M] [L.Structure N]
    (e : M ≃[L] N) : d.PFPHolds M ↔ d.PFPHolds N
proof:
:= by
  refine exists_congr fun n => ?_
  rw [d.partStage_map e n]
  refine and_congr (d.isFixedPt_next_map_iff e _).symm ?_
  exact realize_sentence_of_equiv
    (d.B.extendEquiv' (L' := L) e (d.partStage M n)) d.out

name: DescriptiveComplexity.pfpDefinableFree_congr
proof:
:= by
  constructor <;> rintro ⟨d, hd⟩ <;> refine ⟨d, ?_⟩ <;> intro A _ _ _
  · exact (h A).symm.trans (hd A)
  · exact (h A).trans (hd A)

problem.

name: DescriptiveComplexity.pfpDefinable_congr
proof:
:= by
  constructor <;> rintro ⟨d, hd⟩ <;> refine ⟨d, ?_⟩ <;> intro A _ _ _ _
  · exact (h A).symm.trans (hd A)

/-! ### Closure under reductions -/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.PFPDefinableFree.of_foReduction
statement:
theorem PFPDefinableFree.of_foReduction (f : P ≤ᶠᵒ Q) (h : PFPDefinableFree Q) :
    PFPDefinableFree P
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := h
  let := f.tagFinite
  let := f.tagNonempty
  refine ⟨d.pull f.toInterpretation, ?_⟩
  intro A _ _ _
  have := f.toInterpretation.map_finite A
  have := f.toInterpretation.map_nonempty A
  refine (f.correct A).trans ((hd (f.toInterpretation.Map A)).trans ?_)
  rw [StepDef.PFPHolds, StepDef.PFPHolds]
  refine exists_congr fun n => ?_
  rw [StepDef.partStage_pull f.toInterpretation d A n]
  refine and_congr (StepDef.isFixedPt_next_pull_iff f.toInterpretation d _).symm ?_
  let := (d.B.pull f.Tag f.dim).structure
    (d.B.pullAssign (d.partStage (f.toInterpretation.Map A) n))
  have htrans := realize_sentence_of_equiv
    (f.toInterpretation.extendSOEquiv d.B A (d.partStage (f.toInterpretation.Map A) n))
    d.out
  have hpull := (f.toInterpretation.extendSO d.B).realize_pullSentence d.out A
  exact (hpull.trans htrans).symm

/
reductions**, by the same route as for IFP
(`DescriptiveComplexity.IFPDefinable.of_orderedReduction`), stage by
stage.
Registered in the Lax archive as
[`Lax134656.PartialFixedPointClosure.pfpDefinable_of_orderedReduction`](https://laxarchive.org/lax-134656/Lax134656.PartialFixedPointClosure.html#s-Lax134656.PartialFixedPointClosure.pfpDefinable_of_orderedReduction). -/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.PFPDefinable.of_orderedReduction
statement:
theorem PFPDefinable.of_orderedReduction (f : P ≤ᶠᵒ[≤] Q) (h : PFPDefinable Q) :
    PFPDefinable P
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := h
  let := f.tagFinite
  let := f.tagNonempty
  let : LinearOrder f.Tag := finiteLinearOrder f.Tag
  refine ⟨d.pull f.toInterpretation.ordExtend, ?_⟩
  intro A _ _ _ _
  let := f.toInterpretation.mapLinearOrder A
  have := f.toInterpretation.map_finite A
  have := f.toInterpretation.map_nonempty A
  refine (f.correct A).trans ((hd (f.toInterpretation.Map A)).trans ?_)
  rw [StepDef.PFPHolds, StepDef.PFPHolds]
  refine exists_congr fun n => ?_
  rw [d.partStage_map (f.toInterpretation.ordExtendLEquiv A) n,
    StepDef.partStage_pull f.toInterpretation.ordExtend d A n]
  refine and_congr ((d.isFixedPt_next_map_iff (f.toInterpretation.ordExtendLEquiv A)
    _).trans (StepDef.isFixedPt_next_pull_iff f.toInterpretation.ordExtend d _).symm) ?_
  let := (d.B.pull f.Tag f.dim).structure
    (d.B.pullAssign (d.partStage (f.toInterpretation.ordExtend.Map A) n))
  have e₁ := f.toInterpretation.ordExtend.extendSOEquiv d.B A
    (d.partStage (f.toInterpretation.ordExtend.Map A) n)
  have e₂ := d.B.extendEquiv (f.toInterpretation.ordExtendLEquiv A)
    (d.partStage (f.toInterpretation.ordExtend.Map A) n)
  let : ((L₂.sum Language.order).sum d.B.lang).Structure
      ((f.toInterpretation.ordExtend.extendSO d.B).Map A) :=
    FOInterpretation.mapStructure (f.toInterpretation.ordExtend.extendSO d.B) A
  let : ((L₂.sum Language.order).sum d.B.lang).Structure
      (f.toInterpretation.ordExtend.Map A) :=
    @sumStructure (L₂.sum Language.order) d.B.lang (f.toInterpretation.ordExtend.Map A)
      (FOInterpretation.mapStructure f.toInterpretation.ordExtend A)
      (d.B.structure (d.partStage (f.toInterpretation.ordExtend.Map A) n))
  let : ((L₂.sum Language.order).sum d.B.lang).Structure (f.toInterpretation.Map A) :=
    @sumStructure (L₂.sum Language.order) d.B.lang (f.toInterpretation.Map A) _
      (d.B.structure (d.B.mapAssign (f.toInterpretation.ordExtendLEquiv A).toEquiv
        (d.partStage (f.toInterpretation.ordExtend.Map A) n)))
  have hout := StrongHomClass.realize_sentence
    (L := (L₂.sum Language.order).sum d.B.lang) (e₂.comp e₁) d.out
  have hpull := (f.toInterpretation.ordExtend.extendSO d.B).realize_pullSentence d.out A
  exact hout.symm.trans hpull.symm

/
which are in particular ordered ones.
Registered in the Lax archive as
[`Lax134656.PartialFixedPointClosure.pfpDefinable_of_foReduction`](https://laxarchive.org/lax-134656/Lax134656.PartialFixedPointClosure.html#s-Lax134656.PartialFixedPointClosure.pfpDefinable_of_foReduction). -/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.PFPDefinable.of_foReduction
statement:
theorem PFPDefinable.of_foReduction (f : P ≤ᶠᵒ Q) (h : PFPDefinable Q) :
    PFPDefinable P
proof:
:=
  h.of_orderedReduction f.toOrdered

name: DescriptiveComplexity.StepDef.next_inflate
statement:
theorem StepDef.next_inflate (d : StepDef L) {A : Type} [L.Structure A]
    (ρ : d.B.Assignment A) : d.inflate.next ρ = d.inflStep ρ
proof:
:= by
  funext i x
  exact propext (realize_inflate_step d ρ i x)

/
of the original. -/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.StepDef.partStage_inflate
statement:
theorem StepDef.partStage_inflate (d : StepDef L) (A : Type) [L.Structure A] (n : ℕ) :
    d.inflate.partStage A n = d.inflStage A n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih => rw [d.inflate.partStage_succ, d.inflStage_succ, ih, d.next_inflate]

/
inflationary limit, so its partial value is the inflationary value. -/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.StepDef.pfpHolds_inflate
statement:
theorem StepDef.pfpHolds_inflate (d : StepDef L) (A : Type) [L.Structure A]
    [Finite A] : d.inflate.PFPHolds A ↔ d.IFPHolds A
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨n, hn, hout⟩
    rw [d.partStage_inflate A n] at hn hout
    have hfix : IsFixedPt d.inflStep (d.inflStage A n) :=
      (d.next_inflate (d.inflStage A n)).symm.trans hn
    have hlim : d.inflLimit A = d.inflStage A n := by
      funext i x
      refine propext ⟨?_, fun h => ⟨n, h⟩⟩
      rintro ⟨m, hm⟩
      rcases le_total m n with hle | hle
      · exact d.inflStage_le_of_le hle i x hm
      · have hst : d.inflStage A m = d.inflStage A n :=
          iterate_eq_of_isFixedPt hfix hle
        rwa [hst] at hm
    rw [StepDef.IFPHolds, hlim]
    exact hout
  · intro hout
    refine ⟨Nat.card (BAtom d.B A), ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [d.partStage_inflate A]
      exact (d.next_inflate _).trans (d.isFixedPt_inflStep_card A)
    · rw [d.partStage_inflate A, ← d.inflLimit_eq_stage_card A]
      exact hout

/
induction. The easy inclusion of the Abiteboul–Vianu theorem.
Registered in the Lax archive as
[`Lax134656.InflationaryInPartial.ifpDefinableFree_pfpDefinableFree`](https://laxarchive.org/lax-134656/Lax134656.InflationaryInPartial.html#s-Lax134656.InflationaryInPartial.ifpDefinableFree_pfpDefinableFree). -/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.IFPDefinableFree.pfpDefinableFree
statement:
theorem IFPDefinableFree.pfpDefinableFree [L.IsRelational] {P : DecisionProblem L}
    (h : IFPDefinableFree P) : PFPDefinableFree P
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := h
  refine ⟨d.inflate, ?_⟩
  intro A _ _ _
  exact (hd A).trans (d.pfpHolds_inflate A).symm

[`Lax134656.InflationaryInPartial.ifpDefinable_pfpDefinable`](https://laxarchive.org/lax-134656/Lax134656.InflationaryInPartial.html#s-Lax134656.InflationaryInPartial.ifpDefinable_pfpDefinable). -/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.IFPDefinable.pfpDefinable
statement:
theorem IFPDefinable.pfpDefinable [L.IsRelational] {P : DecisionProblem L}
    (h : IFPDefinable P) : PFPDefinable P
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := h
  refine ⟨d.inflate, ?_⟩
  intro A _ _ _ _
  exact (hd A).trans (d.pfpHolds_inflate A).symm

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SpaceTM.realize_markMeetF
statement:
@[simp]
theorem realize_markMeetF (s r : L'.Relations 1) :
    (markMeetF (γ := γ) s r).Realize v ↔ ∃ q : M, RelMap s ![q] ∧ RelMap r ![q]
proof:
:= by
  rw [markMeetF]
  simp only [Formula.realize_iExs, Formula.realize_inf, Formula.realize_rel₁,
    Term.realize_var, Sum.elim_inr]
  exact ⟨fun ⟨i, hi⟩ => ⟨i 0, hi⟩, fun ⟨q, hq⟩ => ⟨fun _ => q, hq⟩⟩

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SpaceTM.realize_someArgF
statement:
@[simp]
theorem realize_someArgF (r : L'.Relations 2) (x : γ) :
    (someArgF r x).Realize v ↔ ∃ b : M, RelMap r ![v x, b]
proof:
:= by
  rw [someArgF]
  simp only [Formula.realize_iExs, Formula.realize_rel₂, Term.realize_var, Sum.elim_inl,
    Sum.elim_inr]
  exact ⟨fun ⟨i, hi⟩ => ⟨i 0, hi⟩, fun ⟨b, hb⟩ => ⟨fun _ => b, hb⟩⟩

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SpaceTM.realize_applF
statement:
@[simp]
theorem realize_applF (tr : L'.Relations 1) (src rd : L'.Relations 2)
    (s h : L'.Relations 1) (t : L'.Relations 2) (τ : γ) :
    (applF tr src rd s h t τ).Realize v ↔
      (RelMap tr ![v τ] ∧
        ((∀ q : M, RelMap s ![q] → RelMap src ![v τ, q]) ∧
          ∀ p a : M, RelMap h ![p] → RelMap t ![p, a] →
            RelMap rd ![v τ, a]))
proof:
:= by
  rw [applF]
  simp only [Formula.realize_inf, Formula.realize_rel₁, realize_markArgF,
    realize_cellArgF, Term.realize_var]

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SpaceTM.realize_moveToF
statement:
@[simp]
theorem realize_moveToF (right : L'.Relations 1) (le : L'.Relations 2)
    (posn h : L'.Relations 1) (τ p' : γ) :
    (moveToF right le posn h τ p').Realize v ↔
      ∃ p : M, RelMap h ![p] ∧
        ((RelMap right ![v τ] ∧
            SuccPos (fun a b => RelMap le ![a, b]) (fun a => RelMap posn ![a]) p
              (v p')) ∨
          (¬RelMap right ![v τ] ∧
            SuccPos (fun a b => RelMap le ![a, b]) (fun a => RelMap posn ![a])
              (v p') p))
proof:
:= by
  rw [moveToF]
  simp only [Formula.realize_iExs, Formula.realize_inf, Formula.realize_sup,
    Formula.realize_not, Formula.realize_rel₁, realize_succPosF, Term.realize_var,
    Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr]
  exact ⟨fun ⟨i, hi⟩ => ⟨i 0, hi⟩, fun ⟨p, hp⟩ => ⟨fun _ => p, hp⟩⟩

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SpaceTM.realize_goF
statement:
@[simp]
theorem realize_goF (tr : L'.Relations 1) (src rd dst wr : L'.Relations 2)
    (s h : L'.Relations 1) (t : L'.Relations 2) (acc right : L'.Relations 1)
    (le : L'.Relations 2) (posn : L'.Relations 1) :
    (goF (γ := γ) tr src rd dst wr s h t acc right le posn).Realize v ↔
      ((¬∃ q : M, RelMap s ![q] ∧ RelMap acc ![q]) ∧
        ∃ τ p' : M,
          ((RelMap tr ![τ] ∧
              ((∀ q : M, RelMap s ![q] → RelMap src ![τ, q]) ∧
                ∀ p a : M, RelMap h ![p] → RelMap t ![p, a] → RelMap rd ![τ, a])) ∧
            ((∃ b : M, RelMap dst ![τ, b]) ∧
              ((∃ b : M, RelMap wr ![τ, b]) ∧
                ∃ p : M, RelMap h ![p] ∧
                  ((RelMap right ![τ] ∧
                      SuccPos (fun a b => RelMap le ![a, b])
                        (fun a => RelMap posn ![a]) p p') ∨
                    (¬RelMap right ![τ] ∧
                      SuccPos (fun a b => RelMap le ![a, b])
                        (fun a => RelMap posn ![a]) p' p))))))
proof:
:= by
  rw [goF]
  simp only [Formula.realize_inf, Formula.realize_not, realize_markMeetF,
    Formula.realize_iExs, realize_applF, realize_someArgF, realize_moveToF, Sum.elim_inr]
  refine and_congr Iff.rfl
    ⟨fun ⟨i, hi⟩ => ⟨i 0, i 1, hi⟩, fun ⟨τ, p', hp⟩ => ⟨![τ, p'], hp⟩⟩

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SpaceTM.realize_initTapeAtF
statement:
@[simp]
theorem realize_initTapeAtF (inp : L'.Relations 2) (blank : L'.Relations 1)
    (x y : γ) :
    (initTapeAtF inp blank x y).Realize v ↔
      (RelMap inp ![v x, v y] ∨
        ((∀ b : M, ¬RelMap inp ![v x, b]) ∧
          RelMap blank ![v y]))
proof:
:= by
  rw [initTapeAtF]
  simp only [Formula.realize_sup, Formula.realize_inf, Formula.realize_iAlls,
    Formula.realize_not, Formula.realize_rel₂, Formula.realize_rel₁, Term.realize_var,
    Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr]
  exact or_congr Iff.rfl (and_congr
    ⟨fun hh b => hh fun _ => b, fun hh i => hh (i 0)⟩ Iff.rfl)

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SpaceTM.realize_minPosAtF
statement:
@[simp]
theorem realize_minPosAtF (le : L'.Relations 2) (posn : L'.Relations 1)
    (x : γ) :
    (minPosAtF le posn x).Realize v ↔
      MinPos (fun a b => RelMap le ![a, b]) (fun a => RelMap posn ![a]) (v x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [minPosAtF, MinPos]
  simp only [Formula.realize_inf, Formula.realize_iAlls, Formula.realize_imp,
    Formula.realize_rel₁, Formula.realize_rel₂, Term.realize_var, Sum.elim_inl,
    Sum.elim_inr]
  exact and_congr Iff.rfl ⟨fun hh q => hh fun _ => q, fun hh i => hh (i 0)⟩

new symbol written in the marked cell. -/

statement:

    (writeNewF tr src rd s h t wr y).Realize v ↔
      ∃ τ : M, (RelMap tr ![τ] ∧
          ((∀ q : M, RelMap s ![q] → RelMap src ![τ, q]) ∧
            ∀ p a : M, RelMap h ![p] → RelMap t ![p, a] → RelMap rd ![τ, a])) ∧
        RelMap wr ![τ, v y]

    (dstNewF tr src rd s h t dst y).Realize v ↔
      ∃ τ : M, (RelMap tr ![τ] ∧
          ((∀ q : M, RelMap s ![q] → RelMap src ![τ, q]) ∧
            ∀ p a : M, RelMap h ![p] → RelMap t ![p, a] → RelMap rd ![τ, a])) ∧

statement:

theorem realize_headNewF (tr : L'.Relations 1) (src rd : L'.Relations 2)

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SpaceTM.mNextAssign_of_stateEmpty

theorem mNextAssign_of_stateEmpty {ρ : mBlock.Assignment A} (h : StateEmptyOn ρ) :

proof:
:= by
  funext i x
  match i with
  | none =>
    refine propext ⟨fun hh => ?_, fun hh => Or.inl ⟨h, hh⟩⟩
    rcases hh with ⟨-, h2⟩ | ⟨hn, -⟩
    · exact h2
    · exact absurd h hn
  | some false =>
    refine propext ⟨fun hh => ?_, fun hh => Or.inl ⟨h, hh⟩⟩
    rcases hh with ⟨-, h2⟩ | ⟨hn, -⟩
    · exact h2
    · exact absurd h hn
  | some true =>

    rcases hh with ⟨hSE, -⟩ | ⟨-, ⟨-, ht⟩ | ⟨hg, -⟩⟩
    · exact absurd hSE hne
    · exact ht
    · exact absurd hg hng
  | some false =>
    refine propext ⟨fun hh => ?_, fun hh => Or.inr ⟨hne, Or.inl ⟨hng, hh⟩⟩⟩
    rcases hh with ⟨hSE, -⟩ | ⟨-, ⟨-, ht⟩ | ⟨hg, -⟩⟩
    · exact absurd hSE hne
    · exact ht
    · exact absurd hg hng
  | some true =>

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SpaceTM.step_of_goOn
statement:
theorem step_of_goOn {c : Config A} (hgo : GoOn (cfgAssign c)) :
    ∃ d, (tmData A).Step c d
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨-, τ, p', ⟨htr, hsrcs, hreads⟩, ⟨q₀, hq₀⟩, ⟨a₀, ha₀⟩, p, hp, hmv⟩ := hgo
  rw [show p = c.head from hp] at hmv
  refine ⟨⟨q₀, p', fun r => if r = c.head then a₀ else c.tape r⟩, τ, htr,
    hsrcs c.state rfl, hreads c.head (c.tape c.head) rfl rfl, hq₀, ?_, ?_, hmv⟩
  · change TMWrite τ (if c.head = c.head then a₀ else c.tape c.head)
    rw [ite_eq_left rfl]
    exact ha₀
  · intro r hr
    change (if r = c.head then a₀ else c.tape r) = c.tape r
    rw [ite_eq_right hr]

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SpaceTM.mNextAssign_cfgAssign_of_step
statement:
theorem mNextAssign_cfgAssign_of_step (hwf : (tmData A).WellFormed)
    (hdet : (tmData A).Deterministic) {c d : Config A}
    (hnacc : ¬(tmData A).Acc c.state) (hstep : (tmData A).Step c d) :
    mNextAssign (cfgAssign c) = cfgAssign d
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨τ, htr, hsrc, hread, hdst, hwrite, hframe, hmove⟩ := hstep
  have happl : ApplOn (cfgAssign c) τ :=
    ⟨htr, fun q hq => (show q = c.state from hq) ▸ hsrc, fun p a hp ha => by
      rw [show p = c.head from hp] at ha
      have ha' : c.tape c.head = a := ha
      exact ha' ▸ hread⟩
  have hgo : GoOn (cfgAssign c) :=
    ⟨fun ⟨q, hq, hacc⟩ => hnacc (hq ▸ hacc), τ, d.head, happl,
      ⟨d.state, hdst⟩, ⟨d.tape c.head, hwrite⟩, c.head, rfl, hmove⟩
  have hne := not_stateEmptyOn_cfgAssign c
  have happl_uniq : ∀ τ' : A, ApplOn (cfgAssign c) τ' → τ' = τ := by
    rintro τ' ⟨htr', hsrcs', hreads'⟩
    exact hdet.2.1 τ' τ c.state (c.tape c.head) htr' htr (hsrcs' c.state rfl) hsrc
      (hreads' c.head (c.tape c.head) rfl rfl) hread
  funext i x
  match i with
  | none =>
    refine propext ⟨fun hh => ?_, fun hh => ?_⟩
    · rcases hh with ⟨hSE, -⟩ | ⟨-, ⟨hng, -⟩ | ⟨-, ⟨hnh, ht⟩ | ⟨hh, τ', happl', hw⟩⟩⟩
      · exact absurd hSE hne
      · exact absurd hgo hng
      · change d.tape (x 0) = x 1
        rw [hframe (x 0) (fun hcon => hnh hcon)]
        exact ht
      · have heq := happl_uniq τ' happl'
        subst heq
        change d.tape (x 0) = x 1
        rw [show (x 0) = c.head from hh]
        exact hdet.2.2.2 τ' _ _ hwrite hw
    · rcases eq_or_ne (x 0) c.head with hx | hx
      · refine Or.inr ⟨hne, Or.inr ⟨hgo, Or.inr ⟨hx, τ, happl, ?_⟩⟩⟩
        rw [← (show d.tape (x 0) = x 1 from hh), hx]
        exact hwrite
      · refine Or.inr ⟨hne, Or.inr ⟨hgo, Or.inl ⟨hx, ?_⟩⟩⟩
        change c.tape (x 0) = x 1
        rw [← hframe (x 0) hx]
        exact hh
  | some false =>
    refine propext ⟨fun hh => ?_, fun hh => ?_⟩
    · rcases hh with ⟨hSE, -⟩ | ⟨-, ⟨hng, -⟩ | ⟨-, τ', happl', hd'⟩⟩
      · exact absurd hSE hne
      · exact absurd hgo hng
      · have heq := happl_uniq τ' happl'
        subst heq
        exact hdet.2.2.1 τ' _ _ hd' hdst
    · exact Or.inr ⟨hne, Or.inr ⟨hgo, τ, happl,
        (show (x 0) = d.state from hh) ▸ hdst⟩⟩
  | some true =>
    refine propext ⟨fun hh => ?_, fun hh => ?_⟩
    · rcases hh with ⟨hSE, -⟩ | ⟨-, ⟨hng, -⟩ | ⟨-, τ', happl', p, hp, hmv'⟩⟩
      · exact absurd hSE hne
      · exact absurd hgo hng
      · have heq := happl_uniq τ' happl'
        subst heq
        rw [show p = c.head from hp] at hmv'
        change (x 0) = d.head
        rcases hmove with ⟨hr, hs⟩ | ⟨hr, hs⟩ <;> rcases hmv' with ⟨hr', hs'⟩ | ⟨hr', hs'⟩
        · exact (TMData.succPos_right_unique hwf.1 hs' hs :)
        · exact absurd hr hr'
        · exact absurd hr' hr
        · exact (succPos_left_unique hwf.1 hs' hs :)
    · refine Or.inr ⟨hne, Or.inr ⟨hgo, τ, happl, c.head, rfl, ?_⟩⟩
      rw [show (x 0) = d.head from hh]
      exact hmove

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SpaceTM.mInitAssign_eq_cfgAssign
proof:
:= by
  funext i x
  match i with
  | none =>
    refine propext ⟨fun hh => ?_, fun hh => ?_⟩
    · exact TMData.initTape_functional hwf (hinit.2.2 (x 0))
        (show (tmData A).InitTape (x 0) (x 1) from hh)
    · change (tmData A).InitTape (x 0) (x 1)
      rw [← (show c₀.tape (x 0) = x 1 from hh)]
      exact hinit.2.2 (x 0)
  | some false =>
    refine propext ⟨fun hh => ?_, fun hh => ?_⟩
    · exact hdet.1 _ _ hh hinit.1
    · exact show TMStart (x 0) from (show (x 0) = c₀.state from hh) ▸ hinit.1
  | some true =>
    refine propext ⟨fun hh => ?_, fun hh => ?_⟩
    · exact hwf.1.2.2.1 _ _ (hh.2 c₀.head hinit.2.1.1) (hinit.2.1.2 (x 0) hh.1)
    · exact show MinPos TMLe TMPosn (x 0) from
        (show (x 0) = c₀.head from hh) ▸ hinit.2.1

/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SpaceTM.partStage_one
statement: theorem partStage_one : mPfp.partStage A 1 = mInitAssign A
proof:
:=
  (mPfp.partStage_succ 0).trans ((next_mPfp _).trans
    (mNextAssign_of_stateEmpty stateEmptyOn_botAssign))

/
been reached, stage `n + 1` is the `n`-th configuration of the run. -/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SpaceTM.partStage_run
statement:
theorem partStage_run (hwf : (tmData A).WellFormed) (hdet : (tmData A).Deterministic)
    {c₀ : Config A} (hinit : (tmData A).IsInit c₀) :
    ∀ n c, (tmData A).StepsIn n c₀ c →
      (∀ k, k < n → ∀ e, (tmData A).StepsIn k c₀ e → ¬(tmData A).Acc e.state) →
      mPfp.partStage A (n + 1) = cfgAssign c
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro c hsteps _
    rw [← (show c₀ = c from hsteps)]
    exact partStage_one.trans (mInitAssign_eq_cfgAssign hwf hdet hinit)
  | succ n ih =>
    intro c hsteps hnoacc
    obtain ⟨d, hd, hstep⟩ := TMData.stepsIn_succ_iff.mp hsteps
    have hstage := ih d hd fun k hk => hnoacc k (by omega)
    rw [mPfp.partStage_succ, hstage, next_mPfp]
    exact mNextAssign_cfgAssign_of_step hwf hdet (hnoacc n (by omega) d hd) hstep

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SpaceTM.stepsIn_of_reflTransGen
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact ⟨0, rfl⟩
  | tail _ hstep ih =>
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := ih
    exact ⟨n + 1, hn.trans_step hstep⟩

/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SpaceTM.realize_mOut
statement:
theorem realize_mOut (ρ : mBlock.Assignment A) :
    (@Sentence.Realize _ A (mBlock.structure₁ (L := mBase) ρ) mPfp.out) ↔
      ((tmData A).WellFormed ∧ ((tmData A).Deterministic ∧
        ∃ q : A, mState ρ q ∧ TMAcc q))
proof:
:= by
  let := mBlock.structure₁ (L := mBase) ρ
  simp only [mPfp, Sentence.Realize, Formula.realize_inf, realize_wfF, realize_detF,
    realize_markMeetF, relMap_mIn₁, relMap_mS₁]
  exact Iff.rfl

/
converge with an accepting output**: run to the first accepting configuration
and stutter there. -/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SpaceTM.pfpHolds_mPfp_of_acceptsSpace
statement:
theorem pfpHolds_mPfp_of_acceptsSpace (hwf : (tmData A).WellFormed)
    (hdet : (tmData A).Deterministic) (hacc : (tmData A).AcceptsSpace) :
    mPfp.PFPHolds A
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c₀, c, hinit, hreach, haccst⟩ := hacc
  have hex : ∃ n, ∃ cA : Config A,
      (tmData A).StepsIn n c₀ cA ∧ (tmData A).Acc cA.state := by
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := stepsIn_of_reflTransGen hreach
    exact ⟨n, c, hn, haccst⟩
  have hmem : sInf {n | ∃ cA, (tmData A).StepsIn n c₀ cA ∧ (tmData A).Acc cA.state} ∈
      {n | ∃ cA, (tmData A).StepsIn n c₀ cA ∧ (tmData A).Acc cA.state} :=
    Nat.sInf_mem hex
  obtain ⟨cA, hsteps, haccA⟩ := hmem
  have hnoacc : ∀ k, k < sInf {n | ∃ cA, (tmData A).StepsIn n c₀ cA ∧
      (tmData A).Acc cA.state} → ∀ e, (tmData A).StepsIn k c₀ e →
      ¬(tmData A).Acc e.state := by
    intro k hk e hst hacce
    have hmem : k ∈ {n | ∃ cA, (tmData A).StepsIn n c₀ cA ∧ (tmData A).Acc cA.state} :=
      ⟨e, hst, hacce⟩
    exact absurd (Nat.sInf_le hmem) (by omega)
  have hstage := partStage_run hwf hdet hinit _ cA hsteps hnoacc
  refine ⟨sInf {n | ∃ cA, (tmData A).StepsIn n c₀ cA ∧ (tmData A).Acc cA.state} + 1,
    ?_, ?_⟩
  · have h : mPfp.next (mPfp.partStage A (sInf {n | ∃ cA, (tmData A).StepsIn n c₀ cA ∧
        (tmData A).Acc cA.state} + 1)) = mPfp.partStage A (sInf {n | ∃ cA,
        (tmData A).StepsIn n c₀ cA ∧ (tmData A).Acc cA.state} + 1) := by
      rw [hstage, next_mPfp]
      exact mNextAssign_cfgAssign_of_acc haccA
    exact h
  · rw [hstage]
    exact (realize_mOut (cfgAssign cA)).mpr ⟨hwf, hdet, cA.state, rfl, haccA⟩

/
deterministic and accepting**: the stages only ever hold the empty
assignment, the initial assignment, or a configuration of the run. -/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SpaceTM.acceptsSpace_of_pfpHolds_mPfp
statement:
theorem acceptsSpace_of_pfpHolds_mPfp [Finite A] (h : mPfp.PFPHolds A) :
    ((tmData A).WellFormed ∧ ((tmData A).Deterministic ∧
      (tmData A).AcceptsSpace))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, -, hout⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨hwf, hdet, q, hq, hqacc⟩ := (realize_mOut _).mp hout
  by_cases hstart : ∃ q₀ : A, TMStart q₀
  · obtain ⟨q₀, hq₀⟩ := hstart
    obtain ⟨c₀, hinit, -⟩ := TMData.exists_isInit hwf hq₀
    have hinv : ∀ m, mPfp.partStage A m = mBlock.botAssign A ∨
        ∃ k c, (tmData A).StepsIn k c₀ c ∧ mPfp.partStage A m = cfgAssign c := by
      intro m
      induction m with
      | zero => exact Or.inl rfl
      | succ m ihm =>
        rcases ihm with hm | ⟨k, c, hkc, hm⟩ <;> rw [mPfp.partStage_succ, hm, next_mPfp]
        · exact Or.inr ⟨0, c₀, rfl, (mNextAssign_of_stateEmpty
            stateEmptyOn_botAssign).trans (mInitAssign_eq_cfgAssign hwf hdet hinit)⟩
        · by_cases hgo : GoOn (cfgAssign c)
          · obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := step_of_goOn hgo
            refine Or.inr ⟨k + 1, d, hkc.trans_step hd, ?_⟩
            exact mNextAssign_cfgAssign_of_step hwf hdet
              (fun hacc => hgo.1 ⟨c.state, rfl, hacc⟩) hd
          · exact Or.inr ⟨k, c, hkc, mNextAssign_cfgAssign_of_not_goOn hgo⟩
    rcases hinv n with hn | ⟨k, c, hkc, hn⟩
    · rw [hn] at hq
      exact hq.elim
    · rw [hn] at hq
      exact ⟨hwf, hdet, c₀, c, hinit, TMData.reflTransGen_of_stepsIn hkc,
        (show q = c.state from hq) ▸ hqacc⟩
  · have hstages : ∀ m, mPfp.partStage A m = mBlock.botAssign A ∨
        mPfp.partStage A m = mInitAssign A := by
      intro m
      induction m with
      | zero => exact Or.inl rfl
      | succ m ihm =>
        rcases ihm with hm | hm <;> rw [mPfp.partStage_succ, hm, next_mPfp]
        · exact Or.inr (mNextAssign_of_stateEmpty stateEmptyOn_botAssign)
        · exact Or.inr (mNextAssign_of_stateEmpty fun ⟨q', hq'⟩ => hstart ⟨q', hq'⟩)
    rcases hstages n with hn | hn <;> rw [hn] at hq
    · exact hq.elim
    · exact absurd ⟨q, hq⟩ hstart

name: DescriptiveComplexity.dtmAcceptSpace_pfpDefinable
statement: theorem dtmAcceptSpace_pfpDefinable : PFPDefinable DTMAcceptSpace
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨mPfp, ?_⟩
  intro A _ _ _ _
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hwf, hdet, hacc⟩
    exact pfpHolds_mPfp_of_acceptsSpace hwf hdet hacc
  · intro h
    exact acceptsSpace_of_pfpHolds_mPfp h

/
pull the iteration back through the relativized reduction.
Registered in the Lax archive as
[`Lax134656.PartialFixedPointCapture.pfpDefinable_of_mem_PSPACE`](https://laxarchive.org/lax-134656/Lax134656.PartialFixedPointCapture.html#s-Lax134656.PartialFixedPointCapture.pfpDefinable_of_mem_PSPACE). -/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.pfpDefinable_of_mem_PSPACE
statement:
theorem pfpDefinable_of_mem_PSPACE {L : Language.{0, 0}} [L.IsRelational] {P : DecisionProblem L}
    (h : P ∈ PSPACE) : PFPDefinable P
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f⟩ := le_dtmAcceptSpace_of_mem_PSPACE P h
  exact PFPDefinable.of_relOrderedReduction f dtmAcceptSpace_pfpDefinable

/
1989][abiteboul1989fixpoint]; [Ebbinghaus–Flum 1995][ebbinghaus1995finite],
ch. 7): a problem is FO(≤, PFP) definable exactly when it is in PSPACE.
Registered in the Lax archive as
[`Lax134656.PartialFixedPointCapture.pfpDefinable_iff_mem_PSPACE`](https://laxarchive.org/lax-134656/Lax134656.PartialFixedPointCapture.html#s-Lax134656.PartialFixedPointCapture.pfpDefinable_iff_mem_PSPACE). -/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.pfpDefinable_iff_mem_PSPACE
statement:
theorem pfpDefinable_iff_mem_PSPACE {L : Language.{0, 0}} [L.IsRelational] (P : DecisionProblem L) :
    PFPDefinable P ↔ P ∈ PSPACE
proof:
:=
  ⟨mem_PSPACE_of_pfpDefinable, pfpDefinable_of_mem_PSPACE⟩

/
same problems. -/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.pfpDefinable_iff_sotcDefinable
statement:
theorem pfpDefinable_iff_sotcDefinable {L : Language.{0, 0}} [L.IsRelational]
    (P : DecisionProblem L) :
    PFPDefinable P ↔ SOTCDefinable P
proof:
:=
  (pfpDefinable_iff_mem_PSPACE P).trans (mem_PSPACE_iff P)

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SOBlock.mem_idxList
statement: theorem SOBlock.mem_idxList (B : SOBlock) (i : B.ι) : i ∈ B.idxList
proof:
:= by
  let : Fintype B.ι := Fintype.ofFinite B.ι
  exact Finset.mem_toList.mpr (Finset.mem_univ i)

name: DescriptiveComplexity.StepDef.realize_nextSentence
statement:
theorem realize_nextSentence (ρ σ : d.B.Assignment A) :
    (@Sentence.Realize _ A (d.B.structure₂ (L := L) ρ σ) d.nextSentence) ↔
      σ = d.next ρ
proof:
:= by
  let := d.B.structure σ
  let := d.B.structure₁ (L := L) ρ
  rw [nextSentence]
  simp only [Sentence.Realize, realize_listInf]
  constructor
  · intro h
    funext i x
    have hi := h _ (List.mem_map_of_mem (d.B.mem_idxList i))
    rw [Formula.realize_iAlls] at hi
    have hx := hi x
    rw [Formula.realize_iff, Formula.realize_rel, Formula.realize_relabel,
      LHom.realize_onFormula] at hx
    exact propext hx
  · rintro rfl ψ hψ
    obtain ⟨i, -, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hψ
    rw [Formula.realize_iAlls]
    intro x
    rw [Formula.realize_iff, Formula.realize_rel, Formula.realize_relabel,
      LHom.realize_onFormula]
    exact Iff.rfl

name: DescriptiveComplexity.StepDef.realize_botSentence
statement:
theorem realize_botSentence (ρ : d.B.Assignment A) :
    (@Sentence.Realize _ A (d.B.structure₁ (L := L) ρ) d.botSentence) ↔
      ρ = d.B.botAssign A
proof:
:= by
  let := d.B.structure ρ
  rw [botSentence]
  simp only [Sentence.Realize, realize_listInf]
  constructor
  · intro h
    funext i x
    have hi := h _ (List.mem_map_of_mem (d.B.mem_idxList i))
    rw [Formula.realize_iAlls] at hi
    have hx := hi x
    rw [Formula.realize_not, Formula.realize_rel] at hx
    exact propext (iff_false_intro hx)
  · rintro rfl ψ hψ
    obtain ⟨i, -, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hψ
    rw [Formula.realize_iAlls]
    intro x
    rw [Formula.realize_not, Formula.realize_rel]
    exact fun h => h

name: DescriptiveComplexity.StepDef.realize_isFixedPtF
statement:
theorem realize_isFixedPtF (ρ : d.B.Assignment A) :
    (@Sentence.Realize _ A (d.B.structure₁ (L := L) ρ) d.isFixedPtF) ↔
      IsFixedPt d.next ρ
proof:
:= by
  let := d.B.structure ρ
  rw [isFixedPtF]
  simp only [Sentence.Realize, realize_listInf]
  constructor
  · intro h
    funext i x
    have hi := h _ (List.mem_map_of_mem (d.B.mem_idxList i))
    rw [Formula.realize_iAlls] at hi
    have hx := hi x
    rw [Formula.realize_iff, Formula.realize_rel, Formula.realize_relabel] at hx
    exact propext hx.symm
  · rintro hfix ψ hψ
    obtain ⟨i, -, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hψ
    rw [Formula.realize_iAlls]
    intro x
    rw [Formula.realize_iff, Formula.realize_rel, Formula.realize_relabel]
    exact (iff_of_eq (congrFun (congrFun hfix i) x)).symm

name: DescriptiveComplexity.StepDef.toSOTCSpec_step_iff
statement:
theorem StepDef.toSOTCSpec_step_iff (ρ σ : d.B.Assignment A) :
    d.toSOTCSpec.Step ρ σ ↔ σ = d.next ρ
proof:
:=
  d.realize_nextSentence ρ σ

name: DescriptiveComplexity.StepDef.toSOTCSpec_isSrc_iff
statement:
theorem StepDef.toSOTCSpec_isSrc_iff (ρ : d.B.Assignment A) :
    d.toSOTCSpec.IsSrc ρ ↔ ρ = d.B.botAssign A
proof:
:=
  d.realize_botSentence ρ

name: DescriptiveComplexity.StepDef.toSOTCSpec_isTgt_iff
proof:
:= by
  let := d.B.structure ρ
  have h : (@Sentence.Realize _ A (d.B.structure₁ (L := L.sum Language.order) ρ)
        (d.isFixedPtF ⊓ d.out)) ↔
      (@Sentence.Realize _ A (d.B.structure₁ (L := L.sum Language.order) ρ)
          d.isFixedPtF ∧
        @Sentence.Realize _ A (d.B.structure₁ (L := L.sum Language.order) ρ) d.out) :=
    BoundedFormula.realize_inf
  exact h.trans (and_congr (d.realize_isFixedPtF ρ) Iff.rfl)

/
stages. -/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.StepDef.reach_toSOTCSpec
statement:
theorem StepDef.reach_toSOTCSpec (σ : d.B.Assignment A) :
    d.toSOTCSpec.Reach (d.B.botAssign A) σ ↔ ∃ n, σ = d.partStage A n
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    induction h with
    | refl => exact ⟨0, rfl⟩
    | @tail τ υ _ hstep ih =>
      obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := ih
      refine ⟨n + 1, ?_⟩
      rw [d.partStage_succ]
      exact ((d.toSOTCSpec_step_iff _ _).mp hstep : υ = _)
  · rintro ⟨n, rfl⟩
    induction n with
    | zero => exact Relation.ReflTransGen.refl
    | succ n ih =>
      refine ih.tail ((d.toSOTCSpec_step_iff _ _).mpr ?_)
      exact d.partStage_succ n

/
stable stage satisfying the output is reachable from the empty assignment
exactly when the iteration converges to a limit satisfying the output. -/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.StepDef.accepts_toSOTCSpec
statement:
theorem StepDef.accepts_toSOTCSpec :
    d.toSOTCSpec.Accepts A ↔ d.PFPHolds A
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨ρ, σ, hsrc, htgt, hreach⟩
    have hρ : ρ = d.B.botAssign A := (d.toSOTCSpec_isSrc_iff ρ).mp hsrc
    subst hρ
    obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := (d.reach_toSOTCSpec σ).mp hreach
    obtain ⟨hfix, hout⟩ := (d.toSOTCSpec_isTgt_iff _).mp htgt
    exact ⟨n, hfix, hout⟩
  · rintro ⟨n, hfix, hout⟩
    refine ⟨d.B.botAssign A, d.partStage A n, (d.toSOTCSpec_isSrc_iff _).mpr rfl,
      (d.toSOTCSpec_isTgt_iff _).mpr ⟨hfix, hout⟩, (d.reach_toSOTCSpec _).mpr ⟨n, rfl⟩⟩

name: DescriptiveComplexity.PFPDefinable.sotcDefinable
statement:
theorem PFPDefinable.sotcDefinable [L.IsRelational] {P : DecisionProblem L} (h : PFPDefinable P) :
    SOTCDefinable P
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := h
  refine ⟨d.toSOTCSpec, ?_⟩
  intro A _ _ _ _
  exact (hd A).trans (d.accepts_toSOTCSpec (A := A)).symm

/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.mem_PSPACE_of_pfpDefinable
statement:
theorem mem_PSPACE_of_pfpDefinable [L.IsRelational] {P : DecisionProblem L} (h : PFPDefinable P) :
    P ∈ PSPACE
proof:
:=
  (mem_PSPACE_iff P).mpr h.sotcDefinable

name: DescriptiveComplexity.RelFOInterpretation.realize_liftSource_domFormula
statement:
theorem RelFOInterpretation.realize_liftSource_domFormula
    (hexp : @LHom.IsExpansionOn _ _ φ A inst₀ inst₁) (t : Tag) (w : Fin dim → A) :
    (@Formula.Realize _ A inst₁ _ ((I.liftSource φ).domFormula t) w) ↔
      @Formula.Realize _ A inst₀ _ (I.domFormula t) w
proof:
:=
  letI := inst₀
  letI := inst₁
  letI := hexp
  LHom.realize_onFormula φ _

/
interpretation produces the same structure as the original one: the identity
on tagged tuples is an isomorphism. -/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.LFPInterpretation.map_finite
statement: theorem map_finite [Finite Tag] [Finite A] : Finite (I.Map A)
proof:
:=
  letI := I.expStructure A
  I.toRel.mapRel_finite A

name: DescriptiveComplexity.LFPInterpretation.pullProblem_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem pullProblem_apply [L.IsRelational] [L'.IsRelational] (Q : DecisionProblem L')
    (A : Type) [L.Structure A] : I.pullProblem Q A ↔ Q (I.Map A)
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: DescriptiveComplexity.RelFOInterpretation.realize_domNonemptyS
statement:
theorem RelFOInterpretation.realize_domNonemptyS (I : RelFOInterpretation L₁ L₂ Tag dim)
    (A : Type) [L₁.Structure A] :
    A ⊨ I.domNonemptyS ↔ Nonempty (I.MapRel A)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let : Fintype Tag := Fintype.ofFinite Tag
  rw [RelFOInterpretation.domNonemptyS]
  simp only [Sentence.Realize, Formula.realize_iSup, Formula.realize_iExs,
    Formula.realize_relabel]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨t, w, hw⟩
    exact ⟨⟨(t, w), by simpa using hw⟩⟩
  · rintro ⟨⟨⟨t, w⟩, hw⟩⟩
    exact ⟨t, w, by simpa using hw⟩

name: DescriptiveComplexity.IFPDefinable.of_lfpReduction
statement:
theorem IFPDefinable.of_lfpReduction (f : P ≤ˡᶠᵖ Q) (h : IFPDefinable Q) :
    IFPDefinable P
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := h
  let := f.tagFinite
  let : LinearOrder f.Tag := finiteLinearOrder f.Tag
  set I := f.toInterpretation with hI
  refine ⟨I.ind.stratify (d.pullRel I.ordExtend.toRel), ?_⟩
  intro A _ _ _ _
  let := I.mapLinearOrder A
  have : Finite (I.Map A) := I.map_finite A
  have : Nonempty (I.Map A) := f.map_nonempty A
  refine (f.correct A).trans ((hd (I.Map A)).trans ?_)

  have hstrat := I.ind.ifpHolds_stratify (A := A) (d.pullRel I.ordExtend.toRel)
  refine Iff.trans ?_ hstrat.symm

  let : ((L₁.sum Language.order).sum I.ordExtend.ind.B.lang).Structure A :=
    I.ordExtend.expStructure A
  have hpull := StepDef.ifpHolds_pullRel (A := A) d I.ordExtend.toRel
  refine Iff.trans ?_ hpull.symm
  exact (@StepDef.ifpHolds_equiv (L₂.sum Language.order) d (I.ordExtend.Map A) (I.Map A)
    (LFPInterpretation.mapStructure I.ordExtend A)
    (letI := I.mapLinearOrder A; sumOrderStructure L₂ (I.Map A))
    (I.ordExtendLEquiv A)).symm

/
polynomial-time problem by a polynomial-time reduction is polynomial time. -/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.mem_PTIME_of_lfpReduction
statement: theorem mem_PTIME_of_lfpReduction (f : P ≤ˡᶠᵖ Q) (h : Q ∈ PTIME) : P ∈ PTIME
proof:
:=
  (ifpDefinable_iff_mem_PTIME P).mp
    (((ifpDefinable_iff_mem_PTIME Q).mpr h).of_lfpReduction f)

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SigmaSODefinable.of_lfpReduction
statement:
theorem SigmaSODefinable.of_lfpReduction (f : P ≤ˡᶠᵖ Q) (h : SigmaSODefinable 1 Q) :
    SigmaSODefinable 1 P
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Bs, hlen, φ, hφ⟩ := h
  let := f.tagFinite
  set I := f.toInterpretation with hI


  let S : DecisionProblem ((L₁.sum Language.order).sum I.ind.B.lang) :=
    { Holds := fun A' inst =>
        Nonempty (@RelFOInterpretation.MapRel _ _ _ _ I.toRel A' inst) ∧
          Q (@RelFOInterpretation.MapRel _ _ _ _ I.toRel A' inst)
      iso_invariant := fun {M N} instM instN e =>
        and_congr ⟨fun hne => hne.map (I.toRel.mapRelLEquiv e),
            fun hne => hne.map (I.toRel.mapRelLEquiv e.symm)⟩
          (Q.iso_invariant (I.toRel.mapRelLEquiv e)) }
  have hS : SigmaSODefinable 1 S := by
    refine ⟨pullBlocks f.Tag f.dim Bs, by simpa [pullBlocks] using hlen,
      (soLangEmbed (pullBlocks f.Tag f.dim Bs) _).onSentence I.toRel.domNonemptyS ⊓
        pullRelSO Bs _ L₂ I.toRel φ, ?_⟩
    intro A' _ _ _
    rw [sorealize_inf_embed (pullBlocks f.Tag f.dim Bs) _ A' _ _ _ true,
      I.toRel.realize_domNonemptyS A']
    refine and_congr_right fun hne => ?_
    have : Finite (I.toRel.MapRel A') := I.toRel.mapRel_finite A'
    exact (hφ (I.toRel.MapRel A')).trans (sorealize_pullRelSO I.toRel A' Bs φ true)

  have hP' : SigmaSODefinable 1
      ({ Holds := fun A _ => Nonempty (I.Map A) ∧ Q (I.Map A)
         iso_invariant := fun {M N} instM instN e =>
           and_congr ⟨fun hne => hne.map (I.mapLEquiv e),
               fun hne => hne.map (I.mapLEquiv e.symm)⟩
             (Q.iso_invariant (I.mapLEquiv e)) } : DecisionProblem (L₁.sum Language.order)) :=
    sigmaSODefinable_of_ifpExpand I.ind hS fun A _ _ _ => Iff.rfl

  obtain ⟨Cs, hlen', χ, hχ⟩ := hP'
  obtain ⟨C, rfl⟩ := List.length_eq_one_iff.mp hlen'
  refine sigmaSODefinable_of_orderPull [C] rfl χ ?_
  intro A _ _ _
  have key : ∀ lo : LinearOrder A,
      (letI := lo
       P A ↔ SORealize (L₁.sum Language.order) A [C] χ true) := by
    intro lo
    let := lo
    have : Finite (I.Map A) := I.map_finite A
    have hne : Nonempty (I.Map A) := f.map_nonempty A
    refine (f.correct A).trans (Iff.trans ?_ (hχ A))
    exact ⟨fun hQ => ⟨hne, hQ⟩, fun h => h.2⟩
  exact ⟨fun hP => ⟨finiteLinearOrder A, (key _).mp hP⟩, fun ⟨lo, h⟩ => (key lo).mpr h⟩

/
problem by a polynomial-time reduction is in NP. -/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.mem_NP_of_lfpReduction
statement: theorem mem_NP_of_lfpReduction (f : P ≤ˡᶠᵖ Q) (h : Q ∈ NP) : P ∈ NP
proof:
:=
  SigmaSODefinable.of_lfpReduction f h

/
interpretation reduces the complements. -/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.mem_coNP_of_lfpReduction
statement: theorem mem_coNP_of_lfpReduction (f : P ≤ˡᶠᵖ Q) (h : Q ∈ coNP) : P ∈ coNP
proof:
:=
  (mem_piP_iff 1 P).mpr (mem_NP_of_lfpReduction f.compl ((mem_piP_iff 1 Q).mp h))

/
as `DescriptiveComplexity.mem_coNP_of_lfpReduction`, at the level of the
logic. -/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.PiSODefinable.of_lfpReduction
statement:
theorem PiSODefinable.of_lfpReduction (f : P ≤ˡᶠᵖ Q) (h : PiSODefinable 1 Q) :
    PiSODefinable 1 P
proof:
:=
  (piSODefinable_iff_compl 1 P).mpr
    (SigmaSODefinable.of_lfpReduction f.compl ((piSODefinable_iff_compl 1 Q).mp h))

name: DescriptiveComplexity.mem_PTIME_of_relOrderedReduction
statement: theorem mem_PTIME_of_relOrderedReduction (f : P ≤ʳᶠᵒ[≤] Q) (h : Q ∈ PTIME) : P ∈ PTIME
proof:
:=
  (ifpDefinable_iff_mem_PTIME P).mp
    (((ifpDefinable_iff_mem_PTIME Q).mpr h).of_relOrderedReduction f)

/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.mem_NP_of_relOrderedReduction
statement: theorem mem_NP_of_relOrderedReduction (f : P ≤ʳᶠᵒ[≤] Q) (h : Q ∈ NP) : P ∈ NP
proof:
:=
  SigmaSODefinable.of_relOrderedReduction f h

/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.mem_coNP_of_relOrderedReduction
statement: theorem mem_coNP_of_relOrderedReduction (f : P ≤ʳᶠᵒ[≤] Q) (h : Q ∈ coNP) : P ∈ coNP
proof:
:=
  PiSODefinable.of_relOrderedReduction f h

name: DescriptiveComplexity.cofinalHardLFP_iff
statement:
theorem cofinalHardLFP_iff
    (Mem : ∀ {L₀ : Language.{0, 0}} [L₀.IsRelational], DecisionProblem L₀ → Prop)
    (P : DecisionProblem L) :
    CofinalHardLFP Mem P ↔
      ∀ {L'' : Language.{0, 0}} [L''.IsRelational] (Q : DecisionProblem L''),
        Mem Q → Nonempty (Q ≤ˡᶠᵖ P)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h L'' _ Q hQ
    exact h P ⟨(FOReduction.refl P).toLFP⟩ Q hQ
  · intro h L' _ S hS L'' _ Q hQ
    exact ⟨(h Q hQ).some.trans hS.some⟩

/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.CofinalHardLFP.of_lfpReduction
proof:
:= by
  intro L'' _ S hQS L₀ _ R hR
  exact hP S (hQS.map fun g => f.trans g) R hR

/
it under FO(LFP) reductions**: every first-order reduction is an FO(LFP)
reduction. -/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.CofinalHard.toLFP
proof:
:= by
  intro L' _ S hPS L'' _ Q hQ
  exact ((cofinalHard_iff Mem P).mp h Q hQ).map fun g => g.toLFP.trans hPS.some

/
reductions.** Reading a completeness theorem of the catalog with
polynomial-time reductions in place of first-order ones is this corollary. -/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.ComplexityClass.hard_lfp_of_hard
proof:
:=
  CofinalHard.toLFP ((hC P).mp h)

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SigmaSODefinable.of_lfpReduction_succ
statement:
theorem SigmaSODefinable.of_lfpReduction_succ (f : P ≤ˡᶠᵖ Q)
    (h : SigmaSODefinable (k + 1) Q) : SigmaSODefinable (k + 1) P
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Bs, hlen, φ, hφ⟩ := h
  let := f.tagFinite
  set I := f.toInterpretation with hI

  let S : DecisionProblem ((L₁.sum Language.order).sum I.ind.B.lang) :=
    { Holds := fun A' inst =>
        Nonempty (@RelFOInterpretation.MapRel _ _ _ _ I.toRel A' inst) ∧
          Q (@RelFOInterpretation.MapRel _ _ _ _ I.toRel A' inst)
      iso_invariant := fun {M N} instM instN e =>
        and_congr ⟨fun hne => hne.map (I.toRel.mapRelLEquiv e),
            fun hne => hne.map (I.toRel.mapRelLEquiv e.symm)⟩
          (Q.iso_invariant (I.toRel.mapRelLEquiv e)) }
  have hSlen : (pullBlocks f.Tag f.dim Bs).length = k + 1 := by
    simpa [pullBlocks] using hlen
  have hS : ∀ (A' : Type) (inst : ((L₁.sum Language.order).sum I.ind.B.lang).Structure A'),
      Finite A' → Nonempty A' →
      (@DecisionProblem.Holds _ _ S A' inst ↔
        @SORealize _ A' inst (pullBlocks f.Tag f.dim Bs)
          ((soLangEmbed (pullBlocks f.Tag f.dim Bs) _).onSentence I.toRel.domNonemptyS ⊓
            pullRelSO Bs _ L₂ I.toRel φ) true) := by
    intro A' inst _ _
    rw [sorealize_inf_embed (pullBlocks f.Tag f.dim Bs) _ A' inst _ _ true,
      I.toRel.realize_domNonemptyS A']
    refine and_congr_right fun hne => ?_
    have : Finite (I.toRel.MapRel A') := I.toRel.mapRel_finite A'
    exact (hφ (I.toRel.MapRel A')).trans (sorealize_pullRelSO I.toRel A' Bs φ true)

  obtain ⟨Bs', χ, hlen', hχ⟩ :=
    exists_expand_sorealize I.ind (pullBlocks f.Tag f.dim Bs)
      (by intro hnil; rw [hnil] at hSlen; exact absurd hSlen (by simp)) _ true

  refine sigmaSODefinable_of_orderPull Bs' (hlen'.trans hSlen) χ ?_
  intro A _ _ _
  have key : ∀ lo : LinearOrder A,
      (letI := lo
       P A ↔ SORealize (L₁.sum Language.order) A Bs' χ true) := by
    intro lo
    let := lo
    have hfinI : Finite (I.Map A) := I.map_finite A
    have hne : Nonempty (I.Map A) := f.map_nonempty A
    have hpair : Q (I.Map A) ↔ (Nonempty (I.Map A) ∧ Q (I.Map A)) :=
      ⟨fun hQ => ⟨hne, hQ⟩, fun hh => hh.2⟩
    refine (f.correct A).trans (Iff.trans hpair (Iff.trans ?_
      (hχ A _ ‹Finite A› ‹Nonempty A›)))
    exact hS A (I.expStructure A) ‹Finite A› ‹Nonempty A›
  exact ⟨fun hP => ⟨finiteLinearOrder A, (key _).mp hP⟩, fun ⟨lo, h⟩ => (key lo).mpr h⟩

/
complementation. -/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.PiSODefinable.of_lfpReduction_succ
statement:
theorem PiSODefinable.of_lfpReduction_succ (f : P ≤ˡᶠᵖ Q)
    (h : PiSODefinable (k + 1) Q) : PiSODefinable (k + 1) P
proof:
:=
  (piSODefinable_iff_compl (k + 1) P).mpr
    (SigmaSODefinable.of_lfpReduction_succ f.compl
      ((piSODefinable_iff_compl (k + 1) Q).mp h))

name: DescriptiveComplexity.PFPDefinable.of_lfpReduction
statement:
theorem PFPDefinable.of_lfpReduction (f : P ≤ˡᶠᵖ Q) (h : PFPDefinable Q) :
    PFPDefinable P
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := h
  let := f.tagFinite
  let : LinearOrder f.Tag := finiteLinearOrder f.Tag
  set I := f.toInterpretation with hI
  refine ⟨I.ind.stratifyPFP (d.pullRel I.ordExtend.toRel), ?_⟩
  intro A _ _ _ _
  let := I.mapLinearOrder A
  have : Finite (I.Map A) := I.map_finite A
  have : Nonempty (I.Map A) := f.map_nonempty A
  refine (f.correct A).trans ((hd (I.Map A)).trans ?_)

  have hstrat := I.ind.pfpHolds_stratifyPFP (A := A) (d.pullRel I.ordExtend.toRel)
  refine Iff.trans ?_ hstrat.symm

  let : ((L₁.sum Language.order).sum I.ordExtend.ind.B.lang).Structure A :=
    I.ordExtend.expStructure A
  have hpull := StepDef.pfpHolds_pullRel (A := A) d I.ordExtend.toRel
  refine Iff.trans ?_ hpull.symm
  exact (@StepDef.pfpHolds_equiv (L₂.sum Language.order) d (I.ordExtend.Map A) (I.Map A)
    (LFPInterpretation.mapStructure I.ordExtend A)
    (letI := I.mapLinearOrder A; sumOrderStructure L₂ (I.Map A))
    (I.ordExtendLEquiv A)).symm

/

    (PFPDefinable.of_lfpReduction f ((pfpDefinable_iff_mem_PSPACE Q).mpr h))

name: DescriptiveComplexity.nonemptyMark_foDefinable
statement: theorem nonemptyMark_foDefinable : FODefinable NONEMPTYMARK
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨nonemptyMarkS, fun A _ _ _ _ => ?_⟩
  rw [Sentence.Realize, nonemptyMarkS, Formula.realize_iExs]
  simp only [Formula.realize_rel₁, Term.realize_var, Sum.elim_inr]
  exact ⟨fun ⟨x, hx⟩ => ⟨fun _ => x, hx⟩, fun ⟨v, hv⟩ => ⟨v 0, hv⟩⟩

/-! ### EVEN reduces to it, in FO(LFP) -/

/
marked exactly when the induction `d` – which will be one defining EVEN –
answers yes. Its marking formula is the output sentence of `d`, read with a
free variable it does not use. -/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.relMap_evenMarkInterp
statement:
theorem relMap_evenMarkInterp (A : Type) [Language.empty.Structure A] [LinearOrder A]
    (xs : Fin 1 → (evenMarkInterp d).Map A) :
    RelMap (M := (evenMarkInterp d).Map A) Language.markedSetMark xs ↔ d.IFPHolds A
proof:
:= by
  let := (evenMarkInterp d).expStructure A
  rw [StepDef.IFPHolds]
  refine Iff.trans (Formula.realize_relabel (g := fun z : Empty => z.elim)) ?_
  exact iff_of_eq (congrArg _ (Subsingleton.elim _ _))

/
domain formula is `⊤`. -/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.evenMarkInterp_nonempty
statement:
theorem evenMarkInterp_nonempty (A : Type) [Language.empty.Structure A] [LinearOrder A]
    [Nonempty A] : Nonempty ((evenMarkInterp d).Map A)
proof:
:=
  letI := (evenMarkInterp d).expStructure A
  ⟨⟨((), fun _ => Classical.arbitrary A), Formula.realize_top.mpr trivial⟩⟩

/
when the universe is even and nothing when it is odd, the decision being made
by the induction that puts EVEN in PTIME. -/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.even_lfpReduction_nonemptyMark
statement: theorem even_lfpReduction_nonemptyMark : Nonempty (EVEN ≤ˡᶠᵖ NONEMPTYMARK)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := (ifpDefinable_iff_mem_PTIME EVEN).mpr even_mem_PTIME
  refine ⟨{ Tag := Unit
            dim := 1
            toInterpretation := evenMarkInterp d
            map_nonempty := fun A _ _ _ _ => evenMarkInterp_nonempty A
            correct := fun A _ _ _ _ => ?_ }⟩
  have hne : Nonempty ((evenMarkInterp d).Map A) := evenMarkInterp_nonempty A
  refine (hd A).trans ⟨fun hIFP => ?_, fun ⟨x, hx⟩ => ?_⟩
  · exact ⟨hne.some, (relMap_evenMarkInterp A _).mpr hIFP⟩
  · exact (relMap_evenMarkInterp A _).mp hx

/-! ### The separation -/

/
first-order definable and EVEN is not, and definability travels backward along
first-order reductions. -/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.even_not_orderedReduction_nonemptyMark
statement: theorem even_not_orderedReduction_nonemptyMark : IsEmpty (EVEN ≤ᶠᵒ[≤] NONEMPTYMARK)
proof:
:=
  even_not_le_of_foDefinable nonemptyMark_foDefinable

/
EVEN as the witness: it reduces to `DescriptiveComplexity.NONEMPTYMARK` in
FO(LFP) and by no first-order reduction. No complexity-theoretic assumption
enters either half. -/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.exists_lfpReduction_not_orderedReduction
statement:
theorem exists_lfpReduction_not_orderedReduction :
    ∃ (L : Language.{0, 0}) (_ : L.IsRelational) (Q : DecisionProblem L),
      Nonempty (EVEN ≤ˡᶠᵖ Q) ∧ IsEmpty (EVEN ≤ᶠᵒ[≤] Q)
proof:
:=
  ⟨Language.markedSet, inferInstance, NONEMPTYMARK,
    even_lfpReduction_nonemptyMark, even_not_orderedReduction_nonemptyMark⟩

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SOBlock.mapAssign_botAssign
statement:
theorem SOBlock.mapAssign_botAssign (B : SOBlock) {A A' : Type} (e : A ≃ A') :
    B.mapAssign e (B.botAssign A) = B.botAssign A'
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DescriptiveComplexity.realize_formula_of_equiv
proof:
:=
  letI := instM
  letI := instN
  StrongHomClass.realize_formula φ (g := e)

/-! ### The data of a simultaneous induction -/

/
first-order step formula per variable – over the base vocabulary expanded by
the block, its free variables the arguments of the variable – and an output
sentence over the same expanded vocabulary, read at the value of the
iteration. The step formulas are *unrestricted*; which iteration is applied to
them (inflationary or partial) is chosen by the logics built on this data. -/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.StepDef.inflStage_succ
statement:
theorem inflStage_succ (n : ℕ) :
    d.inflStage A (n + 1) = d.inflStep (d.inflStage A n)
proof:
:=
  Function.iterate_succ_apply' d.inflStep n (d.B.botAssign A)

name: DescriptiveComplexity.StepDef.partStage_succ
statement:
theorem partStage_succ (n : ℕ) :
    d.partStage A (n + 1) = d.next (d.partStage A n)
proof:
:=
  Function.iterate_succ_apply' d.next n (d.B.botAssign A)

/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.StepDef.inflStage_le_succ
statement:
theorem inflStage_le_succ (n : ℕ) (i : d.B.ι) (x : Fin (d.B.arity i) → A)
    (h : d.inflStage A n i x) : d.inflStage A (n + 1) i x
proof:
:= by
  rw [d.inflStage_succ]
  exact Or.inl h

/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.StepDef.inflStage_le_of_le
statement:
theorem inflStage_le_of_le {m n : ℕ} (hmn : m ≤ n) (i : d.B.ι)
    (x : Fin (d.B.arity i) → A) (h : d.inflStage A m i x) : d.inflStage A n i x
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => rwa [Nat.le_zero.mp hmn] at h
  | succ n ih =>
    rcases Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.mp (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hmn) with hlt | heq
    · exact d.inflStage_le_succ n i x (ih (Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp hlt))
    · rwa [heq] at h

/
value of a converging partial iteration does not depend on which stable stage
witnesses the convergence. -/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.StepDef.partStage_eq_of_isFixedPt
statement:
theorem partStage_eq_of_isFixedPt {m n : ℕ} (hm : IsFixedPt d.next (d.partStage A m))
    (hn : IsFixedPt d.next (d.partStage A n)) : d.partStage A m = d.partStage A n
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_total m n with h | h
  · exact (iterate_eq_of_isFixedPt hm h).symm
  · exact iterate_eq_of_isFixedPt hn h

name: DescriptiveComplexity.StepDef.exists_inflStage_succ_eq
statement:
theorem exists_inflStage_succ_eq :
    ∃ N ≤ Nat.card (BAtom d.B A), d.inflStage A (N + 1) = d.inflStage A N
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, hN, heq⟩ := exists_succ_eq_of_monotone_subset
    (c := fun n => {q : BAtom d.B A | d.inflStage A n q.1 q.2})
    (fun n q hq => d.inflStage_le_succ n q.1 q.2 hq)
  refine ⟨N, hN, ?_⟩
  funext i x
  exact propext ⟨fun h => (Set.ext_iff.mp heq ⟨i, x⟩).mp h,
    fun h => (Set.ext_iff.mp heq ⟨i, x⟩).mpr h⟩

name: DescriptiveComplexity.StepDef.isFixedPt_inflStep_card
statement:
theorem isFixedPt_inflStep_card :
    IsFixedPt d.inflStep (d.inflStage A (Nat.card (BAtom d.B A)))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, hN, heq⟩ := d.exists_inflStage_succ_eq A
  have hfix : IsFixedPt d.inflStep (d.inflStage A N) :=
    (Function.iterate_succ_apply' d.inflStep N (d.B.botAssign A)).symm.trans heq
  have hc : d.inflStage A (Nat.card (BAtom d.B A)) = d.inflStage A N :=
    iterate_eq_of_isFixedPt hfix hN
  rw [hc]
  exact hfix

/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.StepDef.inflStage_eq_of_card_le
statement:
theorem inflStage_eq_of_card_le {n : ℕ} (hn : Nat.card (BAtom d.B A) ≤ n) :
    d.inflStage A n = d.inflStage A (Nat.card (BAtom d.B A))
proof:
:=
  iterate_eq_of_isFixedPt (d.isFixedPt_inflStep_card A) hn

name: DescriptiveComplexity.StepDef.inflLimit_eq_stage_card
statement:
theorem inflLimit_eq_stage_card :
    d.inflLimit A = d.inflStage A (Nat.card (BAtom d.B A))
proof:
:= by
  funext i x
  refine propext ⟨?_, fun h => ⟨_, h⟩⟩
  rintro ⟨n, hn⟩
  rcases le_or_gt n (Nat.card (BAtom d.B A)) with hle | hlt
  · exact d.inflStage_le_of_le hle i x hn
  · rw [← d.inflStage_eq_of_card_le hlt.le]
    exact hn

name: DescriptiveComplexity.StepDef.isFixedPt_inflStep_inflLimit
statement: theorem isFixedPt_inflStep_inflLimit : IsFixedPt d.inflStep (d.inflLimit A)
proof:
:= by
  rw [d.inflLimit_eq_stage_card A]
  exact d.isFixedPt_inflStep_card A

name: DescriptiveComplexity.StepDef.exists_isFixedPt_partStage_iff
statement:
theorem exists_isFixedPt_partStage_iff :
    (∃ n, IsFixedPt d.next (d.partStage A n)) ↔
      IsFixedPt d.next (d.partStage A (Nat.card (d.B.Assignment A)))
proof:
:=
  (isFixedPt_iterate_card_iff d.next (d.B.botAssign A)).symm

name: DescriptiveComplexity.StepDef.next_map
statement:
theorem next_map (ρ : d.B.Assignment M) :
    d.next (d.B.mapAssign e.toEquiv ρ) = d.B.mapAssign e.toEquiv (d.next ρ)
proof:
:= by
  funext i x
  refine propext ?_
  have h := realize_formula_of_equiv (d.B.extendEquiv' (L' := L) e ρ) (d.step i)
    (fun j => e.toEquiv.symm (x j))
  refine Iff.trans (iff_of_eq (congrArg _ ?_)) h
  exact funext fun j => (e.toEquiv.apply_symm_apply (x j)).symm

/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.StepDef.inflStep_map
statement:
theorem inflStep_map (ρ : d.B.Assignment M) :
    d.inflStep (d.B.mapAssign e.toEquiv ρ) = d.B.mapAssign e.toEquiv (d.inflStep ρ)
proof:
:= by
  funext i x
  have h := congrFun (congrFun (d.next_map e ρ) i) x
  exact congrArg (fun p => d.B.mapAssign e.toEquiv ρ i x ∨ p) h

/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.StepDef.inflStage_map
statement:
theorem inflStage_map (n : ℕ) :
    d.inflStage N n = d.B.mapAssign e.toEquiv (d.inflStage M n)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact (d.B.mapAssign_botAssign e.toEquiv).symm
  | succ n ih => rw [d.inflStage_succ, d.inflStage_succ, ih, d.inflStep_map]

/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.StepDef.partStage_map
statement:
theorem partStage_map (n : ℕ) :
    d.partStage N n = d.B.mapAssign e.toEquiv (d.partStage M n)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact (d.B.mapAssign_botAssign e.toEquiv).symm
  | succ n ih => rw [d.partStage_succ, d.partStage_succ, ih, d.next_map]

/
isomorphism. -/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.StepDef.inflLimit_map
statement: theorem inflLimit_map : d.inflLimit N = d.B.mapAssign e.toEquiv (d.inflLimit M)
proof:
:= by
  funext i x
  refine propext ?_
  change (∃ n, d.inflStage N n i x) ↔ ∃ n, d.inflStage M n i fun j => e.toEquiv.symm (x j)
  refine exists_congr fun n => iff_of_eq ?_
  exact congrFun (congrFun (d.inflStage_map e n) i) x

/
assignment along an isomorphism. -/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.StepDef.isFixedPt_next_map_iff
statement:
theorem isFixedPt_next_map_iff (ρ : d.B.Assignment M) :
    IsFixedPt d.next (d.B.mapAssign e.toEquiv ρ) ↔ IsFixedPt d.next ρ
proof:
:= by
  have hinj : Function.Injective (d.B.mapAssign (A := M) (A' := N) e.toEquiv) :=
    (d.B.assignEquiv e.toEquiv).injective
  exact ⟨fun h => hinj ((d.next_map e ρ).symm.trans h),
    fun h => (d.next_map e ρ).trans (congrArg _ h)⟩

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SOBlock.pullAssign_botAssign
statement:
theorem SOBlock.pullAssign_botAssign (B : SOBlock) {Tag : Type} [Finite Tag]
    {dm : ℕ} {A : Type} :
    B.pullAssign (B.botAssign (Tag × (Fin dm → A))) = (B.pull Tag dm).botAssign A
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DescriptiveComplexity.StepDef.next_pull
statement:
theorem next_pull (ρ : dd.B.Assignment (I.Map A)) :
    (dd.pull I).next (dd.B.pullAssign ρ) = dd.B.pullAssign (dd.next (A := I.Map A) ρ)
proof:
:= by
  funext p x
  refine propext ?_
  let := (dd.B.pull Tag dm).structure₁ (L := L₁) (dd.B.pullAssign ρ)
  have h1 := realize_guardPull (I.extendSO dd.B) (dd.step p.1) p.2 x
  have h2 := realize_formula_of_equiv (I.extendSOEquiv dd.B A ρ) (dd.step p.1)
    (tagVal (I.extendSO dd.B) p.2 x)
  exact h1.trans h2.symm

/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.StepDef.inflStep_pull
statement:
theorem inflStep_pull (ρ : dd.B.Assignment (I.Map A)) :
    (dd.pull I).inflStep (dd.B.pullAssign ρ) = dd.B.pullAssign (dd.inflStep (A := I.Map A) ρ)
proof:
:= by
  funext p x
  have h := congrFun (congrFun (next_pull I dd ρ) p) x
  exact congrArg (fun t => dd.B.pullAssign ρ p x ∨ t) h

name: DescriptiveComplexity.StepDef.inflStage_pull

proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact (dd.B.pullAssign_botAssign).symm
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [(dd.pull I).inflStage_succ, dd.inflStage_succ, ih, inflStep_pull]

name: DescriptiveComplexity.StepDef.inflLimit_pull
statement:

    (dd.pull I).inflLimit A = dd.B.pullAssign (dd.inflLimit (I.Map A))
proof:
:= by
  funext p x
  refine propext ?_
  change (∃ n, (dd.pull I).inflStage A n p x) ↔ ∃ n, dd.inflStage (I.Map A) n p.1 _
  refine exists_congr fun n => iff_of_eq ?_
  exact congrFun (congrFun (inflStage_pull I dd A n) p) x

back: the pullback of assignments is a bijection
(`DescriptiveComplexity.SOBlock.mergeAssign_pullAssign`) intertwining the two

name: DescriptiveComplexity.StepDef.isFixedPt_next_pull_iff
statement:
theorem isFixedPt_next_pull_iff (ρ : dd.B.Assignment (I.Map A)) :
    IsFixedPt (dd.pull I).next (dd.B.pullAssign ρ) ↔ IsFixedPt dd.next ρ
proof:
:= by
  have hinj : Function.Injective
      (dd.B.pullAssign (Tag := Tag) (d := dm) (A := A)) :=
    Function.LeftInverse.injective (g := dd.B.mergeAssign)
      fun σ => dd.B.mergeAssign_pullAssign σ
  exact ⟨fun h => hinj ((next_pull I dd ρ).symm.trans h),
    fun h => (next_pull I dd ρ).trans (congrArg _ h)⟩

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SOBlock.pullAssignRel_iff
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨h, hρ⟩
    have hfun : (fun k => (⟨(τ k, fun j => x (finProdFinEquiv (k, j))), h k⟩ :
        I.MapRel A)) = y :=
      funext fun k => Subtype.ext (hy k).symm
    rwa [hfun] at hρ
  · intro hρ
    have h : ∀ k, (I.domFormula (τ k)).Realize fun j => x (finProdFinEquiv (k, j)) := by
      intro k
      have h2 := (y k).2
      rw [hy k] at h2
      exact h2
    refine ⟨h, ?_⟩
    have hfun : (fun k => (⟨(τ k, fun j => x (finProdFinEquiv (k, j))), h k⟩ :
        I.MapRel A)) = y :=
      funext fun k => Subtype.ext (hy k).symm
    rwa [hfun]

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SOBlock.pullAssignRel_botAssign
statement:
theorem SOBlock.pullAssignRel_botAssign (B : SOBlock)
    (I : RelFOInterpretation L₁ L₂ Tag dm) {A : Type} [L₁.Structure A] :
    B.pullAssignRel I (B.botAssign (I.MapRel A)) = (B.pull Tag dm).botAssign A
proof:
:= by
  funext p x
  refine propext ⟨?_, False.elim⟩
  rintro ⟨hdom, h⟩
  exact h

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SOBlock.pullAssignRel_injective
statement:
theorem SOBlock.pullAssignRel_injective (B : SOBlock)
    (I : RelFOInterpretation L₁ L₂ Tag dm) {A : Type} [L₁.Structure A] :
    Function.Injective (B.pullAssignRel I (A := A))
proof:
:= by
  intro ρ ρ' h
  funext i y
  have key := congrFun (congrFun h ⟨i, fun k => (y k).1.1⟩)
    fun m => (y (finProdFinEquiv.symm m).1).1.2 (finProdFinEquiv.symm m).2
  have hcoord : ∀ (k : Fin (B.arity i)) (j : Fin dm),
      (y (finProdFinEquiv.symm (finProdFinEquiv (k, j))).1).1.2
        (finProdFinEquiv.symm (finProdFinEquiv (k, j))).2 = (y k).1.2 j :=
    fun k j => congrArg (fun z : Fin (B.arity i) × Fin dm => (y z.1).1.2 z.2)
      (Equiv.symm_apply_apply finProdFinEquiv (k, j))
  have hy : ∀ k, (y k).1 = ((y k).1.1,
      fun j => (y (finProdFinEquiv.symm (finProdFinEquiv (k, j))).1).1.2
        (finProdFinEquiv.symm (finProdFinEquiv (k, j))).2) :=
    fun k => congrArg (Prod.mk (y k).1.1) (funext fun j => (hcoord k j).symm)
  refine propext ⟨fun hρ => ?_, fun hρ => ?_⟩
  · exact (B.pullAssignRel_iff I ρ' y hy).mp
      (key ▸ (B.pullAssignRel_iff I ρ y hy).mpr hρ)
  · exact (B.pullAssignRel_iff I ρ y hy).mp
      (key ▸ (B.pullAssignRel_iff I ρ' y hy).mpr hρ)

name: DescriptiveComplexity.realize_domGateF
statement:
theorem realize_domGateF (I : RelFOInterpretation L₁ L₂ Tag dm) (B : SOBlock)
    (p : (B.pull Tag dm).ι) {A : Type} [L₁.Structure A]
    (σ : (B.pull Tag dm).Assignment A) (x : Fin (B.arity p.1 * dm) → A) :
    (@Formula.Realize _ A ((B.pull Tag dm).structure₁ (L := L₁) σ) _ (domGateF I B p) x) ↔
      ∀ k, (I.domFormula (p.2 k)).Realize fun j => x (finProdFinEquiv (k, j))
proof:
:= by
  let := (B.pull Tag dm).structure σ
  rw [domGateF, Formula.realize_iInf]
  refine forall_congr' fun k => ?_
  rw [LHom.realize_onFormula, Formula.realize_relabel]
  exact Iff.rfl

/
assignment: the relativized sibling of `DescriptiveComplexity.guardPull`. -/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.realize_guardPullRel
statement:
theorem realize_guardPullRel {L₃ L₄ : Language.{0, 0}} [L₄.IsRelational]
    (J : RelFOInterpretation L₃ L₄ Tag dm) {A : Type} [L₃.Structure A] {k : ℕ}
    (φ : L₄.Formula (Fin k)) (t : Fin k → Tag) (w : Fin (k * dm) → A)
    (hw : ∀ q, (J.domFormula (t q)).Realize fun j => w (finProdFinEquiv (q, j))) :
    (guardPullRel J φ t).Realize w ↔
      φ.Realize (M := J.MapRel A)
        fun q => ⟨(t q, fun j => w (finProdFinEquiv (q, j))), hw q⟩
proof:
:= by
  have hv : ∀ b : Fin k ⊕ Fin 0,
      (J.domFormula (Sum.elim t finZeroElim b)).Realize fun j =>
        (w ∘ fun p : (Fin k ⊕ Fin 0) × Fin dm =>
          finProdFinEquiv (Sum.elim id finZeroElim p.1, p.2)) (b, j) := by
    rintro (q | z)
    · exact hw q
    · exact z.elim0
  rw [guardPullRel, Formula.realize_relabel,
    J.realize_pullRel (φ : L₄.BoundedFormula (Fin k) 0) (Sum.elim t finZeroElim) _ hv]
  exact iff_of_eq (congrArg₂
    (fun a b => BoundedFormula.Realize (M := J.MapRel A)
      (φ : L₄.BoundedFormula (Fin k) 0) a b)
    (funext fun q => rfl) (Subsingleton.elim _ _))

name: DescriptiveComplexity.realize_extendSORel_domFormula
statement:
theorem realize_extendSORel_domFormula (I : RelFOInterpretation L₁ L₂ Tag dm)
    (B : SOBlock) {A : Type} [L₁.Structure A] (σ : (B.pull Tag dm).Assignment A)
    (t : Tag) (w : Fin dm → A) :
    (@Formula.Realize _ A ((B.pull Tag dm).structure₁ (L := L₁) σ) _
      ((I.extendSORel B).domFormula t) w) ↔ (I.domFormula t).Realize w
proof:
:= by
  let := (B.pull Tag dm).structure σ
  exact LHom.realize_onFormula LHom.sumInl (I.domFormula t)

name: DescriptiveComplexity.StepDef.next_pullRel
statement:
theorem next_pullRel (ρ : dd.B.Assignment (I.MapRel A)) :
    (dd.pullRel I).next (dd.B.pullAssignRel I ρ) =
      dd.B.pullAssignRel I (dd.next (A := I.MapRel A) ρ)
proof:
:= by
  funext p x
  let := (dd.B.pull Tag dm).structure (dd.B.pullAssignRel I ρ)
  have hsplit : (@Formula.Realize _ A ((dd.B.pull Tag dm).structure₁ (L := L₁)
        (dd.B.pullAssignRel I ρ)) _
        (domGateF I dd.B p ⊓ guardPullRel (I.extendSORel dd.B) (dd.step p.1) p.2) x) ↔
      ((@Formula.Realize _ A ((dd.B.pull Tag dm).structure₁ (L := L₁)
          (dd.B.pullAssignRel I ρ)) _ (domGateF I dd.B p) x) ∧
        (@Formula.Realize _ A ((dd.B.pull Tag dm).structure₁ (L := L₁)
          (dd.B.pullAssignRel I ρ)) _
          (guardPullRel (I.extendSORel dd.B) (dd.step p.1) p.2) x)) :=
    Formula.realize_inf
  refine propext (hsplit.trans ?_)
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hdom', hstep⟩
    have hdom := (realize_domGateF I dd.B p _ x).mp hdom'
    have hdomE : ∀ q, ((I.extendSORel dd.B).domFormula (p.2 q)).Realize
        fun j => x (finProdFinEquiv (q, j)) := fun q =>
      (realize_extendSORel_domFormula I dd.B (dd.B.pullAssignRel I ρ) (p.2 q) _).mpr
        (hdom q)
    have h1 := (realize_guardPullRel (I.extendSORel dd.B) (dd.step p.1) p.2 x
      hdomE).mp hstep
    have h2 := (realize_formula_of_equiv (I.extendSORelEquiv dd.B A ρ) (dd.step p.1)
      (fun q => ⟨(p.2 q, fun j => x (finProdFinEquiv (q, j))), hdomE q⟩)).mpr h1
    exact (dd.B.pullAssignRel_iff I (dd.next ρ) (τ := p.2) (x := x)
      (fun q => (I.extendSORelEquiv dd.B A ρ)
        ⟨(p.2 q, fun j => x (finProdFinEquiv (q, j))), hdomE q⟩)
      (fun q => rfl)).mpr h2
  · rintro ⟨hdom, hρ⟩
    have hdomE : ∀ q, ((I.extendSORel dd.B).domFormula (p.2 q)).Realize
        fun j => x (finProdFinEquiv (q, j)) := fun q =>
      (realize_extendSORel_domFormula I dd.B (dd.B.pullAssignRel I ρ) (p.2 q) _).mpr
        (hdom q)
    refine ⟨(realize_domGateF I dd.B p _ x).mpr hdom, ?_⟩
    refine (realize_guardPullRel (I.extendSORel dd.B) (dd.step p.1) p.2 x hdomE).mpr ?_
    refine (realize_formula_of_equiv (I.extendSORelEquiv dd.B A ρ) (dd.step p.1)
      (fun q => ⟨(p.2 q, fun j => x (finProdFinEquiv (q, j))), hdomE q⟩)).mp ?_
    exact (dd.B.pullAssignRel_iff I (dd.next ρ) (τ := p.2) (x := x)
      (fun q => (I.extendSORelEquiv dd.B A ρ)
        ⟨(p.2 q, fun j => x (finProdFinEquiv (q, j))), hdomE q⟩)
      (fun q => rfl)).mp ⟨hdom, hρ⟩

statement:

    (dd.pullRel I).partStage A n =

name: DescriptiveComplexity.StepDef.inflStep_pullRel
statement:
theorem inflStep_pullRel (ρ : dd.B.Assignment (I.MapRel A)) :

      dd.B.pullAssignRel I (dd.inflStep (A := I.MapRel A) ρ)
proof:
:= by

    · exact ⟨h, Or.inl hp⟩
    · obtain ⟨h, hq'⟩ := hnext ▸ hq
      exact ⟨h, Or.inr hq'⟩
  · rintro ⟨h, hp | hq⟩
    · exact Or.inl ⟨h, hp⟩
    · exact Or.inr (hnext.symm ▸ (⟨h, hq⟩ :
        dd.B.pullAssignRel I (dd.next (A := I.MapRel A) ρ) p x))

  have hstage : ∀ n, (dd.pullRel I).inflStage A n p x ↔

  constructor
  · rintro ⟨n, hn⟩
    obtain ⟨h, hρ⟩ := (hstage n).mp hn
    exact ⟨h, ⟨n, hρ⟩⟩

theorem isFixedPt_next_pullRel_iff (ρ : dd.B.Assignment (I.MapRel A)) :

name: DescriptiveComplexity.StepDef.ifpHolds_pullRel
statement: theorem ifpHolds_pullRel : (dd.pullRel I).IFPHolds A ↔ dd.IFPHolds (I.MapRel A)
proof:
:= by
  rw [IFPHolds, IFPHolds, inflLimit_pullRel dd I]
  let := (dd.B.pull Tag dm).structure (dd.B.pullAssignRel I (dd.inflLimit (I.MapRel A)))
  have hpull := (I.extendSORel dd.B).realize_pullRelSentence dd.out A
  have htrans := realize_sentence_of_equiv
    (I.extendSORelEquiv dd.B A (dd.inflLimit (I.MapRel A))) dd.out
  exact hpull.trans htrans

name: DescriptiveComplexity.StepDef.pfpHolds_pullRel
statement: theorem pfpHolds_pullRel : (dd.pullRel I).PFPHolds A ↔ dd.PFPHolds (I.MapRel A)
proof:
:= by
  rw [PFPHolds, PFPHolds]
  refine exists_congr fun n => ?_
  rw [partStage_pullRel dd I n]
  refine and_congr (isFixedPt_next_pullRel_iff dd I _) ?_
  let := (dd.B.pull Tag dm).structure
    (dd.B.pullAssignRel I (dd.partStage (I.MapRel A) n))
  have hpull := (I.extendSORel dd.B).realize_pullRelSentence dd.out A
  have htrans := realize_sentence_of_equiv
    (I.extendSORelEquiv dd.B A (dd.partStage (I.MapRel A) n)) dd.out
  exact hpull.trans htrans

name: DescriptiveComplexity.IFPDefinable.of_relOrderedReduction
statement:
theorem IFPDefinable.of_relOrderedReduction (f : P ≤ʳᶠᵒ[≤] Q) (h : IFPDefinable Q) :
    IFPDefinable P
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := h
  let := f.tagFinite
  let : LinearOrder f.Tag := finiteLinearOrder f.Tag
  refine ⟨d.pullRel f.toRelInterpretation.ordExtendRel, ?_⟩
  intro A _ _ _ _
  let := f.toRelInterpretation.mapRelLinearOrder A
  have : Finite (f.toRelInterpretation.MapRel A) := f.toRelInterpretation.mapRel_finite A
  have : Nonempty (f.toRelInterpretation.MapRel A) := f.mapRel_nonempty A
  refine (f.correct A).trans ((hd (f.toRelInterpretation.MapRel A)).trans ?_)
  refine Iff.trans ?_
    (StepDef.ifpHolds_pullRel d f.toRelInterpretation.ordExtendRel).symm
  exact (@StepDef.ifpHolds_equiv (L₂.sum Language.order) d
    (f.toRelInterpretation.ordExtendRel.MapRel A) (f.toRelInterpretation.MapRel A)
    (RelFOInterpretation.mapRelStructure f.toRelInterpretation.ordExtendRel A)
    (letI := f.toRelInterpretation.mapRelLinearOrder A
     sumOrderStructure L₂ (f.toRelInterpretation.MapRel A))
    (f.toRelInterpretation.ordExtendRelLEquiv A)).symm

/
reductions.**
Registered in the Lax archive as
[`Lax134656.PartialFixedPointClosure.pfpDefinable_of_relOrderedReduction`](https://laxarchive.org/lax-134656/Lax134656.PartialFixedPointClosure.html#s-Lax134656.PartialFixedPointClosure.pfpDefinable_of_relOrderedReduction). -/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.PFPDefinable.of_relOrderedReduction
statement:
theorem PFPDefinable.of_relOrderedReduction (f : P ≤ʳᶠᵒ[≤] Q) (h : PFPDefinable Q) :
    PFPDefinable P
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := h
  let := f.tagFinite
  let : LinearOrder f.Tag := finiteLinearOrder f.Tag
  refine ⟨d.pullRel f.toRelInterpretation.ordExtendRel, ?_⟩
  intro A _ _ _ _
  let := f.toRelInterpretation.mapRelLinearOrder A
  have : Finite (f.toRelInterpretation.MapRel A) := f.toRelInterpretation.mapRel_finite A
  have : Nonempty (f.toRelInterpretation.MapRel A) := f.mapRel_nonempty A
  refine (f.correct A).trans ((hd (f.toRelInterpretation.MapRel A)).trans ?_)
  refine Iff.trans ?_
    (StepDef.pfpHolds_pullRel d f.toRelInterpretation.ordExtendRel).symm
  exact (@StepDef.pfpHolds_equiv (L₂.sum Language.order) d
    (f.toRelInterpretation.ordExtendRel.MapRel A) (f.toRelInterpretation.MapRel A)
    (RelFOInterpretation.mapRelStructure f.toRelInterpretation.ordExtendRel A)
    (letI := f.toRelInterpretation.mapRelLinearOrder A
     sumOrderStructure L₂ (f.toRelInterpretation.MapRel A))
    (f.toRelInterpretation.ordExtendRelLEquiv A)).symm

name: DescriptiveComplexity.realize_strat1Formula
statement:
theorem realize_strat1Formula {α : Type} (σ : (stratBlock B₁ B₂).Assignment A)
    (φ : (L.sum B₁.lang).Formula α) (v : α → A) :
    (@Formula.Realize _ A ((stratBlock B₁ B₂).structure₁ (L := L) σ) _
      ((strat1LHom L B₁ B₂).onFormula φ) v) ↔
      @Formula.Realize _ A (B₁.structure₁ (L := L) (strat1Assign σ)) _ φ v
proof:
:= by

name: DescriptiveComplexity.strat2LHom_isExpansionOn
statement:
theorem strat2LHom_isExpansionOn (σ : (stratBlock B₁ B₂).Assignment A) :
    @LHom.IsExpansionOn _ _ (strat2LHom L B₁ B₂) A
      (@SOBlock.structure₁ (L.sum B₁.lang) B₂ A
        (B₁.structure₁ (L := L) (strat1Assign σ)) (strat2Assign σ))
      ((stratBlock B₁ B₂).structure₁ (L := L) σ)
proof:
:= by
  let := B₁.structure₁ (L := L) (strat1Assign σ)
  let := @SOBlock.structure₁ (L.sum B₁.lang) B₂ A _ (strat2Assign σ)
  let := (stratBlock B₁ B₂).structure₁ (L := L) σ
  refine ⟨fun {n} f x => ?_, fun {n} r x => ?_⟩
  · rcases f with (g | g) | g
    · rfl
    · exact isEmptyElim g
    · exact isEmptyElim g
  · rcases r with (s | s) | s
    · rfl
    · rfl
    · rfl
