    rw [ordEnum_zero, setCo_bot_at _ hbot]
    exact (cArg1_pt _ _ _ _).mpr
      ⟨hok, (okOn_chainN _ _ _).mpr (canon_mono hok (by rw [hl'v]; omega)), ⟨rfl, hl'v⟩, rfl⟩

name: DescriptiveComplexity.cArg2_chainPt
statement:
theorem cArg2_chainPt (i : Fin V.numSyms) (l : Fin (dimOf V)) {u : Fin (dimOf V) → A}
    (hu : Canon (l : ℕ) u) (k : ℕ) (hk : k < Nat.card A) :
    CArg2 (progPt (ProgTag.chainN i l) (setCo V (l : ℕ) (ordEnum A ⟨k, hk⟩) u))
      (chainPt V cP A i l u (k + 1))
proof:
:= by
  have hok : Canon ((l : ℕ) + 1) (setCo V (l : ℕ) (ordEnum A ⟨k, hk⟩) u) :=
    canon_setCo (by omega) _ (canon_mono hu (by omega))
  by_cases hk1 : k + 1 < Nat.card A
  · rw [chainPt, dite_eq_left hk1]
    refine (cArg2_pt _ _ _ _).mpr ⟨hok,
      (okOn_chainN _ _ _).mpr (canon_setCo (by omega) _ (canon_mono hu (by omega))),
      ⟨rfl, rfl⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [setCo_at, setCo_at]
      exact ⟨ordEnum_lt_succ hk1, ordEnum_covBy hk1⟩
    · intro j hj
      rw [setCo_apply_ne V (by omega) _ _, setCo_apply_ne V (by omega) _ _]
  · rw [chainPt, dite_eq_right hk1]
    refine (cArg2_pt _ _ _ _).mpr ⟨hok, canon_botTup _, ?_⟩
    change IsTop _
    rw [setCo_at, show (⟨k, hk⟩ : Fin (Nat.card A)) = ⟨Nat.card A - 1, by omega⟩ from
      Fin.ext (show k = Nat.card A - 1 from by omega)]
    exact isTop_ordEnum_last Nat.card_pos

name: DescriptiveComplexity.decodesTo_levelPt
statement:
theorem decodesTo_levelPt : ∀ (m : ℕ), m ≤ dimOf V → ∀ (i : Fin V.numSyms)
    (u : Fin (dimOf V) → A), Canon (dimOf V - m) u →
    DecodesTo (levelPt V cP A i m u) (levelCode V (Nat.card A) (ordEnum A) i m u)
proof:
:= by
  intro m
  induction m with
  | zero =>
    intro _ i u _
    rw [levelPt, levelCode_zero, bitPt]
    by_cases hb : bitOf V i u
    · rw [ite_eq_left hb, ite_eq_left hb]; exact decodesTo_onePt
    · rw [ite_eq_right hb, ite_eq_right hb]; exact decodesTo_zeroPt
  | succ m ih =>
    intro hm i u hu
    have hlt : dimOf V - (m + 1) < dimOf V := Nat.sub_lt (dimOf_pos V) (Nat.succ_pos m)
    set l : Fin (dimOf V) := ⟨dimOf V - (m + 1), hlt⟩ with hl
    have hlv : (l : ℕ) = dimOf V - (m + 1) := rfl
    have hlm : (l : ℕ) + m + 1 = dimOf V := by rw [hlv]; omega
    have hu' : Canon (l : ℕ) u := by rw [hlv]; exact hu
    have key : ∀ j k : ℕ, k + j = Nat.card A →
        DecodesTo (chainPt V cP A i l u k)
          (codeNestFrom (fun d : Fin (Nat.card A) =>
            levelCode V (Nat.card A) (ordEnum A) i m
              (setCo V (l : ℕ) (ordEnum A d) u)) k) := by
      intro j
      induction j with
      | zero =>
        intro k hk
        have hkn : ¬k < Nat.card A := by omega
        rw [chainPt, dite_eq_right hkn, codeNestFrom_of_ge _ hkn]
        exact decodesTo_zeroPt
      | succ j ihj =>
        intro k hk
        have hkn : k < Nat.card A := by omega
        rw [chainPt, dite_eq_left hkn, codeNestFrom_of_lt _ hkn]
        have hokk : Canon ((l : ℕ) + 1) (setCo V (l : ℕ) (ordEnum A ⟨k, hkn⟩) u) :=
          canon_setCo (by omega) _ (canon_mono hu' (by omega))
        refine ⟨(mark_pt CodeTag.pair _ _).mpr ⟨hokk, rfl⟩,
          levelPt V cP A i m (setCo V (l : ℕ) (ordEnum A ⟨k, hkn⟩) u),
          chainPt V cP A i l u (k + 1), cArg1_chainPt i l m hlm hokk,
          cArg2_chainPt i l hu' k hkn, ?_, ihj (k + 1) (by omega)⟩
        exact ih (by omega) i _ (by rw [show dimOf V - m = (l : ℕ) + 1 from by omega]; exact hokk)
    have h0 := key (Nat.card A) 0 (by omega)
    rw [levelPt, levelCode_succ]
    exact h0

name: DescriptiveComplexity.decodesTo_blockPt
statement:
theorem decodesTo_blockPt (cP : Code) (i : Fin V.numSyms) :
    DecodesTo (progPt (ProgTag.chainN i ⟨0, dimOf_pos V⟩ : ProgTag V cP) (botTup V A))
      (blockCode V (Nat.card A) (ordEnum A) (botTup V A) i)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ : ∃ d, dimOf V = d + 1 :=
    ⟨dimOf V - 1, by have := dimOf_pos V; omega⟩
  have h := decodesTo_levelPt (cP := cP) (d + 1) (by omega) i (botTup V A) (canon_botTup _)
  rw [levelPt, chainPt, dite_eq_left (Nat.card_pos (α := A))] at h
  rw [show (⟨dimOf V - (d + 1), Nat.sub_lt (dimOf_pos V) (Nat.succ_pos d)⟩ : Fin (dimOf V)) =
      ⟨0, dimOf_pos V⟩ from Fin.ext (by change dimOf V - (d + 1) = 0; omega),
    ordEnum_zero, setCo_bot_at _ isBot_botA, ← hd] at h
  rw [blockCode]
  exact h

/-! ### The chain of the blocks of the symbols -/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.decodesTo_symPt
statement:
theorem decodesTo_symPt : ∀ (j k : ℕ), k + j = V.numSyms →
    DecodesTo (symPt V cP A k)
      (codeNestFrom (blockCode V (Nat.card A) (ordEnum A) (botTup V A)) k)
proof:
:= by
  intro j
  induction j with
  | zero =>
    intro k hk
    have hkn : ¬k < V.numSyms := by omega
    rw [symPt, dite_eq_right hkn, codeNestFrom_of_ge _ hkn]
    exact decodesTo_zeroPt
  | succ j ihj =>
    intro k hk
    have hkn : k < V.numSyms := by omega
    rw [symPt, dite_eq_left hkn, codeNestFrom_of_lt _ hkn]
    refine ⟨(mark_pt CodeTag.pair _ _).mpr ⟨canon_botTup _, rfl⟩,
      progPt (ProgTag.chainN ⟨k, hkn⟩ ⟨0, dimOf_pos V⟩) (botTup V A), symPt V cP A (k + 1), ?_, ?_,
      decodesTo_blockPt _ _, ihj (k + 1) (by omega)⟩
    · exact (cArg1_pt _ _ _ _).mpr ⟨canon_botTup _, canon_botTup _, ⟨rfl, rfl⟩, isBot_botA⟩
    · by_cases hk1 : k + 1 < V.numSyms
      · rw [symPt, dite_eq_left hk1]
        exact (cArg2_pt _ _ _ _).mpr ⟨canon_botTup _, canon_botTup _, rfl⟩
      · rw [symPt, dite_eq_right hk1]
        exact (cArg2_pt _ _ _ _).mpr
          ⟨canon_botTup _, canon_botTup _, by change k + 1 = V.numSyms; omega⟩

/-! ### The numeral chain -/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.decodesTo_numPt
statement:
theorem decodesTo_numPt : ∀ (j k : ℕ), k + j = Nat.card A →
    DecodesTo (numPt V cP A k) (numCode (Nat.card A - k))
proof:
:= by
  intro j
  induction j with
  | zero =>
    intro k hk
    have hkn : ¬k < Nat.card A := by omega
    rw [numPt, dite_eq_right hkn, show Nat.card A - k = 0 from by omega, numCode]
    exact decodesTo_zeroPt
  | succ j ihj =>
    intro k hk
    have hkn : k < Nat.card A := by omega
    rw [numPt, dite_eq_left hkn, show Nat.card A - k = Nat.card A - (k + 1) + 1 from by omega,
      numCode]
    have hok : Canon 1 (setCo V 0 (ordEnum A ⟨k, hkn⟩) (botTup V A)) :=
      canon_setCo (by omega) _ (canon_botTup _)
    refine ⟨(mark_pt CodeTag.comp _ _).mpr ⟨hok, rfl⟩, progPt ProgTag.oneN (botTup V A),
      numPt V cP A (k + 1), (cArg1_pt _ _ _ _).mpr ⟨hok, canon_botTup _, trivial⟩, ?_,
      decodesTo_onePt, ihj (k + 1) (by omega)⟩
    by_cases hk1 : k + 1 < Nat.card A
    · rw [numPt, dite_eq_left hk1]
      refine (cArg2_pt _ _ _ _).mpr
        ⟨hok, canon_setCo (show (0 : ℕ) < 1 from by omega) _ (canon_botTup _), ?_⟩
      change _ < _ ∧ _
      rw [setCo_at_fz, setCo_at_fz]
      exact ⟨ordEnum_lt_succ hk1, ordEnum_covBy hk1⟩
    · rw [numPt, dite_eq_right hk1]
      refine (cArg2_pt _ _ _ _).mpr ⟨hok, canon_botTup _, ?_⟩
      change IsTop _
      rw [setCo_at_fz, show (⟨k, hkn⟩ : Fin (Nat.card A)) = ⟨Nat.card A - 1, by omega⟩ from
        Fin.ext (show k = Nat.card A - 1 from by omega)]
      exact isTop_ordEnum_last Nat.card_pos
/-! ### The whole instance -/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.decodesTo_pairPt
statement:
theorem decodesTo_pairPt (cP : Code) :
    DecodesTo (progPt (ProgTag.pairN : ProgTag V cP) (botTup V A))
      (Code.pair (numCode (Nat.card A))
        (codeNestFrom (blockCode V (Nat.card A) (ordEnum A) (botTup V A)) 0))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨(mark_pt CodeTag.pair _ _).mpr ⟨canon_botTup _, rfl⟩, numPt V cP A 0,
    symPt V cP A 0, ?_, ?_, ?_, decodesTo_symPt V.numSyms 0 (Nat.zero_add _)⟩
  · rw [numPt, dite_eq_left (Nat.card_pos (α := A))]
    refine (cArg1_pt _ _ _ _).mpr ⟨canon_botTup _,
      canon_setCo (show (0 : ℕ) < 1 from by omega) _ (canon_botTup _), ?_⟩
    change IsBot _
    rw [setCo_at_fz]
    exact isBot_ordEnum_zero _
  · by_cases hs : 0 < V.numSyms
    · rw [symPt, dite_eq_left hs]
      exact (cArg2_pt _ _ _ _).mpr ⟨canon_botTup _, canon_botTup _, rfl⟩
    · rw [symPt, dite_eq_right hs]
      exact (cArg2_pt _ _ _ _).mpr
        ⟨canon_botTup _, canon_botTup _, by change V.numSyms = 0; omega⟩
  · have h := decodesTo_numPt (V := V) (cP := cP) (A := A) (Nat.card A) 0 (Nat.zero_add _)
    rwa [Nat.sub_zero] at h

name: DescriptiveComplexity.decodesTo_rootPt
statement:
theorem decodesTo_rootPt (cP : Code) :
    DecodesTo (progPt (ProgTag.root : ProgTag V cP) (botTup V A))
      (Code.comp cP (Code.pair (numCode (Nat.card A))
        (codeNestFrom (blockCode V (Nat.card A) (ordEnum A) (botTup V A)) 0)))
proof:
:= by
  have hdraws : Draws cP fun p =>
      (progPt (ProgTag.cp p) (botTup V A) : (codeProgInterp V cP).Map A) :=
    { mark := fun _ => (mark_pt _ _ _).mpr ⟨canon_botTup _, rfl⟩
      arg1 := fun _ _ hq => (cArg1_pt _ _ _ _).mpr ⟨canon_botTup _, canon_botTup _, hq⟩
      arg2 := fun _ _ hq => (cArg2_pt _ _ _ _).mpr ⟨canon_botTup _, canon_botTup _, hq⟩ }
  have hcp := decodesTo_subPos cP _ hdraws (codeRootPos cP)
  rw [subAt_codeRootPos] at hcp
  exact ⟨(mark_pt CodeTag.comp _ _).mpr ⟨canon_botTup _, rfl⟩,
    progPt (ProgTag.cp (codeRootPos cP)) (botTup V A), progPt ProgTag.pairN (botTup V A),
    (cArg1_pt _ _ _ _).mpr ⟨canon_botTup _, canon_botTup _, rfl⟩,
    (cArg2_pt _ _ _ _).mpr ⟨canon_botTup _, canon_botTup _, trivial⟩,
    hcp, decodesTo_pairPt cP⟩

/-! ### The drawing is well formed -/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.progPt_congr
statement:
theorem progPt_congr {t t' : ProgTag V cP} {u u' : Fin (dimOf V) → A} (h : t = t') (h2 : u = u') :
    (progPt t u : (codeProgInterp V cP).Map A) = progPt t' u'
proof: := by subst h; subst h2; rfl

name: DescriptiveComplexity.canon0_ext
statement: theorem canon0_ext {u u' : Fin (dimOf V) → A} (h : Canon 0 u) (h' : Canon 0 u') : u = u'
proof:
:=
  canon_ext h h' (by omega)

name: DescriptiveComplexity.canon_one_bot
statement:
theorem canon_one_bot {u : Fin (dimOf V) → A} (h1 : Canon 1 u) (h0 : IsBot (u (fz V))) :
    Canon 0 u
proof:
:= by
  intro j _
  by_cases hj : (j : ℕ) = 0
  · rw [show j = fz V from Fin.ext hj]; exact h0
  · exact h1 j (by omega)

name: DescriptiveComplexity.okOn_numN
statement:
theorem okOn_numN (u : Fin (dimOf V) → A) :
    OkOn (ProgTag.numN : ProgTag V cP) u ↔ Canon 1 u
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: DescriptiveComplexity.arg1_det
statement:
theorem arg1_det {ta tb tb' : ProgTag V cP} {ua ub ub' : Fin (dimOf V) → A}
    (hob : OkOn tb ub) (hob' : OkOn tb' ub')
    (h : Arg1On ta tb ua ub) (h' : Arg1On ta tb' ua ub') :
    (progPt tb ub : (codeProgInterp V cP).Map A) = progPt tb' ub'
proof:
:= by
  cases ta
  case root =>
    cases tb <;> try exact h.elim
    cases tb' <;> try exact h'.elim
    exact progPt_congr (congrArg ProgTag.cp ((show _ = _ from h).trans (show _ = _ from h').symm))
      (canon0_ext hob hob')
  case cp p =>
    cases tb <;> try exact h.elim
    cases tb' <;> try exact h'.elim
    exact progPt_congr (congrArg ProgTag.cp (Option.some.inj (h.symm.trans h')))
      (canon0_ext hob hob')
  case pairN =>
    cases tb <;> try exact h.elim
    cases tb' <;> try exact h'.elim
    exact progPt_congr rfl
      (canon0_ext (canon_one_bot ((okOn_numN _).mp hob) h)
        (canon_one_bot ((okOn_numN _).mp hob') h'))
  case numN =>
    cases tb <;> try exact h.elim
    cases tb' <;> try exact h'.elim
    exact progPt_congr rfl (canon0_ext hob hob')
  case symN i =>
    cases tb <;> try exact h.elim
    rename_i i₁ l₁
    obtain ⟨⟨hi₁, hl₁⟩, hb₁⟩ := h
    cases tb' <;> try exact h'.elim
    rename_i i₂ l₂
    obtain ⟨⟨hi₂, hl₂⟩, hb₂⟩ := h'
    have hc₁ : Canon 1 ub := by simpa [hl₁] using (okOn_chainN _ _ _).mp hob
    have hc₂ : Canon 1 ub' := by simpa [hl₂] using (okOn_chainN _ _ _).mp hob'
    exact progPt_congr (by rw [← hi₁, ← hi₂, Fin.ext (hl₁.trans hl₂.symm)])
      (canon0_ext (canon_one_bot hc₁ hb₁) (canon_one_bot hc₂ hb₂))
  case chainN i l =>
    cases tb <;> try exact h.elim
    · rename_i i₁ l₁
      obtain ⟨⟨hi₁, hl₁⟩, hu₁⟩ := h
      cases tb' <;> try exact h'.elim
      · rename_i i₂ l₂
        obtain ⟨⟨hi₂, hl₂⟩, hu₂⟩ := h'
        exact progPt_congr (by rw [← hi₁, ← hi₂, Fin.ext (hl₁.trans hl₂.symm)])
          (hu₁.trans hu₂.symm)
      · obtain ⟨hd, -⟩ := h'
        exact absurd l₁.isLt (by omega)
      · obtain ⟨hd, -⟩ := h'
        exact absurd l₁.isLt (by omega)
    · obtain ⟨hd, hbit⟩ := h
      cases tb' <;> try exact h'.elim
      · rename_i i₂ l₂
        obtain ⟨⟨-, hl₂⟩, -⟩ := h'
        exact absurd l₂.isLt (by omega)
      · exact progPt_congr rfl (canon0_ext hob hob')
      · exact absurd hbit h'.2
    · obtain ⟨hd, hbit⟩ := h
      cases tb' <;> try exact h'.elim
      · rename_i i₂ l₂
        obtain ⟨⟨-, hl₂⟩, -⟩ := h'
        exact absurd l₂.isLt (by omega)
      · exact absurd h'.2 hbit
      · exact progPt_congr rfl (canon0_ext hob hob')
  case oneN => exact h.elim
  case zeroN => exact h.elim

name: DescriptiveComplexity.arg2_det
statement:
theorem arg2_det {ta tb tb' : ProgTag V cP} {ua ub ub' : Fin (dimOf V) → A}
    (hob : OkOn tb ub) (hob' : OkOn tb' ub')
    (h : Arg2On ta tb ua ub) (h' : Arg2On ta tb' ua ub') :
    (progPt tb ub : (codeProgInterp V cP).Map A) = progPt tb' ub'
proof:
:= by
  cases ta
  case root =>
    cases tb <;> try exact h.elim
    cases tb' <;> try exact h'.elim
    exact progPt_congr rfl (canon0_ext hob hob')
  case cp p =>
    cases tb <;> try exact h.elim
    cases tb' <;> try exact h'.elim
    exact progPt_congr (congrArg ProgTag.cp (Option.some.inj (h.symm.trans h')))
      (canon0_ext hob hob')
  case pairN =>
    cases tb <;> try exact h.elim
    · rename_i i₁
      cases tb' <;> try exact h'.elim
      · exact progPt_congr (congrArg ProgTag.symN (Fin.ext ((show _ = _ from h).trans
          (show _ = _ from h').symm))) (canon0_ext hob hob')
      · exact absurd i₁.isLt (by have hz : V.numSyms = 0 := h'; omega)
    · cases tb' <;> try exact h'.elim
      · rename_i i₂
        exact absurd i₂.isLt (by have hz : V.numSyms = 0 := h; omega)
      · exact progPt_congr rfl (canon0_ext hob hob')
  case numN =>
    cases tb <;> try exact h.elim
    · cases tb' <;> try exact h'.elim
      · refine progPt_congr rfl (canon_ext ((okOn_numN _).mp hob) ((okOn_numN _).mp hob')
          fun j hj => ?_)
        rw [show j = fz V from Fin.ext (show (j : ℕ) = 0 from by omega)]
        exact cov_unique h.1 h.2 h'.1 h'.2
      · exact absurd h' (not_isTop_of_lt h.1)
    · cases tb' <;> try exact h'.elim
      · exact absurd h (not_isTop_of_lt h'.1)
      · exact progPt_congr rfl (canon0_ext hob hob')
  case symN i =>
    cases tb <;> try exact h.elim
    · rename_i i₁
      cases tb' <;> try exact h'.elim
      · exact progPt_congr (congrArg ProgTag.symN (Fin.ext ((show _ = _ from h).trans
          (show _ = _ from h').symm))) (canon0_ext hob hob')
      · exact absurd i₁.isLt (by
          have h1 : (i₁ : ℕ) = (i : ℕ) + 1 := h
          have h2 : (i : ℕ) + 1 = V.numSyms := h'
          omega)
    · cases tb' <;> try exact h'.elim
      · rename_i i₂
        exact absurd i₂.isLt (by
          have h1 : (i₂ : ℕ) = (i : ℕ) + 1 := h'
          have h2 : (i : ℕ) + 1 = V.numSyms := h
          omega)
      · exact progPt_congr rfl (canon0_ext hob hob')
  case chainN i l =>
    cases tb <;> try exact h.elim
    · rename_i i₁ l₁
      obtain ⟨⟨hi₁, hl₁⟩, hcov₁, hag₁⟩ := h
      subst hl₁
      cases tb' <;> try exact h'.elim
      · rename_i i₂ l₂
        obtain ⟨⟨hi₂, hl₂⟩, hcov₂, hag₂⟩ := h'
        subst hl₂
        refine progPt_congr (by rw [← hi₁, ← hi₂]) (canon_ext ((okOn_chainN _ _ _).mp hob)
          ((okOn_chainN _ _ _).mp hob') fun j hj => ?_)
        rcases Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.mp hj with hj' | hj'
        · rw [hag₁ j hj', hag₂ j hj']
        · rw [show j = l from Fin.ext hj']
          exact cov_unique hcov₁.1 hcov₁.2 hcov₂.1 hcov₂.2
      · exact absurd h' (not_isTop_of_lt hcov₁.1)
    · cases tb' <;> try exact h'.elim
      · rename_i i₂ l₂
        exact absurd h (not_isTop_of_lt h'.2.1.1)
      · exact progPt_congr rfl (canon0_ext hob hob')
  case oneN => exact h.elim
  case zeroN => exact h.elim

name: DescriptiveComplexity.codeWF_codeProg
statement:
theorem codeWF_codeProg : CodeWF ((codeProgInterp V cP).Map A) where
  exclusive a t t' h1 h2
proof:
:= by
    obtain ⟨tg, u, rfl⟩ := exists_progPt a
    exact ((mark_pt t tg u).mp h1).2.symm.trans ((mark_pt t' tg u).mp h2).2
  arg1_fun a b b' h1 h2 := by
    obtain ⟨ta, ua, rfl⟩ := exists_progPt a
    obtain ⟨tb, ub, rfl⟩ := exists_progPt b
    obtain ⟨tb', ub', rfl⟩ := exists_progPt b'
    obtain ⟨-, hob, hab⟩ := (cArg1_pt _ _ _ _).mp h1
    obtain ⟨-, hob', hab'⟩ := (cArg1_pt _ _ _ _).mp h2
    exact arg1_det hob hob' hab hab'
  arg2_fun a b b' h1 h2 := by
    obtain ⟨ta, ua, rfl⟩ := exists_progPt a
    obtain ⟨tb, ub, rfl⟩ := exists_progPt b
    obtain ⟨tb', ub', rfl⟩ := exists_progPt b'
    obtain ⟨-, hob, hab⟩ := (cArg2_pt _ _ _ _).mp h1
    obtain ⟨-, hob', hab'⟩ := (cArg2_pt _ _ _ _).mp h2
    exact arg2_det hob hob' hab hab'

name: DescriptiveComplexity.CodeProgRed.realize_relAtF
statement:
@[simp] theorem realize_relAtF (i : Fin V.numSyms) :
    (relAtF i).Realize v ↔ bitOf V i fun j => v (selA V j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [relAtF, Formula.realize_rel, bitOf]
  simp only [Term.realize_var, relMap_sumInl]

name: DescriptiveComplexity.CodeProgRed.realize_maxAF
statement:
@[simp] theorem realize_maxAF (j : Fin (dimOf V)) :
    (maxAF (V := V) j).Realize v ↔ IsTop (v (selA V j))
proof:
:= by
  rw [maxAF, realize_maxF]
  exact Iff.rfl

name: DescriptiveComplexity.CodeProgRed.realize_botBF
statement:
@[simp] theorem realize_botBF (j : Fin (dimOf V)) :
    (botBF (V := V) j).Realize v ↔ IsBot (v (selB V j))
proof: := realize_botF

name: DescriptiveComplexity.CodeProgRed.realize_succCoF
statement:
@[simp] theorem realize_succCoF (j : Fin (dimOf V)) :
    (succCoF (V := V) j).Realize v ↔
      v (selA V j) < v (selB V j) ∧ ∀ a : A, ¬(v (selA V j) < a ∧ a < v (selB V j))
proof:
:=
  realize_succF _ _

name: DescriptiveComplexity.exists_progPt
statement: theorem exists_progPt (q : (codeProgInterp V cP).Map A) : ∃ t u, q = progPt t u
proof:
:= ⟨q.1, q.2, rfl⟩

/
minima. Elements failing it carry no mark and no child, so they draw nothing. -/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.realize_arg1Body
statement:
theorem realize_arg1Body (t t' : ProgTag V cP) (u u' : Fin (dimOf V) → A)
    (v : Fin 2 × Fin (dimOf V) → A) (hA : ∀ j, v (selA V j) = u j)
    (hB : ∀ j, v (selB V j) = u' j) :
    (arg1Body V cP t t').Realize v ↔ Arg1On t t' u u'
proof:
:= by
  have hAf : (fun j => v (selA V j)) = u := funext hA
  have hBf : (fun j => v (selB V j)) = u' := funext hB
  classical
  cases t <;> cases t' <;>
    simp only [arg1Body, Arg1On] <;> (try split_ifs with h) <;>
    simp_all [Formula.realize_not]

name: DescriptiveComplexity.realize_arg2Body
statement:
theorem realize_arg2Body (t t' : ProgTag V cP) (u u' : Fin (dimOf V) → A)
    (v : Fin 2 × Fin (dimOf V) → A) (hA : ∀ j, v (selA V j) = u j)
    (hB : ∀ j, v (selB V j) = u' j) :
    (arg2Body V cP t t').Realize v ↔ Arg2On t t' u u'
proof:
:= by
  have hAf : (fun j => v (selA V j)) = u := funext hA
  have hBf : (fun j => v (selB V j)) = u' := funext hB
  classical
  cases t <;> cases t' <;>
    simp only [arg2Body, Arg2On] <;> (try split_ifs with h) <;>
    simp_all [Formula.realize_inf]

name: DescriptiveComplexity.cRoot_pt
statement:
theorem cRoot_pt (t : ProgTag V cP) (u : Fin (dimOf V) → A) :
    CRoot (progPt t u) ↔ OkOn t u ∧ t = ProgTag.root
proof:
:= by
  rw [CRoot, FOInterpretation.relMap_map]
  change (rootMarkF V cP t).Realize _ ↔ _
  cases t
  case root =>
    simp only [rootMarkF]
    exact (realize_guardF_sel₀ _ u _ fun _ => rfl).trans (by simp)
  all_goals exact iff_of_false (by simp [rootMarkF]) (by simp)

name: DescriptiveComplexity.mark_pt
statement:
theorem mark_pt (s : CodeTag) (t : ProgTag V cP) (u : Fin (dimOf V) → A) :
    Mark s (progPt t u) ↔ OkOn t u ∧ ProgTag.mark t = s
proof:
:= by
  have hkey : ∀ (φ : Language.code.Relations 1) (hφ : ∀ (τ : Fin 1 → ProgTag V cP),
      (codeProgInterp V cP).relFormula φ τ = markF V cP s (τ 0)),
      (RelMap φ ![progPt t u] : Prop) ↔ OkOn t u ∧ ProgTag.mark t = s := by
    intro φ hφ
    rw [FOInterpretation.relMap_map, hφ]
    change (markF V cP s t).Realize _ ↔ _
    by_cases h : ProgTag.mark t = s
    · rw [markF, ite_eq_left h]
      refine Iff.trans (realize_guardF_sel₀ t u _ fun _ => rfl) ?_
      exact ⟨fun hh => ⟨hh, h⟩, fun hh => hh.1⟩
    · rw [markF, ite_eq_right h]
      exact iff_of_false (by simp) (fun hh => h hh.2)
  cases s
  · exact hkey cZero fun _ => rfl
  · exact hkey cSucc fun _ => rfl
  · exact hkey cLeft fun _ => rfl
  · exact hkey cRight fun _ => rfl
  · exact hkey cPair fun _ => rfl
  · exact hkey cComp fun _ => rfl
  · exact hkey cPrec fun _ => rfl
  · exact hkey cRfind fun _ => rfl

name: DescriptiveComplexity.cArg1_pt
statement:
theorem cArg1_pt (t t' : ProgTag V cP) (u u' : Fin (dimOf V) → A) :
    CArg1 (progPt t u) (progPt t' u') ↔ OkOn t u ∧ OkOn t' u' ∧ Arg1On t t' u u'
proof:
:= by
  rw [CArg1, FOInterpretation.relMap_map]
  change (arg1F V cP t t').Realize _ ↔ _
  rw [arg1F, Formula.realize_inf, Formula.realize_inf,
    realize_guardF_selA t u _ fun _ => rfl, realize_guardF_selB t' u' _ fun _ => rfl,
    realize_arg1Body t t' u u' _ (fun _ => rfl) fun _ => rfl, and_assoc]

name: DescriptiveComplexity.cArg2_pt
statement:
theorem cArg2_pt (t t' : ProgTag V cP) (u u' : Fin (dimOf V) → A) :
    CArg2 (progPt t u) (progPt t' u') ↔ OkOn t u ∧ OkOn t' u' ∧ Arg2On t t' u u'
proof:
:= by
  rw [CArg2, FOInterpretation.relMap_map]
  change (arg2F V cP t t').Realize _ ↔ _
  rw [arg2F, Formula.realize_inf, Formula.realize_inf,
    realize_guardF_selA t u _ fun _ => rfl, realize_guardF_selB t' u' _ fun _ => rfl,
    realize_arg2Body t t' u u' _ (fun _ => rfl) fun _ => rfl, and_assoc]

name: DescriptiveComplexity.subAt_codeRootPos
statement:
@[simp] theorem subAt_codeRootPos : ∀ c : Code, subAt c (codeRootPos c) = c
  | .zero | .succ | .left | .right => rfl
  | .pair _ _ | .comp _ _ | .prec _ _ | .rfind' _ => rfl

/-! ### The tags -/

variable {L : Language.{0, 0}}

/
inductive ProgTag (V : FinVocab L) (cP : Code) where
  /
  | root
  /
  | cp (p : SubPos cP)
  /
  | pairN
  /
  | numN
  /
  | symN (i : Fin V.numSyms)
  /
  held in the coordinate `l` on. -/
  | chainN (i : Fin V.numSyms) (l : Fin (dimOf V))
  /
  | oneN
  /
  | zeroN

namespace ProgTag

variable {V : FinVocab L} {cP : Code}

/
def idx : ProgTag V cP →
    Option (SubPos cP) × Option (Fin V.numSyms) × Option (Fin (dimOf V)) × Fin 8
  | .root => (none, none, none, 0)
  | .cp p => (some p, none, none, 1)
  | .pairN => (none, none, none, 2)
  | .numN => (none, none, none, 3)
  | .symN i => (none, some i, none, 4)
  | .chainN i l => (none, some i, some l, 5)
  | .oneN => (none, none, none, 6)
  | .zeroN => (none, none, none, 7)

name: DescriptiveComplexity.ProgTag.idx_injective
statement: theorem idx_injective : Function.Injective (idx (V := V) (cP := cP))
proof:
:= by
  intro x y h
  cases x <;> cases y <;> simp_all [idx]

name: DescriptiveComplexity.nestDrop_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem nestDrop_zero (v : ℕ) : nestDrop v 0 = v
proof: := rfl

name: DescriptiveComplexity.nestDrop_succ
statement: theorem nestDrop_succ (a b d : ℕ) : nestDrop (Nat.pair a b) (d + 1) = nestDrop b d
proof:
:= by
  rw [nestDrop, Function.iterate_succ_apply, Nat.unpair_pair, nestDrop]

name: DescriptiveComplexity.nestDrop_zero_left
statement: @[simp] theorem nestDrop_zero_left (d : ℕ) : nestDrop 0 d = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction d with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ d ih =>
    rw [show (0 : ℕ) = Nat.pair 0 0 from rfl, nestDrop_succ]
    exact ih

name: DescriptiveComplexity.nestGet_zero_left
statement: @[simp] theorem nestGet_zero_left (d : ℕ) : nestGet 0 d = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [nestGet]

name: DescriptiveComplexity.nestGet_pair_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem nestGet_pair_zero (a b : ℕ) : nestGet (Nat.pair a b) 0 = a
proof:
:= by
  rw [nestGet, nestDrop_zero, Nat.unpair_pair]

name: DescriptiveComplexity.nestGet_pair_succ
statement: theorem nestGet_pair_succ (a b d : ℕ) : nestGet (Nat.pair a b) (d + 1) = nestGet b d
proof:
:= by
  rw [nestGet, nestDrop_succ, nestGet]

name: DescriptiveComplexity.nestLeaf_nil
statement: @[simp] theorem nestLeaf_nil (v : ℕ) : nestLeaf v [] = v
proof: := rfl

name: DescriptiveComplexity.nestLeaf_cons
statement:
@[simp] theorem nestLeaf_cons (v d : ℕ) (ds : List ℕ) :
    nestLeaf v (d :: ds) = nestLeaf (nestGet v d) ds
proof: := rfl

name: DescriptiveComplexity.natNestFrom_of_lt
statement:
theorem natNestFrom_of_lt (g : Fin m → ℕ) {k : ℕ} (h : k < m) :
    natNestFrom g k = Nat.pair (g ⟨k, h⟩) (natNestFrom g (k + 1))
proof:
:= by
  rw [natNestFrom, dite_eq_left h]

name: DescriptiveComplexity.natNestFrom_of_ge
statement: theorem natNestFrom_of_ge (g : Fin m → ℕ) {k : ℕ} (h : ¬k < m) : natNestFrom g k = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [natNestFrom, dite_eq_right h]

name: DescriptiveComplexity.codeNestFrom_of_lt
statement:
theorem codeNestFrom_of_lt (g : Fin m → Code) {k : ℕ} (h : k < m) :
    codeNestFrom g k = Code.pair (g ⟨k, h⟩) (codeNestFrom g (k + 1))
proof:
:= by
  rw [codeNestFrom, dite_eq_left h]

name: DescriptiveComplexity.codeNestFrom_of_ge
statement:
theorem codeNestFrom_of_ge (g : Fin m → Code) {k : ℕ} (h : ¬k < m) :
    codeNestFrom g k = Code.zero
proof:
:= by
  rw [codeNestFrom, dite_eq_right h]

/
entry `k + d`, and `0` past the end. -/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.nestGet_natNestFrom
statement:
theorem nestGet_natNestFrom (g : Fin m → ℕ) (d k : ℕ) :
    nestGet (natNestFrom g k) d = if h : k + d < m then g ⟨k + d, h⟩ else 0
proof:
:= by
  induction d generalizing k with
  | zero =>
    by_cases h : k < m
    · rw [natNestFrom_of_lt g h, nestGet_pair_zero, dite_eq_left (by simpa using h)]
      simp
    · rw [natNestFrom_of_ge g h, nestGet_zero_left, dite_eq_right (by simpa using h)]
  | succ d ih =>
    by_cases h : k < m
    · rw [natNestFrom_of_lt g h, nestGet_pair_succ, ih,
        show k + 1 + d = k + (d + 1) from by omega]
    · rw [natNestFrom_of_ge g h, nestGet_zero_left, dite_eq_right (by omega)]

name: DescriptiveComplexity.eval_pair_zero
statement:
theorem eval_pair_zero {cf cg : Code} {a b : ℕ} (hf : eval cf 0 = Part.some a)
    (hg : eval cg 0 = Part.some b) : eval (Code.pair cf cg) 0 = Part.some (Nat.pair a b)
proof:
:= by
  simp [eval, hf, hg, Seq.seq]

name: DescriptiveComplexity.eval_comp_zero
statement:
theorem eval_comp_zero {cf cg : Code} {b : ℕ} (hg : eval cg 0 = Part.some b) :
    eval (Code.comp cf cg) 0 = eval cf b
proof:
:= by
  simp only [eval, hg]
  exact Part.bind_some _ _

/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.eval_numCode
statement:
theorem eval_numCode : ∀ n : ℕ, eval (numCode n) 0 = Part.some n
  | 0 => rfl
  | n + 1 => by
    rw [numCode, eval_comp_zero (eval_numCode n)]
    rfl

name: DescriptiveComplexity.eval_codeNestFrom
statement:
theorem eval_codeNestFrom {m : ℕ} (gc : Fin m → Code) (gv : Fin m → ℕ)
    (h : ∀ j, eval (gc j) 0 = Part.some (gv j)) (k : ℕ) :
    eval (codeNestFrom gc k) 0 = Part.some (natNestFrom gv k)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hk : k < m
  · rw [codeNestFrom_of_lt gc hk, natNestFrom_of_lt gv hk]
    exact eval_pair_zero (h _) (eval_codeNestFrom gc gv h (k + 1))
  · rw [codeNestFrom_of_ge gc hk, natNestFrom_of_ge gv hk]
    rfl
  termination_by m - k

name: DescriptiveComplexity.arity_lt_dimOf
statement: theorem arity_lt_dimOf (V : FinVocab L) (i : Fin V.numSyms) : V.arity i < dimOf V
proof:
:=
  Nat.lt_succ_of_le (Finset.le_sup (f := fun i : Fin V.numSyms => V.arity i) (Finset.mem_univ i))

name: DescriptiveComplexity.arity_le_dimOf
statement: theorem arity_le_dimOf (V : FinVocab L) (i : Fin V.numSyms) : V.arity i ≤ dimOf V
proof:
:=
  (arity_lt_dimOf V i).le

name: DescriptiveComplexity.dimOf_pos
statement: theorem dimOf_pos (V : FinVocab L) : 0 < dimOf V
proof: := Nat.succ_pos _

name: DescriptiveComplexity.setCo_apply_self
statement:
theorem setCo_apply_self (j : ℕ) (hj : j < dimOf V) (a : A) (t : Fin (dimOf V) → A) :
    setCo V j a t ⟨j, hj⟩ = a
proof: := by rw [setCo, ite_eq_left rfl]

name: DescriptiveComplexity.setCo_apply_ne
statement:
theorem setCo_apply_ne {j : ℕ} {j' : Fin (dimOf V)} (h : (j' : ℕ) ≠ j) (a : A)
    (t : Fin (dimOf V) → A) : setCo V j a t j' = t j'
proof: := by rw [setCo, ite_eq_right h]

name: DescriptiveComplexity.levelVal_zero
statement:
theorem levelVal_zero (n : ℕ) (f : Fin n → A) (i : Fin V.numSyms) (t : Fin (dimOf V) → A) :
    levelVal V n f i 0 t = if bitOf V i t then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [levelVal]

name: DescriptiveComplexity.levelCode_zero
statement:
theorem levelCode_zero (n : ℕ) (f : Fin n → A) (i : Fin V.numSyms) (t : Fin (dimOf V) → A) :
    levelCode V n f i 0 t = if bitOf V i t then Code.succ else Code.zero
proof:
:= by
  rw [levelCode]

name: DescriptiveComplexity.levelVal_succ
statement:
theorem levelVal_succ (n : ℕ) (f : Fin n → A) (i : Fin V.numSyms) (m : ℕ)
    (t : Fin (dimOf V) → A) :
    levelVal V n f i (m + 1) t =
      natNestFrom (fun d : Fin n =>
        levelVal V n f i m (setCo V (dimOf V - (m + 1)) (f d) t)) 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [levelVal]

name: DescriptiveComplexity.levelCode_succ
statement:
theorem levelCode_succ (n : ℕ) (f : Fin n → A) (i : Fin V.numSyms) (m : ℕ)
    (t : Fin (dimOf V) → A) :
    levelCode V n f i (m + 1) t =
      codeNestFrom (fun d : Fin n =>
        levelCode V n f i m (setCo V (dimOf V - (m + 1)) (f d) t)) 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [levelCode]

name: DescriptiveComplexity.eval_levelCode
statement:
theorem eval_levelCode (n : ℕ) (f : Fin n → A) (i : Fin V.numSyms) :
    ∀ (m : ℕ) (t : Fin (dimOf V) → A),
      Nat.Partrec.Code.eval (levelCode V n f i m t) 0 = Part.some (levelVal V n f i m t)
  | 0, t => by
    classical
    rw [levelCode_zero, levelVal_zero]
    by_cases h : bitOf V i t
    · rw [ite_eq_left h, ite_eq_left h]; rfl
    · rw [ite_eq_right h, ite_eq_right h]; rfl
  | m + 1, t => by
    rw [levelCode_succ, levelVal_succ]
    exact eval_codeNestFrom _ _ (fun d => eval_levelCode n f i m _) 0

variable (V)

open Classical in
/
them, over an arbitrary starting tuple (every coordinate is overwritten on the
way down). -/
noncomputable def blockVal (n : ℕ) (f : Fin n → A) (t₀ : Fin (dimOf V) → A)
    (i : Fin V.numSyms) : ℕ
proof:
:=
  levelVal V n f i (dimOf V) t₀

name: DescriptiveComplexity.card_structOf
statement: @[simp] theorem card_structOf (N : ℕ) : (structOf V N).card = N.unpair.1 - 1 + 1
proof: := rfl

name: DescriptiveComplexity.relMapBool_structOf
statement:
theorem relMapBool_structOf (N : ℕ) {a : ℕ} (R : L.Relations a)
    (x : Fin a → (structOf V N).Univ) :
    (structOf V N).relMapBool R x =
      decide (leafOf N (V.index R)
        (List.ofFn fun j : Fin (dimOf V) =>
          if h : (j : ℕ) < a then ((x ⟨j, h⟩ : Fin (N.unpair.1 - 1 + 1)) : ℕ) else 0) = 1)
proof:
:=
  FinStruct.relMapBool_ofTable _ _ _ R x

name: DescriptiveComplexity.nestLeaf_levelVal
statement:
theorem nestLeaf_levelVal (n : ℕ) (f : Fin n → A) (i : Fin V.numSyms)
    (ds : Fin (dimOf V) → ℕ) (hds : ∀ j, ds j < n) :
    ∀ (m : ℕ), m ≤ dimOf V → ∀ t : Fin (dimOf V) → A,
      (∀ j : Fin (dimOf V), (j : ℕ) < dimOf V - m → t j = f ⟨ds j, hds j⟩) →
      nestLeaf (levelVal V n f i m t) ((List.ofFn ds).drop (dimOf V - m)) =
        if bitOf V i (fun j => f ⟨ds j, hds j⟩) then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  intro m
  induction m with
  | zero =>
    intro _ t ht
    have htt : t = fun j => f ⟨ds j, hds j⟩ := funext fun j => ht j (by simp)
    rw [Nat.sub_zero, List.drop_of_length_le (by simp), nestLeaf_nil, levelVal_zero, htt]
  | succ m ih =>
    intro hm t ht
    have hp : dimOf V - (m + 1) < dimOf V := by omega
    have hp1 : dimOf V - (m + 1) + 1 = dimOf V - m := by omega
    set p : ℕ := dimOf V - (m + 1) with hpdef
    have hdrop : (List.ofFn ds).drop p = ds ⟨p, hp⟩ :: (List.ofFn ds).drop (p + 1) := by
      rw [List.drop_eq_getElem_cons (by simpa using hp)]
      simp
    rw [levelVal_succ, hdrop, nestLeaf_cons, nestGet_natNestFrom]
    rw [dite_eq_left (show 0 + ds ⟨p, hp⟩ < n from by simpa using hds _)]
    rw [hp1]
    refine ih (by omega) _ fun j hj => ?_
    rw [← hp1] at hj
    rcases Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.mp hj with hj' | hj'
    · rw [setCo_apply_ne V (by omega) _ _]
      exact ht j (by omega)
    · rw [show j = (⟨p, hp⟩ : Fin (dimOf V)) from Fin.ext hj', setCo_apply_self V p hp]
      exact congrArg f (Fin.ext (by simp))

name: DescriptiveComplexity.unpair_structVal_fst
statement:
@[simp] theorem unpair_structVal_fst (n : ℕ) (f : Fin n → A) (t₀ : Fin (dimOf V) → A) :
    (structVal V n f t₀).unpair.1 = n
proof: := by rw [structVal, Nat.unpair_pair]

name: DescriptiveComplexity.unpair_structVal_snd
statement:
@[simp] theorem unpair_structVal_snd (n : ℕ) (f : Fin n → A) (t₀ : Fin (dimOf V) → A) :
    (structVal V n f t₀).unpair.2 = natNestFrom (blockVal V n f t₀) 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [structVal, Nat.unpair_pair]

name: DescriptiveComplexity.leafOf_structVal
statement:
theorem leafOf_structVal (n : ℕ) (f : Fin n → A) (t₀ : Fin (dimOf V) → A)
    (i : Fin V.numSyms) (ds : Fin (dimOf V) → ℕ) (hds : ∀ j, ds j < n) :
    leafOf (structVal V n f t₀) (i : ℕ) (List.ofFn ds) =
      if bitOf V i (fun j => f ⟨ds j, hds j⟩) then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [leafOf, unpair_structVal_snd, nestGet_natNestFrom,
    dite_eq_left (show 0 + (i : ℕ) < V.numSyms from by simp)]
  have hb : blockVal V n f t₀ ⟨0 + (i : ℕ), by simp⟩ =
      levelVal V n f i (dimOf V) t₀ := by
    rw [blockVal]
    exact congrArg (fun j => levelVal V n f j (dimOf V) t₀) (Fin.ext (by simp))
  rw [hb]
  have := nestLeaf_levelVal V n f i ds hds (dimOf V) le_rfl t₀ (by simp)
  rwa [Nat.sub_self, List.drop_zero] at this

name: DescriptiveComplexity.relMap_heq
statement:
theorem relMap_heq {m a : ℕ} (h : m = a) (R : L.Relations m) (R' : L.Relations a)
    (hR : HEq R R') (y : Fin m → A) (z : Fin a → A) (hy : ∀ j, y j = z (Fin.cast h j)) :
    (RelMap R y : Prop) ↔ RelMap R' z
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  have hyz : y = z := funext fun j => by simpa using hy j
  subst hyz
  rw [eq_of_heq hR]

name: DescriptiveComplexity.relMapBool_structVal
statement:
theorem relMapBool_structVal (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (f : Fin n → A)
    (t₀ : Fin (dimOf V) → A) {a : ℕ} (R : L.Relations a)
    (y : Fin a → (structOf V (structVal V n f t₀)).Univ) (z : Fin a → Fin n)
    (hyz : ∀ j, ((y j : Fin _) : ℕ) = ((z j : Fin n) : ℕ)) :
    (structOf V (structVal V n f t₀)).relMapBool R y =
      decide (RelMap R fun j => f (z j))
proof:
:= by
  have hcard : (structVal V n f t₀).unpair.1 - 1 + 1 = n := by
    rw [unpair_structVal_fst]; omega
  have hds : ∀ j : Fin (dimOf V),
      (if h : (j : ℕ) < a then ((y ⟨j, h⟩ : Fin _) : ℕ) else 0) < n := by
    intro j
    by_cases h : (j : ℕ) < a
    · rw [dite_eq_left h]
      have h2 : ((y ⟨j, h⟩ : (structOf V (structVal V n f t₀)).Univ) : ℕ) <
        (structVal V n f t₀).unpair.1 - 1 + 1 := (y ⟨j, h⟩).isLt
      omega
    · rw [dite_eq_right h]
      exact hn
  have ha : V.arity (V.index R) = a := V.arity_index R
  have hbit : (bitOf V (V.index R) fun j' =>
      f ⟨if h : (j' : ℕ) < a then ((y ⟨j', h⟩ : Fin _) : ℕ) else 0, hds j'⟩) ↔
      RelMap R fun j => f (z j) := by
    refine relMap_heq ha (V.sym (V.index R)) R (V.sym_index R) _ _ fun j => ?_
    have hj : ((Fin.castLE (arity_le_dimOf V (V.index R)) j : Fin (dimOf V)) : ℕ) < a := by
      have hjl := j.isLt
      have hcst : ((Fin.castLE (arity_le_dimOf V (V.index R)) j : Fin (dimOf V)) : ℕ) =
        (j : ℕ) := rfl
      omega
    refine congrArg f (Fin.ext ?_)
    change (if h : ((Fin.castLE (arity_le_dimOf V (V.index R)) j : Fin (dimOf V)) : ℕ) < a then
      ((y ⟨_, h⟩ : Fin _) : ℕ) else 0) = ((z (Fin.cast ha j) : Fin n) : ℕ)
    rw [dite_eq_left hj]
    exact (hyz ⟨_, hj⟩).trans (congrArg (fun w => ((z w : Fin n) : ℕ)) (Fin.ext rfl))
  rw [relMapBool_structOf, leafOf_structVal V n f t₀ (V.index R) _ hds]
  by_cases hb : (bitOf V (V.index R) fun j' =>
      f ⟨if h : (j' : ℕ) < a then ((y ⟨j', h⟩ : Fin _) : ℕ) else 0, hds j'⟩)
  · rw [ite_eq_left hb]
    simp [hbit.mp hb]
  · rw [ite_eq_right hb]
    have hnr : ¬(RelMap R fun j => f (z j) : Prop) := fun hr => hb (hbit.mpr hr)
    simp [hnr]

name: DescriptiveComplexity.primrec_nestGet
statement: theorem primrec_nestGet : Primrec₂ nestGet
proof:
:= by
  have hdrop : Primrec fun q : ℕ × ℕ => nestDrop q.1 q.2 :=
    (Primrec.nat_iterate Primrec.snd Primrec.fst
      (Primrec.snd.comp (Primrec.unpair.comp Primrec.snd)).to₂).of_eq fun _ => rfl
  exact (Primrec.fst.comp (Primrec.unpair.comp hdrop)).of_eq fun _ => rfl

name: DescriptiveComplexity.primrec_nestLeaf
statement: theorem primrec_nestLeaf : Primrec₂ nestLeaf
proof:
:=
  (Primrec.list_foldl Primrec.snd Primrec.fst
    (primrec_nestGet.comp (Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.snd)
      (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.snd)).to₂).to₂

name: DescriptiveComplexity.primrec_structOf
statement: theorem primrec_structOf : Primrec (structOf V)
proof:
:= by
  have hn : Primrec fun N : ℕ => N.unpair.1 := Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.unpair
  have hk : Primrec fun N : ℕ => N.unpair.1 - 1 :=
    Primrec.nat_sub.comp hn (Primrec.const 1)
  refine ((FinStruct.primrec_mk V).comp hk (Primrec.list_ofFn ?_)).of_eq fun _ => rfl
  intro i'
  refine Primrec.list_map
    (Primrec.list_range.comp
      ((FirstOrder.Language.primrec_pow_const (V.arity i')).comp
        (Primrec.succ.comp hk))) ?_
  have hcard : Primrec fun q : ℕ × ℕ => q.1.unpair.1 - 1 + 1 :=
    Primrec.succ.comp (hk.comp Primrec.fst)
  have hds : Primrec fun q : ℕ × ℕ =>
      List.ofFn fun j : Fin (dimOf V) =>
        if (j : ℕ) < V.arity i' then
          FirstOrder.Language.digitAt (q.1.unpair.1 - 1 + 1) q.2 (j : ℕ) else 0 := by
    refine Primrec.list_ofFn fun j => ?_
    by_cases hj : (j : ℕ) < V.arity i'
    · simp only [ite_eq_left hj]
      exact (FirstOrder.Language.primrec_digitAt (j : ℕ)).comp hcard Primrec.snd
    · simp only [ite_eq_right hj]
      exact Primrec.const 0
  have hleaf : Primrec fun q : ℕ × ℕ =>
      nestLeaf (nestGet q.1.unpair.2 (i' : ℕ))
        (List.ofFn fun j : Fin (dimOf V) =>
          if (j : ℕ) < V.arity i' then
            FirstOrder.Language.digitAt (q.1.unpair.1 - 1 + 1) q.2 (j : ℕ) else 0) :=
    primrec_nestLeaf.comp
      (primrec_nestGet.comp
        ((Primrec.snd.comp (Primrec.unpair.comp Primrec.fst))) (Primrec.const (i' : ℕ)))
      hds
  refine ((Primrec.eq.comp hleaf (Primrec.const 1)).decide).of_eq fun q => ?_
  simp only [leafOf, V.index_sym i']
  rfl

name: DescriptiveComplexity.eval_drawnCode
statement:
theorem eval_drawnCode :
    Code.eval (Code.comp cP (Code.pair (numCode (Nat.card A))
        (codeNestFrom (blockCode V (Nat.card A) (ordEnum A) (botTup V A)) 0))) 0 =
      Code.eval cP (structVal V (Nat.card A) (ordEnum A) (botTup V A))
proof:
:= by
  refine eval_comp_zero ?_
  refine eval_pair_zero (eval_numCode _) ?_
  exact eval_codeNestFrom _ _ (fun j => eval_levelCode _ _ j _ _) 0

name: DescriptiveComplexity.codehalt_codeProg
statement:
theorem codehalt_codeProg :
    CODEHALT ((codeProgInterp V cP).Map A) ↔
      (Code.eval cP (structVal V (Nat.card A) (ordEnum A) (botTup V A))).Dom
proof:
:= by
  have hev := eval_drawnCode V cP A
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨q, c, hroot, hdec, hh⟩
    obtain ⟨t, u, rfl⟩ := exists_progPt q
    obtain ⟨hok, rfl⟩ := (cRoot_pt t u).mp hroot
    obtain rfl : u = botTup V A := canon0_ext hok (canon_botTup 0)
    obtain rfl := decodesTo_unique (codeWF_codeProg V cP A) c _ _ hdec (decodesTo_rootPt cP)
    rwa [hev] at hh
  · intro hd
    exact ⟨progPt ProgTag.root (botTup V A), _, (cRoot_pt _ _).mpr ⟨canon_botTup 0, rfl⟩,
      decodesTo_rootPt cP, by rw [hev]; exact hd⟩

/-! ### The value is decoded back into the instance -/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.toPred_structOf_structVal
statement:
theorem toPred_structOf_structVal (P : DecisionProblem L) :
    P.toPred V (structOf V (structVal V (Nat.card A) (ordEnum A) (botTup V A))) ↔ P A
proof:
:=
  P.iso_invariant
    (structValEquiv V (Nat.card A) Nat.card_pos (ordEnum A).toEquiv (botTup V A))

/-! ### The reduction -/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.orderedReduction_codehalt
statement:
theorem orderedReduction_codehalt (P : DecisionProblem L) (h : REPred (P.toPred V)) :
    Nonempty (P ≤ᶠᵒ[≤] CODEHALT)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨cP, hcP⟩ : ∃ cP : Code, ∀ N : ℕ,
      (Code.eval cP N).Dom ↔ P.toPred V (structOf V N) := by
    have hcomp : Partrec fun N : ℕ =>
        (Part.assert (P.toPred V (structOf V N)) fun _ => Part.some ()).map
          fun _ => (0 : ℕ) :=
      (h.comp (primrec_structOf V).to_comp).map (Computable.const (0 : ℕ)).to₂
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := Nat.Partrec.Code.exists_code.mp (Partrec.nat_iff.mp hcomp)
    refine ⟨c, fun N => ?_⟩
    rw [hc]
    simp only [Part.map, Part.assert]
    exact ⟨fun hh => hh.1, fun hp => ⟨hp, trivial⟩⟩
  exact ⟨{ Tag := ProgTag V cP
           dim := dimOf V
           toInterpretation := codeProgInterp V cP
           correct := fun A _ _ _ _ => by
             rw [codehalt_codeProg V cP A, hcP, toPred_structOf_structVal V P] }⟩

name: DescriptiveComplexity.CodeHalt.relMap_inl
statement:
theorem relMap_inl {k : ℕ} (R : Language.code.Relations k) (y : Fin k → A) :
    RelMap (L := Language.code) (M := A ⊕ Fin m) R (fun i => Sum.inl (y i)) ↔ RelMap R y
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y', hy', h⟩
    have hyy : y = y' := funext fun i => Sum.inl_injective (hy' i)
    rw [hyy]
    exact h
  · exact fun h => ⟨y, fun _ => rfl, h⟩

name: DescriptiveComplexity.CodeHalt.relMap_inl₁
statement:
@[simp]
theorem relMap_inl₁ (R : Language.code.Relations 1) (a : A) :
    RelMap (L := Language.code) (M := A ⊕ Fin m) R ![Sum.inl a] ↔ RelMap R ![a]
proof:
:= by
  have h : (![Sum.inl a] : Fin 1 → A ⊕ Fin m) = fun i => Sum.inl (![a] i) := by
    funext i; fin_cases i; rfl
  rw [h, relMap_inl]

name: DescriptiveComplexity.CodeHalt.relMap_inl₂
statement:
@[simp]
theorem relMap_inl₂ (R : Language.code.Relations 2) (a b : A) :
    RelMap (L := Language.code) (M := A ⊕ Fin m) R ![Sum.inl a, Sum.inl b] ↔
      RelMap R ![a, b]
proof:
:= by
  have h : (![Sum.inl a, Sum.inl b] : Fin 2 → A ⊕ Fin m) = fun i => Sum.inl (![a, b] i) := by
    funext i; fin_cases i <;> rfl
  rw [h, relMap_inl]

/-! ### The certificate an assignment carries -/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.CodeHalt.certOf_le
statement:
@[simp] theorem certOf_le (x y : Fin m) :
    (certOf ρ).Le x y ↔ ρ EvIx.le ![Sum.inr x, Sum.inr y]
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: DescriptiveComplexity.CodeHalt.certOf_add
statement:
@[simp] theorem certOf_add (x y z : Fin m) :
    (certOf ρ).Add x y z ↔ ρ EvIx.add ![Sum.inr x, Sum.inr y, Sum.inr z]
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: DescriptiveComplexity.CodeHalt.certOf_pr
statement:
@[simp] theorem certOf_pr (a b p : Fin m) :
    (certOf ρ).Pr a b p ↔ ρ EvIx.pr ![Sum.inr a, Sum.inr b, Sum.inr p]
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: DescriptiveComplexity.CodeHalt.certOf_dec
statement:
@[simp] theorem certOf_dec (n : A) (e : Fin m) :
    (certOf ρ).Dec n e ↔ ρ EvIx.dec ![Sum.inl n, Sum.inr e]
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: DescriptiveComplexity.CodeHalt.certOf_ev
statement:
@[simp] theorem certOf_ev (e x v : Fin m) :
    (certOf ρ).Ev e x v ↔ ρ EvIx.ev ![Sum.inr e, Sum.inr x, Sum.inr v]
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: DescriptiveComplexity.CodeHalt.exists_inr_of_not_isOld
statement: theorem exists_inr_of_not_isOld {x : A ⊕ Fin m} (h : ¬IsOld x) : ∃ j : Fin m, x = Sum.inr j
proof:
:= by
  cases x with
  | inl a => exact absurd (isOld_inl a) h
  | inr j => exact ⟨j, rfl⟩

name: DescriptiveComplexity.CodeHalt.realize_exOldF
statement:
@[simp]
theorem realize_exOldF (φ : certLang.Formula (γ ⊕ Unit)) (v : γ → A ⊕ Fin m) :
    @Formula.Realize certLang _ (certStr ρ) γ (exOldF φ) v ↔
      ∃ a : A, @Formula.Realize certLang _ (certStr ρ) (γ ⊕ Unit) φ
        (Sum.elim v fun _ => Sum.inl a)
proof:
:= by
  let : certLang.Structure (A ⊕ Fin m) := certStr ρ
  simp only [exOldF, Formula.realize_iExs, Formula.realize_inf, realize_oldF, Sum.elim_inr]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i, hi, hφ⟩
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := isOld_iff.mp hi
    have hie : i = fun _ => Sum.inl a := funext fun u => by cases u; exact ha
    subst hie
    exact ⟨a, hφ⟩
  · rintro ⟨a, hφ⟩
    exact ⟨fun _ => Sum.inl a, isOld_inl a, hφ⟩

name: DescriptiveComplexity.CodeHalt.realize_allOldF
statement:
@[simp]
theorem realize_allOldF (φ : certLang.Formula (γ ⊕ Unit)) (v : γ → A ⊕ Fin m) :
    @Formula.Realize certLang _ (certStr ρ) γ (allOldF φ) v ↔
      ∀ a : A, @Formula.Realize certLang _ (certStr ρ) (γ ⊕ Unit) φ
        (Sum.elim v fun _ => Sum.inl a)
proof:
:= by
  let : certLang.Structure (A ⊕ Fin m) := certStr ρ
  simp only [allOldF, Formula.realize_iAlls, Formula.realize_imp, realize_oldF, Sum.elim_inr]
  constructor
  · exact fun h a => h (fun _ => Sum.inl a) (isOld_inl a)
  · intro h i hi
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := isOld_iff.mp hi
    have hie : i = fun _ => Sum.inl a := funext fun u => by cases u; exact ha
    rw [hie]
    exact h a

name: DescriptiveComplexity.CodeHalt.realize_exNewF
statement:
@[simp]
theorem realize_exNewF (φ : certLang.Formula (γ ⊕ Unit)) (v : γ → A ⊕ Fin m) :
    @Formula.Realize certLang _ (certStr ρ) γ (exNewF φ) v ↔
      ∃ j : Fin m, @Formula.Realize certLang _ (certStr ρ) (γ ⊕ Unit) φ
        (Sum.elim v fun _ => Sum.inr j)
proof:
:= by
  let : certLang.Structure (A ⊕ Fin m) := certStr ρ
  simp only [exNewF, Formula.realize_iExs, Formula.realize_inf, Formula.realize_not,
    realize_oldF, Sum.elim_inr]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i, hi, hφ⟩
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := exists_inr_of_not_isOld hi
    have hie : i = fun _ => Sum.inr j := funext fun u => by cases u; exact hj
    subst hie
    exact ⟨j, hφ⟩
  · rintro ⟨j, hφ⟩
    exact ⟨fun _ => Sum.inr j, not_isOld_inr j, hφ⟩

name: DescriptiveComplexity.CodeHalt.realize_allNewF
statement:
@[simp]
theorem realize_allNewF (φ : certLang.Formula (γ ⊕ Unit)) (v : γ → A ⊕ Fin m) :
    @Formula.Realize certLang _ (certStr ρ) γ (allNewF φ) v ↔
      ∀ j : Fin m, @Formula.Realize certLang _ (certStr ρ) (γ ⊕ Unit) φ
        (Sum.elim v fun _ => Sum.inr j)
proof:
:= by
  let : certLang.Structure (A ⊕ Fin m) := certStr ρ
  simp only [allNewF, Formula.realize_iAlls, Formula.realize_imp, Formula.realize_not,
    realize_oldF, Sum.elim_inr]
  constructor
  · exact fun h j => h (fun _ => Sum.inr j) (not_isOld_inr j)
  · intro h i hi
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := exists_inr_of_not_isOld hi
    have hie : i = fun _ => Sum.inr j := funext fun u => by cases u; exact hj
    rw [hie]
    exact h j

/-! ### The shapes that repeat

The order-theoretic shapes (`IsZ`, `IsS`, strictly below) and the arithmetic
of a code's number, each a builder used many times below. -/

/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.CodeHalt.realize_kernelS
statement:
theorem realize_kernelS :
    @Sentence.Realize certLang (A ⊕ Fin m) (certStr ρ) kernelS ↔ CertOK (certOf ρ)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [kernelS, Sentence.Realize, Formula.realize_inf]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6⟩
    exact ⟨(realize_linS ρ).mp h1, (realize_addOkS ρ).mp h2, (realize_prOkS ρ).mp h3,
      (realize_decOkS ρ).mp h4, (realize_evOkS ρ).mp h5, (realize_rootS ρ).mp h6⟩
  · intro h
    exact ⟨(realize_linS ρ).mpr h.le_lin, (realize_addOkS ρ).mpr h.add_ok,
      (realize_prOkS ρ).mpr h.pr_ok, (realize_decOkS ρ).mpr h.dec_ok,
      (realize_evOkS ρ).mpr h.ev_ok, (realize_rootS ρ).mpr h.root⟩

/-! ### The assignment a certificate induces

Read back by `DescriptiveComplexity.CodeHalt.certOf`, this is the identity
*definitionally*, which is what makes the round trip a `rfl`. -/

/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.CodeHalt.certOf_certAssign
statement:
@[simp]
theorem certOf_certAssign (c : Cert A (Fin m)) : certOf (certAssign c) = c
proof: := rfl

name: DescriptiveComplexity.codehalt_sigmaSONewDefinable
statement: theorem codehalt_sigmaSONewDefinable : SigmaSONewDefinable CODEHALT
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨CodeHalt.evBlock, CodeHalt.kernelS, ?_⟩
  intro A _ _ _
  rw [CodeHalt.codehalt_iff_cert]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨m, c, hc⟩
    refine ⟨m, ?_⟩
    rw [sorealize_singleton]
    refine ⟨CodeHalt.certAssign c, (CodeHalt.realize_kernelS (ρ := CodeHalt.certAssign c)).mpr ?_⟩
    rwa [CodeHalt.certOf_certAssign]
  · rintro ⟨m, hm⟩
    rw [sorealize_singleton] at hm
    obtain ⟨ρ, hρ⟩ := hm
    exact ⟨m, CodeHalt.certOf ρ, (CodeHalt.realize_kernelS (ρ := ρ)).mp hρ⟩

/
drawn code – its numbers, its pairings and its intermediate values – which is a
finite object, but no function of the instance bounds it: that is exactly the
difference between `Σ₁` and `∃SO[new]`, and between NP and RE. -/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.codehalt_mem_RE
statement: theorem codehalt_mem_RE : CODEHALT ∈ RE
proof:
:= codehalt_sigmaSONewDefinable

/
work is needed: `DescriptiveComplexity.finsat_hard_of_sigmaSONewDefinable` is
proved for an arbitrary source vocabulary, so putting a problem in RE reduces it
to `DescriptiveComplexity.FINSAT` at once. -/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.codehalt_le_finsat
statement: theorem codehalt_le_finsat : Nonempty (CODEHALT ≤ʳᶠᵒ[≤] FINSAT)
proof:
:=
  finsat_hard_of_sigmaSONewDefinable CODEHALT codehalt_sigmaSONewDefinable

name: DescriptiveComplexity.CodeHalt.numOf_lt
statement: theorem numOf_lt {x y : D} (hle : Le x y) (hne : x ≠ y) : numOf Le x < numOf Le y
proof:
:=
  bitRank_lt hlin trivial hle hne

name: DescriptiveComplexity.CodeHalt.le_of_numOf_lt
statement: theorem le_of_numOf_lt {x y : D} (h : numOf Le x < numOf Le y) : Le x y ∧ x ≠ y
proof:
:= by
  have hne : x ≠ y := fun hxy => absurd h (by rw [hxy]; omega)
  refine ⟨?_, hne⟩
  rcases hlin.2.2.2 x y with hxy | hyx
  · exact hxy
  · exact absurd (numOf_lt hlin hyx fun h' => hne h'.symm) (by omega)

name: DescriptiveComplexity.CodeHalt.numOf_injective
statement: theorem numOf_injective {x y : D} (h : numOf Le x = numOf Le y) : x = y
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hne
  rcases hlin.2.2.2 x y with hxy | hyx
  · exact absurd (numOf_lt hlin hxy hne) (by omega)
  · exact absurd (numOf_lt hlin hyx fun h' => hne h'.symm) (by omega)

name: DescriptiveComplexity.CodeHalt.le_iff_numOf_le
statement: theorem le_iff_numOf_le {x y : D} : Le x y ↔ numOf Le x ≤ numOf Le y
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hxy
    rcases eq_or_ne x y with rfl | hne
    · exact le_rfl
    · exact (numOf_lt hlin hxy hne).le
  · intro h
    rcases Nat.eq_or_lt_of_le h with heq | hlt
    · exact (numOf_injective hlin heq) ▸ hlin.1 x
    · exact (le_of_numOf_lt hlin hlt).1

name: DescriptiveComplexity.CodeHalt.isZ_iff
statement: theorem isZ_iff {d : D} : IsZ Le d ↔ numOf Le d = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hset : {q : D | (fun _ => True) q ∧ Le q d ∧ q ≠ d} = ∅ := by
      ext q
      simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_empty_iff_false, iff_false, true_and, not_and, not_not]
      exact fun hq => hlin.2.2.1 q d hq (h q)
    rw [numOf, bitRank, hset, Set.ncard_empty]
  · intro h e
    by_contra hde
    have hed : Le e d := (hlin.2.2.2 d e).resolve_left hde
    have hne : e ≠ d := fun hh => hde (hh ▸ hlin.1 e)
    exact absurd (numOf_lt hlin hed hne) (by omega)

name: DescriptiveComplexity.CodeHalt.isS_iff
statement: theorem isS_iff {d d' : D} : IsS Le d d' ↔ numOf Le d' = numOf Le d + 1
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hle, hne, hbtw⟩
    have hset : {q : D | (fun _ => True) q ∧ Le q d' ∧ q ≠ d'} =
        insert d {q : D | (fun _ => True) q ∧ Le q d ∧ q ≠ d} := by
      ext q
      simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_insert_iff, true_and]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨hqd', hqne⟩
        rcases hlin.2.2.2 d q with hdq | hqd
        · exact Or.inl ((hbtw q hdq hqd').resolve_right hqne)
        · rcases eq_or_ne q d with rfl | hqdne
          · exact Or.inl rfl
          · exact Or.inr ⟨hqd, hqdne⟩
      · rintro (rfl | ⟨hqd, hqdne⟩)
        · exact ⟨hle, hne⟩
        · refine ⟨hlin.2.1 q d d' hqd hle, ?_⟩
          rintro rfl
          exact hne (hlin.2.2.1 d q hle hqd)
    have hnot : d ∉ {q : D | (fun _ => True) q ∧ Le q d ∧ q ≠ d} := fun hh => hh.2.2 rfl
    rw [numOf, numOf, bitRank, bitRank, hset, Set.ncard_insert_of_notMem hnot (Set.toFinite _)]
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨hle, hne⟩ := le_of_numOf_lt hlin (show numOf Le d < numOf Le d' by omega)
    refine ⟨hle, hne, fun e hde hed' => ?_⟩
    have h1 : numOf Le d ≤ numOf Le e := (le_iff_numOf_le hlin).mp hde
    have h2 : numOf Le e ≤ numOf Le d' := (le_iff_numOf_le hlin).mp hed'
    rcases (by omega : numOf Le e = numOf Le d ∨ numOf Le e = numOf Le d') with he | he
    · exact Or.inl (numOf_injective hlin he)
    · exact Or.inr (numOf_injective hlin he)

name: DescriptiveComplexity.CodeHalt.isZ_iff_minPos
statement: theorem isZ_iff_minPos {d : D} : IsZ Le d ↔ MinPos Le (fun _ => True) d
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => ⟨trivial, fun q _ => h q⟩, fun h q => h.2 q trivial⟩

name: DescriptiveComplexity.CodeHalt.isS_iff_succPos
statement: theorem isS_iff_succPos {d d' : D} : IsS Le d d' ↔ SuccPos Le (fun _ => True) d d'
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => ⟨trivial, trivial, h.1, h.2.1, fun r _ => h.2.2 r⟩,
    fun h => ⟨h.2.2.1, h.2.2.2.1, fun r => h.2.2.2.2 r trivial⟩⟩

/
are an initial segment of `ℕ`. This is what lets a bounded universal over the
segment be read as a bounded universal over `ℕ`. -/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.CodeHalt.exists_numOf
statement:
theorem exists_numOf :
    ∀ (Y : ℕ) (y : D), numOf Le y = Y → ∀ w, w ≤ Y → ∃ x : D, numOf Le x = w
proof:
:= by
  intro Y
  induction Y using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ Y ih =>
    rintro y rfl w hw
    rcases Nat.eq_or_lt_of_le hw with heq | hlt
    · exact ⟨y, heq.symm⟩
    · have hne0 : numOf Le y ≠ 0 := by omega
      have hmin : ¬MinPos Le (fun _ => True) y := fun hm =>
        hne0 ((isZ_iff hlin).mp (isZ_iff_minPos.mpr hm))
      obtain ⟨y', hy'⟩ := exists_predPos hlin (Posn := fun _ => True) trivial hmin
      have hsy : numOf Le y = numOf Le y' + 1 := (isS_iff hlin).mp (isS_iff_succPos.mpr hy')
      exact ih (numOf Le y') (by omega) y' rfl w (by omega)

name: DescriptiveComplexity.CodeHalt.isZ_fin
statement: theorem isZ_fin {i : Fin (N + 1)} : IsZ (· ≤ ·) i ↔ (i : ℕ) = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    simpa [Fin.le_def] using (h 0 : i ≤ 0)
  · intro h j
    show i ≤ j
    rw [Fin.le_def]
    omega

name: DescriptiveComplexity.CodeHalt.isS_fin
statement: theorem isS_fin {i j : Fin (N + 1)} : IsS (· ≤ ·) i j ↔ (j : ℕ) = (i : ℕ) + 1
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hle, hne, hbtw⟩
    have hle' : (i : ℕ) ≤ (j : ℕ) := by rwa [← Fin.le_def]
    have hne' : (i : ℕ) ≠ (j : ℕ) := fun h => hne (Fin.ext h)
    by_contra hcon
    have hb : ((i : ℕ) + 1) < N + 1 := by omega
    set p : Fin (N + 1) := ⟨(i : ℕ) + 1, hb⟩ with hpdef
    have hp : (p : ℕ) = (i : ℕ) + 1 := rfl
    have h1 : i ≤ p := by rw [Fin.le_def, hp]; omega
    have h2 : p ≤ j := by rw [Fin.le_def, hp]; omega
    rcases hbtw _ h1 h2 with h | h <;>
      · have := congrArg Fin.val h
        rw [hp] at this
        omega
  · intro h
    refine ⟨show i ≤ j by rw [Fin.le_def]; omega, fun hc => by rw [hc] at h; omega,
      fun e hie hej => ?_⟩
    have hie' : (i : ℕ) ≤ (e : ℕ) := by rwa [← Fin.le_def]
    have hej' : (e : ℕ) ≤ (j : ℕ) := by rwa [← Fin.le_def]
    rcases (by omega : (e : ℕ) = (i : ℕ) ∨ (e : ℕ) = (j : ℕ)) with he | he
    · exact Or.inl (Fin.ext he)
    · exact Or.inr (Fin.ext he)

name: DescriptiveComplexity.paletteColorableOn_iff
statement:
theorem paletteColorableOn_iff [Finite A] (Cfl : A → A → Prop) (Kp : A → Prop) :
    PaletteColorableOn Cfl Kp ↔ ColorableOn Cfl {x | Kp x}.ncard
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have : Fintype A := Fintype.ofFinite A
  have hcard : Fintype.card {x // Kp x} = {x | Kp x}.ncard := by
    rw [← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, ← Nat.card_coe_set_eq]
    rfl
  let e := Fintype.equivFinOfCardEq hcard
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨col, hcol, hproper⟩
    refine ⟨fun x => e ⟨col x, hcol x⟩, fun x y hxy hc => ?_⟩
    exact hproper x y hxy (congrArg Subtype.val (e.injective hc))
  · rintro ⟨c, hproper⟩
    refine ⟨fun x => (e.symm (c x)).1, fun x => (e.symm (c x)).2, fun x y hxy hc => ?_⟩
    exact hproper x y hxy (e.symm.injective (Subtype.ext hc))

/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.colorableOn_congr
statement:
theorem colorableOn_congr {Cfl Cfl' : A → A → Prop} {k : ℕ}
    (h : ∀ x y, Cfl x y ↔ Cfl' x y) : ColorableOn Cfl k ↔ ColorableOn Cfl' k
proof:
:=
  exists_congr fun _ =>
    ⟨fun hc x y hxy => hc x y ((h x y).mpr hxy), fun hc x y hxy => hc x y ((h x y).mp hxy)⟩

name: DescriptiveComplexity.ColorableOn.of_equiv
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := h
  refine ⟨fun a => c (u.symm a), fun x y hxy => ?_⟩
  exact hc (u.symm x) (u.symm y) ((hcfl (u.symm x) (u.symm y)).mpr (by simpa using hxy))

/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.ColorableOn.equiv_iff
proof:
:=
  ⟨ColorableOn.of_equiv u hcfl,
    ColorableOn.of_equiv u.symm fun a a' => by rw [hcfl]; simp⟩

name: DescriptiveComplexity.kColorable_iso
statement:

name: DescriptiveComplexity.hasSmallChromaticNumber_iso
statement:
theorem hasSmallChromaticNumber_iso (e : A ≃[Language.markedGraph] B) :

name: DescriptiveComplexity.kCol_sigmaSODefinable
statement: theorem kCol_sigmaSODefinable (k : ℕ) : SigmaSODefinable 1 (KCol k)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨[colorGuessBlock k], rfl, kColKernel k, ?_⟩
  intro V _ _ _
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨c, hc⟩
    refine ⟨fun i (w : Fin 1 → V) => c (w 0) = i, (realize_kColKernel _).mpr
      ⟨fun x => ⟨c x, rfl⟩, fun x y hxy i hi => ?_⟩⟩
    exact hc x y hxy (hi.1.trans hi.2.symm)
  · rintro ⟨ρ, hρ⟩
    obtain ⟨hcover, hproper⟩ := (realize_kColKernel ρ).mp hρ
    choose c hcolor using hcover
    exact ⟨c, fun x y hxy hcxy =>
      hproper x y hxy (c x) ⟨hcolor x, hcxy ▸ hcolor y⟩⟩

name: DescriptiveComplexity.chromaticNumber_sigmaSODefinable
statement: theorem chromaticNumber_sigmaSODefinable : SigmaSODefinable 1 ChromaticNumber
proof:
:=
  palette_sigmaSODefinable true ChromaticNumber fun A _ _ => by
    rw [show ChromaticNumber A ↔ HasSmallChromaticNumber A from Iff.rfl, HasSmallChromaticNumber,
      ← paletteColorableOn_iff]
    exact and_iff_right ‹Finite A›

adjacency atom negated – covering by cliques is coloring the complement. -/

statement:
@[simp]
theorem padColor_adj_orig (w₁ w₂ : Fin 1 → A) :
    RelMap (M := (padColorInterp m).Map A) adj ![(none, w₁), (none, w₂)] ↔
      RelMap adj ![w₁ 0, w₂ 0]
proof:

name: DescriptiveComplexity.padColor_adj_left
statement:
@[simp]
theorem padColor_adj_left (i : Fin m) (w₁ w₂ : Fin 1 → A) :
    RelMap (M := (padColorInterp m).Map A) adj ![(some i, w₁), (none, w₂)]
proof:
:= by
  rw [FOInterpretation.relMap_map]
  simp [padColorInterp]

name: DescriptiveComplexity.padColor_adj_right
statement:
@[simp]
theorem padColor_adj_right (i : Fin m) (w₁ w₂ : Fin 1 → A) :

proof:
:= by

name: DescriptiveComplexity.padColor_adj_pad
statement:
@[simp]
theorem padColor_adj_pad (i j : Fin m) (w₁ w₂ : Fin 1 → A) :
    RelMap (M := (padColorInterp m).Map A) adj ![(some i, w₁), (some j, w₂)] ↔ i ≠ j
proof:

name: DescriptiveComplexity.kColorable_map_of_threeColorable
statement:
theorem kColorable_map_of_threeColorable (h : ThreeColorable A) :
    KColorable (3 + m) ((padColorInterp m).Map A)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := h
  refine ⟨paddedColoring c, ?_⟩
  rintro ⟨(_ | i), w₁⟩ ⟨(_ | j), w₂⟩ hadj
  · exact fun h => hc (w₁ 0) (w₂ 0) ((padColor_adj_orig w₁ w₂).mp hadj)
      (origColor_injective h)
  · exact origColor_ne_padColor _ _
  · exact fun h => origColor_ne_padColor _ _ h.symm
  · exact fun h => (padColor_adj_pad i j w₁ w₂).mp hadj (padColor_injective h)

/
input: each of the `m` blown-up universal vertices consumes a color of its
own, all distinct from the colors of the original copy, which is therefore
left with at most three of them. (The input structure must be nonempty: an
empty class would consume no color.) -/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.threeColorable_of_kColorable_map
statement:
theorem threeColorable_of_kColorable_map [Nonempty A]
    (h : KColorable (3 + m) ((padColorInterp m).Map A)) : ThreeColorable A
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨a₀⟩ := ‹Nonempty A›

  set d : Fin m → Fin (3 + m) := fun i => c (some i, fun _ => a₀) with hd
  have hdinj : Function.Injective d := by
    intro i j hij
    by_contra hne
    exact hc _ _ ((padColor_adj_pad i j (fun _ => a₀) fun _ => a₀).mpr hne) hij

  have horig : ∀ (x : A) (i : Fin m), c (none, fun _ => x) ≠ d i := fun x i =>
    hc _ _ (padColor_adj_right i (fun _ => x) fun _ => a₀)

  set S : Finset (Fin (3 + m)) := Finset.univ \ Finset.image d Finset.univ with hS
  have hcard : S.card = 3 := by
    have himg : (Finset.image d Finset.univ).card = m := by
      rw [Finset.card_image_of_injective _ hdinj, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
    rw [hS, Finset.card_sdiff_of_subset (Finset.subset_univ _), Finset.card_univ,
      Fintype.card_fin, himg]
    omega
  have hmem : ∀ x : A, c (none, fun _ => x) ∈ S := by
    intro x
    rw [hS, Finset.mem_sdiff]
    refine ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, ?_⟩
    rw [Finset.mem_image]
    rintro ⟨i, -, hi⟩
    exact horig x i hi.symm
  let e : S ≃ Fin 3 := Finset.equivFinOfCardEq hcard
  refine ⟨fun x => e ⟨c (none, fun _ => x), hmem x⟩, fun x y hxy hcol => ?_⟩
  have hne : c (none, fun _ => x) ≠ c (none, fun _ => y) :=
    hc _ _ ((padColor_adj_orig (fun _ => x) fun _ => y).mpr (by simpa using hxy))
  exact hne (congrArg Subtype.val (e.injective hcol))

/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.threeColorable_iff_kColorable_map
statement:
theorem threeColorable_iff_kColorable_map [Nonempty A] :
    ThreeColorable A ↔ KColorable (3 + m) ((padColorInterp m).Map A)
proof:
:=
  ⟨kColorable_map_of_threeColorable, threeColorable_of_kColorable_map⟩

name: DescriptiveComplexity.chrom_adj_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem chrom_adj_zero (v w : A) :
    MGAdj (cnPt 0 v) (cnPt 0 w) ↔ RelMap adj ![v, w]
proof:
:= by
  rw [MGAdj, FOInterpretation.relMap_map]
  simp [chromInterp, cnPt, Formula.realize_rel₂]

name: DescriptiveComplexity.chrom_adj_same
statement:
@[simp]

  simp [chromInterp, cnPt, hi]

name: DescriptiveComplexity.chrom_adj_diff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem chrom_adj_diff {i j : Fin 4} (hij : i ≠ j) (v w : A) :
    MGAdj (cnPt i v) (cnPt j w) ↔ v = w ∧ RelMap adj ![v, v]
proof:
:= by
  rw [MGAdj, FOInterpretation.relMap_map]
  simp [chromInterp, cnPt, hij, Formula.realize_rel₂]

name: DescriptiveComplexity.chrom_marked
statement:
@[simp]
theorem chrom_marked (i : Fin 4) (v : A) :
    MGMarked (cnPt i v) ↔ i ≠ 3 ∧ ∀ a : A, v ≤ a
proof:
:= by
  rw [MGMarked, FOInterpretation.relMap_map]
  rcases Classical.em (i = 3) with hi | hi
  · simp [chromInterp, cnPt, hi]
  · simp [chromInterp, cnPt, hi, realize_minF]

name: DescriptiveComplexity.chrom_ncard_marked
statement: theorem chrom_ncard_marked : {p : chromInterp.Map A | MGMarked p}.ncard = 3
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ : ∃ m : A, ∀ a : A, m ≤ a := Finite.exists_min id
  have hinj : Function.Injective fun i : Fin 3 => cnPt (A := A) i.castSucc m := by
    intro i j h
    exact Fin.castSucc_injective 3 (congrArg (fun p : Fin 4 × (Fin 1 → A) => p.1) h)
  have hset : {p : chromInterp.Map A | MGMarked p} =
      (fun i : Fin 3 => cnPt (A := A) i.castSucc m) '' Set.univ := by
    ext p
    rcases p with ⟨i, w⟩
    rw [cnPt_eta i w]
    constructor
    · intro hp
      obtain ⟨hi3, hmin⟩ := (chrom_marked i (w 0)).mp hp
      have hw : w 0 = m := le_antisymm (hmin m) (hm (w 0))
      refine ⟨⟨i.val, ?_⟩, Set.mem_univ _, ?_⟩
      · rcases Nat.lt_or_ge i.val 3 with h | h
        · exact h
        · exact absurd (Fin.ext (le_antisymm (Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp i.isLt) h)) hi3
      · rw [hw]
        rfl
    · rintro ⟨j, -, hj⟩
      rw [← hj]
      refine (chrom_marked _ m).mpr ⟨fun h => ?_, hm⟩
      have hval : (j.castSucc : ℕ) = ((3 : Fin 4) : ℕ) := congrArg Fin.val h
      have h3 : ((3 : Fin 4) : ℕ) = 3 := rfl
      have hj3 : (j : ℕ) < 3 := j.isLt
      simp only [Fin.val_castSucc] at hval
      omega
  rw [hset, Set.ncard_image_of_injective _ hinj, Set.ncard_univ, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card,
    Fintype.card_fin]

/
interpreted marked graph has chromatic number at most the size of its marked
set, which is three. -/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.threeColorable_iff_chromaticNumber_map
statement:
theorem threeColorable_iff_chromaticNumber_map :
    ThreeColorable A ↔ HasSmallChromaticNumber (chromInterp.Map A)
proof:
:= by
  have hfin : Finite (chromInterp.Map A) := chromInterp.map_finite A
  rw [HasSmallChromaticNumber, chrom_ncard_marked A]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨c, hc⟩
    refine ⟨hfin, fun p => c (p.2 0), fun p q hpq hcol => ?_⟩
    rcases p with ⟨i, w⟩
    rcases q with ⟨j, w'⟩
    rw [cnPt_eta i w, cnPt_eta j w'] at hpq
    obtain ⟨hne, hadj⟩ := hpq
    rcases Classical.em (i = j) with rfl | hij
    · rcases Classical.em (i = 0) with rfl | hi
      · exact hc (w 0) (w' 0) ((chrom_adj_zero (w 0) (w' 0)).mp hadj) hcol
      · exact chrom_adj_same i hi (w 0) (w' 0) hadj
    · obtain ⟨-, hloop⟩ := (chrom_adj_diff hij (w 0) (w' 0)).mp hadj
      exact hc (w 0) (w 0) hloop rfl
  · rintro ⟨-, c, hc⟩
    refine ⟨fun v => c (cnPt 0 v), fun x y hadj hcol => ?_⟩
    rcases Classical.em (x = y) with rfl | hxy
    ·
      obtain ⟨i, j, hij, hcij⟩ :=
        Fintype.exists_ne_map_eq_of_card_lt (fun i : Fin 4 => c (cnPt i x)) (by simp)
      exact hc (cnPt i x) (cnPt j x)
        ⟨fun h => hij (congrArg (fun p : Fin 4 × (Fin 1 → A) => p.1) h),
          (chrom_adj_diff hij x x).mpr ⟨rfl, hadj⟩⟩ hcij
    · exact hc (cnPt 0 x) (cnPt 0 y)
        ⟨fun h => hxy (cnPt_injective 0 h), (chrom_adj_zero x y).mpr hadj⟩ hcol

name: DescriptiveComplexity.gateVal_map
statement:
theorem gateVal_map (e : A ≃[Language.circuit] B) {b : Bool} {g : A}
    (h : GateVal b g) : GateVal b (e g)
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | constTrue hg => exact .constTrue ((relMap_equiv₁ e circIsTrue _).mp hg)
  | constFalse hg => exact .constFalse ((relMap_equiv₁ e circIsFalse _).mp hg)
  | andTrue hg hl hr _ _ ihl ihr =>
    exact .andTrue ((relMap_equiv₁ e circIsAnd _).mp hg)
      ((relMap_equiv₂ e circLeft _ _).mp hl) ((relMap_equiv₂ e circRight _ _).mp hr) ihl ihr
  | andFalseLeft hg hl _ ihl =>
    exact .andFalseLeft ((relMap_equiv₁ e circIsAnd _).mp hg)
      ((relMap_equiv₂ e circLeft _ _).mp hl) ihl
  | andFalseRight hg hr _ ihr =>
    exact .andFalseRight ((relMap_equiv₁ e circIsAnd _).mp hg)
      ((relMap_equiv₂ e circRight _ _).mp hr) ihr
  | orTrueLeft hg hl _ ihl =>
    exact .orTrueLeft ((relMap_equiv₁ e circIsOr _).mp hg)
      ((relMap_equiv₂ e circLeft _ _).mp hl) ihl
  | orTrueRight hg hr _ ihr =>
    exact .orTrueRight ((relMap_equiv₁ e circIsOr _).mp hg)
      ((relMap_equiv₂ e circRight _ _).mp hr) ihr
  | orFalse hg hl hr _ _ ihl ihr =>
    exact .orFalse ((relMap_equiv₁ e circIsOr _).mp hg)
      ((relMap_equiv₂ e circLeft _ _).mp hl) ((relMap_equiv₂ e circRight _ _).mp hr) ihl ihr
  | notTrue hg hi _ ihi =>
    exact .notTrue ((relMap_equiv₁ e circIsNot _).mp hg)
      ((relMap_equiv₂ e circLeft _ _).mp hi) ihi
  | notFalse hg hi _ ihi =>
    exact .notFalse ((relMap_equiv₁ e circIsNot _).mp hg)
      ((relMap_equiv₂ e circLeft _ _).mp hi) ihi

    (noPosClF c).Realize v ↔ IsCl (v c) ∧ ∀ x : A, ¬PosIn (v c) x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [noPosClF, Formula.realize_inf, realize_clF, Formula.realize_not,
    Formula.realize_iExs, realize_posF, Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr, not_exists]
