name: DescriptiveComplexity.CvpVal.hdVal_top
statement:
theorem hdVal_top {M : A} (hM : ∀ a : A, a ≤ M) (x s : A) :
    HdVal x M s ↔ ForcedIn (orank s + 1) x
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨c, -, hc, hp, hneg⟩
    exact ⟨c, hc, hp, hneg⟩
  · rintro ⟨c, hc, hp, hneg⟩
    exact ⟨c, hM c, hc, hp, hneg⟩

name: DescriptiveComplexity.CvpVal.bdVal_top
statement:
theorem bdVal_top {M : A} (hM : ∀ a : A, a ≤ M) (c s : A) :
    BdVal c M s ↔ ∀ y : A, NegIn c y → ForcedIn (orank s) y
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h y => h y (hM y), fun h y' _ => h y'⟩

/
everything that is forced at all. -/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.CvpVal.forced_iff_top
statement:
theorem forced_iff_top {M : A} (hM : ∀ a : A, a ≤ M) (x : A) :
    Forced x ↔ ForcedIn (orank M + 1) x
proof:
:= by
  have hcard : orank M + 1 = Nat.card A := by
    rw [orank_isTop hM]
    have : 0 < Nat.card A := Nat.card_pos
    omega
  rw [hcard]
  exact ⟨forced_forcedIn_card, fun h => ⟨_, h⟩⟩

/-! ### Building a derivation

Each gate evaluates to `1` as soon as its intended value holds. -/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.CvpVal.gateVal_tt
statement: theorem gateVal_tt (hm : ∀ a : A, m ≤ a) : GateVal true (ttPt (A := A) m)
proof:
:=
  .constTrue ((isTrue_iff .tt _).mpr ⟨rfl, fun a => hm a, fun a => hm a, fun a => hm a⟩)

name: DescriptiveComplexity.CvpVal.gateVal_stage
statement:
theorem gateVal_stage (hm : ∀ a : A, m ≤ a) (hM : ∀ a : A, a ≤ M) :
    ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ s : A, orank s = n →
      (∀ c y : A, BdVal c y s → GateVal true (bdPt c y s)) ∧
        ∀ x c : A, HdVal x c s → GateVal true (hdPt x c s)
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ n ih =>
    intro s hs

    have hright : ∀ c y : A, (NegIn c y → ForcedIn (orank s) y) →
        ∃ q, RelMap (M := cvpInterp.Map A) circRight ![bdPt c y s, q] ∧ GateVal true q := by
      intro c y hy
      by_cases hneg : NegIn c y
      ·
        have hforced := hy hneg
        by_cases hsmin : ∀ a : A, s ≤ a
        · rw [orank_eq_zero hsmin] at hforced
          exact hforced.elim
        · obtain ⟨s', hlt, hnb⟩ := exists_succ_of_not_min hsmin
          have hcov : s' ⋖ s := ⟨hlt, fun z hz hz' => hnb z ⟨hz, hz'⟩⟩
          have hrank : orank s = orank s' + 1 := orank_covBy hcov
          have hlt' : orank s' < n := by omega
          rw [hrank] at hforced
          have hhd : HdVal y M s' := (hdVal_top hM y s').mpr hforced
          refine ⟨hdPt y M s',
            (right_bd hm hM ![c, y, s] _).mpr (Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨hneg, s', hcov, rfl⟩)),
            (ih (orank s') hlt' s' rfl).2 y M hhd⟩
      · exact ⟨ttPt m, (right_bd hm hM ![c, y, s] _).mpr (Or.inl ⟨hneg, rfl⟩), gateVal_tt hm⟩

    have hbd : ∀ c y : A, BdVal c y s → GateVal true (bdPt c y s) := by
      intro c y
      induction y using order_induction with
      | hmin y hy =>
        intro hval
        obtain ⟨q, hq, hqv⟩ := hright c y fun hneg => hval y le_rfl hneg
        exact .andTrue ((isAnd_iff .bd _).mpr (Or.inl rfl))
          ((left_bd hm ![c, y, s] _).mpr (Or.inl ⟨hy, rfl⟩)) hq (gateVal_tt hm) hqv
      | hstep y' y hlt hnb ihy =>
        intro hval
        have hcov : y' ⋖ y := ⟨hlt, fun z hz hz' => hnb z ⟨hz, hz'⟩⟩
        obtain ⟨q, hq, hqv⟩ := hright c y fun hneg => hval y le_rfl hneg
        exact .andTrue ((isAnd_iff .bd _).mpr (Or.inl rfl))
          ((left_bd hm ![c, y, s] _).mpr (Or.inr ⟨y', hcov, rfl⟩)) hq
          (ihy fun y'' hy'' hneg => hval y'' (hy''.trans hlt.le) hneg) hqv
    refine ⟨hbd, ?_⟩

    intro x c
    induction c using order_induction with
    | hmin c hc =>
      rintro ⟨c', hc', hcl, hp, hneg⟩
      have hcc : c' = c := le_antisymm hc' (hc c')
      subst hcc
      refine .orTrueRight ((isOr_iff .hd _).mpr (Or.inl rfl))
        ((right_hd hm hM ![x, c', s] _).mpr (Or.inl ⟨⟨hcl, hp⟩, rfl⟩)) ?_
      exact hbd c' M ((bdVal_top hM c' s).mpr hneg)
    | hstep c' c hlt hnb ihc =>
      rintro ⟨c'', hc'', hcl, hp, hneg⟩
      have hcov : c' ⋖ c := ⟨hlt, fun z hz hz' => hnb z ⟨hz, hz'⟩⟩
      rcases covBy_le_cases hcov hc'' with hle | rfl
      · exact .orTrueLeft ((isOr_iff .hd _).mpr (Or.inl rfl))
          ((left_hd hm ![x, c, s] _).mpr (Or.inr ⟨c', hcov, rfl⟩))
          (ihc ⟨c'', hle, hcl, hp, hneg⟩)
      · refine .orTrueRight ((isOr_iff .hd _).mpr (Or.inl rfl))
          ((right_hd hm hM ![x, c'', s] _).mpr (Or.inl ⟨⟨hcl, hp⟩, rfl⟩)) ?_
        exact hbd c'' M ((bdVal_top hM c'' s).mpr hneg)

/
holds. -/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.CvpVal.gateVal_bdTop
statement:
theorem gateVal_bdTop (hm : ∀ a : A, m ≤ a) (hM : ∀ a : A, a ≤ M) (c y : A)
    (hval : BdTopVal c y) : GateVal true (bdTopPt m c y)
proof:
:= by
  have hand : ∀ y : A, RelMap (M := cvpInterp.Map A) circIsAnd ![bdTopPt m c y] :=
    fun _ => (isAnd_iff .bdTop _).mpr (Or.inr ⟨rfl, fun a => hm a⟩)
  have hleft := fun y : A => left_bdTop hm ![c, y, m]
  have hright' := fun y : A => right_bdTop hm hM ![c, y, m]
  have hright : ∀ y : A, (NegIn c y → Forced y) →
      ∃ q, RelMap (M := cvpInterp.Map A) circRight ![bdTopPt m c y, q] ∧ GateVal true q := by
    intro y hy
    by_cases hneg : NegIn c y
    · refine ⟨hdPt y M M, (hright' y _ fun a => hm a).mpr (Or.inr ⟨hneg, rfl⟩), ?_⟩
      exact (gateVal_stage hm hM (orank M) M rfl).2 y M
        ((hdVal_top hM y M).mpr ((forced_iff_top hM y).mp (hy hneg)))
    · exact ⟨ttPt m, (hright' y _ fun a => hm a).mpr (Or.inl ⟨hneg, rfl⟩), gateVal_tt hm⟩
  induction y using order_induction with
  | hmin y hy =>
    obtain ⟨q, hq, hqv⟩ := hright y fun hneg => hval y le_rfl hneg
    exact .andTrue (hand y) ((hleft y _).mpr (Or.inl ⟨fun a => hm a, hy, rfl⟩)) hq
      (gateVal_tt hm) hqv
  | hstep y' y hlt hnb ihy =>
    have hcov : y' ⋖ y := ⟨hlt, fun z hz hz' => hnb z ⟨hz, hz'⟩⟩
    obtain ⟨q, hq, hqv⟩ := hright y fun hneg => hval y le_rfl hneg
    exact .andTrue (hand y) ((hleft y _).mpr (Or.inr ⟨fun a => hm a, y', hcov, rfl⟩)) hq
      (ihy fun y'' hy'' hneg => hval y'' (hy''.trans hlt.le) hneg) hqv

/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.CvpVal.gateVal_gl
statement:
theorem gateVal_gl (hm : ∀ a : A, m ≤ a) (hM : ∀ a : A, a ≤ M) (c : A) (hval : GlVal c) :
    GateVal true (glPt m c)
proof:
:= by
  have hor : ∀ c : A, RelMap (M := cvpInterp.Map A) circIsOr ![glPt m c] :=
    fun _ => (isOr_iff .gl _).mpr (Or.inr ⟨rfl, fun a => hm a, fun a => hm a⟩)
  have hleft := fun c : A => fun q => left_gl hm ![c, m, m] q (fun a => hm a) fun a => hm a
  have hright := fun c : A => fun q => right_gl hm hM ![c, m, m] q (fun a => hm a) fun a => hm a

  have hgoal : ∀ c : A, IsCl c → (∀ x : A, ¬PosIn c x) → (∀ y : A, NegIn c y → Forced y) →
      GateVal true (glPt m c) := by
    intro c hcl hnp hneg
    exact .orTrueRight (hor c) ((hright c _).mpr (Or.inl ⟨⟨hcl, hnp⟩, rfl⟩))
      (gateVal_bdTop hm hM c M fun y' _ hn => hneg y' hn)
  induction c using order_induction with
  | hmin c hc =>
    rcases hval with hhorn | ⟨c', hc', hcl, hnp, hneg⟩
    · exact .orTrueLeft (hor c) ((hleft c _).mpr (Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨hc, hhorn, rfl⟩)))
        (gateVal_tt hm)
    · have hcc : c' = c := le_antisymm hc' (hc c')
      subst hcc
      exact hgoal c' hcl hnp hneg
  | hstep c' c hlt hnb ihc =>
    have hcov : c' ⋖ c := ⟨hlt, fun z hz hz' => hnb z ⟨hz, hz'⟩⟩
    rcases hval with hhorn | ⟨c'', hc'', hcl, hnp, hneg⟩
    · exact .orTrueLeft (hor c) ((hleft c _).mpr (Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨c', hcov, rfl⟩)))
        (ihc (Or.inl hhorn))
    · rcases covBy_le_cases hcov hc'' with hle | rfl
      · exact .orTrueLeft (hor c) ((hleft c _).mpr (Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨c', hcov, rfl⟩)))
          (ihc (Or.inr ⟨c'', hle, hcl, hnp, hneg⟩))
      · exact hgoal c'' hcl hnp hneg

name: DescriptiveComplexity.CvpVal.val_of_gateVal
statement:
theorem val_of_gateVal (hm : ∀ a : A, m ≤ a) (hM : ∀ a : A, a ≤ M) :
    ∀ {b : Bool} {p : cvpInterp.Map A}, GateVal b p → b = true → Val p
proof:
:= by
  intro b p h
  induction h with
  | @constTrue g hg =>
    obtain ⟨t, w⟩ := g
    obtain ⟨rfl, -, -, -⟩ := (isTrue_iff t w).mp hg
    exact fun _ => trivial
  | @constFalse g hg => simp
  | @andTrue g l r hg hl hr _ _ ihl ihr =>
    intro _
    obtain ⟨t, w⟩ := g
    rcases (isAnd_iff t w).mp hg with rfl | ⟨rfl, -⟩
    ·
      have hcur : NegIn (w 0) (w 1) → ForcedIn (orank (w 2)) (w 1) := by
        intro hneg
        rcases (right_bd hm hM w r).mp hr with ⟨hn, -⟩ | ⟨-, -, rfl⟩ | ⟨-, s', hcov, rfl⟩
        · exact absurd hneg hn
        · exact (ihr rfl).elim
        · rw [orank_covBy hcov]
          exact (hdVal_top hM (w 1) s').mp (ihr rfl)
      rcases (left_bd hm w l).mp hl with ⟨hmin, rfl⟩ | ⟨y', hcov, rfl⟩
      · intro y' hy' hneg
        rw [le_antisymm hy' (hmin y')]
        exact hcur (by rwa [le_antisymm hy' (hmin y')] at hneg)
      · intro y'' hy'' hneg
        rcases covBy_le_cases hcov hy'' with hle | rfl
        · exact ihl rfl y'' hle hneg
        · exact hcur hneg
    ·
      have hcur : NegIn (w 0) (w 1) → Forced (w 1) := by
        intro hneg
        rcases (right_bdTop hm hM w r (by
          rcases (isAnd_iff (CvpTag.bdTop) w).mp hg with h | ⟨-, h2⟩
          · exact absurd h (by simp)
          · exact h2)).mp hr with ⟨hn, -⟩ | ⟨-, rfl⟩
        · exact absurd hneg hn
        · exact (forced_iff_top hM (w 1)).mpr ((hdVal_top hM (w 1) M).mp (ihr rfl))
      rcases (left_bdTop hm w l).mp hl with ⟨-, hmin, rfl⟩ | ⟨-, y', hcov, rfl⟩
      · intro y' hy' hneg
        rw [le_antisymm hy' (hmin y')]
        exact hcur (by rwa [le_antisymm hy' (hmin y')] at hneg)
      · intro y'' hy'' hneg
        rcases covBy_le_cases hcov hy'' with hle | rfl
        · exact ihl rfl y'' hle hneg
        · exact hcur hneg
  | @andFalseLeft g l hg hl _ ihl => simp
  | @andFalseRight g r hg hr _ ihr => simp
  | @orTrueLeft g l hg hl _ ihl =>
    intro _
    obtain ⟨t, w⟩ := g
    rcases (isOr_iff t w).mp hg with rfl | ⟨rfl, h1, h2⟩
    · rcases (left_hd hm w l).mp hl with ⟨-, rfl⟩ | ⟨c', hcov, rfl⟩
      · exact (ihl rfl).elim
      · obtain ⟨c'', hle, hrest⟩ := ihl rfl
        exact ⟨c'', hle.trans hcov.le, hrest⟩
    · rcases (left_gl hm w l h1 h2).mp hl with ⟨-, -, rfl⟩ | ⟨-, hhorn, rfl⟩ | ⟨c', hcov, rfl⟩
      · exact (ihl rfl).elim
      · exact Or.inl hhorn
      · rcases ihl rfl with hhorn | ⟨c'', hle, hrest⟩
        · exact Or.inl hhorn
        · exact Or.inr ⟨c'', hle.trans hcov.le, hrest⟩
  | @orTrueRight g r hg hr _ ihr =>
    intro _
    obtain ⟨t, w⟩ := g
    rcases (isOr_iff t w).mp hg with rfl | ⟨rfl, h1, h2⟩
    · rcases (right_hd hm hM w r).mp hr with ⟨⟨hcl, hp⟩, rfl⟩ | ⟨-, rfl⟩
      · exact ⟨w 1, le_rfl, hcl, hp, (bdVal_top hM (w 1) (w 2)).mp (ihr rfl)⟩
      · exact (ihr rfl).elim
    · rcases (right_gl hm hM w r h1 h2).mp hr with ⟨⟨hcl, hnp⟩, rfl⟩ | ⟨-, rfl⟩
      · exact Or.inr ⟨w 0, le_rfl, hcl, hnp, fun y hn => ihr rfl y (hM y) hn⟩
      · exact (ihr rfl).elim
  | @orFalse g l r hg hl hr _ _ ihl ihr => simp
  | @notTrue g i hg hi _ ihi =>
    obtain ⟨t, w⟩ := g
    exact absurd hg (not_isNot t w)
  | @notFalse g i hg hi _ ihi => simp

name: DescriptiveComplexity.CvpDraw.isTrue_iff
statement:
theorem isTrue_iff (t : CvpTag) (w : Fin 3 → A) :
    RelMap (M := cvpInterp.Map A) circIsTrue ![(t, w)] ↔
      t = .tt ∧ (∀ a : A, w 0 ≤ a) ∧ (∀ a : A, w 1 ≤ a) ∧ (∀ a : A, w 2 ≤ a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [FOInterpretation.relMap_map]
  cases t <;>
    simp [cvpInterp, allMinF, realize_minF, and_assoc]

/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.CvpDraw.isAnd_iff
statement:
theorem isAnd_iff (t : CvpTag) (w : Fin 3 → A) :
    RelMap (M := cvpInterp.Map A) circIsAnd ![(t, w)] ↔
      t = .bd ∨ (t = .bdTop ∧ ∀ a : A, w 2 ≤ a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [FOInterpretation.relMap_map]
  cases t <;> simp [cvpInterp, realize_minF]

/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.CvpDraw.isOr_iff
statement:
theorem isOr_iff (t : CvpTag) (w : Fin 3 → A) :
    RelMap (M := cvpInterp.Map A) circIsOr ![(t, w)] ↔
      t = .hd ∨ (t = .gl ∧ (∀ a : A, w 1 ≤ a) ∧ ∀ a : A, w 2 ≤ a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [FOInterpretation.relMap_map]
  cases t <;> simp [cvpInterp, realize_minF]

/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.CvpDraw.not_isNot
statement:
theorem not_isNot (t : CvpTag) (w : Fin 3 → A) :
    ¬RelMap (M := cvpInterp.Map A) circIsNot ![(t, w)]
proof:
:= by
  rw [FOInterpretation.relMap_map]
  cases t <;> simp [cvpInterp]

/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.CvpDraw.out_iff
statement:
theorem out_iff (t : CvpTag) (w : Fin 3 → A) :
    RelMap (M := cvpInterp.Map A) circOut ![(t, w)] ↔
      t = .gl ∧ (∀ a : A, a ≤ w 0) ∧ (∀ a : A, w 1 ≤ a) ∧ (∀ a : A, w 2 ≤ a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [FOInterpretation.relMap_map]
  cases t <;> simp [cvpInterp, realize_minF, realize_maxF, and_assoc]

name: DescriptiveComplexity.CvpDraw.eq_pad
statement:
theorem eq_pad (hm : ∀ a : A, m ≤ a) {w : Fin 3 → A} (h0 : ∀ a : A, w 0 ≤ a)
    (h1 : ∀ a : A, w 1 ≤ a) (h2 : ∀ a : A, w 2 ≤ a) : w = fun _ => m
proof:
:= by
  funext j
  fin_cases j
  · exact le_antisymm (h0 m) (hm _)
  · exact le_antisymm (h1 m) (hm _)
  · exact le_antisymm (h2 m) (hm _)

name: DescriptiveComplexity.CvpDraw.isBot_iff_eq
statement: theorem isBot_iff_eq (hm : ∀ a : A, m ≤ a) (x : A) : (∀ a : A, x ≤ a) ↔ x = m
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => le_antisymm (h m) (hm x), fun h a => h ▸ hm a⟩

/
the walk, the previous link otherwise. -/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.CvpDraw.left_bd
statement:
theorem left_bd (hm : ∀ a : A, m ≤ a) (w : Fin 3 → A) (q : cvpInterp.Map A) :
    RelMap (M := cvpInterp.Map A) circLeft ![(CvpTag.bd, w), q] ↔
      ((∀ a : A, w 1 ≤ a) ∧ q = ttPt m) ∨ ∃ y', y' ⋖ w 1 ∧ q = bdPt (w 0) y' (w 2)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t', w'⟩ := q
  rw [FOInterpretation.relMap_map]
  cases t' <;>
    simp [cvpInterp, allMinF, ttPt, bdPt, realize_minF, realize_eqF, CovBy,
      FOInterpretation.Map, Prod.ext_iff, funext_iff, Fin.forall_fin_succ, isBot_iff_eq hm,
      and_assoc]

name: DescriptiveComplexity.CvpDraw.isTop_iff_eq
statement: theorem isTop_iff_eq {M : A} (hM : ∀ a : A, a ≤ M) (x : A) : (∀ a : A, a ≤ x) ↔ x = M
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => le_antisymm (hM x) (h M), fun h a => h ▸ hM a⟩

/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.CvpDraw.left_bdTop
statement:
theorem left_bdTop (hm : ∀ a : A, m ≤ a) (w : Fin 3 → A) (q : cvpInterp.Map A) :
    RelMap (M := cvpInterp.Map A) circLeft ![(CvpTag.bdTop, w), q] ↔
      ((∀ a : A, w 2 ≤ a) ∧ (∀ a : A, w 1 ≤ a) ∧ q = ttPt m) ∨
        ((∀ a : A, w 2 ≤ a) ∧ ∃ y', y' ⋖ w 1 ∧ q = bdTopPt m (w 0) y')
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t', w'⟩ := q
  rw [FOInterpretation.relMap_map]
  cases t' <;>
    simp [cvpInterp, allMinF, ttPt, bdTopPt, realize_minF,
      realize_eqF,
      CovBy, FOInterpretation.Map, Prod.ext_iff, funext_iff, Fin.forall_fin_succ,
      isBot_iff_eq hm, and_assoc]
  all_goals tauto

/
the walk over clauses, the previous link otherwise. -/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.CvpDraw.left_hd
statement:
theorem left_hd (hm : ∀ a : A, m ≤ a) (w : Fin 3 → A) (q : cvpInterp.Map A) :
    RelMap (M := cvpInterp.Map A) circLeft ![(CvpTag.hd, w), q] ↔
      ((∀ a : A, w 1 ≤ a) ∧ q = ffPt m) ∨ ∃ c', c' ⋖ w 1 ∧ q = hdPt (w 0) c' (w 2)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t', w'⟩ := q
  rw [FOInterpretation.relMap_map]
  cases t' <;>
    simp [cvpInterp, allMinF, ffPt, hdPt, realize_minF,
      realize_eqF,
      CovBy, FOInterpretation.Map, Prod.ext_iff, funext_iff, Fin.forall_fin_succ,
      isBot_iff_eq hm, and_assoc]

/
constant `1` exactly when the instance is not Horn, which is what makes a
non-Horn instance a yes-instance outright. -/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.CvpDraw.left_gl
statement:
theorem left_gl (hm : ∀ a : A, m ≤ a) (w : Fin 3 → A) (q : cvpInterp.Map A)
    (h1 : ∀ a : A, w 1 ≤ a) (h2 : ∀ a : A, w 2 ≤ a) :
    RelMap (M := cvpInterp.Map A) circLeft ![(CvpTag.gl, w), q] ↔
      ((∀ a : A, w 0 ≤ a) ∧ AtMostOnePositive A ∧ q = ffPt m) ∨
        ((∀ a : A, w 0 ≤ a) ∧ ¬AtMostOnePositive A ∧ q = ttPt m) ∨
          ∃ c', c' ⋖ w 0 ∧ q = glPt m c'
proof:
:= by
  have e1 : w 1 = m := le_antisymm (h1 m) (hm _)
  have e2 : w 2 = m := le_antisymm (h2 m) (hm _)
  obtain ⟨t', w'⟩ := q
  rw [FOInterpretation.relMap_map]
  cases t' <;>
    simp [cvpInterp, allMinF, ttPt, ffPt, glPt, realize_minF,
      realize_hornCondF,
      CovBy, FOInterpretation.Map, Prod.ext_iff, funext_iff, Fin.forall_fin_succ,
      isBot_iff_eq hm, and_assoc, e1, e2]

/
is not a negative literal of the clause, the constant `0` at the bottom stage,
and the propagation gate of the previous stage otherwise. -/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.CvpDraw.right_bd
statement:
theorem right_bd (hm : ∀ a : A, m ≤ a) {M : A} (hM : ∀ a : A, a ≤ M) (w : Fin 3 → A)
    (q : cvpInterp.Map A) :
    RelMap (M := cvpInterp.Map A) circRight ![(CvpTag.bd, w), q] ↔
      (¬NegIn (w 0) (w 1) ∧ q = ttPt m) ∨
        (NegIn (w 0) (w 1) ∧ (∀ a : A, w 2 ≤ a) ∧ q = ffPt m) ∨
          (NegIn (w 0) (w 1) ∧ ∃ s', s' ⋖ w 2 ∧ q = hdPt (w 1) M s')
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t', w'⟩ := q
  rw [FOInterpretation.relMap_map]
  cases t' <;>
    simp [cvpInterp, allMinF, ttPt, ffPt, hdPt, realize_minF, realize_maxF,
      realize_eqF, realize_negF,
      CovBy, FOInterpretation.Map, Prod.ext_iff, funext_iff, Fin.forall_fin_succ,
      isBot_iff_eq hm, isTop_iff_eq hM, and_assoc]
  tauto

/
gate at the last stage. -/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.CvpDraw.right_bdTop
statement:
theorem right_bdTop (hm : ∀ a : A, m ≤ a) {M : A} (hM : ∀ a : A, a ≤ M) (w : Fin 3 → A)
    (q : cvpInterp.Map A) (h2 : ∀ a : A, w 2 ≤ a) :
    RelMap (M := cvpInterp.Map A) circRight ![(CvpTag.bdTop, w), q] ↔
      (¬NegIn (w 0) (w 1) ∧ q = ttPt m) ∨ (NegIn (w 0) (w 1) ∧ q = hdPt (w 1) M M)
proof:
:= by
  have e2 : w 2 = m := le_antisymm (h2 m) (hm _)
  obtain ⟨t', w'⟩ := q
  rw [FOInterpretation.relMap_map]
  cases t' <;>
    simp [cvpInterp, allMinF, ttPt, hdPt, realize_minF, realize_maxF,
      realize_eqF, realize_negF,
      FOInterpretation.Map, Prod.ext_iff, funext_iff, Fin.forall_fin_succ,
      isBot_iff_eq hm, isTop_iff_eq hM, and_assoc, e2]

/
when that clause has the right positive literal, the constant `0` otherwise. -/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.CvpDraw.right_hd
statement:
theorem right_hd (hm : ∀ a : A, m ≤ a) {M : A} (hM : ∀ a : A, a ≤ M) (w : Fin 3 → A)
    (q : cvpInterp.Map A) :
    RelMap (M := cvpInterp.Map A) circRight ![(CvpTag.hd, w), q] ↔
      ((IsCl (w 1) ∧ PosIn (w 1) (w 0)) ∧ q = bdPt (w 1) M (w 2)) ∨
        (¬(IsCl (w 1) ∧ PosIn (w 1) (w 0)) ∧ q = ffPt m)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t', w'⟩ := q
  rw [FOInterpretation.relMap_map]
  cases t' <;>
    simp [cvpInterp, allMinF, ffPt, bdPt, realize_minF, realize_maxF,
      realize_eqF, realize_clF, realize_posF,
      FOInterpretation.Map, Prod.ext_iff, funext_iff, Fin.forall_fin_succ,
      isBot_iff_eq hm, isTop_iff_eq hM, and_assoc]

/
hand when it is a goal clause, the constant `0` otherwise. -/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.CvpDraw.right_gl
statement:
theorem right_gl (hm : ∀ a : A, m ≤ a) {M : A} (hM : ∀ a : A, a ≤ M) (w : Fin 3 → A)
    (q : cvpInterp.Map A) (h1 : ∀ a : A, w 1 ≤ a) (h2 : ∀ a : A, w 2 ≤ a) :
    RelMap (M := cvpInterp.Map A) circRight ![(CvpTag.gl, w), q] ↔
      ((IsCl (w 0) ∧ ∀ x : A, ¬PosIn (w 0) x) ∧ q = bdTopPt m (w 0) M) ∨
        (¬(IsCl (w 0) ∧ ∀ x : A, ¬PosIn (w 0) x) ∧ q = ffPt m)
proof:
:= by
  have e1 : w 1 = m := le_antisymm (h1 m) (hm _)
  have e2 : w 2 = m := le_antisymm (h2 m) (hm _)
  obtain ⟨t', w'⟩ := q
  rw [FOInterpretation.relMap_map]
  cases t' <;>
    simp [cvpInterp, allMinF, ffPt, bdTopPt, realize_minF, realize_maxF,
      realize_eqF, realize_noPosClF,
      FOInterpretation.Map, Prod.ext_iff, funext_iff, Fin.forall_fin_succ,
      isBot_iff_eq hm, isTop_iff_eq hM, and_assoc, e1, e2]

name: DescriptiveComplexity.CvpVal.not_hornSatisfiable_iff_glVal
statement:
theorem not_hornSatisfiable_iff_glVal {M : A} (hM : ∀ a : A, a ≤ M) :
    ¬HornSatisfiable A ↔ GlVal M
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    by_cases hhorn : AtMostOnePositive A
    · have hunsat : ¬Satisfiable A := fun hsat => h ⟨hhorn, hsat⟩
      obtain ⟨c, hc, hneg, hnp⟩ := exists_goalClause hunsat
      exact Or.inr ⟨c, hM c, hc, hnp, hneg⟩
    · exact Or.inl hhorn
  · rintro (hhorn | ⟨c, -, hc, hnp, hneg⟩) h
    · exact hhorn h.1
    · obtain ⟨hhorn, ν, hν⟩ := h
      obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hν c hc
      rcases hx with ⟨hp, -⟩ | ⟨hn, hnv⟩
      · exact hnp x hp
      · exact hnv (forced_subset_model hhorn hν x (hneg x hn))

/-! ### What the drawn circuit accepts -/

/
The output gate is the top of the goal chain, so this is the two halves of the
evaluation read at that gate, against the certificate above. -/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.CvpVal.circuitAccepts_iff
statement:
theorem circuitAccepts_iff :
    CircuitAccepts (cvpInterp.Map A) ↔ ¬HornSatisfiable A
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ : ∃ m : A, ∀ a : A, m ≤ a := by
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := Finite.exists_min (id : A → A)
    exact ⟨m, hm⟩
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ : ∃ M : A, ∀ a : A, a ≤ M := by
    obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := Finite.exists_max (id : A → A)
    exact ⟨M, hM⟩
  rw [not_hornSatisfiable_iff_glVal hM]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨p, hout, hval⟩
    obtain ⟨t, w⟩ := p
    obtain ⟨rfl, htop, -, -⟩ := (out_iff t w).mp hout
    have hgl : GlVal (w 0) := val_of_gateVal hm hM hval rfl
    rwa [le_antisymm (hM (w 0)) (htop M)] at hgl
  · intro hgl
    exact ⟨glPt m M, (out_iff .gl _).mpr ⟨rfl, fun a => hM a, fun a => hm a, fun a => hm a⟩,
      gateVal_gl hm hM M hgl⟩

name: DescriptiveComplexity.cvp_PTIME_hard
statement: theorem cvp_PTIME_hard : PTIME.Hard CVP
proof:
:= by
  refine (hard_PTIME_iff CVP).mpr fun Q hQ => ?_
  obtain ⟨f⟩ := hornSat_hard_of_sigmaSOHornDefinable Qᶜ hQ.compl
  exact ⟨((f.compl.congrSource fun A _ _ => not_not).trans
    hornSatCompl_ordered_fo_reduction_cvp).toRel⟩

name: DescriptiveComplexity.Cvp.realize_kindF
statement:
theorem realize_kindF (r : cvLang.Relations 1) (i : Fin nvars)
    (v : Fin nvars → A) :

proof:

statement:

proof:

`b` when it derives the value `b`. -/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.Cvp.gateAssign_rail
statement:
theorem gateAssign_rail (b : Bool) (i : Fin nvars) (v : Fin nvars → A) :
    (rail b i).Holds (gateAssign (A := A)) v ↔ GateVal b (v i)
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

/
rule. -/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.Cvp.gateAssign_closed
statement:
theorem gateAssign_closed :
    ∀ c ∈ cvpRules, ∀ a : SOAtom valBlock nvars, c.head = some a →
      ∀ v : Fin nvars → A, c.guard.Realize v →
        (∀ b ∈ c.body, b.Holds (gateAssign (A := A)) v) → a.Holds gateAssign v
proof:
:= by
  intro c hc a ha v hg hb

  simp only [cvpRules, List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at hc
  rcases hc with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl <;>
    · simp only [Option.some.injEq] at ha
      subst ha
      simp only [Formula.realize_inf, realize_kindF, realize_wireF] at hg
      simp only [List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false, forall_eq_or_imp,
        forall_eq] at hb
      simp only [gateAssign_rail] at hb ⊢
      first
        | exact .constTrue hg
        | exact .constFalse hg
        | exact .andTrue hg.1.1 hg.1.2 hg.2 hb.1 hb.2
        | exact .andFalseLeft hg.1 hg.2 hb
        | exact .andFalseRight hg.1 hg.2 hb
        | exact .orTrueLeft hg.1 hg.2 hb
        | exact .orTrueRight hg.1 hg.2 hb
        | exact .orFalse hg.1.1 hg.1.2 hg.2 hb.1 hb.2
        | exact .notTrue hg.1 hg.2 hb
        | exact .notFalse hg.1 hg.2 hb

/
least fixed point is contained in the inductive semantics. -/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.Cvp.gateVal_of_derives
proof:
:=
  lfpAssign_least_of_closed (ρ := gateAssign) gateAssign_closed h

/
written `fun _ => g` throughout, which is the shape
`DescriptiveComplexity.Derives.rule` produces for a unary head. -/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.Cvp.derives_of_gateVal
statement:
theorem derives_of_gateVal {b : Bool} {g : A} (h : GateVal b g) :
    Derives cvpRules (⟨b, fun _ => g⟩ : Σ i : valBlock.ι, Fin (valBlock.arity i) → A)
proof:
:= by


  induction h with
  | @constTrue g hg =>
    refine .rule (c := ⟨kindF gIsTrue 0, [], some (rail true 0)⟩)
      (by simp [cvpRules]) rfl (v := ![g, g, g]) ?_ (by simp)
    exact (realize_kindF _ _ _).mpr hg
  | @constFalse g hg =>
    refine .rule (c := ⟨kindF gIsFalse 0, [], some (rail false 0)⟩)
      (by simp [cvpRules]) rfl (v := ![g, g, g]) ?_ (by simp)
    exact (realize_kindF _ _ _).mpr hg
  | @andTrue g l r hgg hl hr _ _ ihl ihr =>
    refine .rule (c := ⟨kindF gIsAnd 0 ⊓ wireF gLeft 0 1 ⊓ wireF gRight 0 2,
        [rail true 1, rail true 2], some (rail true 0)⟩)
      (by simp [cvpRules]) rfl (v := ![g, l, r]) ?_ ?_
    · simp only [Formula.realize_inf, realize_kindF, realize_wireF]
      exact ⟨⟨hgg, hl⟩, hr⟩
    · intro x hx
      simp only [List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at hx
      rcases hx with rfl | rfl
      · exact ihl
      · exact ihr
  | @andFalseLeft g l hgg hl _ ihl =>
    refine .rule (c := ⟨kindF gIsAnd 0 ⊓ wireF gLeft 0 1, [rail false 1], some (rail false 0)⟩)
      (by simp [cvpRules]) rfl (v := ![g, l, l]) ?_ ?_
    · simp only [Formula.realize_inf, realize_kindF, realize_wireF]
      exact ⟨hgg, hl⟩
    · intro x hx
      simp only [List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at hx
      rcases hx with rfl
      exact ihl
  | @andFalseRight g r hgg hr _ ihr =>
    refine .rule (c := ⟨kindF gIsAnd 0 ⊓ wireF gRight 0 2, [rail false 2], some (rail false 0)⟩)
      (by simp [cvpRules]) rfl (v := ![g, r, r]) ?_ ?_
    · simp only [Formula.realize_inf, realize_kindF, realize_wireF]
      exact ⟨hgg, hr⟩
    · intro x hx
      simp only [List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at hx
      rcases hx with rfl
      exact ihr
  | @orTrueLeft g l hgg hl _ ihl =>
    refine .rule (c := ⟨kindF gIsOr 0 ⊓ wireF gLeft 0 1, [rail true 1], some (rail true 0)⟩)
      (by simp [cvpRules]) rfl (v := ![g, l, l]) ?_ ?_
    · simp only [Formula.realize_inf, realize_kindF, realize_wireF]
      exact ⟨hgg, hl⟩
    · intro x hx
      simp only [List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at hx
      rcases hx with rfl
      exact ihl
  | @orTrueRight g r hgg hr _ ihr =>
    refine .rule (c := ⟨kindF gIsOr 0 ⊓ wireF gRight 0 2, [rail true 2], some (rail true 0)⟩)
      (by simp [cvpRules]) rfl (v := ![g, r, r]) ?_ ?_
    · simp only [Formula.realize_inf, realize_kindF, realize_wireF]
      exact ⟨hgg, hr⟩
    · intro x hx
      simp only [List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at hx
      rcases hx with rfl
      exact ihr
  | @orFalse g l r hgg hl hr _ _ ihl ihr =>
    refine .rule (c := ⟨kindF gIsOr 0 ⊓ wireF gLeft 0 1 ⊓ wireF gRight 0 2,
        [rail false 1, rail false 2], some (rail false 0)⟩)
      (by simp [cvpRules]) rfl (v := ![g, l, r]) ?_ ?_
    · simp only [Formula.realize_inf, realize_kindF, realize_wireF]
      exact ⟨⟨hgg, hl⟩, hr⟩
    · intro x hx
      simp only [List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at hx
      rcases hx with rfl | rfl
      · exact ihl
      · exact ihr
  | @notTrue g i hgg hi _ ihi =>
    refine .rule (c := ⟨kindF gIsNot 0 ⊓ wireF gLeft 0 1, [rail false 1], some (rail true 0)⟩)
      (by simp [cvpRules]) rfl (v := ![g, i, i]) ?_ ?_
    · simp only [Formula.realize_inf, realize_kindF, realize_wireF]
      exact ⟨hgg, hi⟩
    · intro x hx
      simp only [List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at hx
      rcases hx with rfl
      exact ihi
  | @notFalse g i hgg hi _ ihi =>
    refine .rule (c := ⟨kindF gIsNot 0 ⊓ wireF gLeft 0 1, [rail true 1], some (rail false 0)⟩)
      (by simp [cvpRules]) rfl (v := ![g, i, i]) ?_ ?_
    · simp only [Formula.realize_inf, realize_kindF, realize_wireF]
      exact ⟨hgg, hi⟩
    · intro x hx
      simp only [List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at hx
      rcases hx with rfl
      exact ihi

/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.Cvp.lfpAssign_iff
statement:
theorem lfpAssign_iff {b : Bool} {x : Fin 1 → A} :
    lfpAssign (A := A) cvpRules b x ↔ GateVal b (x 0)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨gateVal_of_derives, fun h => ?_⟩
  have hx : (fun _ : Fin 1 => x 0) = x := funext fun j => congrArg x (Fin.eq_zero j).symm
  exact hx ▸ derives_of_gateVal h

name: DescriptiveComplexity.Cvp.realize_cvpOut
statement:
theorem realize_cvpOut :
    (@Sentence.Realize (cvLang.sum valBlock.lang) A
        (@sumStructure _ _ A _ (valBlock.structure (lfpAssign (A := A) cvpRules))) cvpOut) ↔
      CircuitAccepts A
proof:
:= by
  let := valBlock.structure (lfpAssign (A := A) cvpRules)
  rw [cvpOut]
  simp only [Sentence.Realize, Formula.realize_iExs, Formula.realize_inf,
    realize_guardOutF, realize_atomF, Formula.realize_rel₁]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i, hout, hval⟩
    exact ⟨i 0, hout, (lfpAssign_iff (x := fun _ => i 0)).mp hval⟩
  · rintro ⟨g, hout, hval⟩
    exact ⟨fun _ => g, hout, (lfpAssign_iff (x := fun _ => g)).mpr hval⟩

/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.Cvp.cvpDef_holds

theorem cvpDef_holds [Finite A] [Nonempty A] :

name: DescriptiveComplexity.CVP_PTIME_complete

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SatCover.Occ.ext
statement: theorem ext {o o' : Occ A} (hc : o.c = o'.c) (hx : o.x = o'.x) (hs : o.s = o'.s) : o = o'
proof:
:=
  Subtype.ext (Prod.ext hc (Prod.ext hx hs))

/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SatCover.Occ.satOccurs
statement: theorem satOccurs : SatOccurs A o.x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨⟨c, x, s⟩, hv⟩ := o
  rcases hv with ⟨_, h⟩ | ⟨c', _, hc, h⟩
  · exact h
  · cases s
    · exact ⟨c', hc, Or.inr h⟩
    · exact ⟨c', hc, Or.inl h⟩

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SatCover.Occ.occIn_of_coe
statement: theorem occIn_of_coe {c : A} (h : o.c = c) : OccIn c o.x o.s
proof:
:= by
  rcases o.2 with ⟨hb, _⟩ | ⟨c', hc', h'⟩
  · exact absurd (hb.symm.trans h) WithBot.bot_ne_coe
  · exact WithBot.coe_injective (hc'.symm.trans h) ▸ h'

/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SatCover.hubOf_of_bot
statement: theorem hubOf_of_bot {o : Occ A} (h : o.c = ⊥) : hubOf o = Sum.inr ⟨o.x, o.satOccurs⟩
proof:
:= by
  rw [hubOf, dite_eq_left h]

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SatCover.hubOf_of_coe
statement:
theorem hubOf_of_coe {o : Occ A} {c : A} (h : o.c = c) :
    hubOf o = Sum.inl ⟨c, (o.occIn_of_coe h).isCl⟩
proof:
:= by
  have h' : o.c ≠ ⊥ := h ▸ WithBot.coe_ne_bot
  rw [hubOf, dite_eq_right h']
  exact congrArg Sum.inl (Subtype.ext (by
    change o.c.unbot h' = c
    exact WithBot.coe_injective ((WithBot.coe_unbot _ h').trans h)))

/
the clause. -/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SatCover.hubOf_eq_inl_iff
statement: theorem hubOf_eq_inl_iff (o : Occ A) (c : {c : A // IsCl c}) : hubOf o = Sum.inl c ↔ o.c = c.1
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    by_cases hb : o.c = ⊥
    · rw [hubOf_of_bot hb] at h
      exact absurd h Sum.inr_ne_inl
    · obtain ⟨c', hc'⟩ := WithBot.ne_bot_iff_exists.mp hb
      rw [hubOf_of_coe hc'.symm] at h
      rw [← hc']
      exact congrArg (fun c : {c : A // IsCl c} => ((c.1 : A) : WithBot A)) (Sum.inl.inj h)
  · intro h
    rw [hubOf_of_coe h]

/
dummy one of the variable. -/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SatCover.hubOf_eq_inr_iff
statement:
theorem hubOf_eq_inr_iff (o : Occ A) (x : {x : A // SatOccurs A x}) :
    hubOf o = Sum.inr x ↔ o.c = ⊥ ∧ o.x = x.1
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    by_cases hb : o.c = ⊥
    · rw [hubOf_of_bot hb] at h
      exact ⟨hb, congrArg Subtype.val (Sum.inr.inj h)⟩
    · obtain ⟨c', hc'⟩ := WithBot.ne_bot_iff_exists.mp hb
      rw [hubOf_of_coe hc'.symm] at h
      exact absurd h Sum.inl_ne_inr
  · rintro ⟨hb, hx⟩
    rw [hubOf_of_bot hb]
    exact congrArg Sum.inr (Subtype.ext hx)

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SatCover.mem_chain
statement:
theorem mem_chain {x : A} {s : Bool} {c : WithBot A} :
    c ∈ chain x s ↔ c = ⊥ ∨ ∃ c' : A, c = c' ∧ OccIn c' x s
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [chain, mem_insert, mem_image, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and]
  exact or_congr_right (exists_congr fun c' => ⟨fun h => ⟨h.2.symm, h.1⟩, fun h => ⟨h.2, h.1.symm⟩⟩)

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SatCover.c_mem_chain
statement: theorem c_mem_chain (o : Occ A) : o.c ∈ chain o.x o.s
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_chain]
  rcases o.2 with ⟨h, _⟩ | ⟨c, hc, h⟩
  · exact Or.inl h
  · exact Or.inr ⟨c, hc, h⟩

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SatCover.chain_nonempty
statement: theorem chain_nonempty (x : A) (s : Bool) : (chain x s).Nonempty
proof:
:=
  ⟨⊥, mem_chain.mpr (Or.inl rfl)⟩

/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SatCover.nextOcc_c
statement: @[simp] theorem nextOcc_c (o : Occ A) : (nextOcc o).c = cycNext (chain o.x o.s) o.c
proof: := rfl

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SatCover.nextOcc_x
statement: @[simp] theorem nextOcc_x (o : Occ A) : (nextOcc o).x = o.x
proof: := rfl

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SatCover.nextOcc_s
statement: @[simp] theorem nextOcc_s (o : Occ A) : (nextOcc o).s = o.s
proof: := rfl

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SatCover.nextOcc_injective
statement: theorem nextOcc_injective : Function.Injective (nextOcc (A := A))
proof:
:= by
  intro o o' h
  have hx : o.x = o'.x := by simpa only [nextOcc_x] using congrArg Occ.x h
  have hs : o.s = o'.s := by simpa only [nextOcc_s] using congrArg Occ.s h
  refine Occ.ext ?_ hx hs
  have hc := congrArg Occ.c h
  rw [nextOcc_c, nextOcc_c, hx, hs] at hc
  exact cycNext_injOn _ (hx ▸ hs ▸ c_mem_chain o) (c_mem_chain o') hc

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SatCover.baseEdge_trk_iff
statement:
theorem baseEdge_trk_iff {o : Occ A} {n : Node A} :
    BaseEdge (trk o) n ↔ n = trk (nextOcc o)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    cases h
    rfl
  · rintro rfl
    exact .track o

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SatCover.baseEdge_spk_iff

proof:
:= by

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SatCover.hub_notMem_del
