/
none (the track is then used entirely or not at all), and every hub has
exactly one spoke whose loop is not chosen, to close a cycle with. -/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SatCover.consistent_of_valid
statement:
theorem consistent_of_valid {U : Finset (Occ A)} {e : Rem U ≃ Rem U} (he : Valid U e) :
    Consistent U
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun o ho => ?_, fun o ho => ?_, fun h => ?_⟩
  · by_contra hn
    have hm := he (e.symm ⟨trk (nextOcc o), trk_mem_del.not.mpr hn⟩)
    rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply] at hm
    obtain ⟨o', ho', hn'⟩ := baseEdge_to_trk_iff.mp hm
    rw [nextOcc_injective hn'] at ho'
    exact (e.symm _).2 (ho' ▸ trk_mem_del.mpr ho)
  · have hm := he ⟨trk o, trk_mem_del.not.mpr ho⟩
    rw [baseEdge_trk_iff] at hm
    exact fun hn => (e _).2 (hm ▸ trk_mem_del.mpr hn)
  · have hm := he ⟨hub h, hub_notMem_del⟩
    obtain ⟨o, ho, hoh⟩ := baseEdge_hub_iff.mp hm
    have hoU : o ∈ U := by
      have h2 := (e ⟨hub h, hub_notMem_del⟩).2
      rw [ho] at h2
      exact not_not.mp (spk_mem_del.not.mp h2)
    refine ⟨o, ⟨hoh, hoU⟩, fun o' ⟨hoh', ho'⟩ => ?_⟩
    have h1 := he ⟨spk o, spk_mem_del.not.mpr (not_not.mpr hoU)⟩
    have h2 := he ⟨spk o', spk_mem_del.not.mpr (not_not.mpr ho')⟩
    rw [baseEdge_spk_iff] at h1 h2
    have := e.injective (Subtype.ext ((h2.trans (congrArg hub (hoh'.trans hoh.symm))).trans
      h1.symm))
    exact Sum.inl.inj (Sum.inr.inj (congrArg Subtype.val this))

/
from each spoke to its hub, from each hub to its one free spoke. -/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SatCover.forced_injective
statement:
theorem forced_injective {U : Finset (Occ A)} (hU : Consistent U) :
    Function.Injective (forced hU)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨n, hn⟩ ⟨n', hn'⟩ h
  rcases n with o | o | k <;> rcases n' with o' | o' | k' <;>
    simp only [forced, Subtype.mk.injEq, trk, spk, hub, Sum.inl.injEq, Sum.inr.injEq,
      reduceCtorEq] at h
  · exact Subtype.ext (congrArg Sum.inl (nextOcc_injective h))
  · have ho : o ∈ U := not_not.mp (spk_mem_del.not.mp hn)
    have ho' : o' ∈ U := not_not.mp (spk_mem_del.not.mp hn')
    exact Subtype.ext (congrArg spk ((hU.2.2 (hubOf o)).unique ⟨rfl, ho⟩ ⟨h.symm, ho'⟩))
  · exact Subtype.ext (congrArg hub (((Classical.choose_spec (hU.2.2 k).exists).1.symm.trans
      (congrArg hubOf h)).trans (Classical.choose_spec (hU.2.2 k').exists).1))

/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SatCover.valid_forcedEquiv
statement: theorem valid_forcedEquiv {U : Finset (Occ A)} (hU : Consistent U) : Valid U (forcedEquiv hU)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨n, hn⟩
  rcases n with o | o | h
  · exact .track o
  · exact .spoke o
  · exact baseEdge_hub_iff.mpr ⟨_, rfl, (Classical.choose_spec (hU.2.2 h).exists).1⟩

/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SatCover.valid_unique
statement:
theorem valid_unique {U : Finset (Occ A)} {e e' : Rem U ≃ Rem U} (he : Valid U e)
    (he' : Valid U e') : e = e'
proof:
:= by
  have hU := consistent_of_valid he
  refine Equiv.ext fun ⟨n, hn⟩ => Subtype.ext ?_
  rcases n with o | o | h
  · exact (baseEdge_trk_iff.mp (he ⟨trk o, hn⟩)).trans (baseEdge_trk_iff.mp (he' ⟨trk o, hn⟩)).symm
  · exact (baseEdge_spk_iff.mp (he ⟨spk o, hn⟩)).trans (baseEdge_spk_iff.mp (he' ⟨spk o, hn⟩)).symm
  · obtain ⟨o, ho, hoh⟩ := baseEdge_hub_iff.mp (he ⟨hub h, hn⟩)
    obtain ⟨o', ho', hoh'⟩ := baseEdge_hub_iff.mp (he' ⟨hub h, hn⟩)
    rw [ho, ho', (hU.2.2 h).unique ⟨hoh, not_not.mp (spk_mem_del.not.mp (ho ▸ (e _).2))⟩
      ⟨hoh', not_not.mp (spk_mem_del.not.mp (ho' ▸ (e' _).2))⟩]

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SatCover.pdel_base
statement:
theorem pdel_base (U : Finset (Occ A)) :
    pdel baseM (del U) (del U) = if Consistent U then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [pdel]
  change bperm (fun a b : Rem U => if BaseEdge a.1 b.1 then (1 : ℤ) else 0) = _
  rw [bperm_boole]
  by_cases hU : Consistent U
  · rw [ite_eq_left hU, Nat.cast_eq_one, Fintype.card_eq_one_iff]
    exact ⟨⟨forcedEquiv hU, valid_forcedEquiv hU⟩, fun e =>
      Subtype.ext (valid_unique e.2 (valid_forcedEquiv hU))⟩
  · rw [ite_eq_right hU, Nat.cast_eq_zero, Fintype.card_eq_zero_iff]
    exact ⟨fun e => hU (consistent_of_valid e.2)⟩

/-! ### The XOR sum over all the choices -/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SatCover.site_injective
statement: theorem site_injective : Function.Injective (site (A := A))
proof:
:=
  fun _ _ h => Sum.inl.inj (congrArg Site.u h)

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SatCover.mem_cols_map_site
statement:
theorem mem_cols_map_site {l : List (Occ A)} {n : Node A} :
    n ∈ cols (l.map site) ↔ ∃ o ∈ l, n = trk o ∨ n = spk o
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp [cols]
  | cons o l ih =>
    simp only [List.map_cons, cols, List.mem_cons, ih]
    constructor
    · rintro (rfl | rfl | ⟨o', ho', h⟩)
      · exact ⟨o, Or.inl rfl, Or.inl rfl⟩
      · exact ⟨o, Or.inl rfl, Or.inr rfl⟩
      · exact ⟨o', Or.inr ho', h⟩
    · rintro ⟨o', rfl | ho', h | h⟩
      · exact Or.inl h
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inl h)
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨o', ho', Or.inl h⟩)
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨o', ho', Or.inr h⟩)

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SatCover.cols_map_site_nodup
statement: theorem cols_map_site_nodup {l : List (Occ A)} (hl : l.Nodup) : (cols (l.map site)).Nodup
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => exact List.nodup_nil
  | cons o l ih =>
    have hnd := List.nodup_cons.mp hl
    refine List.nodup_cons.mpr ⟨?_, List.nodup_cons.mpr ⟨?_, ih hnd.2⟩⟩
    · rw [List.mem_cons, mem_cols_map_site, not_or]
      refine ⟨Sum.inl_ne_inr, ?_⟩
      rintro ⟨o', ho', h | h⟩
      · exact hnd.1 (Sum.inl.inj h ▸ ho')
      · exact Sum.inl_ne_inr h
    · rw [mem_cols_map_site]
      rintro ⟨o', ho', h | h⟩
      · exact Sum.inr_ne_inl h
      · exact hnd.1 (Sum.inl.inj (Sum.inr.inj h) ▸ ho')

/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SatCover.sites_toFinset
statement: theorem sites_toFinset : (sites (A := A)).toFinset = univ.image site
proof:
:= by
  ext s
  simp only [sites, List.mem_toFinset, List.mem_map, Finset.mem_toList, mem_univ, true_and,
    mem_image]

/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SatCover.delRows_sites
statement: theorem delRows_sites (U : Finset (Occ A)) : delRows sites (U.image site) = del U
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : ∀ o, (∃ a ∈ U, site a = site o) ↔ o ∈ U := fun o =>
    ⟨fun ⟨o', ho', h'⟩ => site_injective h' ▸ ho', fun h => ⟨o, h, rfl⟩⟩
  ext n
  simp only [delRows, sites_toFinset, image_image, mem_image, mem_univ, true_and,
    Function.comp_apply, hmem, del, mem_union, mem_compl]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨o, rfl⟩
    by_cases ho : o ∈ U
    · rw [ite_eq_left ho]
      exact Or.inl ⟨o, ho, rfl⟩
    · rw [ite_eq_right ho]
      exact Or.inr ⟨o, ho, rfl⟩
  · rintro (⟨o, ho, rfl⟩ | ⟨o, ho, rfl⟩)
    · exact ⟨o, by rw [ite_eq_left ho]; rfl⟩
    · exact ⟨o, by rw [ite_eq_right ho]; rfl⟩

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SatCover.bperm_attachAll_sites
statement:
theorem bperm_attachAll_sites :
    bperm (attachAll baseM (sites (A := A))) =
      4 ^ Fintype.card (Occ A) * ((univ : Finset (Finset (Occ A))).filter Consistent).card
proof:
:= by
  have hu : ∀ s ∈ sites (A := A), s.u ≠ s.u' := by
    simp only [sites, List.mem_map, forall_exists_index, and_imp, forall_apply_eq_imp_iff₂]
    exact fun _ _ => Sum.inl_ne_inr
  have hcols : (cols (sites (A := A))).Nodup := cols_map_site_nodup (Finset.nodup_toList _)
  have hself : ∀ s ∈ sites (A := A), s.v = s.u ∧ s.v' = s.u' := by
    simp only [sites, List.mem_map, forall_exists_index, and_imp, forall_apply_eq_imp_iff₂]
    exact fun _ _ => ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  have hlen : (sites (A := A)).length = Fintype.card (Occ A) := by
    rw [sites, List.length_map, Finset.length_toList, card_univ]
  rw [← pdel_empty, ← Finset.map_empty (baseEmb (sites (A := A))),
    pdel_attachAll baseM sites ∅ ∅ hu hcols (fun _ _ => ⟨notMem_empty _, notMem_empty _⟩),
    xorSum_eq_sum baseM sites hcols hself ∅ (fun _ _ => ⟨notMem_empty _, notMem_empty _⟩),
    sites_toFinset, powerset_image,
    Finset.sum_image fun _ _ _ _ h => image_injective site_injective h, hlen]
  congr 1
  rw [← Finset.sum_boole]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun U _ => by rw [empty_union, delRows_sites, pdel_base]

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SatCover.bperm_attachedM
statement:
theorem bperm_attachedM :
    bperm (attachedM (A := A)) = 4 ^ Nat.card (Occ A) * (SharpOneInSAT A : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [attachedM, Site.bperm_flatAttach, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
  exact bperm_attachAll_sites_eq

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SatCover.card_satOccurs_le
statement: theorem card_satOccurs_le [Finite A] : Nat.card {x : A // SatOccurs A x} ≤ Nat.card (Occ A)
proof:
:=
  Nat.card_le_card_of_injective (fun x => Occ.dummy x.1 x.2 true) fun _ _ h =>
    Subtype.ext (congrArg Occ.x h)

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SatCover.sharpOneInSat_le
statement: theorem sharpOneInSat_le [Finite A] : SharpOneInSAT A ≤ 2 ^ Nat.card (Occ A)
proof:
:= by
  rw [sharpOneInSat_apply]
  refine le_trans (Nat.card_le_card_of_injective
    (fun ν : {ν : A → Prop // OneInModel A ν} => (⟨ν.1, ν.2.2⟩ :
      {ν : A → Prop // ∀ x, ν x → SatOccurs A x})) fun ν ν' h => Subtype.ext (by
        have := congrArg Subtype.val h
        exact this)) ?_
  rw [card_subsets_eq_two_pow]
  exact Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) card_satOccurs_le

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SatCover.sharpCycleCover_drawInterp
statement:
theorem sharpCycleCover_drawInterp :
    SharpCycleCover (drawInterp.MapRel A) =
      bperm (ladder 3 (widths (Λ := Level A) (attachedM (A := A))))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have : Finite (drawInterp.MapRel A) := drawInterp.mapRel_finite A
  let : Fintype (drawInterp.MapRel A) := Fintype.ofFinite _
  have h1 := sharpCycleCover_eq_bperm (drawInterp.MapRel A)
  have h2 := bperm_reindex drawEquiv drawEquiv
    (fun x y : drawInterp.MapRel A => if DGArc x y then (1 : ℕ) else 0)
  have h3 : (fun y y' : (V A ⊕ RungA A) ⊕ Unit =>
      (fun x y : drawInterp.MapRel A => if DGArc x y then (1 : ℕ) else 0)
        (drawEquiv.symm y) (drawEquiv.symm y')) =
      fun y y' => if DrawEdge y y' then 1 else 0 :=
    funext fun y => funext fun y' => if_congr (drawArc_iff y y') rfl rfl
  have h4 := bperm_extend_loop (ladder 3 (widths (Λ := Level A) (attachedM (A := A))))
    (fun y y' : (V A ⊕ RungA A) ⊕ Unit => if DrawEdge y y' then 1 else 0)
    (fun a b => rfl) (by simp [DrawEdge]) (fun b => by simp [DrawEdge])
  rw [h1, ← h2, h3]
  convert h4 using 2

name: DescriptiveComplexity.sharpCycleCover_sharpP_oneCallHard
statement: theorem sharpCycleCover_sharpP_oneCallHard : SharpP.OneCallHard SharpCycleCover
proof:
:=
  CountingClass.OneCallHard.of_oneCall sharpOneInSat_oneCall_sharpCycleCover
    (oneCallHard_sharpP_of_parsimoniousHard sharpOneInSat_sharpP_parsimoniousHard)

/
one-call `#P`-complete** ([Valiant 1979][valiant1979complexity]). -/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.sharpCycleCover_sharpP_oneCallComplete
statement: theorem sharpCycleCover_sharpP_oneCallComplete : SharpP.OneCallComplete SharpCycleCover
proof:
:=
  .of_mem sharpCycleCover_mem_sharpP sharpCycleCover_sharpP_oneCallHard

name: DescriptiveComplexity.IsCycleCover.rel_toFun
statement:
theorem IsCycleCover.rel_toFun {R F : A → A → Prop} (h : IsCycleCover R F) (x : A) :
    F x (h.toFun x)
proof:
:=
  Classical.choose_spec (h.1 x).exists

name: DescriptiveComplexity.IsCycleCover.eq_toFun
statement:
theorem IsCycleCover.eq_toFun {R F : A → A → Prop} (h : IsCycleCover R F) {x y : A}
    (hxy : F x y) : y = h.toFun x
proof:
:=
  (h.1 x).unique hxy (h.rel_toFun x)

name: DescriptiveComplexity.IsCycleCover.toFun_injective
statement:
theorem IsCycleCover.toFun_injective {R F : A → A → Prop} (h : IsCycleCover R F) :
    Function.Injective h.toFun
proof:
:= fun x x' hxx' =>
  (h.2.1 (h.toFun x)).unique (h.rel_toFun x) (hxx' ▸ h.rel_toFun x')

/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.isCycleCover_of_equiv
statement:
theorem isCycleCover_of_equiv {R : A → A → Prop} (e : A ≃ A) (he : ∀ x, R x (e x)) :
    IsCycleCover R fun x y => e x = y
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun x => ⟨e x, rfl, fun _ h => h.symm⟩,
    fun y => ⟨e.symm y, e.apply_symm_apply y, fun _ h => by rw [← h, e.symm_apply_apply]⟩,
    fun x y h => h ▸ he x⟩

/
arcs.** -/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.card_isCycleCover_eq_bperm
statement:
theorem card_isCycleCover_eq_bperm [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (R : A → A → Prop)
    [DecidableRel R] :
    Nat.card {F : A → A → Prop // IsCycleCover R F} =
      bperm fun x y => if R x y then (1 : ℕ) else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [bperm_boole, Nat.cast_id, Nat.card_congr (cycleCoverEquiv R), Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]

name: DescriptiveComplexity.realize_cycleCoverKernel
statement:
theorem realize_cycleCoverKernel (ρ : coverGuessBlock.Assignment A) :
    (@Sentence.Realize coverSOLang A
        (@sumStructure _ _ A _ (coverGuessBlock.structure ρ)) cycleCoverKernel) ↔
      IsCycleCover (fun x y : A => DGArc x y) fun x y : A => ρ .nxt ![x, y]
proof:
:= by
  let := coverGuessBlock.structure ρ
  have hsub : ∀ w : Fin 2 → A, RelMap (L := coverSOLang) (M := A) cvNxtSym w ↔ ρ .nxt w :=
    fun _ => Iff.rfl
  rw [cycleCoverKernel]
  simp only [nxtF, Sentence.Realize, Formula.realize_inf, Formula.realize_iAlls,
    Formula.realize_iExs, Formula.realize_imp, Formula.realize_equal, Formula.realize_rel₂,
    Term.realize_var, Sum.elim_inr, Sum.elim_inl, hsub, Language.relMap_sumInl]
  simp only [IsCycleCover, DGArc, ExistsUnique]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4, h5⟩
    refine ⟨fun x => ?_, fun y => ?_, fun x y => h5 ![x, y]⟩
    · obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := h1 fun _ => x
      exact ⟨y 0, hy, fun y' hy' => h2 ![x, y', y 0] ⟨hy', hy⟩⟩
    · obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := h3 fun _ => y
      exact ⟨x 0, hx, fun x' hx' => h4 ![x', x 0, y] ⟨hx', hx⟩⟩
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩
    refine ⟨fun i => ?_, fun i hi => ?_, fun i => ?_, fun i hi => ?_, fun i => h3 (i 0) (i 1)⟩
    · obtain ⟨y, hy, -⟩ := h1 (i 0)
      exact ⟨fun _ => y, hy⟩
    · obtain ⟨y, -, huniq⟩ := h1 (i 0)
      exact (huniq _ hi.1).trans (huniq _ hi.2).symm
    · obtain ⟨x, hx, -⟩ := h2 (i 0)
      exact ⟨fun _ => x, hx⟩
    · obtain ⟨x, -, huniq⟩ := h2 (i 2)
      exact (huniq _ hi.1).trans (huniq _ hi.2).symm

/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.card_isCycleCover_eq_witnessCount
statement:
theorem card_isCycleCover_eq_witnessCount (A : Type) [Language.digraph.Structure A] :
    Nat.card {F : A → A → Prop // IsCycleCover (fun x y : A => DGArc x y) F} =
      witnessCount coverGuessBlock cycleCoverKernel A
proof:
:=
  Nat.card_congr (Equiv.subtypeEquiv (coverAssignEquiv A) fun F => by
    rw [realize_cycleCoverKernel]
    rfl).symm

name: DescriptiveComplexity.sharpCycleCover_apply
statement:
theorem sharpCycleCover_apply (A : Type) [Language.digraph.Structure A] :
    SharpCycleCover A = Nat.card {F : A → A → Prop // IsCycleCover (fun x y : A => DGArc x y) F}
proof:
:=
  rfl

/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.sharpCycleCover_eq_bperm
statement:
theorem sharpCycleCover_eq_bperm (A : Type) [Language.digraph.Structure A] [Fintype A]
    [DecidableEq A] [DecidableRel fun x y : A => DGArc x y] :
    SharpCycleCover A = bperm fun x y : A => if DGArc x y then (1 : ℕ) else 0
proof:
:=
  card_isCycleCover_eq_bperm _

/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.sharpCycleCover_mem_sharpP
statement: theorem sharpCycleCover_mem_sharpP : SharpCycleCover ∈ SharpP
proof:
:=
  sharpPDefinable_congr (fun A _ _ => (card_isCycleCover_eq_witnessCount A).symm)
    (sharpPDefinable_ofKernel coverGuessBlock cycleCoverKernel)

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SatCover.card_occInterp
statement: theorem card_occInterp : Nat.card (occInterp.MapRel A) = Nat.card (Occ A)
proof:
:=
  Nat.card_congr occInterpEquiv

/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SatCover.levelOfPos_injective
statement: theorem levelOfPos_injective : Function.Injective (levelOfPos (A := A))
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨o, k⟩ ⟨o', k'⟩ h
  have h1 := congrArg (fun ℓ : Level A => ℓ.1.1) h
  have h2 := congrArg (fun ℓ : Level A => ℓ.1.2) h
  change LevelTag.pos (occTag o) k = LevelTag.pos (occTag o') k' at h1
  change ![(occPair o).1, (occPair o).2] = ![(occPair o').1, (occPair o').2] at h2
  obtain ⟨ht, hk⟩ := Prod.mk.inj (Option.some.inj h1)
  have hp : occPair o = occPair o' :=
    Prod.ext (congrFun h2 0) (congrFun h2 1)
  rw [← occOf_occTag o, ← occOf_occTag o']
  exact Prod.ext (by simp only [ht, hp]) hk

/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SatCover.three_mul_card_occ_le
statement:
theorem three_mul_card_occ_le [Finite A] :
    3 * Nat.card (Occ A) ≤ Nat.card (Level A)
proof:
:= by
  have := Nat.card_le_card_of_injective _ (levelOfPos_injective (A := A))
  rwa [Nat.card_prod, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card (α := Fin 3), Fintype.card_fin, mul_comm] at this

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SatCover.realize_pinF
statement:
theorem realize_pinF {w : Fin 6 → A} :
    pinF.Realize w ↔ w 2 = w 0 ∧ w 3 = w 0 ∧ w 4 = w 0 ∧ w 5 = w 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [pinF, Formula.realize_inf, realize_eqF]

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SatCover.realize_drawDomF_base
statement:
theorem realize_drawDomF_base {t : VTag} {w : Fin 6 → A} :
    (drawDomF (Sum.inl (Sum.inl t))).Realize w ↔
      VDom t (w 0) (w 1) ∧ (w 2 = w 0 ∧ w 3 = w 0 ∧ w 4 = w 0 ∧ w 5 = w 0)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [drawDomF, Formula.realize_inf, realize_vDomF, realize_pinF]

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SatCover.realize_drawDomF_extra
statement:
theorem realize_drawDomF_extra {w : Fin 6 → A} :
    (drawDomF (Sum.inr ())).Realize w ↔
      (∀ y, w 0 ≤ y) ∧ w 1 = w 0 ∧ (w 2 = w 0 ∧ w 3 = w 0 ∧ w 4 = w 0 ∧ w 5 = w 0)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [drawDomF, Formula.realize_inf, realize_isMinF, realize_eqF, realize_pinF]

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SatCover.realize_drawDomF_rung
statement:
theorem realize_drawDomF_rung {t t' : VTag} {l : LevelTag} {j : Fin 3} {w : Fin 6 → A} :
    (drawDomF (Sum.inl (Sum.inr (t, t', l, j)))).Realize w ↔ RungDom t t' l j w
proof:
:= by
  simp only [drawDomF, Formula.realize_inf, realize_vDomF, realize_levelDomF, RungDom]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨h, h', h'', hw⟩
    exact ⟨h, h', h'', fun _ _ _ => (realize_widthF h h' h'').mp hw⟩
  · rintro ⟨h, h', h'', hw⟩
    exact ⟨h, h', h'', (realize_widthF h h' h'').mpr (hw h h' h'')⟩

/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SatCover.vOf_eq_iff
statement:
theorem vOf_eq_iff {t t' : VTag} {c x c' x' : A} (h : VDom t c x) (h' : VDom t' c' x') :
    vOf t c x h = vOf t' c' x' h' ↔ t = t' ∧ (c, x) = (c', x')
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro he
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [← vTag_vOf t c x h, he, vTag_vOf]
    · rw [← vPair_vOf t c x h, he, vPair_vOf]
  · rintro ⟨rfl, h2⟩
    obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := Prod.mk.inj h2
    rfl

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SatCover.mkLevel_eq_iff
statement:
theorem mkLevel_eq_iff {t t' : LevelTag} {c x c' x' : A} (h : LevelDom t c x)
    (h' : LevelDom t' c' x') :
    mkLevel t c x h = mkLevel t' c' x' h' ↔ t = t' ∧ (c, x) = (c', x')
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro he
    have h1 := congrArg (fun ℓ : Level A => ℓ.1.1) he
    have h2 := congrArg (fun ℓ : Level A => ℓ.1.2) he
    exact ⟨h1, Prod.ext (congrFun h2 0) (congrFun h2 1)⟩
  · rintro ⟨rfl, h2⟩
    obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := Prod.mk.inj h2
    rfl

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SatCover.v_eq_iff
statement: theorem v_eq_iff (n n' : V A) : n = n' ↔ vTag n = vTag n' ∧ vPair n = vPair n'
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro rfl
    exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
    rw [← vOf_vTag n, ← vOf_vTag n']
    exact (vOf_eq_iff _ _).mpr ⟨h1, h2⟩

/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SatCover.drawEquiv_symm_node
statement:
theorem drawEquiv_symm_node (n : V A) :
    (drawEquiv.symm (Sum.inl (Sum.inl n)) : drawInterp.MapRel A).1 =
      (Sum.inl (Sum.inl (vTag n)), pin (vPair n))
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SatCover.drawEquiv_symm_rung
statement:
theorem drawEquiv_symm_rung (q : RungA A) :
    (drawEquiv.symm (Sum.inl (Sum.inr q)) : drawInterp.MapRel A).1 =
      (Sum.inl (Sum.inr (vTag q.src, vTag q.tgt, q.lvl.1.1, q.idx)), rungTuple q)
proof:
:=
  rfl

/
self-loop of the extra node. -/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SatCover.drawArc_iff
statement:
theorem drawArc_iff (y y' : (V A ⊕ RungA A) ⊕ Unit) :
    DGArc (drawEquiv.symm y) (drawEquiv.symm y') ↔ DrawEdge y y'
proof:
:= by
  rw [DGArc, RelFOInterpretation.relMap_mapRel]
  rcases y with (n | q) | ⟨⟩ <;> rcases y' with (n' | q') | ⟨⟩
  · change (drawArcF (Sum.inl (Sum.inl (vTag n))) (Sum.inl (Sum.inl (vTag n')))).Realize _ ↔ _
    exact iff_of_false (by simp [drawArcF]) (ladderEdge_inl_inl _ _)
  ·
    set v : Fin 2 × Fin 6 → A := fun pr =>
      ((![drawEquiv.symm (Sum.inl (Sum.inl n)), drawEquiv.symm (Sum.inl (Sum.inr q'))] :
        Fin 2 → drawInterp.MapRel A) pr.1).1.2 pr.2 with hv
    change (drawArcF (Sum.inl (Sum.inl (vTag n)))
      (Sum.inl (Sum.inr (vTag q'.src, vTag q'.tgt, q'.lvl.1.1, q'.idx)))).Realize v ↔
      LadderEdge 3 (widths attachedM) (Sum.inl n) (Sum.inr q')
    rw [ladderEdge_inl_inr]
    simp only [drawArcF]
    split_ifs with ht
    · rw [Formula.realize_inf, Formula.realize_inf, realize_eqF, realize_eqF,
        realize_levelMinF (v := v) (c := (1, 4)) (x := (1, 5)) (levelDom_of q'.lvl)]
      change (vPair n).1 = (vPair q'.src).1 ∧ (vPair n).2 = (vPair q'.src).2 ∧
        mkLevel q'.lvl.1.1 (q'.lvl.1.2 0) (q'.lvl.1.2 1) (levelDom_of q'.lvl) = ⊥ ↔
        q'.src = n ∧ q'.lvl = ⊥
      rw [mkLevel_eq]
      rw [v_eq_iff, ← ht]
      simp only [true_and]
      exact ⟨fun ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ => ⟨Prod.ext h1.symm h2.symm, h3⟩,
        fun ⟨h12, h3⟩ => ⟨(congrArg Prod.fst h12).symm, (congrArg Prod.snd h12).symm, h3⟩⟩
    · simp only [Formula.realize_bot, false_iff, not_and]
      intro he
      exact absurd (congrArg vTag he).symm ht
  · change (drawArcF (Sum.inl (Sum.inl (vTag n))) (Sum.inr ())).Realize _ ↔ _
    exact iff_of_false (by simp [drawArcF]) (by simp [DrawEdge])
  ·
    set v : Fin 2 × Fin 6 → A := fun pr =>
      ((![drawEquiv.symm (Sum.inl (Sum.inr q)), drawEquiv.symm (Sum.inl (Sum.inl n'))] :
        Fin 2 → drawInterp.MapRel A) pr.1).1.2 pr.2 with hv
    change (drawArcF (Sum.inl (Sum.inr (vTag q.src, vTag q.tgt, q.lvl.1.1, q.idx)))
      (Sum.inl (Sum.inl (vTag n')))).Realize v ↔
      LadderEdge 3 (widths attachedM) (Sum.inr q) (Sum.inl n')
    rw [ladderEdge_inr_inl]
    simp only [drawArcF]
    split_ifs with ht
    · rw [Formula.realize_inf, Formula.realize_inf, realize_eqF, realize_eqF,
        realize_levelMaxF (v := v) (c := (0, 4)) (x := (0, 5)) (levelDom_of q.lvl)]
      change (vPair q.tgt).1 = (vPair n').1 ∧ (vPair q.tgt).2 = (vPair n').2 ∧
        mkLevel q.lvl.1.1 (q.lvl.1.2 0) (q.lvl.1.2 1) (levelDom_of q.lvl) = ⊤ ↔
        q.tgt = n' ∧ q.lvl = ⊤
      rw [mkLevel_eq]
      rw [v_eq_iff, ht]
      simp only [true_and]
      exact ⟨fun ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ => ⟨Prod.ext h1 h2, h3⟩,
        fun ⟨h12, h3⟩ => ⟨congrArg Prod.fst h12, congrArg Prod.snd h12, h3⟩⟩
    · simp only [Formula.realize_bot, false_iff, not_and]
      intro he
      exact absurd (congrArg vTag he) ht
  ·
    set v : Fin 2 × Fin 6 → A := fun pr =>
      ((![drawEquiv.symm (Sum.inl (Sum.inr q)), drawEquiv.symm (Sum.inl (Sum.inr q'))] :
        Fin 2 → drawInterp.MapRel A) pr.1).1.2 pr.2 with hv
    change (drawArcF (Sum.inl (Sum.inr (vTag q.src, vTag q.tgt, q.lvl.1.1, q.idx)))
      (Sum.inl (Sum.inr (vTag q'.src, vTag q'.tgt, q'.lvl.1.1, q'.idx)))).Realize v ↔
      LadderEdge 3 (widths attachedM) (Sum.inr q) (Sum.inr q')
    rw [ladderEdge_inr_inr]
    simp only [drawArcF, Formula.realize_sup]
    rw [realize_ite_bot, realize_ite_bot, Formula.realize_iInf]
    simp only [realize_eqF, Formula.realize_inf]
    rw [realize_levelCovF (v := v) (c := (0, 4)) (x := (0, 5)) (c' := (1, 4)) (x' := (1, 5))
      (levelDom_of q.lvl) (levelDom_of q'.lvl)]
    change ((vTag q.src, vTag q.tgt, q.lvl.1.1, q.idx) =
        (vTag q'.src, vTag q'.tgt, q'.lvl.1.1, q'.idx) ∧ ∀ i, rungTuple q i = rungTuple q' i) ∨
      ((vTag q.src = vTag q'.src ∧ vTag q.tgt = vTag q'.tgt) ∧
        (vPair q.src).1 = (vPair q'.src).1 ∧ (vPair q.src).2 = (vPair q'.src).2 ∧
        (vPair q.tgt).1 = (vPair q'.tgt).1 ∧ (vPair q.tgt).2 = (vPair q'.tgt).2 ∧
        mkLevel q.lvl.1.1 (q.lvl.1.2 0) (q.lvl.1.2 1) (levelDom_of q.lvl) ⋖
          mkLevel q'.lvl.1.1 (q'.lvl.1.2 0) (q'.lvl.1.2 1) (levelDom_of q'.lvl)) ↔ _
    rw [mkLevel_eq, mkLevel_eq]
    constructor
    · rintro (⟨htags, hw⟩ | ⟨⟨hs, ht⟩, h0, h1, h2, h3, hc⟩)
      · left
        obtain ⟨hs, ht, hl, hj⟩ := Prod.mk.inj htags |>.imp_right (Prod.mk.inj · |>.imp_right
          Prod.mk.inj)
        refine Rung.ext ((v_eq_iff _ _).mpr ⟨hs, Prod.ext (hw 0) (hw 1)⟩)
          ((v_eq_iff _ _).mpr ⟨ht, Prod.ext (hw 2) (hw 3)⟩) ?_ hj
        exact Subtype.ext (Prod.ext hl (funext fun i => by
          fin_cases i
          · exact hw 4
          · exact hw 5))
      · right
        exact ⟨(v_eq_iff _ _).mpr ⟨hs, Prod.ext h0 h1⟩, (v_eq_iff _ _).mpr ⟨ht, Prod.ext h2 h3⟩, hc⟩
    · rintro (rfl | ⟨hs, ht, hc⟩)
      · left
        exact ⟨rfl, fun _ => rfl⟩
      · right
        exact ⟨⟨congrArg vTag hs, congrArg vTag ht⟩, congrArg (fun n => (vPair n).1) hs,
          congrArg (fun n => (vPair n).2) hs, congrArg (fun n => (vPair n).1) ht,
          congrArg (fun n => (vPair n).2) ht, hc⟩
  · change (drawArcF (Sum.inl (Sum.inr (vTag q.src, vTag q.tgt, q.lvl.1.1, q.idx)))
      (Sum.inr ())).Realize _ ↔ _
    exact iff_of_false (by simp [drawArcF]) (by simp [DrawEdge])
  · change (drawArcF (Sum.inr ()) (Sum.inl (Sum.inl (vTag n')))).Realize _ ↔ _
    exact iff_of_false (by simp [drawArcF]) (by simp [DrawEdge])
  · change (drawArcF (Sum.inr ()) (Sum.inl (Sum.inr (vTag q'.src, vTag q'.tgt, q'.lvl.1.1,
      q'.idx)))).Realize _ ↔ _
    exact iff_of_false (by simp [drawArcF]) (by simp [DrawEdge])
  · change (drawArcF (Sum.inr ()) (Sum.inr ())).Realize _ ↔ _
    exact iff_of_true (by simp [drawArcF]) trivial

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SatCover.occOf_c
statement:
@[simp] theorem occOf_c (d s : Bool) (c x : A) (h : OccDom d s c x) :
    (occOf d s c x h).c = occC d c
proof: := rfl

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SatCover.occOf_x
statement:
@[simp] theorem occOf_x (d s : Bool) (c x : A) (h : OccDom d s c x) :
    (occOf d s c x h).x = x
proof: := rfl

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SatCover.occOf_s
statement:
@[simp] theorem occOf_s (d s : Bool) (c x : A) (h : OccDom d s c x) :
    (occOf d s c x h).s = s
proof:
:= rfl

/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SatCover.occTag_of_bot
statement: theorem occTag_of_bot {o : Occ A} (hb : o.c = ⊥) : occTag o = (true, o.s)
proof:
:= by
  rw [occTag, hb, WithBot.recBotCoe_bot]

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SatCover.occTag_of_coe
statement: theorem occTag_of_coe {o : Occ A} {c : A} (hc : o.c = c) : occTag o = (false, o.s)
proof:
:= by
  rw [occTag, hc, WithBot.recBotCoe_coe]

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SatCover.occPair_of_bot
statement: theorem occPair_of_bot {o : Occ A} (hb : o.c = ⊥) : occPair o = (o.x, o.x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [occPair, hb, WithBot.unbotD_bot]

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SatCover.occPair_of_coe
statement: theorem occPair_of_coe {o : Occ A} {c : A} (hc : o.c = c) : occPair o = (c, o.x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [occPair, hc, WithBot.unbotD_coe]

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SatCover.occDom_occTag
statement:
theorem occDom_occTag (o : Occ A) :
    OccDom (occTag o).1 (occTag o).2 (occPair o).1 (occPair o).2
proof:
:= by
  rcases o.2 with ⟨hb, hx⟩ | ⟨c, hc, h⟩
  · rw [occTag_of_bot hb, occPair_of_bot hb]
    exact ⟨rfl, hx⟩
  · rw [occTag_of_coe hc, occPair_of_coe hc]
    exact h

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SatCover.occOf_occTag
statement:
theorem occOf_occTag (o : Occ A) :
    occOf (occTag o).1 (occTag o).2 (occPair o).1 (occPair o).2 (occDom_occTag o) = o
proof:
:= by
  refine Occ.ext ?_ rfl rfl
  rw [occOf_c]
  rcases o.2 with ⟨hb, _⟩ | ⟨c, hc, _⟩
  · rw [occTag_of_bot hb, occPair_of_bot hb]
    exact hb.symm
  · rw [occTag_of_coe hc, occPair_of_coe hc]
    exact hc.symm

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SatCover.occTag_occOf
statement:
theorem occTag_occOf (d s : Bool) (c x : A) (h : OccDom d s c x) :
    occTag (occOf d s c x h) = (d, s)
proof:
:= by
  cases d
  · exact occTag_of_coe (c := c) rfl
  · exact occTag_of_bot rfl

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SatCover.occPair_occOf
statement:
theorem occPair_occOf (d s : Bool) (c x : A) (h : OccDom d s c x) :
    occPair (occOf d s c x h) = (c, x)
proof:
:= by
  cases d
  · exact occPair_of_coe (c := c) rfl
  · rw [occPair_of_bot rfl]
    exact Prod.ext h.1.symm rfl

/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SatCover.nodeDom_nodeTag
statement: theorem nodeDom_nodeTag (n : Node A) : NodeDom (nodeTag n) (nodePair n).1 (nodePair n).2
proof:
:= by
  rcases n with o | o | c | x
  · exact occDom_occTag o
  · exact occDom_occTag o
  · exact ⟨c.2, rfl⟩
  · exact ⟨x.2, rfl⟩

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SatCover.nodeOf_nodeTag
statement:
theorem nodeOf_nodeTag (n : Node A) :
    nodeOf (nodeTag n) (nodePair n).1 (nodePair n).2 (nodeDom_nodeTag n) = n
proof:
:= by
  rcases n with o | o | c | x
  · exact congrArg trk (occOf_occTag o)
  · exact congrArg spk (occOf_occTag o)
  · rfl
  · rfl

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SatCover.nodeTag_nodeOf
statement:
theorem nodeTag_nodeOf (t : NodeTag) (c x : A) (h : NodeDom t c x) :
    nodeTag (nodeOf t c x h) = t
proof:
:= by
  rcases t with ⟨d, s⟩ | ⟨d, s⟩ | _ | _
  · exact congrArg Sum.inl (occTag_occOf d s c x h)
  · exact congrArg (fun o => Sum.inr (Sum.inl o)) (occTag_occOf d s c x h)
  · rfl
  · rfl

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SatCover.nodePair_nodeOf
statement:
theorem nodePair_nodeOf (t : NodeTag) (c x : A) (h : NodeDom t c x) :
    nodePair (nodeOf t c x h) = (c, x)
proof:
:= by
  rcases t with ⟨d, s⟩ | ⟨d, s⟩ | _ | _
  · exact occPair_occOf d s c x h
  · exact occPair_occOf d s c x h
  · exact Prod.ext rfl h.2.symm
  · exact Prod.ext rfl h.2.symm

/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SatCover.vDom_vTag
statement: theorem vDom_vTag (n : V A) : VDom (vTag n) (vPair n).1 (vPair n).2
proof:
:= by
  rcases n with n | ⟨o, j⟩
  · exact nodeDom_nodeTag n
  · exact occDom_occTag o

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SatCover.vOf_vTag
statement: theorem vOf_vTag (n : V A) : vOf (vTag n) (vPair n).1 (vPair n).2 (vDom_vTag n) = n
proof:
:= by
  rcases n with n | ⟨o, j⟩
  · exact congrArg Sum.inl (nodeOf_nodeTag n)
  · exact congrArg (fun o => Sum.inr (o, j)) (occOf_occTag o)

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SatCover.vTag_vOf
statement: theorem vTag_vOf (t : VTag) (c x : A) (h : VDom t c x) : vTag (vOf t c x h) = t
proof:
:= by
  rcases t with t | ⟨⟨d, s⟩, j⟩
  · exact congrArg Sum.inl (nodeTag_nodeOf t c x h)
  · exact congrArg (fun o => Sum.inr (o, j)) (occTag_occOf d s c x h)

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SatCover.vPair_vOf
statement: theorem vPair_vOf (t : VTag) (c x : A) (h : VDom t c x) : vPair (vOf t c x h) = (c, x)
proof:
:= by
  rcases t with t | ⟨⟨d, s⟩, j⟩
  · exact nodePair_nodeOf t c x h
  · exact occPair_occOf d s c x h

/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SatCover.realize_satOccF
statement: theorem realize_satOccF {x : α} : (satOccF x).Realize v ↔ SatOccurs A (v x)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [satOccF, Formula.realize_iExs, Formula.realize_inf, Formula.realize_sup, realize_clF,
    realize_posF, realize_negF, Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr, SatOccurs, IsCl, PosIn, NegIn]
  exact ⟨fun ⟨c, h⟩ => ⟨c 0, h⟩, fun ⟨c, h⟩ => ⟨fun _ => c, h⟩⟩

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SatCover.realize_occDomF
statement:
theorem realize_occDomF {d s : Bool} {c x : α} :
    (occDomF d s c x).Realize v ↔ OccDom d s (v c) (v x)
proof:
:= by
  cases d <;> simp [occDomF, OccDom, realize_eqF, realize_satOccF]

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SatCover.realize_nodeDomF
statement:
theorem realize_nodeDomF {t : NodeTag} {c x : α} :
    (nodeDomF t c x).Realize v ↔ NodeDom t (v c) (v x)
proof:
:= by
  rcases t with ⟨d, s⟩ | ⟨d, s⟩ | b
  · exact realize_occDomF
  · exact realize_occDomF
  · cases b <;> simp [nodeDomF, NodeDom, realize_eqF, realize_satOccF, realize_clF]

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SatCover.realize_vDomF
statement: theorem realize_vDomF {t : VTag} {c x : α} : (vDomF t c x).Realize v ↔ VDom t (v c) (v x)
proof:
:= by
  rcases t with t | ⟨⟨d, s⟩, j⟩
  · exact realize_nodeDomF
  · exact realize_occDomF

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SatCover.realize_isMinF
statement: theorem realize_isMinF {c : α} : (isMinF c).Realize v ↔ ∀ y, v c ≤ y
proof:
:= by
  simp only [isMinF, Formula.realize_iAlls, realize_leF, Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr]
  exact ⟨fun h y => h fun _ => y, fun h y => h (y 0)⟩

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SatCover.realize_levelDomF
statement:
theorem realize_levelDomF {t : LevelTag} {c x : α} :
    (levelDomF t c x).Realize v ↔ LevelDom t (v c) (v x)
proof:
:= by
  rcases (t : Option (OccTag × Fin 3)) with _ | ⟨⟨d, s⟩, k⟩
  · simp [levelDomF, LevelDom, realize_isMinF, realize_eqF]
  · exact realize_occDomF

/-! #### The next occurrence -/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SatCover.mem_above_chain
statement:
theorem mem_above_chain {x : A} {s : Bool} {a y : WithBot A} :
    y ∈ above (chain x s) a ↔ (y = ⊥ ∨ ∃ y₀ : A, y = y₀ ∧ OccIn y₀ x s) ∧ a < y
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_above, mem_chain]

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SatCover.realize_nextF
statement:
theorem realize_nextF {d d' s : Bool} {c x c' : α} (h : OccDom d s (v c) (v x))
    (h' : OccDom d' s (v c') (v x)) :
    (nextF d d' s c x c').Realize v ↔
      cycNext (chain (v x) s) (occC d (v c)) = occC d' (v c')
proof:
:= by
  cases d <;> cases d' <;>
    simp only [nextF, Formula.realize_iAlls, Formula.realize_imp, Formula.realize_not,
      Formula.realize_inf, realize_occF, realize_leF, realize_ltF, Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr,
      occC, ↓reduceIte, Bool.false_eq_true]
  ·
    change OccIn (v c) (v x) s at h
    change OccIn (v c') (v x) s at h'
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hlt, hall⟩
      have hne : (above (chain (v x) s) (v c)).Nonempty :=
        ⟨v c', mem_above_chain.mpr ⟨Or.inr ⟨_, rfl, h'⟩, WithBot.coe_lt_coe.mpr hlt⟩⟩
      rw [cycNext_of_nonempty hne]
      refine le_antisymm (min'_le _ _ (mem_above_chain.mpr ⟨Or.inr ⟨_, rfl, h'⟩,
        WithBot.coe_lt_coe.mpr hlt⟩)) (le_min' _ _ _ fun y hy => ?_)
      obtain ⟨hb | ⟨y₀, rfl, hy₀⟩, hlt'⟩ := mem_above_chain.mp hy
      · exact absurd (hb ▸ hlt') not_lt_bot
      · exact WithBot.coe_le_coe.mpr (hall (fun _ => y₀) hy₀ (WithBot.coe_lt_coe.mp hlt'))
    · intro heq
      by_cases hne : (above (chain (v x) s) (v c)).Nonempty
      · rw [cycNext_of_nonempty hne] at heq
        have hmem := heq ▸ min'_mem _ hne
        obtain ⟨-, hlt⟩ := mem_above_chain.mp hmem
        refine ⟨WithBot.coe_lt_coe.mp hlt, fun y hy hlt' => WithBot.coe_le_coe.mp ?_⟩
        rw [← heq]
        exact min'_le _ _ (mem_above_chain.mpr ⟨Or.inr ⟨_, rfl, hy⟩, WithBot.coe_lt_coe.mpr hlt'⟩)
      · rw [cycNext_of_not_nonempty hne (chain_nonempty _ _)] at heq
        exact absurd (heq ▸ min'_le _ _ (mem_chain.mpr (Or.inl rfl)) : (v c' : WithBot A) ≤ ⊥)
          (WithBot.coe_ne_bot ∘ le_bot_iff.mp)
  ·
    change OccIn (v c) (v x) s at h
    constructor
    · intro hall
      have hne : ¬(above (chain (v x) s) (v c)).Nonempty := by
        rintro ⟨y, hy⟩
        obtain ⟨hb | ⟨y₀, rfl, hy₀⟩, hlt⟩ := mem_above_chain.mp hy
        · exact absurd (hb ▸ hlt) not_lt_bot
        · exact (hall (fun _ => y₀) hy₀).not_gt (WithBot.coe_lt_coe.mp hlt)
      rw [cycNext_of_not_nonempty hne (chain_nonempty _ _)]
      exact le_antisymm (min'_le _ _ (mem_chain.mpr (Or.inl rfl))) bot_le
    · intro heq y hy
      by_contra hlt
      rw [not_le] at hlt
      have hne : (above (chain (v x) s) (v c)).Nonempty :=
        ⟨y 0, mem_above_chain.mpr ⟨Or.inr ⟨_, rfl, hy⟩, WithBot.coe_lt_coe.mpr hlt⟩⟩
      rw [cycNext_of_nonempty hne] at heq
      obtain ⟨-, hlt'⟩ := mem_above_chain.mp (heq ▸ min'_mem _ hne)
      exact not_lt_bot hlt'
  ·
    change OccIn (v c') (v x) s at h'
    have hne : (above (chain (v x) s) ⊥).Nonempty :=
      ⟨v c', mem_above_chain.mpr ⟨Or.inr ⟨_, rfl, h'⟩, WithBot.bot_lt_coe _⟩⟩
    rw [cycNext_of_nonempty hne]
    constructor
    · intro hall
      refine le_antisymm (min'_le _ _ (mem_above_chain.mpr ⟨Or.inr ⟨_, rfl, h'⟩,
        WithBot.bot_lt_coe _⟩)) (le_min' _ _ _ fun y hy => ?_)
      obtain ⟨hb | ⟨y₀, rfl, hy₀⟩, hlt⟩ := mem_above_chain.mp hy
      · exact absurd (hb ▸ hlt) not_lt_bot
      · exact WithBot.coe_le_coe.mpr (hall (fun _ => y₀) hy₀)
    · intro heq y hy
      refine WithBot.coe_le_coe.mp ?_
      rw [← heq]
      exact min'_le _ _ (mem_above_chain.mpr ⟨Or.inr ⟨_, rfl, hy⟩, WithBot.bot_lt_coe _⟩)
  ·
    constructor
    · intro hall
      have hne : ¬(above (chain (v x) s) ⊥).Nonempty := by
        rintro ⟨y, hy⟩
        obtain ⟨hb | ⟨y₀, rfl, hy₀⟩, hlt⟩ := mem_above_chain.mp hy
        · exact absurd (hb ▸ hlt) not_lt_bot
        · exact hall (fun _ => y₀) hy₀
      rw [cycNext_of_not_nonempty hne (chain_nonempty _ _)]
      exact le_antisymm (min'_le _ _ (mem_chain.mpr (Or.inl rfl))) bot_le
    · intro heq y hy
      have hne : (above (chain (v x) s) ⊥).Nonempty :=
        ⟨y 0, mem_above_chain.mpr ⟨Or.inr ⟨_, rfl, hy⟩, WithBot.bot_lt_coe _⟩⟩
      rw [cycNext_of_nonempty hne] at heq
      obtain ⟨-, hlt'⟩ := mem_above_chain.mp (heq ▸ min'_mem _ hne)
      exact not_lt_bot hlt'

/-! #### The base edges -/

/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SatCover.nodeKind_nodeOf
statement:
theorem nodeKind_nodeOf (t : NodeTag) (c x : A) (h : NodeDom t c x) :
    nodeKind (nodeOf t c x h) = tagKind t
proof:
:= by
  rcases t with _ | _ | b
  · rfl
  · rfl
  · cases b <;> rfl

/
hub, or from a hub to a spoke. -/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SatCover.baseEdge_kind
statement:
theorem baseEdge_kind {n n' : Node A} (h : BaseEdge n n') :
    (nodeKind n = 0 ∧ nodeKind n' = 0) ∨ (nodeKind n = 1 ∧ nodeKind n' = 2) ∨
      (nodeKind n = 2 ∧ nodeKind n' = 1)
proof:
:= by
  cases h with
  | track o => exact Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  | spoke o => exact Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl⟩)
  | hub o => exact Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨rfl, rfl⟩)

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SatCover.occOf_eq_iff
statement:
theorem occOf_eq_iff {d s d' s' : Bool} {c x c' x' : A} (h : OccDom d s c x)
    (h' : OccDom d' s' c' x') :
    occOf d s c x h = occOf d' s' c' x' h' ↔ (d, s) = (d', s') ∧ (c, x) = (c', x')
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro he
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [← occTag_occOf d s c x h, he, occTag_occOf]
    · rw [← occPair_occOf d s c x h, he, occPair_occOf]
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
    obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := Prod.mk.inj h1
    obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := Prod.mk.inj h2
    rfl

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SatCover.nodeOf_eq_iff
statement:
theorem nodeOf_eq_iff {t t' : NodeTag} {c x c' x' : A} (h : NodeDom t c x)
    (h' : NodeDom t' c' x') :
    nodeOf t c x h = nodeOf t' c' x' h' ↔ t = t' ∧ (c, x) = (c', x')
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro he
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [← nodeTag_nodeOf t c x h, he, nodeTag_nodeOf]
    · rw [← nodePair_nodeOf t c x h, he, nodePair_nodeOf]
  · rintro ⟨rfl, h2⟩
    obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := Prod.mk.inj h2
    rfl

/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SatCover.not_baseEdge_of_kind
statement:
theorem not_baseEdge_of_kind {t t' : NodeTag} {c x c' x' : A} (h : NodeDom t c x)
    (h' : NodeDom t' c' x')
    (hk : ¬((tagKind t = 0 ∧ tagKind t' = 0) ∨ (tagKind t = 1 ∧ tagKind t' = 2) ∨
      (tagKind t = 2 ∧ tagKind t' = 1))) :
    ¬BaseEdge (nodeOf t c x h) (nodeOf t' c' x' h')
proof:
:= fun he =>
  hk (by simpa only [nodeKind_nodeOf] using baseEdge_kind he)

/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SatCover.baseEdge_spk_hub_iff
statement:
theorem baseEdge_spk_hub_iff {d s : Bool} {c x : A} (h : OccDom d s c x) (k : Hub A) :
    BaseEdge (spk (occOf d s c x h)) (hub k) ↔ hubOf (occOf d s c x h) = k
proof:
:= by
  rw [baseEdge_spk_iff]
  exact ⟨fun h => (Sum.inr.inj (Sum.inr.inj h)).symm, fun h => congrArg hub h.symm⟩

/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SatCover.baseEdge_hub_spk_iff
statement:
theorem baseEdge_hub_spk_iff (k : Hub A) {d s : Bool} {c x : A} (h : OccDom d s c x) :
    BaseEdge (hub k) (spk (occOf d s c x h)) ↔ hubOf (occOf d s c x h) = k
proof:
:= by
  rw [baseEdge_hub_iff]
  exact ⟨fun ⟨o, ho, hk⟩ => (Sum.inl.inj (Sum.inr.inj ho)) ▸ hk, fun hk => ⟨_, rfl, hk⟩⟩

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SatCover.realize_baseEdgeF
statement:
theorem realize_baseEdgeF {t t' : NodeTag} {c x c' x' : α} (h : NodeDom t (v c) (v x))
    (h' : NodeDom t' (v c') (v x')) :
    (baseEdgeF t t' c x c' x').Realize v ↔
      BaseEdge (nodeOf t (v c) (v x) h) (nodeOf t' (v c') (v x') h')
proof:
:= by
  rcases t with ⟨d, s⟩ | ⟨d, s⟩ | b <;> rcases t' with ⟨d', s'⟩ | ⟨d', s'⟩ | b'
  ·
    change OccDom d s (v c) (v x) at h
    change OccDom d' s' (v c') (v x') at h'
    simp only [baseEdgeF, nodeOf, baseEdge_trk_iff, trk, Sum.inl.injEq]
    split_ifs with hs
    · subst hs
      rw [Formula.realize_inf, realize_eqF]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨hx, hn⟩
        have h'' : OccDom d' s (v c') (v x) := hx ▸ h'
        rw [realize_nextF h h''] at hn
        exact Occ.ext (by rw [occOf_c, nextOcc_c, occOf_c, occOf_x, occOf_s, hn]) hx.symm rfl
      · intro he
        have hx : v x = v x' := (congrArg Occ.x he).symm
        have h'' : OccDom d' s (v c') (v x) := hx ▸ h'
        refine ⟨hx, (realize_nextF h h'').mpr ?_⟩
        have := congrArg Occ.c he
        rw [occOf_c, nextOcc_c, occOf_c, occOf_x, occOf_s] at this
        exact this.symm
    · simp only [Formula.realize_bot, false_iff]
      intro he
      have := congrArg Occ.s he
      rw [occOf_s, nextOcc_s, occOf_s] at this
      exact hs this.symm
  · exact iff_of_false (by simp [baseEdgeF]) (not_baseEdge_of_kind h h' (by simp [tagKind]))
  · exact iff_of_false (by simp [baseEdgeF]) (not_baseEdge_of_kind h h' (by simp [tagKind]))
  · exact iff_of_false (by simp [baseEdgeF]) (not_baseEdge_of_kind h h' (by simp [tagKind]))
  · exact iff_of_false (by simp [baseEdgeF]) (not_baseEdge_of_kind h h' (by simp [tagKind]))
  ·
    change OccDom d s (v c) (v x) at h
    cases b' with
    | true =>
      change IsCl (v c') ∧ v x' = v c' at h'
      change _ ↔ BaseEdge (spk (occOf d s (v c) (v x) h)) (hub (Sum.inl ⟨v c', h'.1⟩))
      rw [baseEdge_spk_hub_iff, hubOf_eq_inl_iff, occOf_c]
      cases d <;> simp [baseEdgeF, occC, realize_eqF]
    | false =>
      change SatOccurs A (v c') ∧ v x' = v c' at h'
      change _ ↔ BaseEdge (spk (occOf d s (v c) (v x) h)) (hub (Sum.inr ⟨v c', h'.1⟩))
      rw [baseEdge_spk_hub_iff, hubOf_eq_inr_iff, occOf_c, occOf_x]
      cases d <;> simp [baseEdgeF, occC, realize_eqF]
  · exact iff_of_false (by simp [baseEdgeF]) (not_baseEdge_of_kind h h' (by simp [tagKind]))
  ·
    change OccDom d' s' (v c') (v x') at h'
    cases b with
    | true =>
      change IsCl (v c) ∧ v x = v c at h
      change _ ↔ BaseEdge (hub (Sum.inl ⟨v c, h.1⟩)) (spk (occOf d' s' (v c') (v x') h'))
      rw [baseEdge_hub_spk_iff, hubOf_eq_inl_iff, occOf_c]
      cases d' <;> simp [baseEdgeF, occC, realize_eqF, eq_comm]
    | false =>
      change SatOccurs A (v c) ∧ v x = v c at h
      change _ ↔ BaseEdge (hub (Sum.inr ⟨v c, h.1⟩)) (spk (occOf d' s' (v c') (v x') h'))
      rw [baseEdge_hub_spk_iff, hubOf_eq_inr_iff, occOf_c, occOf_x]
      cases d' <;> simp [baseEdgeF, occC, realize_eqF, eq_comm]
  · exact iff_of_false (by simp [baseEdgeF]) (not_baseEdge_of_kind h h' (by simp [tagKind]))

/-! #### The entries of the attached matrix -/

/
at every site, on the flat node type. -/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SatCover.xorGadget_bounds
statement: theorem xorGadget_bounds (j j' : Fin 4) : -1 ≤ xorGadget j j' ∧ xorGadget j j' ≤ 3
proof:
:= by
  revert j j'
  decide

/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SatCover.attachedM_bounds
statement: theorem attachedM_bounds (a b : V A) : -1 ≤ attachedM a b ∧ attachedM a b ≤ 3
proof:
:= by
  rcases a with n | ⟨o, j⟩ <;> rcases b with n' | ⟨o', j'⟩
  · simp only [attachedM, Site.flatAttach, baseM]
    split_ifs <;> omega
  · simp only [attachedM, Site.flatAttach]
    split_ifs <;> omega
  · simp only [attachedM, Site.flatAttach]
    split_ifs <;> omega
  · simp only [attachedM, Site.flatAttach]
    split_ifs
    · exact xorGadget_bounds j j'
    · omega

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SatCover.realize_ite_bot
statement:
theorem realize_ite_bot {β : Type} {w : β → A} (p : Prop) [Decidable p] (φ : satOrd.Formula β) :
    (if p then φ else ⊥).Realize w ↔ p ∧ φ.Realize w
proof:
:= by
  split_ifs with hp <;> simp [hp]

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SatCover.ite_one_eq_iff
statement:
theorem ite_one_eq_iff {k : ℤ} (_hk : k ≠ 0) (P : Prop) [Decidable P] :
    (if P then (1 : ℤ) else 0) = k ↔ k = 1 ∧ P
proof:
:= by
  split_ifs with hp
  · simp [hp, eq_comm]
  · simp [hp]
    omega

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SatCover.ite_add_ite_eq_iff
statement:
theorem ite_add_ite_eq_iff {k : ℤ} (_hk : k ≠ 0) (P Q : Prop) [Decidable P] [Decidable Q]
    (hPQ : ¬(P ∧ Q)) :
    ((if P then (1 : ℤ) else 0) + if Q then 1 else 0) = k ↔ k = 1 ∧ (P ∨ Q)
proof:
:= by
  split_ifs with hp hq <;> simp_all <;> omega

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SatCover.ite_eq_iff_of_ne
statement:
theorem ite_eq_iff_of_ne {k z : ℤ} (_hk : k ≠ 0) (P : Prop) [Decidable P] :
    (if P then z else 0) = k ↔ P ∧ z = k
proof:
:= by
  split_ifs with hp
  · simp [hp]
  · simp [hp]
    omega

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SatCover.realize_flatEntryF
statement:
theorem realize_flatEntryF {k : ℤ} (hk : k ≠ 0) {t t' : VTag} {c x c' x' : α}
    (h : VDom t (v c) (v x)) (h' : VDom t' (v c') (v x')) :
    (flatEntryF k t t' c x c' x').Realize v ↔
      attachedM (vOf t (v c) (v x) h) (vOf t' (v c') (v x') h') = k
proof:
:= by
  rcases t with t | ⟨⟨d, s⟩, j⟩ <;> rcases t' with t' | ⟨⟨d', s'⟩, j'⟩
  ·
    change NodeDom t (v c) (v x) at h
    change NodeDom t' (v c') (v x') at h'
    simp only [flatEntryF, vOf, attachedM, Site.flatAttach, baseM]
    rw [realize_ite_bot, realize_baseEdgeF h h', ite_one_eq_iff hk]
  ·
    change NodeDom t (v c) (v x) at h
    change OccDom d' s' (v c') (v x') at h'
    have h1' : NodeDom (Sum.inl (d', s')) (v c') (v x') := h'
    have h2' : NodeDom (Sum.inr (Sum.inl (d', s'))) (v c') (v x') := h'
    have e1 : nodeOf t (v c) (v x) h = trk (occOf d' s' (v c') (v x') h') ↔
        t = Sum.inl (d', s') ∧ (v c, v x) = (v c', v x') :=
      nodeOf_eq_iff h h1'
    have e2 : nodeOf t (v c) (v x) h = spk (occOf d' s' (v c') (v x') h') ↔
        t = Sum.inr (Sum.inl (d', s')) ∧ (v c, v x) = (v c', v x') :=
      nodeOf_eq_iff h h2'
    have hex : ¬((nodeOf t (v c) (v x) h = (site (occOf d' s' (v c') (v x') h')).u ∧ j' = 0) ∧
        (nodeOf t (v c) (v x) h = (site (occOf d' s' (v c') (v x') h')).u' ∧ j' = 3)) := by
      rintro ⟨⟨_, h0⟩, ⟨_, h3⟩⟩
      rw [h0] at h3
      exact absurd h3 (by decide)
    simp only [flatEntryF, vOf, attachedM, Site.flatAttach]
    rw [realize_ite_bot, ite_add_ite_eq_iff hk _ _ hex]
    change _ ↔ k = 1 ∧ ((nodeOf t (v c) (v x) h = trk (occOf d' s' (v c') (v x') h') ∧ j' = 0) ∨
      (nodeOf t (v c) (v x) h = spk (occOf d' s' (v c') (v x') h') ∧ j' = 3))
    rw [e1, e2, Formula.realize_inf, realize_eqF, realize_eqF, Prod.mk.injEq]
    tauto
  ·
    change OccDom d s (v c) (v x) at h
    change NodeDom t' (v c') (v x') at h'
    have h1' : NodeDom (Sum.inl (d, s)) (v c) (v x) := h
    have h2' : NodeDom (Sum.inr (Sum.inl (d, s))) (v c) (v x) := h
    have e1 : nodeOf t' (v c') (v x') h' = trk (occOf d s (v c) (v x) h) ↔
        t' = Sum.inl (d, s) ∧ (v c', v x') = (v c, v x) :=
      nodeOf_eq_iff h' h1'
    have e2 : nodeOf t' (v c') (v x') h' = spk (occOf d s (v c) (v x) h) ↔
        t' = Sum.inr (Sum.inl (d, s)) ∧ (v c', v x') = (v c, v x) :=
      nodeOf_eq_iff h' h2'
    have hex : ¬((j = 3 ∧ nodeOf t' (v c') (v x') h' = (site (occOf d s (v c) (v x) h)).v) ∧
        (j = 0 ∧ nodeOf t' (v c') (v x') h' = (site (occOf d s (v c) (v x) h)).v')) := by
      rintro ⟨⟨h3, _⟩, ⟨h0, _⟩⟩
      rw [h0] at h3
      exact absurd h3 (by decide)
    simp only [flatEntryF, vOf, attachedM, Site.flatAttach]
    rw [realize_ite_bot, ite_add_ite_eq_iff hk _ _ hex]
    change _ ↔ k = 1 ∧ ((j = 3 ∧ nodeOf t' (v c') (v x') h' = trk (occOf d s (v c) (v x) h)) ∨
      (j = 0 ∧ nodeOf t' (v c') (v x') h' = spk (occOf d s (v c) (v x) h)))
    rw [e1, e2, Formula.realize_inf, realize_eqF, realize_eqF, Prod.mk.injEq]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨⟨hk1, hC⟩, hc, hx⟩
      exact ⟨hk1, hC.imp (fun h => ⟨h.1, h.2, hc.symm, hx.symm⟩)
        fun h => ⟨h.1, h.2, hc.symm, hx.symm⟩⟩
    · rintro ⟨hk1, ⟨hj, ht, hc, hx⟩ | ⟨hj, ht, hc, hx⟩⟩
      · exact ⟨⟨hk1, Or.inl ⟨hj, ht⟩⟩, hc.symm, hx.symm⟩
      · exact ⟨⟨hk1, Or.inr ⟨hj, ht⟩⟩, hc.symm, hx.symm⟩
  ·
    change OccDom d s (v c) (v x) at h
    change OccDom d' s' (v c') (v x') at h'
    simp only [flatEntryF, vOf, attachedM, Site.flatAttach]
    rw [realize_ite_bot, ite_eq_iff_of_ne hk, occOf_eq_iff h h', Formula.realize_inf, realize_eqF,
      realize_eqF, Prod.mk.injEq, Prod.mk.injEq]
    tauto

/-! #### The levels -/

/
vocabulary: the number of levels is then a definable cardinality. -/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SatCover.levelDom_of
statement: theorem levelDom_of (ℓ : Level A) : LevelDom ℓ.1.1 (ℓ.1.2 0) (ℓ.1.2 1)
proof:
:=
  realize_levelDomF.mp ℓ.2

/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SatCover.mkLevel_eq
statement: theorem mkLevel_eq (ℓ : Level A) : mkLevel ℓ.1.1 (ℓ.1.2 0) (ℓ.1.2 1) (levelDom_of ℓ) = ℓ
proof:
:=
  Subtype.ext (Prod.ext rfl (funext fun j => by fin_cases j <;> rfl))

/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SatCover.tupLeLex_two
statement:
theorem tupLeLex_two (c x c' x' : A) :
    tupLeLex ![c, x] ![c', x'] ↔ c < c' ∨ (c = c' ∧ x ≤ x')
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro (h | ⟨j, hj, hlt⟩)
    · have h0 := congrFun h 0
      have h1 := congrFun h 1
      simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one] at h0 h1
      exact Or.inr ⟨h0, h1.le⟩
    · fin_cases j
      · exact Or.inl (by simpa using hlt)
      · refine Or.inr ⟨by simpa using hj 0 (by decide), ?_⟩
        simp only [Fin.mk_one, Fin.isValue, Matrix.cons_val_one] at hlt
        exact hlt.le
  · rintro (h | ⟨rfl, h⟩)
    · exact Or.inr ⟨0, fun i hi => absurd hi (Fin.not_lt_zero i), by simpa using h⟩
    · rcases h.lt_or_eq with h | rfl
      · refine Or.inr ⟨1, fun i hi => ?_, by simpa using h⟩
        fin_cases i
        · rfl
        · exact absurd hi (by decide)
      · exact Or.inl rfl

/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SatCover.mkLevel_le_iff
statement:
theorem mkLevel_le_iff {t t' : LevelTag} {c x c' x' : A} (h : LevelDom t c x)
    (h' : LevelDom t' c' x') :
    mkLevel t c x h ≤ mkLevel t' c' x' h' ↔ t < t' ∨ (t = t' ∧ (c < c' ∨ (c = c' ∧ x ≤ x')))
proof:
:= by
  change (tagTupleOrder : LinearOrder (LevelTag × (Fin 2 → A))).le (t, ![c, x]) (t', ![c', x']) ↔ _
  rw [← tagTupleLe_iff_le, tagTupleLe, tupLeLex_two]

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SatCover.realize_levelLeF
statement:
theorem realize_levelLeF {t t' : LevelTag} {c x c' x' : α} (h : LevelDom t (v c) (v x))
    (h' : LevelDom t' (v c') (v x')) :
    (levelLeF t t' c x c' x').Realize v ↔
      mkLevel t (v c) (v x) h ≤ mkLevel t' (v c') (v x') h'
proof:
:= by
  rw [mkLevel_le_iff, levelLeF]
  split_ifs with h1 h2
  · simp only [Formula.realize_top, true_iff]
    exact Or.inl h1
  · simp only [Formula.realize_bot, false_iff]
    rintro (h | ⟨rfl, _⟩)
    · exact h1 h
    · exact lt_irrefl _ h2
  · have ht : t = t' := le_antisymm (not_lt.mp h2) (not_lt.mp h1)
    rw [Formula.realize_sup, Formula.realize_inf, realize_ltF, realize_eqF, realize_leF]
    simp only [ht, lt_self_iff_false, false_or, true_and]

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SatCover.realize_levelLtF
statement:
theorem realize_levelLtF {t t' : LevelTag} {c x c' x' : α} (h : LevelDom t (v c) (v x))
    (h' : LevelDom t' (v c') (v x')) :
    (levelLtF t t' c x c' x').Realize v ↔
      mkLevel t (v c) (v x) h < mkLevel t' (v c') (v x') h'
proof:
:= by
  rw [levelLtF, Formula.realize_inf, Formula.realize_not, realize_levelLeF h h',
    realize_levelLeF h' h, lt_iff_le_not_ge]

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SatCover.realize_levelMinF
statement:
theorem realize_levelMinF {t : LevelTag} {c x : α} (h : LevelDom t (v c) (v x)) :
    (levelMinF t c x).Realize v ↔ mkLevel t (v c) (v x) h = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  rw [← isBot_iff_eq_bot]
  simp only [levelMinF, Formula.realize_iInf, Formula.realize_iAlls, Formula.realize_imp]
  constructor
  · intro H ℓ
    have hd : LevelDom ℓ.1.1 (ℓ.1.2 0) (ℓ.1.2 1) := levelDom_of ℓ
    have := H ℓ.1.1 ℓ.1.2 (realize_levelDomF.mpr hd)
    rw [realize_levelLeF (v := Sum.elim v ℓ.1.2) (c := Sum.inl c) (x := Sum.inl x)
      (c' := Sum.inr 0) (x' := Sum.inr 1) h hd] at this
    exact mkLevel_eq ℓ ▸ this
  · intro H t' w hw
    rw [realize_levelDomF] at hw
    rw [realize_levelLeF (v := Sum.elim v w) (c := Sum.inl c) (x := Sum.inl x)
      (c' := Sum.inr 0) (x' := Sum.inr 1) h hw]
    exact H _

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SatCover.realize_levelMaxF
statement:
theorem realize_levelMaxF {t : LevelTag} {c x : α} (h : LevelDom t (v c) (v x)) :
    (levelMaxF t c x).Realize v ↔ mkLevel t (v c) (v x) h = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [← isTop_iff_eq_top]
  simp only [levelMaxF, Formula.realize_iInf, Formula.realize_iAlls, Formula.realize_imp]
  constructor
  · intro H ℓ
    have hd : LevelDom ℓ.1.1 (ℓ.1.2 0) (ℓ.1.2 1) := levelDom_of ℓ
    have := H ℓ.1.1 ℓ.1.2 (realize_levelDomF.mpr hd)
    rw [realize_levelLeF (v := Sum.elim v ℓ.1.2) (c := Sum.inr 0) (x := Sum.inr 1)
      (c' := Sum.inl c) (x' := Sum.inl x) hd h] at this
    exact mkLevel_eq ℓ ▸ this
  · intro H t' w hw
    rw [realize_levelDomF] at hw
    rw [realize_levelLeF (v := Sum.elim v w) (c := Sum.inr 0) (x := Sum.inr 1)
      (c' := Sum.inl c) (x' := Sum.inl x) hw h]
    exact H _

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SatCover.realize_levelCovF
statement:
theorem realize_levelCovF {t t' : LevelTag} {c x c' x' : α} (h : LevelDom t (v c) (v x))
    (h' : LevelDom t' (v c') (v x')) :
    (levelCovF t t' c x c' x').Realize v ↔
      mkLevel t (v c) (v x) h ⋖ mkLevel t' (v c') (v x') h'
proof:
:= by
  simp only [levelCovF, Formula.realize_inf, Formula.realize_not, Formula.realize_iSup,
    Formula.realize_iExs]
  rw [realize_levelLtF h h']
  refine and_congr_right fun _ => ?_
  constructor
  · intro H ℓ hlt hlt'
    refine H ⟨ℓ.1.1, ℓ.1.2, realize_levelDomF.mpr (levelDom_of ℓ), ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [realize_levelLtF (v := Sum.elim v ℓ.1.2) (c := Sum.inl c) (x := Sum.inl x)
        (c' := Sum.inr 0) (x' := Sum.inr 1) h (levelDom_of ℓ)]
      exact mkLevel_eq ℓ ▸ hlt
    · rw [realize_levelLtF (v := Sum.elim v ℓ.1.2) (c := Sum.inr 0) (x := Sum.inr 1)
        (c' := Sum.inl c') (x' := Sum.inl x') (levelDom_of ℓ) h']
      exact mkLevel_eq ℓ ▸ hlt'
  · rintro H ⟨t'', w, hw, h1, h2⟩
    rw [realize_levelDomF] at hw
    rw [realize_levelLtF (v := Sum.elim v w) (c := Sum.inl c) (x := Sum.inl x)
      (c' := Sum.inr 0) (x' := Sum.inr 1) h hw] at h1
    rw [realize_levelLtF (v := Sum.elim v w) (c := Sum.inr 0) (x := Sum.inr 1)
      (c' := Sum.inl c') (x' := Sum.inl x') hw h'] at h2
    exact H h1 h2

/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SatCover.realize_widthF
statement:
theorem realize_widthF [Fintype A] {t t' : VTag} {l : LevelTag} {j : Fin 3} {c x c' x' c'' x'' : α}
    (h : VDom t (v c) (v x)) (h' : VDom t' (v c') (v x')) (h'' : LevelDom l (v c'') (v x'')) :
    (widthF t t' l j c x c' x' c'' x'').Realize v ↔
      j.val < widths (Λ := Level A) attachedM (vOf t (v c) (v x) h) (vOf t' (v c') (v x') h')
        (mkLevel l (v c'') (v x'') h'')
proof:
:= by
  simp only [widthF, Formula.realize_sup, Formula.realize_inf, Formula.realize_not,
    realize_flatEntryF (by decide : (-1 : ℤ) ≠ 0) h h',
    realize_flatEntryF (by decide : (1 : ℤ) ≠ 0) h h',
    realize_flatEntryF (by decide : (2 : ℤ) ≠ 0) h h',
    realize_flatEntryF (by decide : (3 : ℤ) ≠ 0) h h',
    realize_levelMinF h'', realize_ite_bot, Formula.realize_top, and_true, widths]
  obtain ⟨hlo, hhi⟩ := attachedM_bounds (vOf t (v c) (v x) h) (vOf t' (v c') (v x') h')
  generalize attachedM (vOf t (v c) (v x) h) (vOf t' (v c') (v x') h') = m at hlo hhi ⊢
  generalize mkLevel l (v c'') (v x'') h'' = ℓ
  by_cases hm : m = -1
  · simp only [hm, ↓reduceIte, true_and, not_true_eq_false, false_and, or_false]
  · simp only [hm, false_and, false_or, not_false_eq_true, true_and]
    obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ : ∃ n : ℕ, m = n := ⟨m.toNat, (Int.toNat_of_nonneg (by omega)).symm⟩
    rw [Int.toNat_natCast]
    by_cases hℓ : ℓ = ⊥
    · simp only [hℓ, ↓reduceIte, true_and, not_true_eq_false, false_and, or_false]
      omega
    · simp only [hℓ, ↓reduceIte, false_and, false_or, not_false_eq_true, true_and]

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SatCover.chain_all_or_none
statement:
theorem chain_all_or_none {U : Finset (Occ A)} (hU : Consistent U) (x : A) (s : Bool) :
    (∀ o : Occ A, o.x = x → o.s = s → o ∈ U) ∨ ∀ o : Occ A, o.x = x → o.s = s → o ∉ U
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hx : SatOccurs A x
  · let T : Finset (WithBot A) := (U.filter fun o : Occ A => o.x = x ∧ o.s = s).image Occ.c
    have hmemT : ∀ c, c ∈ T ↔ ∃ o ∈ U, o.x = x ∧ o.s = s ∧ o.c = c := fun c => by
      simp only [T, mem_image, mem_filter]
      exact exists_congr fun o => ⟨fun ⟨⟨h1, h2, h3⟩, h4⟩ => ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩,
        fun ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ => ⟨⟨h1, h2, h3⟩, h4⟩⟩
    have hvalid : ∀ c ∈ chain x s, OccValid (c, x, s) := fun c hc => by
      rcases mem_chain.mp hc with rfl | ⟨c', rfl, h⟩
      · exact Or.inl ⟨rfl, hx⟩
      · exact Or.inr ⟨c', rfl, h⟩
    have hTS : T ⊆ chain x s := fun c hc => by
      obtain ⟨o, -, hox, hos, rfl⟩ := (hmemT c).mp hc
      exact hox ▸ hos ▸ c_mem_chain o
    have hcl : ∀ c ∈ T, cycNext (chain x s) c ∈ T := fun c hc => by
      obtain ⟨o, ho, hox, hos, rfl⟩ := (hmemT c).mp hc
      refine (hmemT _).mpr ⟨nextOcc o, hU.1 o ho, hox, hos, ?_⟩
      rw [nextOcc_c, hox, hos]
    have hcl' : ∀ c ∈ chain x s, c ∉ T → cycNext (chain x s) c ∉ T := fun c hc hcT hnext => by
      obtain ⟨o', ho', hox', hos', hc'⟩ := (hmemT _).mp hnext
      have ho : (⟨(c, x, s), hvalid c hc⟩ : Occ A) ∉ U := fun h =>
        hcT ((hmemT c).mpr ⟨_, h, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩)
      have : nextOcc ⟨(c, x, s), hvalid c hc⟩ = o' := Occ.ext hc'.symm hox'.symm hos'.symm
      exact hU.2.1 _ ho (this ▸ ho')
    rcases eq_empty_or_eq_of_cycNext_closed hTS hcl hcl' with hT | hT
    · refine Or.inr fun o hox hos ho => ?_
      have : o.c ∈ T := (hmemT _).mpr ⟨o, ho, hox, hos, rfl⟩
      rw [hT] at this
      exact notMem_empty _ this
    · refine Or.inl fun o hox hos => ?_
      have : o.c ∈ T := hT ▸ (hox ▸ hos ▸ c_mem_chain o)
      obtain ⟨o', ho', hox', hos', hc'⟩ := (hmemT _).mp this
      exact Occ.ext hc'.symm (hox.trans hox'.symm) (hos.trans hos'.symm) ▸ ho'
  · exact Or.inr fun o hox _ _ => hx (hox ▸ o.satOccurs)

/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SatCover.mem_iff_dummy_mem
statement:
theorem mem_iff_dummy_mem {U : Finset (Occ A)} (hU : Consistent U) (o : Occ A) :
    o ∈ U ↔ Occ.dummy o.x o.satOccurs o.s ∈ U
proof:
:= by
  rcases chain_all_or_none hU o.x o.s with h | h
  · exact ⟨fun _ => h _ rfl rfl, fun _ => h o rfl rfl⟩
  · exact ⟨fun ho => absurd ho (h o rfl rfl), fun ho => absurd ho (h _ rfl rfl)⟩

/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SatCover.dummy_true_mem_iff
statement:
theorem dummy_true_mem_iff {U : Finset (Occ A)} (hU : Consistent U) (x : A)
    (hx : SatOccurs A x) : Occ.dummy x hx true ∈ U ↔ Occ.dummy x hx false ∉ U
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨o, ⟨hoh, ho⟩, huniq⟩ := hU.2.2 (Sum.inr ⟨x, hx⟩)
  obtain ⟨hob, hox⟩ := (hubOf_eq_inr_iff o ⟨x, hx⟩).mp hoh
  have ho' : o = Occ.dummy x hx o.s := Occ.ext hob hox rfl
  have hd : ∀ s, hubOf (Occ.dummy x hx s) = Sum.inr ⟨x, hx⟩ := fun s =>
    (hubOf_eq_inr_iff _ _).mpr ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  constructor
  · intro ht hf
    have h1 := huniq _ ⟨hd true, ht⟩
    have h2 := huniq _ ⟨hd false, hf⟩
    exact Bool.false_ne_true (congrArg Occ.s (h2.trans h1.symm))
  · intro hf
    cases hs : o.s
    · rw [hs] at ho'
      exact absurd (ho' ▸ ho) hf
    · rw [hs] at ho'
      exact ho' ▸ ho

/-! ### From choices to models -/

/
loop of its positive dummy occurrence is chosen. -/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SatCover.litTrue_toModel_iff
statement:
theorem litTrue_toModel_iff {U : Finset (Occ A)} (hU : Consistent U) (o : Occ A) :
    LitTrue (toModel U) o.x o.s ↔ o ∈ U
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_iff_dummy_mem hU o]
  cases hs : o.s
  · simp only [LitTrue, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, toModel, not_exists]
    exact ⟨fun h => not_not.mp ((dummy_true_mem_iff hU o.x o.satOccurs).not.mp (h o.satOccurs)),
      fun hf _ ht => (dummy_true_mem_iff hU _ _).mp ht hf⟩
  · simp only [LitTrue, ↓reduceIte, toModel]
    exact ⟨fun ⟨_, h⟩ => h, fun h => ⟨_, h⟩⟩

/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SatCover.oneInModel_toModel
statement: theorem oneInModel_toModel {U : Finset (Occ A)} (hU : Consistent U) : OneInModel A (toModel U)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun c hc => ?_, fun x ⟨hx, _⟩ => hx⟩
  obtain ⟨o, ⟨hoh, ho⟩, huniq⟩ := hU.2.2 (Sum.inl ⟨c, hc⟩)
  have hoc : o.c = c := (hubOf_eq_inl_iff o ⟨c, hc⟩).mp hoh
  refine ⟨o.x, o.s, o.occIn_of_coe hoc, (litTrue_toModel_iff hU o).mpr ho, fun y t hyt hlit => ?_⟩
  have h := huniq (Occ.real c y t hyt) ⟨(hubOf_eq_inl_iff _ _).mpr rfl,
    (litTrue_toModel_iff hU (Occ.real c y t hyt)).mp hlit⟩
  exact ⟨congrArg Occ.x h, congrArg Occ.s h⟩

/-! ### From models to choices -/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SatCover.mem_ofModel
statement: theorem mem_ofModel {ν : A → Prop} {o : Occ A} : o ∈ ofModel ν ↔ LitTrue ν o.x o.s
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [ofModel]

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SatCover.consistent_ofModel
statement: theorem consistent_ofModel {ν : A → Prop} (hν : OneInModel A ν) : Consistent (ofModel ν)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun o ho => ?_, fun o ho => ?_, fun h => ?_⟩
  · rw [mem_ofModel] at ho ⊢
    exact ho
  · rw [mem_ofModel] at ho ⊢
    exact ho
  rcases h with ⟨c, hc⟩ | ⟨x, hx⟩
  · obtain ⟨x, s, hocc, hlit, huniq⟩ := hν.1 c hc
    refine ⟨Occ.real c x s hocc, ⟨(hubOf_eq_inl_iff _ _).mpr rfl, mem_ofModel.mpr hlit⟩,
      fun o ⟨hoh, ho⟩ => ?_⟩
    have hoc : o.c = c := (hubOf_eq_inl_iff o ⟨c, hc⟩).mp hoh
    obtain ⟨hx, hs⟩ := huniq o.x o.s (o.occIn_of_coe hoc) (mem_ofModel.mp ho)
    exact Occ.ext hoc hx hs
  · refine ⟨Occ.dummy x hx (decide (ν x)), ⟨(hubOf_eq_inr_iff _ _).mpr ⟨rfl, rfl⟩, ?_⟩,
      fun o ⟨hoh, ho⟩ => ?_⟩
    · rw [mem_ofModel]
      by_cases h : ν x
      · simp [Occ.dummy, Occ.x, Occ.s, LitTrue, h]
      · simp [Occ.dummy, Occ.x, Occ.s, LitTrue, h]
    · obtain ⟨hob, hox⟩ := (hubOf_eq_inr_iff o ⟨x, hx⟩).mp hoh
      refine Occ.ext hob hox ?_
      have hlit := mem_ofModel.mp ho
      rw [hox] at hlit
      cases hs : o.s
      · rw [hs] at hlit
        simp only [LitTrue, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte] at hlit
        simp [Occ.dummy, Occ.s, hlit]
      · rw [hs] at hlit
        simp only [LitTrue, ↓reduceIte] at hlit
        simp [Occ.dummy, Occ.s, hlit]

/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SatCover.card_consistent
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Fintype.card_subtype, ← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Nat.card_congr consistentEquiv]

/
number of occurrences times the number of exactly-one models.** -/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SatCover.bperm_attachAll_sites_eq
statement:
theorem bperm_attachAll_sites_eq :
    bperm (Site.attachAll baseM (sites (A := A))) =
      4 ^ Fintype.card (Occ A) * (SharpOneInSAT A : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [bperm_attachAll_sites, card_consistent, sharpOneInSat_apply]

name: DescriptiveComplexity.TopoOn.of_equiv
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hirr, htrans, hmono⟩ := h
  refine ⟨fun x hx hlt => ?_, fun x y z hx hy hz h₁ h₂ => ?_, fun x y hx hy harc => ?_⟩
  · exact hirr (u.symm x) ((hV _).mpr (by simpa using hx)) ((hLt _ _).mpr (by simpa using hlt))
  · have := htrans (u.symm x) (u.symm y) (u.symm z) ((hV _).mpr (by simpa using hx))
      ((hV _).mpr (by simpa using hy)) ((hV _).mpr (by simpa using hz))
      ((hLt _ _).mpr (by simpa using h₁)) ((hLt _ _).mpr (by simpa using h₂))
    simpa using (hLt (u.symm x) (u.symm z)).mp this
  · have := hmono (u.symm x) (u.symm y) ((hV _).mpr (by simpa using hx))
      ((hV _).mpr (by simpa using hy)) ((hArc _ _).mpr (by simpa using harc))
    simpa using (hLt (u.symm x) (u.symm y)).mp this

/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.TopoOn.equiv_iff
proof:
:=
  ⟨TopoOn.of_equiv u hV hLt hArc,
    TopoOn.of_equiv u.symm (fun a => by rw [hV]; simp) (fun a a' => by rw [hLt]; simp)
      fun a a' => by rw [hArc]; simp⟩

/
set admit a topological order precisely when they are acyclic on it. Left to
right a cycle would give `Lt x x`; right to left the transitive closure is the
order (`DescriptiveComplexity.acyclicRel_iff_exists_order`, on the subtype of
marked elements).

This is why carrying the witness costs no generality: every DAG is a
yes-instance-shaped instance, and no other structure is. -/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.acyclicOn_iff_exists_topoOn
statement:
theorem acyclicOn_iff_exists_topoOn (V : A → Prop) (Arc : A → A → Prop) :
    AcyclicRel (fun x y : {x : A // V x} => Arc x.1 y.1) ↔
      ∃ Lt : A → A → Prop, TopoOn V Lt Arc
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hac
    obtain ⟨Lt, htrans, hirr, hmono⟩ := (acyclicRel_iff_exists_order _).mp hac
    exact ⟨fun x y => ∃ (hx : V x) (hy : V y), Lt ⟨x, hx⟩ ⟨y, hy⟩,
      fun x _ ⟨hx₁, _, hlt⟩ => hirr ⟨x, hx₁⟩ hlt,
      fun x _ z hx _ hz ⟨_, _, h₁⟩ ⟨_, _, h₂⟩ => ⟨hx, hz, htrans _ _ _ h₁ h₂⟩,
      fun x y hx hy harc => ⟨hx, hy, hmono ⟨x, hx⟩ ⟨y, hy⟩ harc⟩⟩
  · rintro ⟨Lt, hirr, htrans, hmono⟩
    refine (acyclicRel_iff_exists_order _).mpr
      ⟨fun x y => Lt x.1 y.1, fun x y z h₁ h₂ => htrans _ _ _ x.2 y.2 z.2 h₁ h₂,
        fun x => hirr x.1 x.2, fun a b h => hmono _ _ a.2 b.2 h⟩

name: DescriptiveComplexity.hasDagIso_iso
statement:
theorem hasDagIso_iso (e : A ≃[Language.twoDags] B) :
    HasDagIso A ↔ HasDagIso B
proof:
:=
  and_congr e.toEquiv.finite_iff
    (and_congr
      (TopoOn.equiv_iff e.toEquiv (fun a => relMap_equiv₁ e tdPatV a)
        (fun a b => relMap_equiv₂ e tdPatLt a b) fun a b => relMap_equiv₂ e tdPatArc a b)
      (and_congr
        (TopoOn.equiv_iff e.toEquiv (fun a => relMap_equiv₁ e tdHostV a)
          (fun a b => relMap_equiv₂ e tdHostLt a b) fun a b => relMap_equiv₂ e tdHostArc a b)
        (RelIsoOn.equiv_iff e.toEquiv (fun a => relMap_equiv₁ e tdPatV a)
          (fun a => relMap_equiv₁ e tdHostV a) (fun a b => relMap_equiv₂ e tdPatArc a b)
          fun a b => relMap_equiv₂ e tdHostArc a b)))

name: DescriptiveComplexity.DagIso.two_eta
statement: theorem two_eta (w : Fin 2 → A) : w = ![w 0, w 1]
proof:
:= by
  funext i; fin_cases i <;> rfl

/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.DagIso.vtx_eta
statement: theorem vtx_eta (w : Fin 2 → A) : ((NodeTag.vtx, w) : incInterp.Map A) = vPt2 (w 0) (w 1)
proof:
:=
  Prod.ext_iff.mpr ⟨rfl, two_eta w⟩

/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.DagIso.mid_eta
statement: theorem mid_eta (w : Fin 2 → A) : ((NodeTag.arcMid, w) : incInterp.Map A) = midPt (w 0) (w 1)
proof:
:=
  Prod.ext_iff.mpr ⟨rfl, two_eta w⟩

/

statement: theorem end_eta (w : Fin 2 → A) : ((NodeTag.arcEnd, w) : incInterp.Map A) = endPt (w 0) (w 1)

:=
  Prod.ext_iff.mpr ⟨rfl, two_eta w⟩

name: DescriptiveComplexity.DagIso.vPt_injective
statement: theorem vPt_injective : Function.Injective (vPt (A := A))
proof:
:= fun _ _ h =>
  congrArg (fun p : incInterp.Map A => p.2 0) h

name: DescriptiveComplexity.DagIso.midPt_inj
statement: theorem midPt_inj {u v u' v' : A} (h : midPt u v = midPt u' v') : u = u' ∧ v = v'
proof:
:=
  ⟨congrArg (fun p : incInterp.Map A => p.2 0) h, congrArg (fun p : incInterp.Map A => p.2 1) h⟩

name: DescriptiveComplexity.DagIso.pat_vPt2
statement:
@[simp]
theorem pat_vPt2 (u v : A) : TDPatV (vPt2 u v) ↔ u = v ∧ TGPatV u
proof:
:= by
  rw [TDPatV, FOInterpretation.relMap_map]
  simp [incInterp, nodeF, vPt2, TGPatV, Formula.realize_rel₁, Formula.realize_equal]

name: DescriptiveComplexity.DagIso.pat_vPt
statement:
@[simp]
theorem pat_vPt (v : A) : TDPatV (vPt v) ↔ TGPatV v
proof:
:= by
  rw [vPt, pat_vPt2]
  simp

name: DescriptiveComplexity.DagIso.pat_midPt
statement:
@[simp]
theorem pat_midPt (u v : A) :
    TDPatV (midPt u v) ↔ TGPatV u ∧ TGPatV v ∧ TGPatE u v
proof:
:= by
  rw [TDPatV, FOInterpretation.relMap_map]
  simp [incInterp, nodeF, midPt, TGPatV, TGPatE, Formula.realize_rel₁, Formula.realize_rel₂,
    and_assoc]

name: DescriptiveComplexity.DagIso.pat_endPt
statement:
@[simp]
theorem pat_endPt (u v : A) :
    TDPatV (endPt u v) ↔ TGPatV u ∧ TGPatV v ∧ TGPatE u v
proof:
:= by
  rw [TDPatV, FOInterpretation.relMap_map]
  simp [incInterp, nodeF, endPt, TGPatV, TGPatE, Formula.realize_rel₁, Formula.realize_rel₂,
    and_assoc]

/
hypothesis is unfolded by `rcases` rather than by `rw`: the defining formula's
realization is definitionally a conjunction, and a pair literal at
`FOInterpretation.Map` type does not match at rewriting transparency. -/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.DagIso.patV_cases
statement:
theorem patV_cases {p : incInterp.Map A} (h : TDPatV p) :
    (∃ v, TGPatV v ∧ p = vPt v) ∨
      (∃ u v, (TGPatV u ∧ TGPatV v ∧ TGPatE u v) ∧ p = midPt u v) ∨
      ∃ u v, (TGPatV u ∧ TGPatV v ∧ TGPatE u v) ∧ p = endPt u v
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, w⟩ := p
  cases t
  · obtain ⟨heq, hmark⟩ := (pat_vPt2 (w 0) (w 1)).mp (Eq.mp (congrArg TDPatV (vtx_eta w)) h)
    exact Or.inl ⟨w 0, hmark, (vtx_eta w).trans (by rw [vPt, heq])⟩
  · exact Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨w 0, w 1,
      (pat_midPt (w 0) (w 1)).mp (Eq.mp (congrArg TDPatV (mid_eta w)) h), mid_eta w⟩)
  · exact Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨w 0, w 1,
      (pat_endPt (w 0) (w 1)).mp (Eq.mp (congrArg TDPatV (end_eta w)) h), end_eta w⟩)

/
climb the three levels. The six forbidden tag combinations need no argument –
their defining formula is `⊥`, so the hypothesis *is* `False`. -/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.DagIso.pat_arc_tag
statement:
theorem pat_arc_tag {p q : incInterp.Map A} (h : TDPatArc p q) :
    (p.1 = .vtx ∧ q.1 = .arcMid) ∨ (p.1 = .vtx ∧ q.1 = .arcEnd) ∨
      (p.1 = .arcMid ∧ q.1 = .arcEnd)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, w⟩ := p
  obtain ⟨s, x⟩ := q
  cases t <;> cases s <;>
    first
      | exact h.elim
      | exact Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
      | exact Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl⟩)
      | exact Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨rfl, rfl⟩)

/
hypothesis is unfolded by `rcases` rather than by `rw`: the defining formula's
realization is definitionally a conjunction, and a pair literal at
`FOInterpretation.Map` type does not match at rewriting transparency. -/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.DagIso.hostV_cases
statement:
theorem hostV_cases {p : incInterp.Map A} (h : TDHostV p) :
    (∃ v, TGHostV v ∧ p = vPt v) ∨
      (∃ u v, (TGHostV u ∧ TGHostV v ∧ TGHostE u v) ∧ p = midPt u v) ∨
      ∃ u v, (TGHostV u ∧ TGHostV v ∧ TGHostE u v) ∧ p = endPt u v
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, w⟩ := p
  cases t
  · obtain ⟨heq, hmark⟩ := (host_vPt2 (w 0) (w 1)).mp (Eq.mp (congrArg TDHostV (vtx_eta w)) h)
    exact Or.inl ⟨w 0, hmark, (vtx_eta w).trans (by rw [vPt, heq])⟩
  · exact Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨w 0, w 1,
      (host_midPt (w 0) (w 1)).mp (Eq.mp (congrArg TDHostV (mid_eta w)) h), mid_eta w⟩)
  · exact Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨w 0, w 1,
      (host_endPt (w 0) (w 1)).mp (Eq.mp (congrArg TDHostV (end_eta w)) h), end_eta w⟩)

/
climb the three levels. The six forbidden tag combinations need no argument –
their defining formula is `⊥`, so the hypothesis *is* `False`. -/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.DagIso.host_arc_tag
statement:
theorem host_arc_tag {p q : incInterp.Map A} (h : TDHostArc p q) :
    (p.1 = .vtx ∧ q.1 = .arcMid) ∨ (p.1 = .vtx ∧ q.1 = .arcEnd) ∨
      (p.1 = .arcMid ∧ q.1 = .arcEnd)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, w⟩ := p
  obtain ⟨s, x⟩ := q
  cases t <;> cases s <;>
    first
      | exact h.elim
      | exact Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
      | exact Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl⟩)
      | exact Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨rfl, rfl⟩)

/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.DagIso.patLt_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem patLt_iff (p q : incInterp.Map A) : TDPatLt p q ↔ level p.1 < level q.1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, w⟩ := p
  obtain ⟨s, x⟩ := q
  cases t <;> cases s <;>

      | exact ⟨fun h => h.elim, fun h => absurd h (by simp [level])⟩

/
witness: the order is the level comparison, so irreflexivity and transitivity
are those of `<` on `ℕ`, and every arc climbs a level. -/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.DagIso.topoOn_pat
statement: theorem topoOn_pat : TopoOn (TDPatV (A := incInterp.Map A)) TDPatLt TDPatArc
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun p _ h => absurd ((patLt_iff p p).mp h) (lt_irrefl _),
    fun p q r _ _ _ h₁ h₂ =>
      (patLt_iff p r).mpr (((patLt_iff p q).mp h₁).trans ((patLt_iff q r).mp h₂)),
    fun _ _ _ _ h => patLt_of_patArc h⟩

/

    fun _ _ _ _ h => hostLt_of_hostArc h⟩
