  refine piSODefinable_of_orderPull (pullBlocks f.Tag f.dim Bs)
    (by simpa [pullBlocks] using hk)
    (pullSO Bs (L₁.sum Language.order) L₂ f.toInterpretation φ) ?_
  intro A _ _ _
  have hpull : ∀ lo : LinearOrder A,
      letI := lo
      (P A ↔ SORealize (L₁.sum Language.order) A (pullBlocks f.Tag f.dim Bs)
        (pullSO Bs (L₁.sum Language.order) L₂ f.toInterpretation φ) false) := by
    intro lo
    let := lo
    have := f.toInterpretation.map_finite A
    have := f.toInterpretation.map_nonempty A
    exact (f.correct A).trans ((hφ (f.toInterpretation.Map A)).trans
      (sorealize_pullSO f.toInterpretation A Bs φ false))
  exact ⟨fun hP lo => (hpull lo).mp hP,
    fun hall => (hpull (finiteLinearOrder A)).mpr (hall _)⟩

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SOBlock.relMap_paramSym
proof:
:= by
  have hvec : (fun j => w (Fin.cast (congrArg (· + 1) b.2) j)) =
      Fin.cons c fun j => w (Fin.cast b.2 j).succ := by
    funext j
    refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun k => ?_) j
    · rw [Fin.cons_zero]
      exact (congrArg w (Fin.ext rfl)).trans hw
    · rw [Fin.cons_succ]
      exact congrArg w (Fin.ext rfl)
  exact iff_of_eq (congrArg (ρ b.1) hvec)

name: DescriptiveComplexity.FOInterpretation.realize_pullSentence
statement:
theorem FOInterpretation.realize_pullSentence (φ : L₂.Sentence) (A : Type)
    [L₁.Structure A] :
    A ⊨ I.pullSentence φ ↔ I.Map A ⊨ φ
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : A ⊨ I.pullSentence φ ↔
      (I.pull (φ : L₂.BoundedFormula Empty 0) (isEmptyElim : (Empty ⊕ Fin 0) → Tag)).Realize
        ((default : Empty → A) ∘ fun p : (Empty ⊕ Fin 0) × Fin d =>
          (isEmptyElim p.1 : Empty)) :=
    Formula.realize_relabel
  rw [h1, I.realize_pull]
  exact iff_of_eq (congrArg₂
    (fun a b => BoundedFormula.Realize (M := I.Map A) (φ : L₂.BoundedFormula Empty 0) a b)
    (Subsingleton.elim _ _) (Subsingleton.elim _ _))

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SOBlock.pullAssign_mergeAssign
statement:
theorem SOBlock.pullAssign_mergeAssign (B : SOBlock) (σ : (B.pull Tag d).Assignment A) :
    B.pullAssign (B.mergeAssign σ) = σ
proof:
:= by
  funext p x
  change σ p
    (fun m => x (finProdFinEquiv
      ((finProdFinEquiv.symm m).1, (finProdFinEquiv.symm m).2))) = σ p x
  exact congrArg (σ p) (funext fun m => congrArg x (Equiv.apply_symm_apply _ _))

/
`DescriptiveComplexity.SOBlock.pullAssign` is injective, with
`DescriptiveComplexity.SOBlock.mergeAssign` as a retraction on the other side. -/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SOBlock.mergeAssign_pullAssign
statement:
theorem SOBlock.mergeAssign_pullAssign (B : SOBlock)
    (ρ : B.Assignment (Tag × (Fin d → A))) : B.mergeAssign (B.pullAssign ρ) = ρ
proof:
:= by
  funext i y
  change ρ i (fun k => ((y k).1, fun j =>
    (y (finProdFinEquiv.symm (finProdFinEquiv (k, j))).1).2
      (finProdFinEquiv.symm (finProdFinEquiv (k, j))).2)) = ρ i y
  refine congrArg (ρ i) (funext fun k => ?_)
  simp only [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]

name: DescriptiveComplexity.sorealize_pullSO
statement:
theorem sorealize_pullSO [instRel : L₂.IsRelational] (I : FOInterpretation L₁ L₂ Tag d)
    (A : Type) [L₁.Structure A] (Bs : List SOBlock) (φ : (soLang L₂ Bs).Sentence)
    (pol : Bool) :
    SORealize L₂ (I.Map A) Bs φ pol ↔
      SORealize L₁ A (pullBlocks Tag d Bs) (pullSO Bs L₁ L₂ I φ) pol
proof:
:=
  sorealize_pullSO_aux Bs L₁ L₂ instRel I A _ φ pol

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SigmaSODefinable.of_foReduction
statement:
theorem SigmaSODefinable.of_foReduction (f : P ≤ᶠᵒ Q) (h : SigmaSODefinable k Q) :
    SigmaSODefinable k P
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Bs, hk, φ, hφ⟩ := h
  let := f.tagFinite
  let := f.tagNonempty
  refine ⟨pullBlocks f.Tag f.dim Bs, by simp [pullBlocks, hk],
    pullSO Bs L₁ L₂ f.toInterpretation φ, ?_⟩
  intro A _ _ _
  have := f.toInterpretation.map_finite A
  have := f.toInterpretation.map_nonempty A
  exact (f.correct A).trans ((hφ (f.toInterpretation.Map A)).trans
    (sorealize_pullSO f.toInterpretation A Bs φ true))

/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.PiSODefinable.of_foReduction
statement:
theorem PiSODefinable.of_foReduction (f : P ≤ᶠᵒ Q) (h : PiSODefinable k Q) :
    PiSODefinable k P
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Bs, hk, φ, hφ⟩ := h
  let := f.tagFinite
  let := f.tagNonempty
  refine ⟨pullBlocks f.Tag f.dim Bs, by simp [pullBlocks, hk],
    pullSO Bs L₁ L₂ f.toInterpretation φ, ?_⟩
  intro A _ _ _
  have := f.toInterpretation.map_finite A
  have := f.toInterpretation.map_nonempty A
  exact (f.correct A).trans ((hφ (f.toInterpretation.Map A)).trans
    (sorealize_pullSO f.toInterpretation A Bs φ false))

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SOAtom.pull_holds
statement:
theorem SOAtom.pull_holds {A : Type} (I : FOInterpretation L₁ L₂ Tag d) (a : SOAtom B k)
    (t : Fin k → Tag) (ρ : B.Assignment (I.Map A)) (w : Fin (k * d) → A) :
    (a.pull d t).Holds (B.pullAssign ρ) w ↔ a.Holds ρ (tagVal I t w)
proof:
:= by
  refine iff_of_eq (congrArg (ρ a.idx) (funext fun j => ?_))
  refine Prod.ext_iff.mpr ⟨rfl, funext fun i => ?_⟩
  refine congrArg w ?_
  change finProdFinEquiv (a.args (finProdFinEquiv.symm (finProdFinEquiv (j, i))).1,
    (finProdFinEquiv.symm (finProdFinEquiv (j, i))).2) = finProdFinEquiv (a.args j, i)
  rw [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]

name: DescriptiveComplexity.tagVal_split
statement:
theorem tagVal_split {A : Type} (I : FOInterpretation L₁ L₂ Tag d) (v : Fin k → I.Map A) :
    tagVal I (fun p => (v p).1)
      (fun m => (v (finProdFinEquiv.symm m).1).2 (finProdFinEquiv.symm m).2) = v
proof:
:= by
  funext p
  refine Prod.ext_iff.mpr ⟨rfl, funext fun j => ?_⟩
  rw [tagVal]
  exact congrArg₂ (fun (q : Fin k) (i : Fin d) => (v q).2 i)
    (congrArg Prod.fst (Equiv.symm_apply_apply _ _))
    (congrArg Prod.snd (Equiv.symm_apply_apply _ _))

name: DescriptiveComplexity.realize_guardPull
statement:
theorem realize_guardPull {A : Type} [L₁.Structure A] (I : FOInterpretation L₁ L₂ Tag d)
    (φ : L₂.Formula (Fin k)) (t : Fin k → Tag) (w : Fin (k * d) → A) :
    (guardPull I φ t).Realize w ↔ φ.Realize (M := I.Map A) (tagVal I t w)
proof:
:= by
  rw [guardPull, Formula.realize_relabel, I.realize_pull]
  exact iff_of_eq (congrArg₂
    (fun a b => BoundedFormula.Realize (M := I.Map A) (φ : L₂.BoundedFormula (Fin k) 0) a b)
    (funext fun _ => rfl) (Subsingleton.elim _ _))

name: DescriptiveComplexity.mem_allTagAssign
statement: theorem mem_allTagAssign (t : Fin k → Tag) : t ∈ allTagAssign Tag k
proof:
:= by
  let : Fintype Tag := Fintype.ofFinite Tag
  exact Finset.mem_toList.mpr (Finset.mem_univ t)

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SOBlock.readAssignRel_iff
statement:
theorem SOBlock.readAssignRel_iff (B : SOBlock) (I : RelFOInterpretation L₁ L₂ Tag dm)
    (σ : (B.pull Tag dm).Assignment A) {i : B.ι} (y : Fin (B.arity i) → I.MapRel A) :
    B.readAssignRel I σ i y ↔
      σ ⟨i, fun k => (y k).1.1⟩ fun m =>
        (y (finProdFinEquiv.symm m).1).1.2 (finProdFinEquiv.symm m).2
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

/
assignment back on the domain returns it unchanged. (The other composite is
*not* the identity – a guessed pulled assignment may hold of tuples that are
not points of the domain.) -/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SOBlock.readAssignRel_pullAssignRel
statement:
theorem SOBlock.readAssignRel_pullAssignRel (B : SOBlock)
    (I : RelFOInterpretation L₁ L₂ Tag dm) (ρ : B.Assignment (I.MapRel A)) :
    B.readAssignRel I (B.pullAssignRel I ρ) = ρ
proof:
:= by
  funext i y
  refine propext ?_
  have hcoord : ∀ (k : Fin (B.arity i)) (j : Fin dm),
      (y (finProdFinEquiv.symm (finProdFinEquiv (k, j))).1).1.2
          (finProdFinEquiv.symm (finProdFinEquiv (k, j))).2 = (y k).1.2 j :=
    fun k j => congrArg (fun z : Fin (B.arity i) × Fin dm => (y z.1).1.2 z.2)
      (Equiv.symm_apply_apply finProdFinEquiv (k, j))
  have hy : ∀ k, (y k).1 = ((y k).1.1,
      fun j => (y (finProdFinEquiv.symm (finProdFinEquiv (k, j))).1).1.2
        (finProdFinEquiv.symm (finProdFinEquiv (k, j))).2) :=
    fun k => congrArg (Prod.mk (y k).1.1) (funext fun j => (hcoord k j).symm)
  exact B.pullAssignRel_iff I ρ y hy

name: DescriptiveComplexity.sorealize_pullRelSO
statement:
theorem sorealize_pullRelSO [instRel : L₂.IsRelational]
    (I : RelFOInterpretation L₁ L₂ Tag dm) (A : Type) [L₁.Structure A]
    (Bs : List SOBlock) (φ : (soLang L₂ Bs).Sentence) (pol : Bool) :
    SORealize L₂ (I.MapRel A) Bs φ pol ↔
      SORealize L₁ A (pullBlocks Tag dm Bs) (pullRelSO Bs L₁ L₂ I φ) pol
proof:
:=
  sorealize_pullRelSO_aux Bs L₁ L₂ instRel I A _ φ pol

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SigmaSODefinable.of_relOrderedReduction
statement:
theorem SigmaSODefinable.of_relOrderedReduction (f : P ≤ʳᶠᵒ[≤] Q)
    (h : SigmaSODefinable (k + 1) Q) : SigmaSODefinable (k + 1) P
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Bs, hk, φ, hφ⟩ := h
  let := f.tagFinite
  refine sigmaSODefinable_of_orderPull (pullBlocks f.Tag f.dim Bs)
    (by simpa [pullBlocks] using hk) (pullRelSO Bs (L₁.sum Language.order) L₂
      f.toRelInterpretation φ) ?_
  intro A _ _ _
  have key : ∀ lo : LinearOrder A,
      (letI := lo
       P A ↔ SORealize (L₁.sum Language.order) A (pullBlocks f.Tag f.dim Bs)
        (pullRelSO Bs (L₁.sum Language.order) L₂ f.toRelInterpretation φ) true) := by
    intro lo
    let := lo
    have : Finite (f.toRelInterpretation.MapRel A) := f.toRelInterpretation.mapRel_finite A
    have : Nonempty (f.toRelInterpretation.MapRel A) := f.mapRel_nonempty A
    exact (f.correct A).trans ((hφ (f.toRelInterpretation.MapRel A)).trans
      (sorealize_pullRelSO f.toRelInterpretation A Bs φ true))
  exact ⟨fun hP => ⟨finiteLinearOrder A, (key _).mp hP⟩, fun ⟨lo, h⟩ => (key lo).mpr h⟩

/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.PiSODefinable.of_relOrderedReduction
statement:
theorem PiSODefinable.of_relOrderedReduction (f : P ≤ʳᶠᵒ[≤] Q)
    (h : PiSODefinable (k + 1) Q) : PiSODefinable (k + 1) P
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Bs, hk, φ, hφ⟩ := h
  let := f.tagFinite
  refine piSODefinable_of_orderPull (pullBlocks f.Tag f.dim Bs)
    (by simpa [pullBlocks] using hk) (pullRelSO Bs (L₁.sum Language.order) L₂
      f.toRelInterpretation φ) ?_
  intro A _ _ _
  have key : ∀ lo : LinearOrder A,
      (letI := lo
       P A ↔ SORealize (L₁.sum Language.order) A (pullBlocks f.Tag f.dim Bs)
        (pullRelSO Bs (L₁.sum Language.order) L₂ f.toRelInterpretation φ) false) := by
    intro lo
    let := lo
    have : Finite (f.toRelInterpretation.MapRel A) := f.toRelInterpretation.mapRel_finite A
    have : Nonempty (f.toRelInterpretation.MapRel A) := f.mapRel_nonempty A
    exact (f.correct A).trans ((hφ (f.toRelInterpretation.MapRel A)).trans
      (sorealize_pullRelSO f.toRelInterpretation A Bs φ false))
  exact ⟨fun hP lo => (key lo).mp hP, fun h => (key (finiteLinearOrder A)).mpr (h _)⟩

name: DescriptiveComplexity.repBlocks_length
statement:
@[simp]
theorem repBlocks_length (B : SOBlock) (k : ℕ) : (repBlocks B k).length = k
proof:
:=
  List.length_replicate ..

/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.relMap_repSym
statement:
theorem relMap_repSym (B : SOBlock) {A : Type} {n : ℕ} (x : B.ι) (h : B.arity x = n) :
    ∀ (k : ℕ) (ρs : Fin k → B.Assignment A) (i : Fin k) (v : Fin n → A),
      @RelMap (repMerged B k).lang A ((repMerged B k).structure (repBlockAssign B A k ρs)) n
          (repSym B x h k i) v ↔ ρs i x fun j => v (Fin.cast h j)
proof:
:= by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero => intro _ i; exact i.elim0
  | succ k ih =>
    intro ρs i v
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := i
    cases j with
    | zero => exact Iff.rfl
    | succ j => exact ih (fun i => ρs i.succ) ⟨j, Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ hj⟩ v

/-! ### Alternating over the rounds -/

/
of index `0` is quantified outermost, existentially if `pol` is `true`, and the
polarities alternate inwards. -/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.altBlockQuant_congr
statement:
theorem altBlockQuant_congr {A : Type} {B : SOBlock} :
    ∀ (k : ℕ) (P Q : (Fin k → B.Assignment A) → Prop), (∀ ρs, P ρs ↔ Q ρs) →
      ∀ pol : Bool, altBlockQuant A B k P pol ↔ altBlockQuant A B k Q pol
proof:
:= by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero => intro P Q h pol; exact h _
  | succ k ih =>
    intro P Q h pol
    cases pol with
    | true => exact exists_congr fun ρ => ih _ _ (fun ρs => h _) false
    | false => exact forall_congr' fun ρ => ih _ _ (fun ρs => h _) true

/
pieces of the merged assignment of `k` copies of `B` is alternating over `k`
assignments of `B`. -/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.altAssign_repBlocks
statement:
theorem altAssign_repBlocks (B : SOBlock) {A : Type} :
    ∀ (k : ℕ) (P : (repMerged B k).Assignment A → Prop) (pol : Bool),
      altAssign A (repBlocks B k) P pol ↔
        altBlockQuant A B k (fun ρs => P (repBlockAssign B A k ρs)) pol
proof:
:= by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero => intro P pol; exact Iff.rfl
  | succ k ih =>
    intro P pol
    have hrep : ∀ (ρ : B.Assignment A) (ρs : Fin k → B.Assignment A),
        repBlockAssign B A (k + 1) (Fin.cons ρ ρs) = consAssign ρ (repBlockAssign B A k ρs) := by
      intro ρ ρs
      simp only [repBlockAssign, Fin.cons_zero, Fin.cons_succ]
      rfl
    have key : ∀ ρ : B.Assignment A,
        altAssign A (repBlocks B k) (fun μ => P (consAssign ρ μ)) (!pol) ↔
          altBlockQuant A B k
            (fun ρs => P (repBlockAssign B A (k + 1) (Fin.cons ρ ρs))) (!pol) := by
      intro ρ
      refine (ih _ (!pol)).trans (altBlockQuant_congr k _ _ (fun ρs => ?_) (!pol))
      exact iff_of_eq (congrArg P (hrep ρ ρs).symm)
    cases pol with
    | true => exact exists_congr key
    | false => exact forall_congr' key

/-! ### The definability statement

Put together: a sentence over the *single* merged block, transported into the
iterated expansion by `DescriptiveComplexity.unmergeHom`, is satisfied
alternately exactly when the `k` round assignments are quantified alternately.
This is the form a `Σₖ`-definability proof consumes. -/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.sorealize_repBlocks
statement:
theorem sorealize_repBlocks (B : SOBlock) (L : Language.{0, 0}) (A : Type)
    (instL : L.Structure A) (k : ℕ) (ψ : (L.sum (repMerged B k).lang).Sentence) (pol : Bool) :
    @SORealize L A instL (repBlocks B k) ((unmergeHom (repBlocks B k) L).onSentence ψ) pol ↔
      altBlockQuant A B k (fun ρs =>
        @Sentence.Realize (L.sum (repMerged B k).lang) A
          (@sumStructure L (repMerged B k).lang A instL
            ((repMerged B k).structure (repBlockAssign B A k ρs))) ψ) pol
proof:
:=
  (sorealize_unmerge (repBlocks B k) L A instL ψ pol).trans (altAssign_repBlocks B k _ pol)

name: DescriptiveComplexity.realize_sentence_of_equiv
proof:
:=
  letI := instM
  letI := instN
  StrongHomClass.realize_sentence e φ

/
interpreted by an assignment. -/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SOBlock.assignEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem SOBlock.assignEquiv_apply (B : SOBlock) {A A' : Type} (e : A ≃ A')
    (ρ : B.Assignment A) : B.assignEquiv e ρ = B.mapAssign e ρ
proof:
:=
  rfl

/
two assignments being transported. -/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SOTCSpec.reach_map
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact Relation.ReflTransGen.refl
  | @tail c d _ hcd ih => exact ih.tail ((hstep c d).mp hcd)

/
steps and endpoints to endpoints. -/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SOTCSpec.accepts_congr
statement:
theorem accepts_congr (e : spec₁.State A ≃ spec₂.State B)
    (hstep : ∀ ρ σ, spec₁.Step ρ σ ↔ spec₂.Step (e ρ) (e σ))
    (hsrc : ∀ ρ, spec₁.IsSrc ρ ↔ spec₂.IsSrc (e ρ))
    (htgt : ∀ ρ, spec₁.IsTgt ρ ↔ spec₂.IsTgt (e ρ)) :
    spec₁.Accepts A ↔ spec₂.Accepts B
proof:
:= by
  have hstep' : ∀ ρ σ, spec₂.Step ρ σ ↔ spec₁.Step (e.symm ρ) (e.symm σ) := by
    intro ρ σ
    rw [hstep (e.symm ρ) (e.symm σ), e.apply_symm_apply, e.apply_symm_apply]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨ρ, σ, hρ, hσ, h⟩
    exact ⟨e ρ, e σ, (hsrc ρ).mp hρ, (htgt σ).mp hσ, reach_map e hstep h⟩
  · rintro ⟨ρ, σ, hρ, hσ, h⟩
    refine ⟨e.symm ρ, e.symm σ, ?_, ?_, reach_map e.symm hstep' h⟩
    · rw [hsrc, e.apply_symm_apply]
      exact hρ
    · rw [htgt, e.apply_symm_apply]
      exact hσ

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SOTCSpec.step_equiv
statement:
theorem step_equiv (e : A ≃[L.sum Language.order] A') (ρ σ : spec.State A) :
    spec.Step ρ σ ↔ spec.Step (spec.B.mapAssign e.toEquiv ρ) (spec.B.mapAssign e.toEquiv σ)
proof:
:=
  realize_sentence_of_equiv (spec.B.extendEquiv₂ e ρ σ) spec.step

/
expansions. -/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SOTCSpec.isSrc_equiv
statement:
theorem isSrc_equiv (e : A ≃[L.sum Language.order] A') (ρ : spec.State A) :
    spec.IsSrc ρ ↔ spec.IsSrc (spec.B.mapAssign e.toEquiv ρ)
proof:
:=
  realize_sentence_of_equiv (spec.B.extendEquiv e ρ) spec.src

/
expansions. -/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SOTCSpec.isTgt_equiv
statement:
theorem isTgt_equiv (e : A ≃[L.sum Language.order] A') (ρ : spec.State A) :
    spec.IsTgt ρ ↔ spec.IsTgt (spec.B.mapAssign e.toEquiv ρ)
proof:
:=
  realize_sentence_of_equiv (spec.B.extendEquiv e ρ) spec.tgt

/
expansions, the order being visible to the sentences). -/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SOTCSpec.accepts_equiv
statement:
theorem accepts_equiv (e : A ≃[L.sum Language.order] A') :
    spec.Accepts A ↔ spec.Accepts A'
proof:
:=
  accepts_congr (spec.B.assignEquiv e.toEquiv) (spec.step_equiv e) (spec.isSrc_equiv e)
    (spec.isTgt_equiv e)

name: DescriptiveComplexity.sotcDefinable_congr
proof:
:= by
  constructor <;> rintro ⟨spec, hspec⟩ <;> refine ⟨spec, ?_⟩ <;> intro A _ _ _ _
  · exact (h A).symm.trans (hspec A)
  · exact (h A).trans (hspec A)

name: DescriptiveComplexity.addOrderOne_isExpansionOn
statement:
theorem addOrderOne_isExpansionOn (ρ : B.Assignment A) :
    @LHom.IsExpansionOn _ _ (addOrderOne L B) A
      (B.structure₁ (L := L) ρ)
      (@SOBlock.structure₁ (L.sum Language.order) B A (@sumOrderStructure L A instL _) ρ)
proof:
:= by
  let := B.structure₁ (L := L) ρ
  let := @SOBlock.structure₁ (L.sum Language.order) B A (@sumOrderStructure L A instL _) ρ
  refine ⟨fun {n} f x => ?_, fun {n} r x => ?_⟩
  · match f with
    | Sum.inl g => rfl
    | Sum.inr g => exact isEmptyElim g
  · match r with
    | Sum.inl s => rfl
    | Sum.inr s => rfl

name: DescriptiveComplexity.addOrderTwo_isExpansionOn
statement:
theorem addOrderTwo_isExpansionOn (ρ σ : B.Assignment A) :
    @LHom.IsExpansionOn _ _ (addOrderTwo L B) A
      (B.structure₂ (L := L) ρ σ)
      (@SOBlock.structure₂ (L.sum Language.order) B A (@sumOrderStructure L A instL _) ρ σ)
proof:
:= by
  let := B.structure₂ (L := L) ρ σ
  let := @SOBlock.structure₂ (L.sum Language.order) B A (@sumOrderStructure L A instL _) ρ σ
  refine ⟨fun {n} f x => ?_, fun {n} r x => ?_⟩
  · match f with
    | Sum.inl (Sum.inl g) => rfl
    | Sum.inl (Sum.inr g) => exact isEmptyElim g
    | Sum.inr g => exact isEmptyElim g
  · match r with
    | Sum.inl (Sum.inl s) => rfl
    | Sum.inl (Sum.inr s) => rfl
    | Sum.inr s => rfl

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SOTCSpecFree.toSpec_step_iff
statement: theorem toSpec_step_iff (ρ σ : spec.State A) : spec.toSpec.Step ρ σ ↔ spec.Step ρ σ
proof:
:= by
  let := spec.B.structure₂ (L := L) ρ σ
  let := @SOBlock.structure₂ (L.sum Language.order) spec.B A (@sumOrderStructure L A instL _) ρ σ
  have := addOrderTwo_isExpansionOn (L := L) (B := spec.B) ρ σ
  exact LHom.realize_onSentence (M := A) (addOrderTwo L spec.B) spec.step

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SOTCSpecFree.toSpec_isSrc_iff
statement: theorem toSpec_isSrc_iff (ρ : spec.State A) : spec.toSpec.IsSrc ρ ↔ spec.IsSrc ρ
proof:
:= by
  let := spec.B.structure₁ (L := L) ρ
  let := @SOBlock.structure₁ (L.sum Language.order) spec.B A (@sumOrderStructure L A instL _) ρ
  have := addOrderOne_isExpansionOn (L := L) (B := spec.B) ρ
  exact LHom.realize_onSentence (M := A) (addOrderOne L spec.B) spec.src

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SOTCSpecFree.toSpec_isTgt_iff
statement: theorem toSpec_isTgt_iff (ρ : spec.State A) : spec.toSpec.IsTgt ρ ↔ spec.IsTgt ρ
proof:
:= by
  let := spec.B.structure₁ (L := L) ρ
  let := @SOBlock.structure₁ (L.sum Language.order) spec.B A (@sumOrderStructure L A instL _) ρ
  have := addOrderOne_isExpansionOn (L := L) (B := spec.B) ρ
  exact LHom.realize_onSentence (M := A) (addOrderOne L spec.B) spec.tgt

/
not mention it. -/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SOTCSpecFree.accepts_toSpec_iff
statement: theorem accepts_toSpec_iff : spec.toSpec.Accepts A ↔ spec.Accepts A
proof:
:= by
  have hreach : ∀ ρ σ : spec.State A, spec.toSpec.Reach ρ σ ↔ spec.Reach ρ σ := by
    refine fun ρ σ => ⟨fun h => ?_, fun h => ?_⟩
    · induction h with
      | refl => exact Relation.ReflTransGen.refl
      | tail _ hcd ih => exact ih.tail ((toSpec_step_iff _ _).mp hcd)
    · induction h with
      | refl => exact Relation.ReflTransGen.refl
      | tail _ hcd ih => exact ih.tail ((toSpec_step_iff _ _).mpr hcd)
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨ρ, σ, hρ, hσ, h⟩
    exact ⟨ρ, σ, (toSpec_isSrc_iff ρ).mp hρ, (toSpec_isTgt_iff σ).mp hσ, (hreach ρ σ).mp h⟩
  · rintro ⟨ρ, σ, hρ, hσ, h⟩
    exact ⟨ρ, σ, (toSpec_isSrc_iff ρ).mpr hρ, (toSpec_isTgt_iff σ).mpr hσ, (hreach ρ σ).mpr h⟩

name: DescriptiveComplexity.realize_fixedOrdS
proof:
:= by
  let := instA
  let := @SOBlock.structure₂ L B.withOrder A instA ρ σ
  have hfst : ∀ w : Fin 2 → A,
      RelMap (L := (L.sum B.withOrder.lang).sum B.withOrder.lang) (M := A) (ordFstSym L B) w ↔
        ρ (Sum.inl ()) w := fun _ => Iff.rfl
  have hsnd : ∀ w : Fin 2 → A,
      RelMap (L := (L.sum B.withOrder.lang).sum B.withOrder.lang) (M := A) (ordSndSym L B) w ↔
        σ (Sum.inl ()) w := fun _ => Iff.rfl
  simp only [fixedOrdS, leFstF, leSndF, Sentence.Realize, Formula.realize_iAlls,
    Formula.realize_inf, Formula.realize_imp, Formula.realize_rel₂, Term.realize_var,
    Sum.elim_inr, hfst, hsnd]
  constructor
  · intro h w
    have hw := h w
    rw [vec_eta₂] at hw
    exact ⟨hw.1, hw.2⟩
  · intro h x
    exact ⟨(h _).mp, (h _).mpr⟩

/
`DescriptiveComplexity.orderElimLHom_isExpansionOn`: when the *current* state
assigns the linear order of the structure to the order variable, the two-copy
block expansion is an expansion along `DescriptiveComplexity.orderElimTwoLHom`
of the ordered one. -/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.orderElimTwoLHom_isExpansionOn
statement:
theorem orderElimTwoLHom_isExpansionOn (L : Language.{0, 0}) (B : SOBlock) (A : Type)
    (instA : L.Structure A) (lo : LinearOrder A) (ρ σ : B.withOrder.Assignment A)
    (hord : ∀ w : Fin 2 → A, ρ (Sum.inl ()) w ↔ w 0 ≤ w 1) :
    @LHom.IsExpansionOn _ _ (orderElimTwoLHom L B) A
      (@SOBlock.structure₂ (L.sum Language.order) B A
        (letI := instA; letI := lo; sumOrderStructure L A) (B.restPart ρ) (B.restPart σ))
      (@SOBlock.structure₂ L B.withOrder A instA ρ σ)
proof:
:= by
  let := instA
  let := lo
  let := @SOBlock.structure₂ (L.sum Language.order) B A (sumOrderStructure L A)
    (B.restPart ρ) (B.restPart σ)
  let := @SOBlock.structure₂ L B.withOrder A instA ρ σ
  refine ⟨fun {n} f x => ?_, fun {n} r x => ?_⟩
  · match f with
    | Sum.inl (Sum.inl (Sum.inl g)) => rfl
    | Sum.inl (Sum.inl (Sum.inr g)) => exact nomatch g
    | Sum.inl (Sum.inr g) => exact nomatch g
    | Sum.inr g => exact nomatch g
  · match n, r with
    | _, Sum.inl (Sum.inl (Sum.inl s)) => rfl
    | _, Sum.inl (Sum.inl (Sum.inr .le)) => exact propext (hord x)
    | _, Sum.inl (Sum.inr s) => rfl
    | _, Sum.inr s => rfl

name: DescriptiveComplexity.realize_orderElim_one
proof:
:= by
  let := @SOBlock.structure₁ (L.sum Language.order) B A (sumOrderStructure L A) (B.restPart ρ)
  let := @SOBlock.structure₁ L B.withOrder A instL ρ
  have : @LHom.IsExpansionOn _ _ (orderElimLHom L B) A
      (@SOBlock.structure₁ (L.sum Language.order) B A (sumOrderStructure L A) (B.restPart ρ))
      (@SOBlock.structure₁ L B.withOrder A instL ρ) :=
    orderElimLHom_isExpansionOn L B A instL lo ρ hord
  exact LHom.realize_onSentence (M := A) (orderElimLHom L B) φ

/
order is read in the copy holding the current state. -/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.realize_orderElim_two
proof:
:= by
  let := @SOBlock.structure₂ (L.sum Language.order) B A (sumOrderStructure L A)
    (B.restPart ρ) (B.restPart σ)
  let := @SOBlock.structure₂ L B.withOrder A instL ρ σ
  have : @LHom.IsExpansionOn _ _ (orderElimTwoLHom L B) A
      (@SOBlock.structure₂ (L.sum Language.order) B A (sumOrderStructure L A)
        (B.restPart ρ) (B.restPart σ))
      (@SOBlock.structure₂ L B.withOrder A instL ρ σ) :=
    orderElimTwoLHom_isExpansionOn L B A instL lo ρ σ hord
  exact LHom.realize_onSentence (M := A) (orderElimTwoLHom L B) φ

name: DescriptiveComplexity.realize_linearGuard_of_hord
proof:
:=
  (realize_linearGuard L spec.B instL ρ).mpr
    ⟨fun a => (hord_pair hord a a).mpr le_rfl,
      ⟨fun a b c hab hbc =>
          (hord_pair hord a c).mpr (le_trans ((hord_pair hord a b).mp hab)
            ((hord_pair hord b c).mp hbc)),
        ⟨fun a b hab hba =>
            le_antisymm ((hord_pair hord a b).mp hab) ((hord_pair hord b a).mp hba),
          fun a b => (le_total a b).imp (hord_pair hord a b).mpr (hord_pair hord b a).mpr⟩⟩⟩

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SOTCSpec.orderFree_isSrc_iff
statement:
theorem SOTCSpec.orderFree_isSrc_iff :
    spec.orderFree.IsSrc ρ ↔ spec.IsSrc (spec.B.restPart ρ)
proof:
:= by
  let := @SOBlock.structure₁ L spec.orderFree.B A instL ρ
  have hinf : spec.orderFree.IsSrc ρ ↔
      (@Sentence.Realize _ A (@SOBlock.structure₁ L spec.B.withOrder A instL ρ)
          (linearGuard L spec.B) ∧
        @Sentence.Realize _ A (@SOBlock.structure₁ L spec.B.withOrder A instL ρ)
          ((orderElimLHom L spec.B).onSentence spec.src)) := Formula.realize_inf
  rw [hinf]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨-, h⟩
    exact (realize_orderElim_one ρ hord spec.src).mp h
  · intro h
    exact ⟨realize_linearGuard_of_hord hord, (realize_orderElim_one ρ hord spec.src).mpr h⟩

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SOTCSpec.orderFree_isTgt_iff
statement:
theorem SOTCSpec.orderFree_isTgt_iff :
    spec.orderFree.IsTgt ρ ↔ spec.IsTgt (spec.B.restPart ρ)
proof:
:=
  realize_orderElim_one ρ hord spec.tgt

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SOTCSpec.orderFree_step_iff
statement:
theorem SOTCSpec.orderFree_step_iff :
    spec.orderFree.Step ρ σ ↔
      ((∀ w : Fin 2 → A, ρ (Sum.inl ()) w ↔ σ (Sum.inl ()) w) ∧
        spec.Step (spec.B.restPart ρ) (spec.B.restPart σ))
proof:
:= by
  let := @SOBlock.structure₂ L spec.orderFree.B A instL ρ σ
  have hinf : spec.orderFree.Step ρ σ ↔
      (@Sentence.Realize _ A (@SOBlock.structure₂ L spec.B.withOrder A instL ρ σ)
          (fixedOrdS L spec.B) ∧
        @Sentence.Realize _ A (@SOBlock.structure₂ L spec.B.withOrder A instL ρ σ)
          ((orderElimTwoLHom L spec.B).onSentence spec.step)) := Formula.realize_inf
  rw [hinf]
  exact and_congr (realize_fixedOrdS instL ρ σ) (realize_orderElim_two ρ σ hord spec.step)

/
state walks in the original specification. -/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SOTCSpec.orderFree_reach
statement:
theorem SOTCSpec.orderFree_reach (h : spec.orderFree.Reach ρ σ) :
    (∀ w : Fin 2 → A, ρ (Sum.inl ()) w ↔ σ (Sum.inl ()) w) ∧
      spec.Reach (spec.B.restPart ρ) (spec.B.restPart σ)
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact ⟨fun _ => Iff.rfl, Relation.ReflTransGen.refl⟩
  | @tail c d _ hcd ih =>
    obtain ⟨heq, hreach⟩ := ih
    have hordc : ∀ w : Fin 2 → A, c (Sum.inl ()) w ↔ w 0 ≤ w 1 :=
      fun w => (heq w).symm.trans (hord w)
    obtain ⟨heq', hstep⟩ := (SOTCSpec.orderFree_step_iff (spec := spec) hordc).mp hcd
    exact ⟨fun w => (heq w).trans (heq' w), hreach.tail hstep⟩

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SOTCSpec.orderFree_reach_of
statement:
theorem SOTCSpec.orderFree_reach_of [LinearOrder A] {ρ₁ σ₁ : spec.B.Assignment A}
    (h : spec.Reach ρ₁ σ₁) :
    spec.orderFree.Reach (spec.B.joinOrder (fun w => w 0 ≤ w 1) ρ₁)
      (spec.B.joinOrder (fun w => w 0 ≤ w 1) σ₁)
proof:
:= by
  have hord : ∀ (x : spec.B.Assignment A) (w : Fin 2 → A),
      spec.B.joinOrder (fun w : Fin 2 → A => w 0 ≤ w 1) x (Sum.inl ()) w ↔ w 0 ≤ w 1 :=
    fun _ _ => Iff.rfl
  induction h with
  | refl => exact Relation.ReflTransGen.refl
  | @tail c d _ hcd ih =>
    exact ih.tail ((SOTCSpec.orderFree_step_iff (spec := spec) (hord c)).mpr
      ⟨fun _ => Iff.rfl, hcd⟩)

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SOTCSpec.orderFree_accepts_iff
statement:
theorem SOTCSpec.orderFree_accepts_iff :
    spec.orderFree.Accepts A ↔ ∃ lo : LinearOrder A, @SOTCSpec.Accepts L spec A instL lo
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨ρ, σ, hsrc, htgt, hreach⟩
    let := @SOBlock.structure₁ L spec.orderFree.B A instL ρ
    have hinf : spec.orderFree.IsSrc ρ ↔
        (@Sentence.Realize _ A (@SOBlock.structure₁ L spec.B.withOrder A instL ρ)
            (linearGuard L spec.B) ∧
          @Sentence.Realize _ A (@SOBlock.structure₁ L spec.B.withOrder A instL ρ)
            ((orderElimLHom L spec.B).onSentence spec.src)) := Formula.realize_inf
    obtain ⟨hrefl, htrans, hantisymm, htotal⟩ :=
      (realize_linearGuard L spec.B instL ρ).mp (hinf.mp hsrc).1
    let lo : LinearOrder A :=
      linearOrderOfGuard (ρ (Sum.inl ())) hrefl htrans hantisymm htotal
    have hord : ∀ w : Fin 2 → A, ρ (Sum.inl ()) w ↔ w 0 ≤ w 1 := by
      intro w
      change ρ (Sum.inl ()) w ↔ ρ (Sum.inl ()) ![w 0, w 1]
      rw [vec_eta₂]
    obtain ⟨heq, hreach'⟩ := SOTCSpec.orderFree_reach (spec := spec) hord hreach
    have hordσ : ∀ w : Fin 2 → A, σ (Sum.inl ()) w ↔ w 0 ≤ w 1 :=
      fun w => (heq w).symm.trans (hord w)
    exact ⟨lo, spec.B.restPart ρ, spec.B.restPart σ,
      (SOTCSpec.orderFree_isSrc_iff (spec := spec) hord).mp hsrc,
      (SOTCSpec.orderFree_isTgt_iff (spec := spec) hordσ).mp htgt, hreach'⟩
  · rintro ⟨lo, ρ₁, σ₁, hsrc, htgt, hreach⟩
    let := lo
    have hord : ∀ w : Fin 2 → A,
        spec.B.joinOrder (fun w : Fin 2 → A => w 0 ≤ w 1) ρ₁ (Sum.inl ()) w ↔ w 0 ≤ w 1 :=
      fun _ => Iff.rfl
    have hordσ : ∀ w : Fin 2 → A,
        spec.B.joinOrder (fun w : Fin 2 → A => w 0 ≤ w 1) σ₁ (Sum.inl ()) w ↔ w 0 ≤ w 1 :=
      fun _ => Iff.rfl
    refine ⟨spec.B.joinOrder (fun w => w 0 ≤ w 1) ρ₁, spec.B.joinOrder (fun w => w 0 ≤ w 1) σ₁,
      (SOTCSpec.orderFree_isSrc_iff (spec := spec) hord).mpr ?_,
      (SOTCSpec.orderFree_isTgt_iff (spec := spec) hordσ).mpr ?_,
      SOTCSpec.orderFree_reach_of hreach⟩
    · exact hsrc
    · exact htgt

name: DescriptiveComplexity.sotcDefinable_iff_free
statement:
theorem sotcDefinable_iff_free [L.IsRelational] {P : DecisionProblem L} :
    SOTCDefinable P ↔ SOTCDefinableFree P
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨spec, hspec⟩
    refine ⟨spec.orderFree, fun A _ _ _ => ?_⟩
    rw [SOTCSpec.orderFree_accepts_iff]
    constructor
    · intro hP
      let := Fintype.ofFinite A
      let lo : LinearOrder A :=
        LinearOrder.lift' (Fintype.equivFin A) (Fintype.equivFin A).injective
      exact ⟨lo, (hspec A).mp hP⟩
    · rintro ⟨lo, h⟩
      let := lo
      exact (hspec A).mpr h
  · rintro ⟨spec, hspec⟩
    refine ⟨spec.toSpec, fun A _ _ _ _ => ?_⟩
    rw [SOTCSpecFree.accepts_toSpec_iff]
    exact hspec A

/
SO(TC) specification.
Registered in the Lax archive as
[`Lax134656.TransitiveClosureWithoutOrder.mem_PSPACE_iff_sotcDefinableFree`](https://laxarchive.org/lax-134656/Lax134656.TransitiveClosureWithoutOrder.html#s-Lax134656.TransitiveClosureWithoutOrder.mem_PSPACE_iff_sotcDefinableFree). -/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.mem_PSPACE_iff_sotcDefinableFree
statement:
theorem mem_PSPACE_iff_sotcDefinableFree [L.IsRelational] (P : DecisionProblem L) :
    P ∈ PSPACE ↔ SOTCDefinableFree P
proof:
:=
  (mem_PSPACE_iff P).trans sotcDefinable_iff_free

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SOTCSpec.comap_isSrc_iff
statement:
theorem SOTCSpec.comap_isSrc_iff (ρ : spec.B.Assignment (I.Map A)) :
    letI
proof:
:= I.mapLinearOrder A
    spec.IsSrc ρ ↔ (spec.comap I).IsSrc (spec.B.pullAssign ρ) := by
  let := I.mapLinearOrder A
  let := (spec.B.pull Tag d).structure₁ (L := L.sum Language.order) (spec.B.pullAssign ρ)
  exact Iff.symm (((I.ordExtendSO spec.B).realize_pullSentence spec.src A).trans
    ((realize_sentence_of_equiv (I.ordExtend.extendSOEquiv spec.B A ρ) spec.src).trans
      (realize_sentence_of_equiv (spec.B.extendEquiv (I.ordExtendLEquiv A) ρ) spec.src)))

/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SOTCSpec.comap_isTgt_iff
statement:
theorem SOTCSpec.comap_isTgt_iff (ρ : spec.B.Assignment (I.Map A)) :
    letI
proof:
:= I.mapLinearOrder A
    spec.IsTgt ρ ↔ (spec.comap I).IsTgt (spec.B.pullAssign ρ) := by
  let := I.mapLinearOrder A
  let := (spec.B.pull Tag d).structure₁ (L := L.sum Language.order) (spec.B.pullAssign ρ)
  exact Iff.symm (((I.ordExtendSO spec.B).realize_pullSentence spec.tgt A).trans
    ((realize_sentence_of_equiv (I.ordExtend.extendSOEquiv spec.B A ρ) spec.tgt).trans
      (realize_sentence_of_equiv (spec.B.extendEquiv (I.ordExtendLEquiv A) ρ) spec.tgt)))

/
structure is a step of the pullback on the base structure. -/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SOTCSpec.comap_step_iff
statement:
theorem SOTCSpec.comap_step_iff (ρ σ : spec.B.Assignment (I.Map A)) :
    letI
proof:
:= I.mapLinearOrder A
    spec.Step ρ σ ↔ (spec.comap I).Step (spec.B.pullAssign ρ) (spec.B.pullAssign σ) := by
  let := I.mapLinearOrder A
  let := (spec.B.pull Tag d).structure₁ (L := L.sum Language.order) (spec.B.pullAssign ρ)
  let := (spec.B.pull Tag d).structure₂ (L := L.sum Language.order) (spec.B.pullAssign ρ)
    (spec.B.pullAssign σ)
  exact Iff.symm ((((I.ordExtendSO spec.B).extendSO spec.B).realize_pullSentence
      spec.step A).trans
    ((realize_sentence_of_equiv
        ((I.ordExtendSO spec.B).extendSOEquiv spec.B A σ) spec.step).trans
      ((realize_sentence_of_equiv
          (spec.B.extendEquiv' (I.ordExtend.extendSOEquiv spec.B A ρ) σ) spec.step).trans
        (realize_sentence_of_equiv
          (spec.B.extendEquiv₂ (I.ordExtendLEquiv A) ρ σ) spec.step))))

/
specification accepts the interpreted one. -/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SOTCSpec.comap_accepts_iff
statement:
theorem SOTCSpec.comap_accepts_iff :
    letI
proof:
:= I.mapLinearOrder A
    spec.Accepts (I.Map A) ↔ (spec.comap I).Accepts A := by
  let := I.mapLinearOrder A
  exact SOTCSpec.accepts_congr (spec.B.pullAssignEquiv Tag d A) (spec.comap_step_iff I)
    (spec.comap_isSrc_iff I) (spec.comap_isTgt_iff I)

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SOTCDefinable.of_orderedReduction
statement:
theorem SOTCDefinable.of_orderedReduction (f : P ≤ᶠᵒ[≤] Q) (h : SOTCDefinable Q) :
    SOTCDefinable P
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨spec, hspec⟩ := h
  let := f.tagFinite
  let := f.tagNonempty
  let : LinearOrder f.Tag := finiteLinearOrder f.Tag
  refine ⟨spec.comap f.toInterpretation, ?_⟩
  intro A _ _ _ _
  let := f.toInterpretation.mapLinearOrder A
  have := f.toInterpretation.map_finite A
  have := f.toInterpretation.map_nonempty A
  exact (f.correct A).trans ((hspec (f.toInterpretation.Map A)).trans
    (spec.comap_accepts_iff f.toInterpretation))

/
Registered in the Lax archive as
[`Lax134656.PSPACEClosure.PSPACE_mem_of_foReduction`](https://laxarchive.org/lax-134656/Lax134656.PSPACEClosure.html#s-Lax134656.PSPACEClosure.PSPACE_mem_of_foReduction). -/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.SOTCDefinable.of_foReduction
statement:
theorem SOTCDefinable.of_foReduction (f : P ≤ᶠᵒ Q) (h : SOTCDefinable Q) :
    SOTCDefinable P
proof:
:=
  h.of_orderedReduction f.toOrdered

name: DescriptiveComplexity.FormulaSubst.realize_domGuard
statement:
theorem realize_domGuard {n : ℕ} (v : β → M) (xs : Fin (n + 1) → M) :
    (domGuard (β := β) D n).Realize v xs ↔ D.Realize ![xs (Fin.last n)]
proof:
:= by
  rw [domGuard, BoundedFormula.realize_relabel]
  refine iff_of_eq (congrArg₂ _ (funext fun i => ?_) (Subsingleton.elim _ _))
  rw [Subsingleton.elim i 0]
  rfl

/
definable part**: quantifiers range over the part, and atoms hold as their
formulas say. -/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.FormulaSubst.realize_substTo
proof:
:= by
  let := F.strucOn e
  induction φ with
  | falsum => exact Iff.rfl
  | equal t₁ t₂ =>
    change (Sum.elim (fun b => e (v b)) (fun i => e (xs i)) t₁.varOf =
        Sum.elim (fun b => e (v b)) (fun i => e (xs i)) t₂.varOf) ↔ _
    rw [elim_map, elim_map]
    change _ ↔ (t₁.realize (Sum.elim v xs) = t₂.realize (Sum.elim v xs))
    rw [Term.realize_varOf, Term.realize_varOf]
    exact ⟨fun h => hinj h, fun h => congrArg _ h⟩
  | rel r ts =>
    rw [substTo, BoundedFormula.realize_relabel]
    refine Iff.trans (iff_of_eq (congrArg₂ _ (funext fun i => ?_) (Subsingleton.elim _ _)))
      (Iff.rfl : @Formula.Realize _ M _ _ (F.rel r)
        (fun i => e ((ts i).realize (Sum.elim v xs))) ↔ _)
    change Sum.elim (fun b => e (v b)) (fun i => e (xs i)) (ts i).varOf = _
    rw [elim_map]
    exact congrArg e (Term.realize_varOf (ts i)).symm
  | imp _ _ ih₁ ih₂ =>
    rw [substTo]
    exact imp_congr (ih₁ xs) (ih₂ xs)
  | all _ ih =>
    rw [substTo]
    simp only [BoundedFormula.realize_all, BoundedFormula.realize_imp]
    have hsnoc : ∀ p : Pt, (Fin.snoc (fun i => e (xs i)) (e p) : Fin _ → M) =
        fun i => e ((Fin.snoc xs p : Fin _ → Pt) i) :=
      fun p => funext fun i => congrFun (Fin.comp_snoc e xs p).symm i
    constructor
    · intro h p
      have hg : (domGuard D _).Realize (fun b => e (v b))
          (Fin.snoc (fun i => e (xs i)) (e p)) := by
        rw [realize_domGuard, Fin.snoc_last]
        exact (hD _).mpr ⟨p, rfl⟩
      have hb := h (e p) hg
      rw [hsnoc p] at hb
      exact (ih (Fin.snoc xs p)).mp hb
    · intro h x hg
      rw [realize_domGuard, Fin.snoc_last] at hg
      obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := (hD x).mp hg
      have hb := (ih (Fin.snoc xs p)).mpr (h p)
      rw [← hsnoc p] at hb
      exact hb

/
`DescriptiveComplexity.FormulaSubst.realize_substTo`. -/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.FormulaSubst.realize_substSentence
statement:
theorem realize_substSentence [L₁.IsRelational] (hinj : Function.Injective e)
    (hD : ∀ x : M, D.Realize ![x] ↔ ∃ p : Pt, e p = x) (φ : L₁.Sentence) :
    (M ⊨ substSentence F D φ) ↔ @Sentence.Realize _ Pt (F.strucOn e) φ
proof:
:= by
  have h := realize_substTo (F := F) (D := D) (e := e) hinj hD (β := Empty) φ default default
  refine Iff.trans (iff_of_eq (congrArg₂
    (fun (u : Empty → M) (ys : Fin 0 → M) =>
      @BoundedFormula.Realize _ M _ _ 0 (substTo F D φ) u ys)
    (funext fun x => x.elim) (Subsingleton.elim _ _))) h

name: DescriptiveComplexity.TCSpec.step_equiv
statement:
theorem step_equiv (e : A ≃[L.sum Language.order] B) (a b : spec.Node A) :
    spec.Step (spec.mapNode e a) (spec.mapNode e b) ↔ spec.Step a b
proof:
:= by
  rw [Step, Step, mapNode, mapNode, ← StrongHomClass.realize_formula
    (φ := spec.step a.1 b.1) e]
  refine iff_of_eq (congrArg (spec.step a.1 b.1).Realize (funext fun i => ?_))
  cases i <;> rfl

/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.TCSpec.reach_equiv
statement:
theorem reach_equiv (e : A ≃[L.sum Language.order] B) {a b : spec.Node A}
    (h : spec.Reach a b) : spec.Reach (spec.mapNode e a) (spec.mapNode e b)
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact Relation.ReflTransGen.refl
  | @tail c d _ hcd ih => exact ih.tail ((spec.step_equiv e c d).mpr hcd)

name: DescriptiveComplexity.TCSpec.accepts_equiv
statement: theorem accepts_equiv (e : A ≃[L.sum Language.order] B) : spec.Accepts A ↔ spec.Accepts B
proof:
:=
  ⟨spec.accepts_of_equiv e, spec.accepts_of_equiv e.symm⟩

name: DescriptiveComplexity.tcDefinable_congr
proof:
:= by
  constructor <;> rintro ⟨spec, hspec⟩ <;> refine ⟨spec, ?_⟩ <;> intro A _ _ _ _
  · exact (h A).symm.trans (hspec A)
  · exact (h A).trans (hspec A)

name: DescriptiveComplexity.TCSpec.pad_accepts_iff
statement: theorem pad_accepts_iff : (spec.pad).Accepts A ↔ spec.Accepts A
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨u, v, hu, hv, huv⟩
    obtain ⟨p, x⟩ := u
    cases p with
    | none => exact absurd hu (by exact fun h => h)
    | some m =>
      obtain ⟨v', rfl, hreach⟩ := spec.reach_of_pad_reach (a := (m, x)) huv
      exact ⟨(m, x), v', hu, hv, hreach⟩
  · rintro ⟨u, v, hu, hv, huv⟩
    exact ⟨spec.padNode u, spec.padNode v, hu, hv, spec.pad_reach_of_reach huv⟩

name: DescriptiveComplexity.TCCompl.toNode_ofNode
statement: @[simp] theorem toNode_ofNode (n : spec.Node A) : toNode (ofNode n) = n
proof: := rfl

name: DescriptiveComplexity.TCCompl.ofNode_toNode
statement: @[simp] theorem ofNode_toNode (z : NodeOrd spec A) : ofNode (toNode z) = z
proof:
:= rfl

/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.TCCompl.reach_of_edge
statement:
theorem reach_of_edge {z z' : NodeOrd spec A} (h : Relation.ReflTransGen edge z z') :
    spec.Reach (toNode z) (toNode z')
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact Relation.ReflTransGen.refl
  | @tail b c _ hbc ih => exact ih.tail hbc

name: DescriptiveComplexity.TCCompl.edge_of_reach
statement:
theorem edge_of_reach {u v : spec.Node A} (h : spec.Reach u v) :
    Relation.ReflTransGen (edge (spec := spec)) (ofNode u) (ofNode v)
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact Relation.ReflTransGen.refl
  | @tail b c _ hbc ih => exact ih.tail hbc

name: DescriptiveComplexity.TCCompl.exists_reach_iff
statement:
theorem exists_reach_iff :
    (∃ a b : NodeOrd spec A, src a ∧ tgt b ∧ Relation.ReflTransGen edge a b) ↔
      spec.Accepts A
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab⟩
    exact ⟨toNode a, toNode b, ha, hb, reach_of_edge hab⟩
  · rintro ⟨u, v, hu, hv, huv⟩
    exact ⟨ofNode u, ofNode v, hu, hv, edge_of_reach huv⟩

/-! ### Registers inside one tuple -/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.TCCompl.regTup_mkTup
statement:
@[simp] theorem regTup_mkTup (f : Reg → Fin spec.k → A) (r : Reg) :
    regTup (mkTup spec f) r = f r
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  simp [regTup, mkTup, regIdx]

/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.TCCompl.realize_slotSel
statement:
theorem realize_slotSel (x y : Fin (dim spec) → A) (a : Slot) (i : Fin spec.k) :
    Sum.elim x y (slotSel spec a i) = slotTup x y a i
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, r⟩ := a
  cases s <;> rfl

/-! ### The formulas of the atomic constraints -/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.TCCompl.realize_eqTupF
statement:
theorem realize_eqTupF (x y : Fin (dim spec) → A) (a b : Slot) :
    (eqTupF spec a b).Realize (Sum.elim x y) ↔ slotTup x y a = slotTup x y b
proof:
:= by
  rw [eqTupF, realize_listInf]
  constructor
  · intro h
    funext i
    have hi := h _ (List.mem_map.mpr ⟨i, List.mem_finRange i, rfl⟩)
    rw [Formula.realize_equal, Term.realize_var, Term.realize_var, realize_slotSel,
      realize_slotSel] at hi
    exact hi
  · rintro h φ hφ
    obtain ⟨i, -, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hφ
    rw [Formula.realize_equal, Term.realize_var, Term.realize_var, realize_slotSel,
      realize_slotSel, h]

name: DescriptiveComplexity.TCCompl.realize_stepF
statement:
theorem realize_stepF (x y : Fin (dim spec) → A) (m m' : spec.Mode) (a b : Slot) :
    (stepF spec m m' a b).Realize (Sum.elim x y) ↔
      spec.Step ((m, slotTup x y a) : spec.Node A) (m', slotTup x y b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [stepF, Formula.realize_relabel]
  refine iff_of_eq (congrArg (spec.step m m').Realize (funext fun j => ?_))
  cases j with
  | inl i => exact realize_slotSel x y a i
  | inr i => exact realize_slotSel x y b i

name: DescriptiveComplexity.TCCompl.realize_srcF
statement:
theorem realize_srcF (x y : Fin (dim spec) → A) (m : spec.Mode) (a : Slot) :
    (srcF spec m a).Realize (Sum.elim x y) ↔ spec.IsSrc ((m, slotTup x y a) : spec.Node A)
proof:
:= by
  rw [srcF, Formula.realize_relabel]
  exact iff_of_eq (congrArg (spec.src m).Realize (funext fun i => realize_slotSel x y a i))

name: DescriptiveComplexity.TCCompl.realize_tgtF
statement:
theorem realize_tgtF (x y : Fin (dim spec) → A) (m : spec.Mode) (a : Slot) :
    (tgtF spec m a).Realize (Sum.elim x y) ↔ spec.IsTgt ((m, slotTup x y a) : spec.Node A)
proof:
:= by
  rw [tgtF, Formula.realize_relabel]
  exact iff_of_eq (congrArg (spec.tgt m).Realize (funext fun i => realize_slotSel x y a i))

name: DescriptiveComplexity.TCCompl.realize_minTup
statement:
theorem realize_minTup (x y : Fin (dim spec) → A) (a : Slot) :
    (minTupF (L := L) (slotSel spec a)).Realize (Sum.elim x y) ↔
      ∀ (p : Fin spec.k) (z : A), slotTup x y a p ≤ z
proof:
:= by
  rw [realize_minTupF]
  exact forall_congr' fun p => by rw [realize_slotSel]

name: DescriptiveComplexity.TCCompl.realize_maxTup
statement:
theorem realize_maxTup (x y : Fin (dim spec) → A) (a : Slot) :
    (maxTupF (L := L) (slotSel spec a)).Realize (Sum.elim x y) ↔
      ∀ (p : Fin spec.k) (z : A), z ≤ slotTup x y a p
proof:
:= by
  rw [realize_maxTupF]
  exact forall_congr' fun p => by rw [realize_slotSel]

name: DescriptiveComplexity.TCCompl.realize_succTup
statement:
theorem realize_succTup (x y : Fin (dim spec) → A) (a b : Slot) :
    (succTupF (L := L) (slotSel spec a) (slotSel spec b)).Realize (Sum.elim x y) ↔
      TupSucc (slotTup x y a) (slotTup x y b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [realize_succTupF]
  have h1 : Sum.elim x y ∘ slotSel spec a = slotTup x y a := funext (realize_slotSel x y a)
  have h2 : Sum.elim x y ∘ slotSel spec b = slotTup x y b := funext (realize_slotSel x y b)
  rw [h1, h2]

name: DescriptiveComplexity.TCCompl.fuse_none
statement: theorem fuse_none (t : Fin spec.k → A) : fuse spec none t = ⊥
proof: := rfl

name: DescriptiveComplexity.TCCompl.fuse_some
statement:
theorem fuse_some (m : spec.Mode) (t : Fin spec.k → A) :
    fuse spec (some m) t = ↑(ofNode ((m, t) : spec.Node A))
proof: := rfl

name: DescriptiveComplexity.TCCompl.fuse_eq_iff
statement:
theorem fuse_eq_iff {m m' : spec.Mode} {t t' : Fin spec.k → A} :
    fuse spec (some m) t = fuse spec (some m') t' ↔ m = m' ∧ t = t'
proof:
:= by
  rw [fuse_some, fuse_some, WithBot.coe_inj]
  constructor
  · intro h
    have h' : ((m, t) : spec.Node A) = (m', t') := congrArg toNode h
    exact ⟨congrArg Prod.fst h', congrArg Prod.snd h'⟩
  · rintro ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    rfl

name: DescriptiveComplexity.TCCompl.fuse_ne_bot
statement: theorem fuse_ne_bot {m : spec.Mode} {t : Fin spec.k → A} : fuse spec (some m) t ≠ ⊥
proof:
:= by
  rw [fuse_some]
  exact WithBot.coe_ne_bot

name: DescriptiveComplexity.TCCompl.covBy_fuse
statement:
theorem covBy_fuse [Nonempty A] {m m' : spec.Mode} {t t' : Fin spec.k → A} :
    fuse spec (some m) t ⋖ fuse spec (some m') t' ↔
      (m = m' ∧ TupSucc t t') ∨
        (m ⋖ m' ∧ (∀ (p : Fin spec.k) (z : A), z ≤ t p) ∧
          ∀ (p : Fin spec.k) (z : A), t' p ≤ z)
proof:
:= by
  rw [fuse_some, fuse_some, WithBot.coe_covBy_coe]
  have h : (ofNode ((m, t) : spec.Node A) ⋖ ofNode ((m', t') : spec.Node A)) ↔
      (toLex (m, toLex t) ⋖ toLex (m', toLex t')) := Iff.rfl
  rw [h, prodLex_covBy_iff]
  exact or_congr (and_congr_right fun _ => tupSucc_iff_covBy.symm)
    (and_congr_right fun _ => and_congr tup_isTop_iff tup_isBot_iff)

name: DescriptiveComplexity.TCCompl.bot_covBy_fuse
statement:
theorem bot_covBy_fuse {m : spec.Mode} {t : Fin spec.k → A} :
    (⊥ : WithBot (NodeOrd spec A)) ⋖ fuse spec (some m) t ↔
      (∀ m' : spec.Mode, m ≤ m') ∧ ∀ (p : Fin spec.k) (z : A), t p ≤ z
proof:
:= by
  rw [fuse_some, WithBot.bot_covBy_coe]
  constructor
  · intro h
    have h' : ∀ u : NodeOrd spec A, ofNode ((m, t) : spec.Node A) ≤ u := fun u =>
      (le_total u (ofNode ((m, t) : spec.Node A))).elim (fun hu => h hu) id
    have := prodLex_isBot_iff.mp h'
    exact ⟨this.1, tup_isBot_iff.mp this.2⟩
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
    have h' : ∀ u : NodeOrd spec A, ofNode ((m, t) : spec.Node A) ≤ u :=
      prodLex_isBot_iff.mpr ⟨h1, tup_isBot_iff.mpr h2⟩
    exact fun u _ => h' u

name: DescriptiveComplexity.TCCompl.eW_fuse
statement:
theorem eW_fuse {m m' : spec.Mode} {t t' : Fin spec.k → A} :
    EW (edge (spec := spec)) (fuse spec (some m) t) (fuse spec (some m') t') ↔
      spec.Step ((m, t) : spec.Node A) (m', t')
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨p, q, hp, hq, hpq⟩
    rw [fuse_some, WithBot.coe_inj] at hp hq
    subst hp; subst hq
    exact hpq
  · intro h
    exact ⟨_, _, rfl, rfl, h⟩

name: DescriptiveComplexity.TCCompl.eW_fuse_none_left
statement:
theorem eW_fuse_none_left {om : Option spec.Mode} {t t' : Fin spec.k → A} :
    ¬EW (edge (spec := spec)) (fuse spec none t) (fuse spec om t')
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨p, q, hp, -, -⟩
  exact absurd hp.symm (WithBot.coe_ne_bot)

name: DescriptiveComplexity.TCCompl.eW_fuse_none_right
statement:
theorem eW_fuse_none_right {om : Option spec.Mode} {t t' : Fin spec.k → A} :
    ¬EW (edge (spec := spec)) (fuse spec om t) (fuse spec none t')
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨p, q, -, hq, -⟩
  exact absurd hq.symm (WithBot.coe_ne_bot)

name: DescriptiveComplexity.TCCompl.pW_fuse
statement:
theorem pW_fuse {P : NodeOrd spec A → Prop} {m : spec.Mode} {t : Fin spec.k → A} :
    PW P (fuse spec (some m) t) ↔ P (ofNode ((m, t) : spec.Node A))
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨p, hp, h⟩
    rw [fuse_some, WithBot.coe_inj] at hp
    exact hp ▸ h
  · intro h
    exact ⟨_, rfl, h⟩

name: DescriptiveComplexity.TCCompl.pW_fuse_none
statement:
theorem pW_fuse_none {P : NodeOrd spec A → Prop} {t : Fin spec.k → A} :
    ¬PW P (fuse spec none t)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨p, hp, -⟩
  exact absurd hp.symm (WithBot.coe_ne_bot)

name: DescriptiveComplexity.TCCompl.pW_fuse_isMin
statement:
theorem pW_fuse_isMin {m : spec.Mode} {t : Fin spec.k → A} :
    PW (fun p : NodeOrd spec A => ∀ z : NodeOrd spec A, p ≤ z) (fuse spec (some m) t) ↔
      (∀ m' : spec.Mode, m ≤ m') ∧ ∀ (p : Fin spec.k) (z : A), t p ≤ z
proof:
:= by
  rw [pW_fuse]
  constructor
  · intro h
    have := prodLex_isBot_iff.mp h
    exact ⟨this.1, tup_isBot_iff.mp this.2⟩
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
    exact prodLex_isBot_iff.mpr ⟨h1, tup_isBot_iff.mpr h2⟩

name: DescriptiveComplexity.TCCompl.pW_fuse_isMax
statement:
theorem pW_fuse_isMax {m : spec.Mode} {t : Fin spec.k → A} :
    PW (fun p : NodeOrd spec A => ∀ z : NodeOrd spec A, z ≤ p) (fuse spec (some m) t) ↔
      (∀ m' : spec.Mode, m' ≤ m) ∧ ∀ (p : Fin spec.k) (z : A), z ≤ t p
proof:
:= by
  rw [pW_fuse]
  constructor
  · intro h
    have := prodLex_isTop_iff.mp h
    exact ⟨this.1, tup_isTop_iff.mp this.2⟩
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
    exact prodLex_isTop_iff.mpr ⟨h1, tup_isTop_iff.mpr h2⟩

name: DescriptiveComplexity.TCCompl.slotVal_regsOf
statement:
theorem slotVal_regsOf (pm qm : Reg → Option spec.Mode) (x y : Fin (dim spec) → A) (a : Slot) :
    slotVal (regsOf pm x) (regsOf qm y) a = fuse spec (slotMode spec pm qm a) (slotTup x y a)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, r⟩ := a
  cases s <;> rfl

name: DescriptiveComplexity.TCCompl.holds_iff_compileAtom
statement:
theorem holds_iff_compileAtom [Nonempty A] (pm qm : Reg → Option spec.Mode)
    (x y : Fin (dim spec) → A) (a : VAtom) :
    VAtom.Holds (edge (spec := spec)) src tgt (regsOf pm x) (regsOf qm y) a ↔
      ∃ f, compileAtom spec pm qm a = some f ∧ f.Realize (Sum.elim x y)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  cases a with
  | eqR a b =>
    simp only [VAtom.Holds, slotVal_regsOf, compileAtom]
    cases hma : slotMode spec pm qm a <;> cases hmb : slotMode spec pm qm b
    · refine iff_some ?_
      simp [fuse_none]
    · refine iff_none ?_
      simp [fuse_none, fuse_some]
    · refine iff_none ?_
      simp [fuse_none, fuse_some]
    · rename_i m m'
      dsimp only
      split_ifs with hmm
      · refine iff_some ?_
        rw [fuse_eq_iff, realize_eqTupF]; simp [hmm]
      · simp only [false_and, exists_false, iff_false]
        rw [fuse_eq_iff]; tauto
  | neqR a b =>
    simp only [VAtom.Holds, slotVal_regsOf, compileAtom]
    cases hma : slotMode spec pm qm a <;> cases hmb : slotMode spec pm qm b
    · refine iff_none ?_
      simp [fuse_none]
    · refine iff_some ?_
      simp [fuse_none, fuse_some]
    · refine iff_some ?_
      simp [fuse_none, fuse_some]
    · rename_i m m'
      dsimp only
      split_ifs with hmm
      · refine iff_some ?_
        rw [ne_eq, Formula.realize_not, fuse_eq_iff, realize_eqTupF]; simp [hmm]
      · refine iff_some ?_
        rw [ne_eq, Formula.realize_top, fuse_eq_iff]; tauto
  | succR a b =>
    simp only [VAtom.Holds, slotVal_regsOf, compileAtom]
    cases hma : slotMode spec pm qm a <;> cases hmb : slotMode spec pm qm b
    · refine iff_none ?_
      rw [fuse_none]; exact fun h => absurd h.lt (lt_irrefl _)
    · rename_i m'
      dsimp only
      split_ifs with h
      · refine iff_some ?_
        rw [fuse_none, bot_covBy_fuse, realize_minTup]; simp [h]
      · simp only [false_and, exists_false, iff_false]
        rw [fuse_none, bot_covBy_fuse]
        tauto
    · refine iff_none ?_
      exact fun h => absurd h.lt not_lt_bot
    · rename_i m m'
      dsimp only
      split_ifs with hmm hcov
      · refine iff_some ?_
        rw [covBy_fuse, realize_succTup]
        exact ⟨fun hh => hh.elim (fun h1 => h1.2) (fun h1 => absurd (hmm ▸ h1.1).lt (lt_irrefl _)),
          fun hh => Or.inl ⟨hmm, hh⟩⟩
      · refine iff_some ?_
        rw [covBy_fuse, Formula.realize_inf, realize_maxTup, realize_minTup]
        exact ⟨fun hh => hh.elim (fun h1 => absurd h1.1 hmm) (fun h1 => ⟨h1.2.1, h1.2.2⟩),
          fun hh => Or.inr ⟨hcov, hh.1, hh.2⟩⟩
      · simp only [false_and, exists_false, iff_false]
        rw [covBy_fuse]
        rintro (h1 | h1)
        · exact hmm h1.1
        · exact hcov h1.1
  | edge a b =>
    simp only [VAtom.Holds, slotVal_regsOf, compileAtom]
    cases hma : slotMode spec pm qm a <;> cases hmb : slotMode spec pm qm b
    · exact iff_none eW_fuse_none_left
    · exact iff_none eW_fuse_none_left
    · exact iff_none eW_fuse_none_right
    · refine iff_some ?_
      rw [eW_fuse, realize_stepF]
  | nedge a b =>
    simp only [VAtom.Holds, slotVal_regsOf, compileAtom]
    cases hma : slotMode spec pm qm a <;> cases hmb : slotMode spec pm qm b
    · refine iff_some ?_
      rw [Formula.realize_top]
      exact ⟨fun _ => trivial, fun _ => eW_fuse_none_left⟩
    · refine iff_some ?_
      rw [Formula.realize_top]
      exact ⟨fun _ => trivial, fun _ => eW_fuse_none_left⟩
    · refine iff_some ?_
      rw [Formula.realize_top]
      exact ⟨fun _ => trivial, fun _ => eW_fuse_none_right⟩
    · refine iff_some ?_
      rw [Formula.realize_not, eW_fuse, realize_stepF]
  | srcR a =>
    simp only [VAtom.Holds, slotVal_regsOf, compileAtom]
    cases hma : slotMode spec pm qm a
    · exact iff_none pW_fuse_none
    · refine iff_some ?_
      rw [pW_fuse, realize_srcF]; exact Iff.rfl
  | nsrcR a =>
    simp only [VAtom.Holds, slotVal_regsOf, compileAtom]
    cases hma : slotMode spec pm qm a
    · refine iff_some ?_
      rw [Formula.realize_top]
      exact ⟨fun _ => trivial, fun _ => pW_fuse_none⟩
    · refine iff_some ?_
      rw [Formula.realize_not, pW_fuse, realize_srcF]; exact Iff.rfl
  | tgtR a =>
    simp only [VAtom.Holds, slotVal_regsOf, compileAtom]
    cases hma : slotMode spec pm qm a
    · exact iff_none pW_fuse_none
    · refine iff_some ?_
      rw [pW_fuse, realize_tgtF]; exact Iff.rfl
  | ntgtR a =>
    simp only [VAtom.Holds, slotVal_regsOf, compileAtom]
    cases hma : slotMode spec pm qm a
    · refine iff_some ?_
      rw [Formula.realize_top]
      exact ⟨fun _ => trivial, fun _ => pW_fuse_none⟩
    · refine iff_some ?_
      rw [Formula.realize_not, pW_fuse, realize_tgtF]; exact Iff.rfl
  | botNode a =>
    simp only [VAtom.Holds, slotVal_regsOf, compileAtom]
    cases hma : slotMode spec pm qm a
    · exact iff_none pW_fuse_none
    · rename_i m
      dsimp only
      split_ifs with h
      · refine iff_some ?_
        rw [pW_fuse_isMin, realize_minTup]; simp [h]
      · simp only [false_and, exists_false, iff_false]
        rw [pW_fuse_isMin]; tauto
  | topNode a =>
    simp only [VAtom.Holds, slotVal_regsOf, compileAtom]
    cases hma : slotMode spec pm qm a
    · exact iff_none pW_fuse_none
    · rename_i m
      dsimp only
      split_ifs with h
      · refine iff_some ?_
        rw [pW_fuse_isMax, realize_maxTup]; simp [h]
      · simp only [false_and, exists_false, iff_false]
        rw [pW_fuse_isMax]; tauto
  | isZero a =>
    simp only [VAtom.Holds, slotVal_regsOf, compileAtom]
    cases hma : slotMode spec pm qm a
    · refine iff_some ?_
      rw [fuse_none, Formula.realize_top]
      exact ⟨fun _ => trivial, fun _ => rfl⟩
    · refine iff_none ?_
      rw [fuse_some]; exact WithBot.coe_ne_bot

name: DescriptiveComplexity.TCCompl.sat_iff_compileConj
statement:
theorem sat_iff_compileConj (pm qm : Reg → Option spec.Mode) (x y : Fin (dim spec) → A)
    (l : List VAtom) :
    Sat (edge (spec := spec)) src tgt (regsOf pm x) (regsOf qm y) l ↔
      ∃ f, compileConj spec pm qm l = some f ∧ f.Realize (Sum.elim x y)
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil =>
    simp only [compileConj, Option.some.injEq, exists_eq_left', Formula.realize_top]
    exact ⟨fun _ => trivial, fun _ => sat_nil _ _ _ _ _⟩
  | cons a l ih =>
    rw [sat_cons, ih, holds_iff_compileAtom]
    cases hA : compileAtom spec pm qm a <;> cases hB : compileConj spec pm qm l <;>
      simp [compileConj, hA, hB, Formula.realize_inf]

name: DescriptiveComplexity.TCCompl.exists_sat_iff_compileDisj
statement:
theorem exists_sat_iff_compileDisj (pm qm : Reg → Option spec.Mode)
    (x y : Fin (dim spec) → A) (ls : List (List VAtom)) :
    (∃ l ∈ ls, Sat (edge (spec := spec)) src tgt (regsOf pm x) (regsOf qm y) l) ↔
      (compileDisj spec pm qm ls).Realize (Sum.elim x y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [compileDisj, realize_listSup]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨l, hl, hsat⟩
    obtain ⟨f, hf, hr⟩ := (sat_iff_compileConj pm qm x y l).mp hsat
    exact ⟨f, List.mem_filterMap.mpr ⟨l, hl, hf⟩, hr⟩
  · rintro ⟨f, hf, hr⟩
    obtain ⟨l, hl, hfl⟩ := List.mem_filterMap.mp hf
    exact ⟨l, hl, (sat_iff_compileConj pm qm x y l).mpr ⟨f, hfl, hr⟩⟩

name: DescriptiveComplexity.TCCompl.fuse_split
statement:
theorem fuse_split (w : WithBot (NodeOrd spec A)) :
    fuse spec (splitMode w) (splitTup w) = w
proof:
:= by
  cases w with
  | bot => rfl
  | coe z => rfl

/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.TCCompl.toCfg_ofCfg
statement: theorem toCfg_ofCfg (s : Cfg (NodeOrd spec A)) : toCfg (ofCfg s) = s
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ph, fl, regs⟩ := s
  refine congrArg (Cfg.mk ph fl) (funext fun r => ?_)
  change fuse spec (splitMode (regs r)) (regTup (mkTup spec fun r => splitTup (regs r)) r)
    = regs r
  rw [regTup_mkTup, fuse_split]

name: DescriptiveComplexity.TCCompl.step_iff
statement:
theorem step_iff (n n' : (complSpec spec).Node A) :
    (complSpec spec).Step n n' ↔ CfgStep (edge (spec := spec)) src tgt (toCfg n) (toCfg n')
proof:
:=
  (exists_sat_iff_compileDisj n.1.2.2 n'.1.2.2 n.2 n'.2 _).symm

name: DescriptiveComplexity.TCCompl.cfgReach_of_reach
statement:
theorem cfgReach_of_reach {n n' : (complSpec spec).Node A} (h : (complSpec spec).Reach n n') :
    CfgReach (edge (spec := spec)) src tgt (toCfg n) (toCfg n')
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact Relation.ReflTransGen.refl
  | @tail b c _ hbc ih => exact ih.tail ((step_iff b c).mp hbc)

name: DescriptiveComplexity.TCCompl.reach_of_cfgReach
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact ⟨n, rfl, Relation.ReflTransGen.refl⟩
  | @tail b c _ hbc ih =>
    obtain ⟨n1, hn1, hreach⟩ := ih
    refine ⟨ofCfg c, toCfg_ofCfg c, hreach.tail ?_⟩
    rw [step_iff, hn1, toCfg_ofCfg]
    exact hbc

name: DescriptiveComplexity.TCCompl.realize_srcFormula
statement:
theorem realize_srcFormula (p : Ctrl spec) (x : Fin (dim spec) → A) :
    (srcFormula spec p).Realize x ↔ p.1 = Phase.initCount ∧ p.2.1 = false ∧
      p.2.2 Reg.c = none ∧ ∃ m : spec.Mode, p.2.2 Reg.v = some m ∧ (∀ m' : spec.Mode, m ≤ m') ∧
        ∀ (i : Fin spec.k) (z : A), x (regIdx spec Reg.v i) ≤ z
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [srcFormula]
  split_ifs with h
  · obtain ⟨hph, hfl, hc, m, hm, hmin⟩ := h
    rw [realize_minTupF]
    exact ⟨fun hx => ⟨hph, hfl, hc, m, hm, hmin, hx⟩, fun hx => hx.2.2.2.choose_spec.2.2⟩
  · rw [Formula.realize_bot]
    refine ⟨False.elim, fun hx => absurd ?_ h⟩
    obtain ⟨hph, hfl, hc, m, hm, hmin, -⟩ := hx
    exact ⟨hph, hfl, hc, m, hm, hmin⟩

name: DescriptiveComplexity.TCCompl.isSrc_iff
statement:
theorem isSrc_iff (n : (complSpec spec).Node A) :
    (complSpec spec).IsSrc n ↔ CfgIsSrc (toCfg n)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine Iff.trans (realize_srcFormula n.1 n.2) ?_
  have hv : (toCfg n).regs Reg.v = fuse spec (n.1.2.2 Reg.v) (regTup n.2 Reg.v) := rfl
  have hc : (toCfg n).regs Reg.c = fuse spec (n.1.2.2 Reg.c) (regTup n.2 Reg.c) := rfl
  simp only [CfgIsSrc, hv, hc]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hph, hfl, hcnone, m, hm, hmin, hx⟩
    refine ⟨hph, hfl, by rw [hcnone, fuse_none], ?_⟩
    rw [hm, pW_fuse_isMin]
    exact ⟨hmin, fun i z => hx i z⟩
  · rintro ⟨hph, hfl, hcbot, hvmin⟩
    refine ⟨hph, hfl, ?_, ?_⟩
    · cases hm : n.1.2.2 Reg.c with
      | none => rfl
      | some m =>
        rw [hm] at hcbot
        exact absurd hcbot fuse_ne_bot
    · cases hm : n.1.2.2 Reg.v with
      | none =>
        rw [hm] at hvmin
        exact absurd hvmin pW_fuse_none
      | some m =>
        rw [hm, pW_fuse_isMin] at hvmin
        exact ⟨m, rfl, hvmin.1, fun i z => hvmin.2 i z⟩

name: DescriptiveComplexity.TCCompl.realize_tgtFormula
statement:
theorem realize_tgtFormula (p : Ctrl spec) (x : Fin (dim spec) → A) :
    ((complSpec spec).tgt p).Realize x ↔ p.1 = Phase.accept
proof:
:= by
  classical
  change (if p.1 = Phase.accept then (⊤ : (L.sum Language.order).Formula (Fin (dim spec)))
    else ⊥).Realize x ↔ _
  split_ifs with h
  · simp only [Formula.realize_top]
    exact ⟨fun _ => h, fun _ => trivial⟩
  · simp only [Formula.realize_bot]
    exact ⟨False.elim, fun hh => absurd hh h⟩

name: DescriptiveComplexity.TCCompl.isTgt_iff
statement:
theorem isTgt_iff (n : (complSpec spec).Node A) :
    (complSpec spec).IsTgt n ↔ CfgIsTgt (toCfg n)
proof:
:=
  realize_tgtFormula n.1 n.2

name: DescriptiveComplexity.TCCompl.accepts_iff
statement:
theorem accepts_iff :
    (complSpec spec).Accepts A ↔
      MachineAccepts (edge (spec := spec) (A := A)) (src (spec := spec) (A := A))
        (tgt (spec := spec) (A := A))
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨u, v, hu, hv, huv⟩
    exact ⟨toCfg u, toCfg v, (isSrc_iff u).mp hu, (isTgt_iff v).mp hv, cfgReach_of_reach huv⟩
  · rintro ⟨s, s', hs, hs', hss'⟩
    obtain ⟨n', hn', hreach⟩ :=
      reach_of_cfgReach (n := ofCfg s) (s := s') (by rw [toCfg_ofCfg]; exact hss')
    exact ⟨ofCfg s, n', (isSrc_iff _).mpr (by rw [toCfg_ofCfg]; exact hs),
      (isTgt_iff _).mpr (by rw [hn']; exact hs'), hreach⟩

/
structures the given specification rejects. -/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.TCCompl.complSpec_accepts_iff
statement:
theorem complSpec_accepts_iff [Nonempty spec.Mode] [Finite A] :
    (complSpec spec).Accepts A ↔ ¬spec.Accepts A
proof:
:= by
  rw [accepts_iff, machineAccepts_iff, exists_reach_iff]

name: DescriptiveComplexity.realize_copyF
statement:
@[simp]
theorem realize_copyF (sel sel' : ι → γ) :
    (copyF (L := L) sel sel').Realize v ↔ v ∘ sel' = v ∘ sel
proof:
:= by
  rw [copyF, Formula.realize_iInf]
  simp only [Formula.realize_equal, Term.realize_var]
  exact ⟨fun h => funext fun i => (h i).symm, fun h i => (congrFun h i).symm⟩

name: DescriptiveComplexity.reach_invariant
statement:
theorem reach_invariant {P : N → Prop} (hP : ∀ a b, P a → R a b → P b) {a b : N}
    (h : Relation.ReflTransGen R a b) (ha : P a) : P b
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact ha
  | tail _ hcd ih => exact hP _ _ ih hcd

name: DescriptiveComplexity.Decider.Decides.congr
statement:
theorem Decides.congr {v : β → A} {P Q : Prop} (h : D.Decides v P) (hPQ : P ↔ Q) :
    D.Decides v Q
proof:
:=
  fun t => ⟨((h t).1).trans hPQ, ((h t).2).trans (not_congr hPQ)⟩

name: DescriptiveComplexity.Decider.Decides.congr_val
statement:
theorem Decides.congr_val {v w : β → A} {P : Prop} (h : D.Decides v P) (hvw : v = w) :
    D.Decides w P
proof:
:=
  hvw ▸ h

name: DescriptiveComplexity.Decider.Functional.step_unique
statement:
theorem Functional.step_unique (h : D.Functional A) {v : β → A} {a b c : D.Node A}
    (hb : D.StepAt v a b) (hc : D.StepAt v a c) : b = c
proof:
:=
  Sum.inl_injective (h v a (Sum.inl b) (Sum.inl c) hb hc)

name: DescriptiveComplexity.Decider.Functional.not_exit_of_step
statement:
theorem Functional.not_exit_of_step (h : D.Functional A) {v : β → A} {a b : D.Node A}
    (hb : D.StepAt v a b) {o : Bool} (ho : D.ExitAt v a o) : False
proof:
:=
  Sum.inl_ne_inr (h v a (Sum.inl b) (Sum.inr o) hb ho)

name: DescriptiveComplexity.Decider.Functional.exit_unique
statement:
theorem Functional.exit_unique (h : D.Functional A) {v : β → A} {a : D.Node A} {o o' : Bool}
    (ho : D.ExitAt v a o) (ho' : D.ExitAt v a o') : o = o'
proof:
:=
  Sum.inr_injective (h v a (Sum.inr o) (Sum.inr o') ho ho')

/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.Decider.functional_of
statement:
theorem functional_of (hstep : ∀ (v : β → A) (a b c : D.Node A),
      D.StepAt v a b → D.StepAt v a c → b = c)
    (hexit : ∀ (v : β → A) (a b : D.Node A) (o : Bool), D.StepAt v a b → ¬D.ExitAt v a o)
    (hboth : ∀ (v : β → A) (a : D.Node A), D.ExitAt v a true → ¬D.ExitAt v a false) :
    D.Functional A
proof:
:= by
  intro v a m m' hm hm'
  rcases m with b | o <;> rcases m' with c | o'
  · exact congrArg Sum.inl (hstep v a b c hm hm')
  · exact absurd hm' (hexit v a b o' hm)
  · exact absurd hm (hexit v a c o hm')
  · cases o <;> cases o'
    · rfl
    · exact absurd hm (hboth v a hm')
    · exact absurd hm' (hboth v a hm)
    · rfl

name: DescriptiveComplexity.Decider.stepAt_relabelPar
statement:
theorem stepAt_relabelPar (a b : D.Node A) :
    (D.relabelPar f).StepAt v a b ↔ D.StepAt (v ∘ f) a b
proof:
:= by
  change ((D.step a.1 b.1).relabel (Sum.map id f)).Realize (Sum.elim (Sum.elim a.2 b.2) v) ↔
    (D.step a.1 b.1).Realize (Sum.elim (Sum.elim a.2 b.2) (v ∘ f))
  rw [Formula.realize_relabel]
  refine iff_of_eq (congrArg (D.step a.1 b.1).Realize (funext fun i => ?_))
  rcases i with (i | i) | i <;> rfl

name: DescriptiveComplexity.Decider.exitAt_relabelPar
statement:
theorem exitAt_relabelPar (a : D.Node A) (o : Bool) :
    (D.relabelPar f).ExitAt v a o ↔ D.ExitAt (v ∘ f) a o
proof:
:= by
  change ((D.exit a.1 o).relabel (Sum.map id f)).Realize (Sum.elim a.2 v) ↔
    (D.exit a.1 o).Realize (Sum.elim a.2 (v ∘ f))
  rw [Formula.realize_relabel]
  refine iff_of_eq (congrArg (D.exit a.1 o).Realize (funext fun i => ?_))
  rcases i with i | i <;> rfl

name: DescriptiveComplexity.Decider.reachAt_relabelPar
statement:
theorem reachAt_relabelPar (a b : D.Node A) :
    (D.relabelPar f).ReachAt v a b ↔ D.ReachAt (v ∘ f) a b
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    induction h with
    | refl => exact Relation.ReflTransGen.refl
    | @tail c d _ hcd ih => exact ih.tail ((D.stepAt_relabelPar f v c d).mp hcd)
  · intro h
    induction h with
    | refl => exact Relation.ReflTransGen.refl
    | @tail c d _ hcd ih => exact ih.tail ((D.stepAt_relabelPar f v c d).mpr hcd)

name: DescriptiveComplexity.Decider.out_relabelPar
statement:
theorem out_relabelPar (t : D.Coord → A) (o : Bool) :
    (D.relabelPar f).Out v t o ↔ D.Out (v ∘ f) t o
proof:
:=
  exists_congr fun a => and_congr (D.reachAt_relabelPar f v _ a) (D.exitAt_relabelPar f v a o)

name: DescriptiveComplexity.Decider.decides_relabelPar
statement: theorem decides_relabelPar {P : Prop} (h : D.Decides (v ∘ f) P) : (D.relabelPar f).Decides v P
proof:
:=
  fun t => ⟨(D.out_relabelPar f v t true).trans (h t).1,
    (D.out_relabelPar f v t false).trans (h t).2⟩

name: DescriptiveComplexity.Decider.functional_relabelPar
statement: theorem functional_relabelPar (h : D.Functional A) : (D.relabelPar f).Functional A
proof:
:= by
  intro v a m m' hm hm'
  refine h (v ∘ f) a m m' ?_ ?_
  · rcases m with b | o
    · exact (D.stepAt_relabelPar f v a b).mp hm
    · exact (D.exitAt_relabelPar f v a o).mp hm
  · rcases m' with b | o
    · exact (D.stepAt_relabelPar f v a b).mp hm'
    · exact (D.exitAt_relabelPar f v a o).mp hm'

name: DescriptiveComplexity.Decider.exitAt_atom
statement:
theorem exitAt_atom (a : (atom ψ).Node A) (o : Bool) :
    (atom ψ).ExitAt v a o ↔ (if o then ψ.Realize v else ¬ψ.Realize v)
proof:
:= by
  cases o
  · change Formula.Realize (∼(ψ.relabel Sum.inr)) (Sum.elim a.2 v) ↔ ¬ψ.Realize v
    rw [Formula.realize_not, Formula.realize_relabel]
    exact not_congr (iff_of_eq (congrArg ψ.Realize (funext fun i => rfl)))
  · change (ψ.relabel Sum.inr).Realize (Sum.elim a.2 v) ↔ ψ.Realize v
    rw [Formula.realize_relabel]
    exact iff_of_eq (congrArg ψ.Realize (funext fun i => rfl))

name: DescriptiveComplexity.Decider.not_stepAt_atom
statement: theorem not_stepAt_atom (a b : (atom ψ).Node A) : ¬(atom ψ).StepAt v a b
proof:
:=
  fun h => h

name: DescriptiveComplexity.Decider.reachAt_atom
statement: theorem reachAt_atom {a b : (atom ψ).Node A} (h : (atom ψ).ReachAt v a b) : b = a
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | refl => rfl
  | tail _ hcd _ => exact absurd hcd (not_stepAt_atom ψ v _ _)

name: DescriptiveComplexity.Decider.decides_atom
statement: theorem decides_atom : (atom ψ).Decides v (ψ.Realize v)
proof:
:= by
  intro t
  have hout : ∀ o, (atom ψ).Out v t o ↔ (if o then ψ.Realize v else ¬ψ.Realize v) := by
    intro o
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨a, ha, he⟩
      rw [reachAt_atom ψ v ha] at he
      exact (exitAt_atom ψ v _ o).mp he
    · intro h
      exact ⟨_, Relation.ReflTransGen.refl, (exitAt_atom ψ v _ o).mpr h⟩
  exact ⟨hout true, hout false⟩

name: DescriptiveComplexity.Decider.functional_atom
statement: theorem functional_atom : (atom ψ).Functional A
proof:
:= by
  refine functional_of (fun v a b c hb _ => absurd hb (not_stepAt_atom ψ v a b))
    (fun v a b o hb _ => absurd hb (not_stepAt_atom ψ v a b)) fun v a h h' => ?_
  rw [exitAt_atom] at h h'
  exact h' h

name: DescriptiveComplexity.Decider.stepAt_neg
statement: theorem stepAt_neg (a b : D.Node A) : D.neg.StepAt v a b ↔ D.StepAt v a b
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: DescriptiveComplexity.Decider.exitAt_neg
statement: theorem exitAt_neg (a : D.Node A) (o : Bool) : D.neg.ExitAt v a o ↔ D.ExitAt v a (!o)
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: DescriptiveComplexity.Decider.reachAt_neg
statement: theorem reachAt_neg (a b : D.Node A) : D.neg.ReachAt v a b ↔ D.ReachAt v a b
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: DescriptiveComplexity.Decider.out_neg
statement: theorem out_neg (t : D.Coord → A) (o : Bool) : D.neg.Out v t o ↔ D.Out v t (!o)
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: DescriptiveComplexity.Decider.decides_neg
statement: theorem decides_neg {P : Prop} (h : D.Decides v P) : D.neg.Decides v (¬P)
proof:
:= by
  intro t
  refine ⟨(D.out_neg v t true).trans (h t).2, (D.out_neg v t false).trans ?_⟩
  rw [not_not]
  exact (h t).1

name: DescriptiveComplexity.Decider.functional_neg
statement: theorem functional_neg (h : D.Functional A) : D.neg.Functional A
proof:
:= by
  refine functional_of (fun v a b c hb hc => h.step_unique hb hc)
    (fun v a b o hb ho => h.not_exit_of_step ((D.stepAt_neg v a b).mp hb)
      ((D.exitAt_neg v a o).mp ho)) fun v a h₁ h₂ => ?_
  exact Bool.false_ne_true (h.exit_unique ((D.exitAt_neg v a true).mp h₁)
    ((D.exitAt_neg v a false).mp h₂))

name: DescriptiveComplexity.Decider.stepAt_seq_inl_inl
statement:
theorem stepAt_seq_inl_inl (m m' : D₁.Mode) (t t' : D₁.Coord ⊕ D₂.Coord → A) :
    (seq D₁ D₂).StepAt v (Sum.inl m, t) (Sum.inl m', t') ↔
      D₁.StepAt v (m, t ∘ Sum.inl) (m', t' ∘ Sum.inl) ∧ t' ∘ Sum.inr = t ∘ Sum.inr
proof:
:= by
  change ((D₁.step m m').relabel seqVarL ⊓ _).Realize _ ↔ _
  rw [Formula.realize_inf, Formula.realize_relabel, realize_copyF]
  refine and_congr (iff_of_eq (congrArg (D₁.step m m').Realize (funext fun i => ?_))) Iff.rfl
  rcases i with (i | i) | i <;> rfl

name: DescriptiveComplexity.Decider.stepAt_seq_inl_inr
statement:
theorem stepAt_seq_inl_inr (m : D₁.Mode) (m' : D₂.Mode) (t t' : D₁.Coord ⊕ D₂.Coord → A) :
    (seq D₁ D₂).StepAt v (Sum.inl m, t) (Sum.inr m', t') ↔
      m' = D₂.start ∧ D₁.ExitAt v (m, t ∘ Sum.inl) true ∧ t' = t
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hstep : (seq D₁ D₂).step (Sum.inl m) (Sum.inr m') = if m' = D₂.start then
      (D₁.exit m true).relabel seqExitStep ⊓
        copyF (fun c : D₁.Coord ⊕ D₂.Coord => curVar c) (fun c => nextVar c)
      else ⊥ := rfl
  unfold StepAt
  rw [hstep]
  split_ifs with h
  · rw [Formula.realize_inf, Formula.realize_relabel, realize_copyF, and_iff_right h]
    refine and_congr (iff_of_eq (congrArg (Formula.Realize (M := A) (D₁.exit m true))
      (funext fun i => ?_))) ?_
    · rcases i with i | i <;> rfl
    · exact ⟨fun h => funext fun c => congrFun h c, fun h => funext fun c => congrFun h c⟩
  · simp only [Formula.realize_bot, false_iff, not_and]
    exact fun h' => absurd h' h

name: DescriptiveComplexity.Decider.not_stepAt_seq_inr_inl
statement:
theorem not_stepAt_seq_inr_inl (m : D₂.Mode) (m' : D₁.Mode) (t t' : D₁.Coord ⊕ D₂.Coord → A) :
    ¬(seq D₁ D₂).StepAt v (Sum.inr m, t) (Sum.inl m', t')
proof:
:=
  fun h => h

name: DescriptiveComplexity.Decider.stepAt_seq_inr_inr
statement:
theorem stepAt_seq_inr_inr (m m' : D₂.Mode) (t t' : D₁.Coord ⊕ D₂.Coord → A) :
    (seq D₁ D₂).StepAt v (Sum.inr m, t) (Sum.inr m', t') ↔
      D₂.StepAt v (m, t ∘ Sum.inr) (m', t' ∘ Sum.inr) ∧ t' ∘ Sum.inl = t ∘ Sum.inl
proof:
:= by
  change ((D₂.step m m').relabel seqVarR ⊓ _).Realize _ ↔ _
  rw [Formula.realize_inf, Formula.realize_relabel, realize_copyF]
  refine and_congr (iff_of_eq (congrArg (D₂.step m m').Realize (funext fun i => ?_))) Iff.rfl
  rcases i with (i | i) | i <;> rfl

name: DescriptiveComplexity.Decider.exitAt_seq_inl
statement:
theorem exitAt_seq_inl (m : D₁.Mode) (t : D₁.Coord ⊕ D₂.Coord → A) (o : Bool) :
    (seq D₁ D₂).ExitAt v (Sum.inl m, t) o ↔ o = false ∧ D₁.ExitAt v (m, t ∘ Sum.inl) false
proof:
:= by
  cases o
  · change ((D₁.exit m false).relabel seqExitL).Realize _ ↔ _
    rw [Formula.realize_relabel]
    refine (iff_of_eq (congrArg (D₁.exit m false).Realize (funext fun i => ?_))).trans
      (and_iff_right rfl).symm
    rcases i with i | i <;> rfl
  · change (⊥ : (L.sum Language.order).Formula _).Realize _ ↔ _
    simp

name: DescriptiveComplexity.Decider.exitAt_seq_inr
statement:
theorem exitAt_seq_inr (m : D₂.Mode) (t : D₁.Coord ⊕ D₂.Coord → A) (o : Bool) :
    (seq D₁ D₂).ExitAt v (Sum.inr m, t) o ↔ D₂.ExitAt v (m, t ∘ Sum.inr) o
proof:
:= by
  change ((D₂.exit m o).relabel seqExitR).Realize _ ↔ _
  rw [Formula.realize_relabel]
  refine iff_of_eq (congrArg (D₂.exit m o).Realize (funext fun i => ?_))
  rcases i with i | i <;> rfl

/
component's coordinates fixed. -/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.Decider.reachAt_seq_of_reachAt₁
statement:
theorem reachAt_seq_of_reachAt₁ {a b : D₁.Node A} (h : D₁.ReachAt v a b) (y : D₂.Coord → A) :
    (seq D₁ D₂).ReachAt v (Sum.inl a.1, Sum.elim a.2 y) (Sum.inl b.1, Sum.elim b.2 y)
proof:
:= by
  refine Relation.ReflTransGen.lift (fun c : D₁.Node A => (Sum.inl c.1, Sum.elim c.2 y))
    (fun c d hcd => ?_) _ _ h
  exact (stepAt_seq_inl_inl D₁ D₂ v c.1 d.1 _ _).mpr (by simpa using hcd)

/
component's coordinates fixed. -/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.Decider.reachAt_seq_of_reachAt₂
statement:
theorem reachAt_seq_of_reachAt₂ {a b : D₂.Node A} (h : D₂.ReachAt v a b) (x : D₁.Coord → A) :
    (seq D₁ D₂).ReachAt v (Sum.inr a.1, Sum.elim x a.2) (Sum.inr b.1, Sum.elim x b.2)
proof:
:= by
  refine Relation.ReflTransGen.lift (fun c : D₂.Node A => (Sum.inr c.1, Sum.elim x c.2))
    (fun c d hcd => ?_) _ _ h
  exact (stepAt_seq_inr_inr D₁ D₂ v c.1 d.1 _ _).mpr (by simpa using hcd)

/
first component reached by it, the second's coordinates untouched, or a node of
the second component reached after the first exited `yes`. -/

name: DescriptiveComplexity.Decider.seqInv_of_reachAt
statement:
theorem seqInv_of_reachAt (t : D₁.Coord ⊕ D₂.Coord → A) {c : (seq D₁ D₂).Node A}
    (h : (seq D₁ D₂).ReachAt v (Sum.inl D₁.start, t) c) : SeqInv D₁ D₂ v t c
proof:
:= by
  refine reach_invariant (P := SeqInv D₁ D₂ v t) (fun a b ha hab => ?_) h
    (Or.inl ⟨D₁.start, t, rfl, Relation.ReflTransGen.refl, rfl⟩)
  obtain ⟨mb, tb⟩ := b
  rcases ha with ⟨m, t', rfl, hr, ht⟩ | ⟨m, t', rfl, ho, hr⟩
  · rcases mb with mb | mb
    · obtain ⟨hs, hc⟩ := (stepAt_seq_inl_inl D₁ D₂ v m mb t' tb).mp hab
      exact Or.inl ⟨mb, tb, rfl, hr.tail hs, hc.trans ht⟩
    · obtain ⟨rfl, he, htb⟩ := (stepAt_seq_inl_inr D₁ D₂ v m mb t' tb).mp hab
      refine Or.inr ⟨D₂.start, tb, rfl, ⟨_, hr, he⟩, ?_⟩
      rw [htb, ht]
  · rcases mb with mb | mb
    · exact absurd hab (not_stepAt_seq_inr_inl D₁ D₂ v m mb t' tb)
    · obtain ⟨hs, -⟩ := (stepAt_seq_inr_inr D₁ D₂ v m mb t' tb).mp hab
      exact Or.inr ⟨mb, tb, rfl, ho, hr.tail hs⟩

name: DescriptiveComplexity.Decider.out_seq
statement:
theorem out_seq (t : D₁.Coord ⊕ D₂.Coord → A) (o : Bool) :
    (seq D₁ D₂).Out v t o ↔
      (o = false ∧ D₁.Out v (t ∘ Sum.inl) false) ∨
        (D₁.Out v (t ∘ Sum.inl) true ∧ D₂.Out v (t ∘ Sum.inr) o)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨c, hc, he⟩
    rcases seqInv_of_reachAt D₁ D₂ v t hc with ⟨m, t', rfl, hr, -⟩ | ⟨m, t', rfl, ho, hr⟩
    · obtain ⟨rfl, he'⟩ := (exitAt_seq_inl D₁ D₂ v m t' o).mp he
      exact Or.inl ⟨rfl, _, hr, he'⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨ho, _, hr, (exitAt_seq_inr D₁ D₂ v m t' o).mp he⟩
  · rintro (⟨rfl, a, ha, he⟩ | ⟨⟨a, ha, he⟩, b, hb, he'⟩)
    · refine ⟨(Sum.inl a.1, Sum.elim a.2 (t ∘ Sum.inr)), ?_, ?_⟩
      · have := reachAt_seq_of_reachAt₁ D₁ D₂ v ha (t ∘ Sum.inr)
        rwa [Sum.elim_comp_inl_inr] at this
      · exact (exitAt_seq_inl D₁ D₂ v a.1 _ false).mpr ⟨rfl, by simpa using he⟩
    · refine ⟨(Sum.inr b.1, Sum.elim a.2 b.2), ?_, (exitAt_seq_inr D₁ D₂ v b.1 _ o).mpr
        (by simpa using he')⟩
      have h1 := reachAt_seq_of_reachAt₁ D₁ D₂ v ha (t ∘ Sum.inr)
      rw [Sum.elim_comp_inl_inr] at h1
      have h2 : (seq D₁ D₂).StepAt v (Sum.inl a.1, Sum.elim a.2 (t ∘ Sum.inr))
          (Sum.inr D₂.start, Sum.elim a.2 (t ∘ Sum.inr)) :=
        (stepAt_seq_inl_inr D₁ D₂ v a.1 D₂.start _ _).mpr ⟨rfl, by simpa using he, rfl⟩
      exact (h1.tail h2).trans (reachAt_seq_of_reachAt₂ D₁ D₂ v hb a.2)

name: DescriptiveComplexity.Decider.decides_seq
statement:
theorem decides_seq {P Q : Prop} (h₁ : D₁.Decides v P) (h₂ : D₂.Decides v Q) :
    (seq D₁ D₂).Decides v (P ∧ Q)
proof:
:= by
  intro t
  rw [out_seq, out_seq, (h₁ _).1, (h₁ _).2, (h₂ _).1, (h₂ _).2]
  constructor
  · simp
  · constructor
    · rintro (⟨-, h⟩ | ⟨hp, hq⟩)
      · exact fun h' => h h'.1
      · exact fun h' => hq h'.2
    · intro h
      by_cases hp : P
      · exact Or.inr ⟨hp, fun hq => h ⟨hp, hq⟩⟩
      · exact Or.inl ⟨rfl, hp⟩

name: DescriptiveComplexity.Decider.functional_seq
statement:
theorem functional_seq (h₁ : D₁.Functional A) (h₂ : D₂.Functional A) :
    (seq D₁ D₂).Functional A
proof:
:= by
  refine functional_of ?_ ?_ ?_
  · rintro v ⟨m, t⟩ ⟨mb, tb⟩ ⟨mc, tc⟩ hb hc
    rcases m with m | m <;> rcases mb with mb | mb <;> rcases mc with mc | mc
    · obtain ⟨hb, hb'⟩ := (stepAt_seq_inl_inl D₁ D₂ v m mb t tb).mp hb
      obtain ⟨hc, hc'⟩ := (stepAt_seq_inl_inl D₁ D₂ v m mc t tc).mp hc
      have := h₁.step_unique hb hc
      refine Prod.ext (congrArg Sum.inl (congrArg Prod.fst this)) (funext fun i => ?_)
      rcases i with i | i
      · exact congrFun (congrArg Prod.snd this) i
      · exact (congrFun hb' i).trans (congrFun hc' i).symm
    · obtain ⟨hb, -⟩ := (stepAt_seq_inl_inl D₁ D₂ v m mb t tb).mp hb
      obtain ⟨-, hc, -⟩ := (stepAt_seq_inl_inr D₁ D₂ v m mc t tc).mp hc
      exact absurd hc (h₁.not_exit_of_step hb)
    · obtain ⟨-, hb, -⟩ := (stepAt_seq_inl_inr D₁ D₂ v m mb t tb).mp hb
      obtain ⟨hc, -⟩ := (stepAt_seq_inl_inl D₁ D₂ v m mc t tc).mp hc
      exact absurd hb (h₁.not_exit_of_step hc)
    · obtain ⟨hmb, -, htb⟩ := (stepAt_seq_inl_inr D₁ D₂ v m mb t tb).mp hb
      obtain ⟨hmc, -, htc⟩ := (stepAt_seq_inl_inr D₁ D₂ v m mc t tc).mp hc
      rw [hmb, hmc, htb, htc]
    · exact absurd hb (not_stepAt_seq_inr_inl D₁ D₂ v m mb t tb)
    · exact absurd hb (not_stepAt_seq_inr_inl D₁ D₂ v m mb t tb)
    · exact absurd hc (not_stepAt_seq_inr_inl D₁ D₂ v m mc t tc)
    · obtain ⟨hb, hb'⟩ := (stepAt_seq_inr_inr D₁ D₂ v m mb t tb).mp hb
      obtain ⟨hc, hc'⟩ := (stepAt_seq_inr_inr D₁ D₂ v m mc t tc).mp hc
      have := h₂.step_unique hb hc
      refine Prod.ext (congrArg Sum.inr (congrArg Prod.fst this)) (funext fun i => ?_)
      rcases i with i | i
      · exact (congrFun hb' i).trans (congrFun hc' i).symm
      · exact congrFun (congrArg Prod.snd this) i
  · rintro v ⟨m, t⟩ ⟨mb, tb⟩ o hb he
    rcases m with m | m <;> rcases mb with mb | mb
    · obtain ⟨hb, -⟩ := (stepAt_seq_inl_inl D₁ D₂ v m mb t tb).mp hb
      obtain ⟨-, he⟩ := (exitAt_seq_inl D₁ D₂ v m t o).mp he
      exact h₁.not_exit_of_step hb he
    · obtain ⟨-, hb, -⟩ := (stepAt_seq_inl_inr D₁ D₂ v m mb t tb).mp hb
      obtain ⟨-, he⟩ := (exitAt_seq_inl D₁ D₂ v m t o).mp he
      exact Bool.noConfusion (h₁.exit_unique hb he)
    · exact not_stepAt_seq_inr_inl D₁ D₂ v m mb t tb hb
